translation.en: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt , that they might give him horses and much people . Shall he prosper ? shall he escape that doeth such things ? or shall he break the covenant , and be delivered ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem ka Judah u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah bad u la phah briew sha Ijipt ban ïoh ki kulai bad ka kynhun shipai bakhraw . Hato un jop ? Hato u lah ban leh ei ei da kata ? Um lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jingïateh lok bad leit khlem shah pynshitom !

translation.en: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth–el , and taught them how they should fear the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u lyngdoh ki Israel ïa uba la phah pat na Samaria u la leit bad shong ha Bethel , ha kaba u hikai ïa ki briew kumno ban mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And they went every one straight forward : whither the spirit was to go , they went  ; and they turned not when they went .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u jingthaw u phai sha baroh saw tylli ki dong , bad kumta ka kynhun ka ïaid kat shaba ka kwah , khlem da hap phai .

translation.en: And there I will meet with the children of Israel , and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory .
translation.kha: Hangta keiñ ngan ïakynduh bad ki Israel , bad ka jingshai baphyrnai jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga kan pynlong ïa kata ka jaka kaba khuid .

translation.en: And thou shalt be brought down , and shalt speak out of the ground , and thy speech shall be low out of the dust , and thy voice shall be , as of one that hath a familiar spirit , out of the ground , and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust .
translation.kha: Ka Jerusalem kan long kum u ksuid uba ksaid ban kren napoh khyndew , ka sur ba la set kaba mih na ka khyndew .

translation.en: Paul , a servant of God , and an apostle of Jesus Christ , according to the faith of God s elect , and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness ;
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u shakri jong U Blei bad u apostol jong U Jisu Khrist . Ïa nga la jied bad la phah ban ïarap ïa ka jingngeit jong ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei bad ban ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingshisha ba la hikai kat kum ka jingngeit jong ngi ,

translation.en: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him : for the  Lord  thy God hardened his spirit , and made his heart obstinate , that he might deliver him into thy hand , as appeareth this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Sihon um shah ïa ngi ban ïaid lynti na ka ri jong u . Naba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyneh ïa ka mynsiem jong u bad u la pynlong mutlop ïa u , khnang ba ngin ïoh jop bad shim ïa ri jong u ïa kaba ngi dang bat haduh mynta .

translation.en: Them take , and purify thyself with them , and be at charges with them , that they may shave their heads : and all may know that those things , whereof they were informed concerning thee , are nothing  ; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly , and keepest the law .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad ki bad ïasoh bad ki ha ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid bad siew ïa ki jinglut jingsep jong ki ; nangta kin lah ban khi ïa la ki khlieh . Ha kane ka rukom uwei pa uwei un tip ba kam don ka jingshisha ha kano kano na kita kiei kiei kiba la ïathuh ha ki shaphang jong me , hynrei ba ma me hi me im kat kum ka Hukum u Moses .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto the people , Ye cannot serve the  Lord  : for he is an holy God  ; he is a jealous God  ; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha u paidbah ,  Hynrei phin ym lah ban shakri ïa U  Trai . U long U Blei uba khuid bad un ym map ïa ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: He yearns to bring back those who are in his memory and to see them live on earth again .
translation.kha: U kwah ban wanrah biang ïa kito kiba u buh jingkynmaw bad ban ïohi ba ki im biang ha pyrthei .

translation.en: And the apostles said unto the Lord , Increase our faith .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la ong ha U Trai ,  To kham pynkhraw ïa ka jingngeit jong ngi .

translation.en: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years , and begat a son :
translation.kha: Haba u Lamekh u la dap shispah phraphew ar snem ka rta , u ïoh khun shynrang ,

translation.en: Seest thou a man diligent in his business ? he shall stand before kings  ; he shall not stand before mean men .
translation.kha: Pyni ha nga ïa u briew uba leh ïa ka kam babha , bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba kham bha ban ïa ka kynhun babun bad babit tam jong ki syiem .

translation.en: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites , in all their burdens , and in all their service : and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens .
translation.kha: Kine ki kur u Kohath kin shong dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shathie jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance , and hath greatly offended , and revenged himself upon them  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Ki paid ka Edom ki la pynhiarkput jubor halor ka Judah , bad kata ka jingpynhiarkput ka la wanrah ka jingpynrem baneh ha ka Edom .

translation.en: And he said unto Abram , Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs , and shall serve them  ; and they shall afflict them four hundred years  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin long ki nongwei ha ka ri nongwei ; kin long ki mraw hangta , bad kin shah pynshitom beiñ haduh sawspah snem .

translation.en: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief : but a faithful ambassador is health .
translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien ki bym lah ban shaniah ki thaw jingkulmar , hynrei kito kiba lah ban shaniah ki wallam ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: For ye shall not go out with haste , nor go by flight : for the  Lord  will go before you  ; and the God of Israel will be your rearward .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sien phin ym hap mihnoh ha ka jingkyrkieh ; phin ym pyrshang ban phet noh . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa phi bad un ïada ïa phi na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: Who only hath immortality , dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto ; whom no man hath seen , nor can see : to whom be honour and power everlasting . Amen .
translation.kha: Dei tang ma u marwei u bymïap shuh ; u shong ha ka jingshai ha kaba ym don uba lah ban leit sha jan jong u . Ym don uno uno uba la ju ïohi ïa u ; ym don uno uno uba lah ban ïohi ïa u . Ha u , to long ka burom bad ka borbah bymjukut ! Amen .

translation.en: And Pharaoh–neco made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father , and turned his name to Jehoiakim , and took Jehoahaz away : and he came to Egypt , and died there .
translation.kha: U syiem Neko u pynlong ïa u Eliakim , u khun jong u Josaïah , kum u syiem Judah ha ka jaka u Josaïah u kpa jong u , bad u pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Jehoïakim . Ïa u Joahas la rah sha Ijipt da u syiem Neko , bad u la ïap hangta .

translation.en: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel : he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy , and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire , which devoureth round about .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Judah ki long ki mraw ki bym lah leh ei ei , kiba la shah pynmih da ka bor na la ka ïing . Ki la shong la sah ha kiwei pat ki ri , khlem kano kano ka jaka ban khot ka jong ki hi — La kerkut da ki nongshun , khlem kano kano ka lad ban lait im .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he drew back his hand , that , behold , his brother came out : and she said , How hast thou broken forth ? this breach be upon thee : therefore his name was called Pharez .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u pynran noh pat ïa la ka kti , bad kumta la kha shuwa ïa u para jong u . Kata ka nongpynkha khun ka ong ,  Da kumne mo me wan mih !  Kumta la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Peres .

translation.en: And she said , Who would have said unto Abraham , that Sarah should have given children suck ? for I have born him a son in his old age .
translation.kha: Nangta ka bynrap ,  Uei u ban leit ong ha u Abraham ba ka Sarah kan ïoh sumar khun ? Pynban nga la kha khun shynrang ïa u haba u la tymmen .

translation.en: He may prepare it , but the just shall put it on , and the innocent shall divide the silver .
translation.kha: hynrei kin don ki briew kiba bha ki ban phong ïa kita ki jingriam , bad kin don ki briew kiba hok ki ban ïoh ïa kata ka rupa .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day , to love the  Lord  your God , and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul ,
translation.kha: Kumta , to kohnguh ïa ki hukum ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ; ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes , and prudent in their own sight !
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi pyrkhat phi long uba stad , kumta kiba shalak shibun .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said , Who is the  Lord  , that I should obey his voice to let Israel go ? I know not the  Lord  , neither will I let Israel go .
translation.kha: Uei uta U  Trai  ?  u Pharaoh u kylli .  Balei ba nga dei ban shahshkor ïa u , bad shah ïa ki Israel ban leit ? Ngam ithuh ïa U  Trai  , bad ngam shah ïa ki Israel ban leit .

translation.en: But Deborah Rebekah s nurse died , and she was buried beneath Beth–el under an oak : and the name of it was called Allon–bachuth .
translation.kha: Ka Deborah , ka nongsumar ïa ka Rebekka , ka la ïap noh bad la tep ïa ka ha trai u dieng Sning shaphang shathie jong ka Bethel . Kumta la khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  U Dieng Sning jong ka jingïam .

translation.en: And David said , Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul , that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan s sake ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Dabid u kylli ,  Don mano mano ba dang sah na ka longïing jong u Saul ? Lada don , nga kwah ban pyn-i ka jingbhasbun ïa u na ka bynta u Jonathan .

translation.en: For the  Lord  taketh pleasure in his people : he will beautify the meek with salvation .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don ka jingsngewbha ha ki briew jong u ; u pyndonburom ïa kiba sngewrit da ka jingjop .

translation.en: And this is thine  ; the heave offering of their gift , with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel : I have given them unto thee , and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee , by a statute for ever : every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it .
translation.kha: Nalor kine , kiwei pat ki jingai kiba kyrpang ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga ki dei ki jong me . Nga ai ïa ki ha me , ha ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong me , ha ki por ki ban wan baroh . Uwei pa uwei na ka longïing jong me uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam u lah ban bam ïa ki .

translation.en: And Abimelech charged all his people , saying , He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u la maham ïa ki briew baroh ;  Uno uno uba lehbeiñ ïa une u briew lane ïa ka tnga jong u , un shah pynïap .

translation.en: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you , to cleanse you , that ye may be clean from all your sins before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , dei ban pyndep ïa ki rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ki na ki pop jong ki baroh , ba kumta yn ñiew ïa ki ba ki long kiba khuid .

translation.en: Sihon king of the Amorites , and Og king of Bashan , and all the kingdoms of Canaan :
translation.kha: ïa u Sihon , u syiem ki Amor , ïa u Og , u syiem ka Bashan , bad ïa baroh ki syiem ha Kanaan .

translation.en: For what saith the scripture ? Abraham believed God , and it was counted unto him for righteousness .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Abraham u la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .

translation.en: He has eaten .
translation.kha: U bam .

translation.en: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the  Lord s  house which was toward the north  ; and , behold , there sat women weeping for Tammuz .
translation.kha: Kumta u ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei ka Templ bad u la pyn-i ha nga ïa ki kynthei kiba ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka jingïap u blei Tammus .

translation.en: Whosoever shall make like unto that , to smell thereto , shall even be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba shna ïa kaba kum kane ka jingiwbih yn ym kheiñ shuh kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And they came to Balaam , and said to him , Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor , Let nothing , I pray thee , hinder thee from coming unto me :
translation.kha: Ki la leit sha u Balaam bad ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na u Balak :  Sngewbha wat shah ba kaei kaei kan khanglad ïa phi ban wan sha nga !

translation.en: The sons of Rachel Jacob s wife  ; Joseph , and Benjamin .
translation.kha: Ki khun ka Rakhel ka tnga jong u Jakob : U Joseph bad u Benjamin .

translation.en: And , behold , the whole family is risen against thine handmaid , and they said , Deliver him that smote his brother , that we may kill him , for the life of his brother whom he slew  ; and we will destroy the heir also : and so they shall quench my coal which is left , and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko kynrad , baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga ki la phai pyrshah ïa nga bad ki dawa ba ngan ai ha ki ïa u khun shynrang jong nga , khnang ba ki lah ban pynïap ïa u namar ba u la pynïap ïa uba shi para bad u . Lada ki leh ïa kane , ngan shah iehnoh khlem u khun . Kin pynjot ïa ka jingkyrmen bakhatduh jong nga bad kin iehnoh ïa u tnga jong nga khlem u khun jong u ban ri pynim ïa ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: And John answered him , saying , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name , and he followeth not us : and we forbad him , because he followeth not us .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la ong ïa u ,  Ko Nonghikai , ngi la ïohi ïa u briew uba beh ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong me , bad ngi la ong ïa u ban sangeh , namar um long satia ha ka kynhun jong ngi .

translation.en: And David reigned over all Israel  ; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la synshar halor ka ri Israel baroh , bad u da pynthikna ba ki briew jong u kin ïohmad ïa ka jinglehhok bad ka jingbymshah shiliang .

translation.en: But me , even me thy servant , and Zadok the priest , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and thy servant Solomon , hath he not called .
translation.kha: Hynrei , kynrad , um shym khot sngewbha ïa nga , lane ïa u Sadok u lyngdoh lane ïa u Benaïah lane ïa u Solomon .

translation.en: He said unto them , An enemy hath done this . The servants said unto him , Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up ?
translation.kha: ‘ La dei katto katne ngut ki nongshun kiba la leh ïa kane ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Phi kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad phut noh ïa ki ñiut ?’ ki la kylli ïa u .

translation.en: Thou shalt not steal .
translation.kha: Wat tuh .

translation.en: He saith unto them ,  Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives : but from the beginning it was not so .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  U Moses u la shah ïa phi ban pyllait ïa la ki tnga namar phi long kiba eh ban shah hikai . Hynrei kam shym long kumta ha ka por ba mynnyngkong .

translation.en: Now therefore up by night , thou and the people that is with thee , and lie in wait in the field :
translation.kha: Mynta te , ma phi lem bad ki rangbah jong phi phin ïaid da miet bad rieh ha ki lyngkha .

translation.en: Saying , Sir , we remember that that deceiver said , while he was yet alive ,  After three days I will rise again .
translation.kha: bad ki la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , ngi kynmaw ba katba uta u nongshukor u dang im u la ong , ‘ Yn sa pynmihpat ïa nga hadien lai sngi .’

translation.en: As a bird that wandereth from her nest , so is a man that wandereth from his place .
translation.kha: U briew sha jngai na la ïing u long kum ka sim kaba jngai na la ka skum .

translation.en: And the men of Kirjath–jearim came , and fetched up the ark of the  Lord  , and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill , and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nong Kiriath Jearim ki wan shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ki leit rah ïa ka sha ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Abinadab , uba shong ha uwei u lum . Ki la pynkyntang ïa u Eleasar u khun jong u ban sumar ïa ka .

translation.en: I in them , and thou in me , that they may be made perfect in one  ; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me , and hast loved them , as thou hast loved me .
translation.kha: Ma nga ha ki bad ma me ha nga , khnang ba ka pyrthei ka lah ban tip ba me la phah ïa nga bad ba me ieit ïa ki kumba me ieit ïa nga .

translation.en: And those which remain shall hear , and fear , and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you .
translation.kha: Te kiwei pat kin ïohsngew aïu ka la jia ; kin sngewsheptieng , bad kin ym nud shuh ban leh kum ïa kata ka kam bymman .

translation.en: And they brought young children to him , that he should touch them : and his disciples rebuked those that brought them .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khynnah ha U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jong u ha ki , hynrei ki synran ki la mai ïa kita ki briew .

translation.en: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father : there is one that accuseth you , even Moses , in whom ye trust .
translation.kha: Pynban , wat pyrkhat ba dei ma nga u ban mudui ïa phi ha U Kpa jong nga . U Moses , ha uba phi la buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen , dei ma u , u ban mudui ïa phi .

translation.en: And I will multiply upon you man and beast  ; and they shall increase and bring fruit : and I will settle you after your old estates , and will do better unto you than at your beginnings : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynroi ïa ki briew bad ïa ki jingri . Hangta phin nang kham roi ban ïa kaba long mynshuwa bad phin ïoh shibun ki khun ki kti . Ngan shah ïa phi ban shong hangta kumba phi la ju shong , bad ngan pynlong ïa phi ban kham man roi ban ïa kaba mynshuwa . Te phin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Otherwise it shall come to pass , when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers , that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders .
translation.kha: Lada phim leh kumta , tang mar ïa-ïap ma phi , u Solomon , u khun jong nga bad ma nga ngin shah ñiew kum ki nongshetkylla .

translation.en: And if any man hunger , let him eat at home ; that ye come not together unto condemnation . And the rest will I set in order when I come .
translation.kha: Bad lada uno uno u thngan , u dei ban bam ha ïing , khnang ba phin ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar jong U Blei haba phi dang ïaseng lang . Ïa kiwei pat ki bynta , ngan sa pynbeit ïa ki ynda nga wan .

translation.en: They went to the mosque .
translation.kha: Ki Leit sha ka mosque .

translation.en: But even unto this day , when Moses is read , the veil is upon their heart .
translation.kha: Wat mynta ruh , man ba pule ïa ka Hukum u Moses , kata ka jingkah ka dang tap hi ïa ki jingmut jong ki .

translation.en: Thus shall ye say unto them , The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth , even they shall perish from the earth , and from under these heavens .
translation.kha: ( Ma phi ki paidbah phi dei ban ïathuh ïa ki ba ki blei ki bym shym la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa ka sahit bneng yn sa pynjot . Kin ym don shuh hangno hangno ha ka pyrthei . )

translation.en: And he did very abominably in following idols , according to all things as did the Amorites , whom the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa ka pop kaba ijli eh da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , kumba ki Amor ki la leh , ïa kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki paid Israel ki nang ïaid sha khmat . )

translation.en: From Sihor , which is before Egypt , even unto the borders of Ekron northward , which is counted to the Canaanite : five lords of the Philistines  ; the Gazites , and the Ashdothites , the Eshkalonites , the Gittites , and the Ekronites  ; also the Avites :
translation.kha: kumjuh ruh ka ri jong ka Abbim ha ka phang bashathie ( ka jaka naduh ka wahduid Shihor ha ki khappud jong ka Ijipt haduh khappud Ekron ha ka phang bashatei , ïa kaba la ñiew ba ka dei ka jong ki Kanaan ; ki syiem Philistia ki la shong ha Gasa , Ashdod , Ashkelon , Gath , bad Ekron ) .

translation.en: And they said , This is blood : the kings are surely slain , and they have smitten one another : now therefore , Moab , to the spoil .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka snam !  ki la kyang jam .  Ki lai kynhun ki shipai nongshun ki la ïaleh bad pynïap iwei ïa iwei ! Ïa ngin leit bad lute ïa ki jaka shong dara jong ki !

translation.en: ( 2 Corinthians 1 :3 , 4 ) We gladly share the Bible’s promises with those in despair , offering the assurance that soon God’s Kingdom will bring an end to all the tragedies that cause pain and suffering . —Revelation 21 :4 .
translation.kha: ( 2 Korinth 1 :3 , 4 ) Da ka jingkmen ngi ïasam ïa ki jingkular jong ka Baibl bad kito kiba sngewsih , ngi pynthikna ïa ki ba shen ka Hima jong U Blei kan sa pynduh lut ïa ki jingjia ba sngewsih baroh kiba wanrah jingpang bad jingjynjar . —Jingpynpaw 21 :4 .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahas u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say , Why then did ye not believe him ?
translation.kha: Ki la sdang ïatainia para ma ki :  Kaei ngin ong ? Lada ngi jubab , ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un sa ong , ‘ Balei te , phim shym la ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’

translation.en: And Remeth , and En–gannim , and En–haddah , and Beth–pazez  ;
translation.kha: ka Remeth , ka Engannim , ka Enhaddah , bad ka Bethpasses .

translation.en: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan nga shem ïa lade ha ka jingjahburom ha khmat u paidbah .

translation.en: A man that is an heretic after the first and second admonition reject ;
translation.kha: La kumno kumno to ai ïa ka jingmaham ar sien ïa u briew uba pynmih ki jingïapait , bad hadien kata to kiar noh na u .

translation.en: And this is the case of the slayer , which shall flee thither , that he may live : Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly , whom he hated not in time past  ;
translation.kha: Lada u briew u kum pynïap ïa uno uno u bym dei u nongshun jong u , u lah ban phet sha kawei na kita ki shnong ban leit rieh .

translation.en: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt , and gather them out of Assyria  ; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon  ; and place shall not be found for them .
translation.kha: Na Ijipt bad na Assyria ngan wallam ïa ki sha ïing bad ngan pynshongduh ïa ki ha ka ri jong ki hi . Ngan pynshongduh ïa ki ha Gilead bad ha Lebanon kumjuh ; ka ri baroh kawei kan dap da ki briew .

translation.en: A fool hath no delight in understanding , but that his heart may discover itself .
translation.kha: Uba bieit um suidñiew la u sngewthuh ne em ïa kano kano ; baroh kaba u kwah ban leh ka long ban pynpaw katno u long uba sian .

translation.en: And I will give peace in the land , and ye shall lie down , and none shall make you afraid : and I will rid evil beasts out of the land , neither shall the sword go through your land .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ïa ka jingsuk ha ka ri jong phi , bad phin thiah phin dem khlem tieng ïano ïano . Ngan ym shah ban don ki mradkhlaw kiba runar ha kata ka ri , bad ka thma kan ym don shuh hangta .

translation.en: This thing is not good that thou hast done . As the  Lord  liveth , ye are worthy to die , because ye have not kept your master , the  Lord s  anointed . And now see where the king s spear is , and the cruse of water that was at his bolster .
translation.kha: Mem shym la leh ïa la ka kamram , Abner ! Nga smai da U  Trai  uba im , ba phi baroh phi dei hok ban ïap , namar phim shym la ïada ïa la u kynrad , uba U  Trai  u la pynlong syiem . Peit shane ! Ha-ei u sum jong u syiem ? Ha-ei u khiew um ba la buh hajan ka khlieh jong u ?

translation.en: I will lay thy cities waste , and thou shalt be desolate , and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan iehnoh ïa ki nongbah jong me ha ki jingjot , bad ïa ka ri jong me kaba kynjah ; te men sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And he went from year to year in circuit to Beth–el , and Gilgal , and Mizpah , and judged Israel in all those places .
translation.kha: Man ka snem u ju leit sha Bethel , sha Gilgal , bad sha Mispah , bad ha kine ki jaka u pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia .

translation.en: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation , because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day , and said unto the people , There are six days in which men ought to work : in them therefore come and be healed , and not on the sabbath day .
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar jong ka synagog u la bitar ba U Jisu u la pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton , kumta u la kren bad u la ong ha u paidbah ,  Don hynriew sngi ha kaba ngi dei ban trei ; kumta to wan ha kito ki sngi bad ban ïoh jingpynkhiah , hynrei ym ha ka sngi Sabbaton !

translation.en: I just want him to go away .
translation.kha: Nga shu kwah ia u ba un phet .

translation.en: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold ! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver !
translation.kha: Ka kham bha — nang kham bha — ban don ka jingstad bad ka jingtip ban ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa .

translation.en: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel , which were holy unto the  Lord  , Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build  ; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders : serve now the  Lord  your God , and his people Israel ,
translation.kha: U ai ruh ïa kine ki jingbthah sha ki Lebi , ki nonghikai jong ki Israel , ïa kiba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  :  Buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bakyntang ha ka Templ kaba u syiem Solomon , u khun jong u Dabid , u la tei . Phim dei ban rah shuh ïa ka na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat , hynrei phi dei ban shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad ki briew jong u ki Israel .

translation.en: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters , but thou shalt not enjoy them  ; for they shall go into captivity .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh ki khun shynrang bad kynthei , hynrei phin duh ïa ki , naba yn rong noh ïa ki kum ki koidi thma .

translation.en: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth , and smote him : I hid me , and was wroth , and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart .
translation.kha: Nga la bitar ïa ki namar ka pop bad ka jingkwah lalot jong ki , bad kumta nga la pynshitom bad iehnoh ïa ki . Hynrei ki la long mutlop bad ki la nang ïaid ha la ki jong ki lynti .

translation.en: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished , they brought him to Jerusalem , to present him to the Lord  ;
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ïa u Joseph bad ka Mari ban pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid , kumba ka Hukum u Moses ka dawa . Kumta ki la leit rah ïa u khunlung sha Jerusalem ban aiti ïa u sha U Trai ,

translation.en: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth , and addeth learning to his lips .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang ki da pyrkhat ha shuwa ban kren ; ki lah ban pynkohnguh da kaei kaba ki ong .

translation.en: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram , Give me the persons , and take the goods to thyself .
translation.kha: U syiem jong ka Sodom u ong ha u Abram ,  Bat ïa kaba la ïoh lute , hynrei pynphai noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh .

translation.en: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices , and drank the wine of their drink offerings ? let them rise up and help you , and be your protection .
translation.kha: Phi la bsa ïa ki da ka khleiñ na ki jingkñia jong phi , bad phi la ai waiñ de ïa ki ban dih . Ai ba kin wan mynta bad ïarap ïa phi , ai ba kin wan kloi ban pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza : and Josiah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ïa u Amon la tep ha ka jingtep ha ka kper u Ussa , bad u Josaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And all this assembly shall know that the  Lord  saveth not with sword and spear : for the battle is the  Lord s  , and he will give you into our hands .
translation.kha: Te ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan tip ba ki Israel ki don U Blei , bad ba uwei pa uwei hangne un ïohi ba U  Trai  um donkam ïa ki waitlam ne ki sum ban pyllait im ïa la ki briew . U long u nongjop ha ka thma , naba ka thma ka long ka jong U  Trai  , bad un buh ïa phi baroh hapoh ka bor jong ngi .

translation.en: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth  ; and the earth was reaped .
translation.kha: Te uta uba shong halor u lyoh u la pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi ha ka pyrthei , bad la ïohlum ïa ka jingot jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people .
translation.kha: Ki khmat jong nga ki tuid da ki ummat kum ki wah ha ka jingshah pynjot jong ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out , and stood in the entering of the gate of the city : and Abimelech rose up , and the people that were with him , from lying in wait .
translation.kha: Haba u Abimelekh bad ki rangbah jong u ki ïohi ïa u Gaal ba u mih shabar bad ïeng ha khyrdop shnong , ki ïeng joit na la ki jakarieh .

translation.en: Go up to Lebanon , and cry  ; and lift up thy voice in Bashan , and cry from the passages : for all thy lovers are destroyed .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki briew ka Jerusalem , khie leit sha Lebanon bad pyrta jam , khie leit sha ka ri Bashan bad to kyang ; pyrta na ki lumbah ka Moab , namar baroh kiba ïateh lok bad phi ki la shahjop .

translation.en: There were also that said , We have borrowed money for the king s tribute , and that upon our lands and vineyards .
translation.kha: Sa kiwei ki ong ,  Ngi hap ban pan pisa kylliang ban siew ïa ka khajna syiem halor ki pynthor bad ki bri sohwaiñ .

translation.en: And Ahaz slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city , even in Jerusalem : but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel : and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahas u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha Jerusalem , hynrei ym ha ka jingtep ki syiem , u Hesekaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in all the way of David his father , and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  ; u bud ïa ka nuksa jong u syiem Dabid , u kpa tymmen jong u , da kaba bud pyrkhing ïa baroh ki aiñ U Blei .

translation.en: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war : and in multitude of counsellors there is safety .
translation.kha: Nalor baroh , phi dei ban thaw ki buit kiba biang shuwa ba phin ïaleh ïa ka thma , bad katba nang bun ki jingkyntu babha ba phi ïoh , katta phin nang long kiba jop .

translation.en: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents : I have not found it by secret search , but upon all these .
translation.kha: Ki jaiñ jong phi ki la khah da ka snam jong kiba duk bad kiba lui lui , ym da ka snam jong ki nonglute .

translation.en: And not that only , but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace , which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord , and declaration of your ready mind :
translation.kha: Bad nalor kata , ïa u la jied bad la thung da ki balang ban leit bad ngi katba ngi dang ïai pyndep ïa kane ka jingshakri jong ka jingieit na ka bynta ka burom U Trai , bad khnang ban pyn-i ba ngi kwah ban ïarap .

translation.en: And Laban said unto Jacob , Because thou art my brother , shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought ? tell me , what shall thy wages be ?
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ïa u Jakob ,  Tang namar ba me dei u kur u jait jong nga , mem dei ban shu trei ei na ka bynta jong nga . Katno ka bainong me kwah ?

translation.en: And thou shalt become an astonishment , a proverb , and a byword , among all nations whither the  Lord  shall lead thee .
translation.kha: Ki briew ha ki ri sha kiba U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa phi , kin kyndit ïa kata kaba la jia ha phi ; kin sa krenbeiñ bad rkhiebeiñ ïa phi .

translation.en: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai , saying , Deal gently for my sake with the young man , even with Absalom . And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom .
translation.kha: U la ai hukum ïa u Joab , u Abishai , bad u Ittai :  Na ka bynta jong nga wat pynmynsaw ïa u samla Absalom .  Bad ki kynhun shipai baroh ki ïohsngew ba u Dabid u ai ïa kane ka hukum ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u .

translation.en: I will greatly rejoice in the  Lord  , my soul shall be joyful in my God  ; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation , he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness , as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments , and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem to shadkmen namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh . Ka long kum ka nongleitkurim kaba riam na ka bynta ka jingkyntiew kurim jong ka . U Blei u la pynkup ïa ka da ka jingpynim bad ka jingjop .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting : and let all the people say , Amen . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Israel ; ïaroh ïa u mynta bad junom ! Ai ba baroh kin ong ,  Amen !  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: But ye are they that forsake the  Lord  , that forget my holy mountain , that prepare a table for that troop , and that furnish the drink offering unto that number .
translation.kha: Hynrei kan long pher ïa phi kiba la kyntait ïa nga , kiba lyndet ïa ka Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga , bad mane ïa u Gad bad u Meni , ki blei ka nusip bad ka kupar .

translation.en: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea , the waters of the great deep  ; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over ?
translation.kha: Dei ma me ruh uba la pynrngad ïa ka duriaw bad pynlong ka lynti ïaid lyngba ki um , khnang ba kito kiba me pyllait im kin ïoh ïaid lyngba .

translation.en: And Delilah said to Samson , Tell me , I pray thee , wherein thy great strength lieth , and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Delilah ka ong ha u Samson ,  Sngewbha ïathuh ïa nga kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban long uba khlaiñbor bha . Lada uno uno u kwah ban khum ïa phi bad pynlong u bym lah shuh ban leh ei ei , da kumno un leh ïa kata ?

translation.en: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father , and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba nga lah ban kyrpad jingïarap na U Kpa jong nga , bad shisyndon un da la phah palat khat-ar kynhun ki angel ?

translation.en: But let none come into the house of the  Lord  , save the priests , and they that minister of the Levites  ; they shall go in , for they are holy : but all the people shall keep the watch of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano u ban rung sha ki ïing ka Templ lait noh tang ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba wan ban pyndep kam . Ki lah ban rung , namar ki long kiba la pynkyntang , hynrei kiba sah jong ki paidbah ki dei ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong U  Trai  bad ban shong shabar .

translation.en: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited : and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Uta u  langsohmoh un kit lut noh ïa ki pop baroh sha ka ri kaba ym pat ju don ba sah briew .

translation.en: And he said , Behold now , I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord : Peradventure there shall be twenty found there . And he said , I will not destroy it for twenty s sake .
translation.kha: U Abraham u ong ,  To map ko Trai ïa ka jingshlur bieit jong nga ban kren ha me . Tharai don tang arphew ngut hangta ?  U jubab ,  Ngan ym pynjot ïa ka nongbah lada nga shem arphew ngut .

translation.en: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against , ye ought to be quiet , and to do nothing rashly .
translation.kha: Ym don ba lah ban len ïa kine kiei kiei . Kumta te , phi dei ban long jai jai bad ban ym leh ïa kaei kaei da ka jingthurmur .

translation.en: Let him eschew evil , and do good  ; let him seek peace , and ensue it .
translation.kha: U dei ban phai noh na kaba sniew bad ban leh ïa kaba bha ; u dei ban ïaleh shitom na ka bynta ka jingsuk da ka dohnud jong u baroh .

translation.en: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law , and did all that he had said .
translation.kha: U Moses u pdiang ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u Jethro

translation.en: And I will lay it waste : it shall not be pruned , nor digged  ; but there shall come up briers and thorns : I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it .
translation.kha: Ngan shah ïa ka ba kan dap da ki ñiut suda . Ngan ym khap ïa ki thning lane kara ïa ka khyndew , hynrei ngan shah ïa ki dieng shynraiñ bad ki shiah ba kin tap ïa ka . Ngan khang wat ïa ki lyoh ban pynhap slap ha ka .

translation.en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds , who prepareth rain for the earth , who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains .
translation.kha: U pynphriang ïa ki lyoh ha ka suiñbneng ; u pynbiang slap ïa ka khyndew bad u pynlong ba u phlang un mih ha ki lum .

translation.en: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the  Lord  , where the ark of God was , and Samuel was laid down to sleep  ;
translation.kha: u Samuel pat u thiah hapoh ka jaka kyntang ha kaba don ka Synduk ka Jutang . Shuwa ban kynjat shai katba ka sharak ka dang meh ,

translation.en: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , and saw an altar that was at Damascus : and king Ahaz sent to Uriah the priest the fashion of the altar , and the pattern of it , according to all the workmanship thereof .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Ahas u leit sha Damaskos ban ïakynduh ïa u Tiglath Pileser u Patsha , u ïohi ïa ka duwan hangta bad u phah pat sha u Uriah u lyngdoh ïa ka dur pyn-i jong ka , haduh ki jingbatai bniah kiba rit eh .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the king of Assyria , He shall not come into this city , nor shoot an arrow there , nor come before it with shield , nor cast a bank against it .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong shaphang u patsha ka Assyria : ‘ Un nym ïohrung shapoh ka nongbah lane ïoh siat ïa uwei ruh u khnam pyrshah ïa ka . Yn ym don shipai rah stieh ki ban lah ban wan sha jan ka nongbah , bad yn ym tei kynton kerkut sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: Honour thy father and thy mother : and , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
translation.kha: burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ; bad to ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa lade .

translation.en: For , lo , I will command , and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations , like as corn is sifted in a sieve , yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ka hukum , bad ngan kyrsih ïa ki paid Israel kum ïa u kew . Ngan kyrsih ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew ban weng ïa kita baroh ki bymdondor .

translation.en: Then tidings came to Joab : for Joab had turned after Adonijah , though he turned not after Absalom . And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and caught hold on the horns of the altar .
translation.kha: U Joab u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia . ( U la kyrshan ïa u Adonijah , hynrei ym ïa u Absalom . ) Kumta u la phet krad sha ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u bat ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan .

translation.en: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words , saying , Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon , and serve him and his people , and live .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa kajuh ha u syiem Sedekaïah jong ka Judah .  Pyndem ha u syiem jong ka Babilonia . Shakri ïa u bad ïa ki briew jong u , bad phin im .

translation.en: Now after that John was put in prison , Jesus came into Galilee , preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba la set ïa u Ïoannis ha ka byndi , U Jisu u la leit noh sha Galilaïa bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei .

translation.en: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples , how that he must go unto Jerusalem , and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be killed , and be raised again the third day .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la sdang ban kren shai ha la ki synran ,  Nga dei ban leit sha Jerusalem bad shahshitom shibun na ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Ïa nga yn pynïap , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa nga .

translation.en: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the  Lord  , and to do it , and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments .
translation.kha: U Esra u la aiti ïa la ka jingim ha kaba pule ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai  , ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ka , bad ha kaba hikai ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And then if any man shall say to you , Lo , here is Christ  ; or , lo , he is there  ; believe him not :
translation.kha: Te , lada uno uno u ong ha phi , ‘ Khmih , hangne u don U Messaïah !’ lane , ‘ Khmih , hangtai u don !’ — wat ngeit ïa u .

translation.en: And because he was of the same craft , he abode with them , and wrought : for by their occupation they were tentmakers .
translation.kha: U Paul u la leit ban jngoh ïa ki , namar ba u la kamai da kaba shna ïingjaiñ , kumba long ma ki .

translation.en: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery , and life unto the bitter in soul  ;
translation.kha: Balei ban shah ïa ki briew ban ïai im ha ki jingjynjar ? Balei ban ai jingshai ïa kito kiba don ha ka jingsngewsih ?

translation.en: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno na phi u lah ban im kham slem da kaba khuslai shaphang jong ka ?

translation.en: The righteous also shall hold on his way , and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dawa ba ki long kiba donburom ki la nang sngewdei shuh shuh ba kim shym la bakla .

translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  of hosts unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor jong U  Trai  kaba la wan ha nga .

translation.en: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel , and all his great men , and his kinsfolks , and his priests , until he left him none remaining .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehu u pynïap lut sa ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u Ahab kiba shong basah ha Jesreel , bad ïa baroh ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , ki paralok kiba jan eh bad u , bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong u ; ym don shuh uwei na ki ïa uba dang sah pynim .

translation.en: Nevertheless , if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it  ; if he do not turn from his way , he shall die in his iniquity  ; but thou hast delivered thy soul .
translation.kha: Lada me maham ïa u briew ba-bymman bad um sangeh na kaba leh pop , un ïap , kum u nongpop , hynrei ïa ka jingim jong me yn pynsah .

translation.en: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee , and cast out devils .
translation.kha: Kumta u la leit sha baroh ki jaka ha Galilaïa , da kaba ïalap ha ki synagog bad beh noh ïa ki ksuid .

translation.en: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord   ; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U khun pongka    bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u haduh kaba shiphew pateng bynriew ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .

translation.en: Be not over much wicked , neither be thou foolish : why shouldest thou die before thy time ?
translation.kha: Hynrei wat long kiba sniew palat ne kiba bieit palat , ym kawei ruh na ki — balei phin ïap haba phim pat dei ?

translation.en: Lo , these are parts of his ways : but how little a portion is heard of him ? but the thunder of his power who can understand ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kine ki dei tang ki dak barit ïa ka bor jong u , tang ki jingpasiaw ba ngi la ïohsngew . Uei uba lah ban tip haduh katno U Blei u long shisha uba khraw ?

translation.en: And in cutting of stones , to set them , and in carving of timber , to work in all manner of workmanship .
translation.kha: ban ot ïa ki mawlynnai bad ban pyndait ïa ki , ban oh-shrong ïa ki dieng , bad ban trei ïa kano kano ka jait jingtrei kaba da ki dur pynitynnat .

translation.en: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad , and she that bare thee shall rejoice .
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ban sarong na ka bynta jong phi ; ai ïa ka kmie jong phi ïa kata ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Then Sarah denied , saying , I laughed not  ; for she was afraid . And he said , Nay  ; but thou didst laugh .
translation.kha: Namar ba ka Sarah ka la sheptieng , ka la len ïa kata . Ka da ong ,  Ngam shym rkhie .  U phai ktien ,  Ho-oid , pha la leh kumta , pha la rkhie .

translation.en: Her young ones also suck up blood : and where the slain are , there is she .
translation.kha: Sawdong ki metïap ki pukni ki ïaboi , bad ki khun pukni ki dih ïa ka snam .

translation.en: The portion of Jacob is not like them : for he is the former of all things  ; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance : The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
translation.kha: U Blei jong u Jakob um long kum ma ki ; u long uta uba thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad u la jied ïa ki Israel ban long ki briew jong u hi . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and all his army , and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion , and all the people , fought against Jerusalem , and against all the cities thereof , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga mynba u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u , ba la kyrshan da ki shipai na baroh ki hima bad ki jaitbynriew kiba la hap hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u , ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki shnong ba-marjan .

translation.en: And when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto his disciples , Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ki Pharisi ki la ïohi ïa kane bad ki la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Balei u nonghikai jong phi u ïabam lem bad kiba kum kine ki briew ?

translation.en: So Joab arose and went to Geshur , and brought Absalom to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïeng joit bad u leit sha Geshur , bad u wan ïalam pat ïa u Absalom sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her : for he said , My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel , because the places are holy , whereunto the ark of the  Lord  hath come .
translation.kha: U Solomon u wan ïalam noh ïa la ka tnga , ka khun u syiem Ijipt , na ka Nongbah u Dabid sha ka ïing ba u la tei ïa ka . U ong ,  Kam dei ban shong ha ka ïingsyiem jong u Dabid , u syiem ka Israel , namar ha kano kano ka jaka ha kaba ka Synduk ka Jutang ka la don ka long kaba kyntang .

translation.en: And they took ashes of the furnace , and stood before Pharaoh  ; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven  ; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man , and upon beast .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la rah khyndiat u dpei bad ki la ïeng ha khmat u Pharaoh ; U Moses u la kynting ïa uta u dpei sha ka lyer , bad u dpei u la pynmih ïa ki tohjaw kiba kylla prum ha u briew bad ha u mrad .

translation.en: And all the people said unto Samuel , Pray for thy servants unto the  Lord  thy God , that we die not : for we have added unto all our sins this evil , to ask us a king .
translation.kha: bad ki ong ha u Samuel ,  A kynrad , to duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi na ka bynta jong ngi , ba ngin ym ïap . Mynta ngi sngewthuh ba nalor ki pop jong ngi baroh , ngi la leh pop da kaba pan ban ïoh syiem .

translation.en: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest , to offer upon mine altar , to burn incense , to wear an ephod before me ? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel ?
translation.kha: Napdeng ki jait Israel baroh nga la jied ïa ka longïing jong u ban long ki lyngdoh jong nga , ban shakri ha ka duwan , ban thang ïa ka jingiwbih , bad ban phong ïa ka ephod ban ïakren bad nga . Bad nga la ai ha ki ïa ka hok ban ïoh bynta ïa ki jingainguh thang ba-halor ka duwan .

translation.en: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence , and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood , that he may die .
translation.kha: ki rangbah shnong jong phi hi kin phah leit ring ïa u nangta , bad kin aiti ïa u ha u nongwad kput khnang ba un pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Strive not with a man without cause , if he have done thee no harm .
translation.kha: Wat ïakynroi badno badno khlem daw haba um ju leh kano kano ka ban pynmynsaw ïa phi .

translation.en: If now thou hast understanding , hear this : hearken to the voice of my words .
translation.kha: Mynta to shahshkor ïa nga , lada phi long kiba stad .

translation.en: And the land is defiled : therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it , and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants .
translation.kha: Ki kam jong ki , ki la pyntngit ïa kata ka ri , bad kumta U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ka ri bad un pynlong ruh ïa ka , ban kyntait noh ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta .

translation.en: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon  ; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia :
translation.kha: U ïalam ïa baroh kiba dang lait im sha Babilonia , ha kaba ki shakri ïa u bad ïa kiba hiarpateng na u , kum ki mraw haduh ka por ka jingkhie rasong ka Hima Persia .

translation.en: Yea , and certain women also of our company made us astonished , which were early at the sepulchre  ;
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki kynthei jong ka kynhun jong ngi , ki la pynkyndit ïa ngi ; ki la leit dang kynjat shai sha ka jingtep , hynrei kim shym la lah ban shem ïa ka met jong u .

translation.en: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south : and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits .
translation.kha: Hangne ruh la don kawei ka khyrdop kaba ïalam sha ka khyrdop bashapoh . Uta u briew u la thew ïa ka jingjngai ïa kane ka khyrdop kaba ar bad ka la long sanphew mitar .

translation.en: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways  ; and the  Lord  was with him .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ïalam ïa la ki briew sha ka thma bad u jop ha kat kaba u leh , namar U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u .

translation.en: Whose are the fathers , and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came , who is over all , God blessed for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: ki hiarpateng na ki kpa tymmen Hebru bapawnam ; bad U Khrist , kum u briew , u long na ka jaitbynriew jong ki . To ai ba yn ïaroh junom ïa U Blei uba synshar halor baroh! Amen .

translation.en: Wine is a mocker , strong drink is raging : and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise .
translation.kha: Kaba dih kyiad palat ka pynlong ïa phi uba bunktien bad uba bieit . Ka long ka jingijli ban buaid .

translation.en: Then Job arose , and rent his mantle , and shaved his head , and fell down upon the ground , and worshipped ,
translation.kha: Te u Job u ïeng joit bad u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih . U khi ïa la ka khlieh bad u bret ïa lade da pyllup ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: For he mightily convinced the Jews , and that publickly , shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ .
translation.kha: Naba da ki nia bakhlaiñ jong u , u la jop ïa ki Jiw ha ki jingïatainia ha khmat ki paidbah da kaba pynshisha na ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Jisu u dei U Messaïah .

translation.en: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone s cast , and kneeled down , and prayed ,
translation.kha: Nangta u la leit noh na ki kumba shi pda maw bad u la dem khohsiew bad u la duwai .

translation.en: But call to remembrance the former days , in which , after ye were illuminated , ye endured a great fight of afflictions  ;
translation.kha: To kynmaw kumno ka la long bad phi ha ka por mynshuwa . Ha kito ki sngi , hadien ba ka jingshai U Blei ka la tyngshaiñ ha phi , phi la shahshitom shibun kiei kiei , pynban phim shym la shahjop ha kata ka jingïaleh .

translation.en: And they asked him , saying , Why say the scribes that Elias must first come ?
translation.kha: Bad ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Balei ba ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki ong ba u Elijah u hap ban wan nyngkong ?

translation.en: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives , because I am broken with their whorish heart , which hath departed from me , and with their eyes , which go a whoring after their idols : and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations .
translation.kha: Hangta kin sa kynmaw ïa nga bad tip ba nga la pynshitom ïa ki bad pynlehrain ïa ki , namar ki dohnud bymngeit jong ki , ki la kylla dien na nga bad ki la jied ïa ki bleithaw ban ïa nga . Bad kin sa isih hi ïa lade namar ki kam ba-bymman bad bajahburom ba ki la leh .

translation.en: By these three was the third part of men killed , by the fire , and by the smoke , and by the brimstone , which issued out of their mouths .
translation.kha: Shi bynta na ki lai bynta jong u bynriew la pynïap da kito ki lai tylli ki jingïapthem : Ka ding , ka tdem , bad u kyndok kiba mihnoh na ki shyntur jong ki kulai .

translation.en: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was , and saw him , she fell down at his feet , saying unto him , Lord , if thou hadst been here , my brother had not died .
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la poi ha ka jaka ha kaba U Jisu u la don , bad mar ïa-ïohi ïa u , ka la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u .  Ko Trai ,  ka la ong ,  lada men jin da la don hangne , u para jong nga un ym jin da la ïap !

translation.en: They shall come with weeping , and with supplications will I lead them : I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way , wherein they shall not stumble : for I am a father to Israel , and Ephraim is my firstborn .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga kin wan phai da kaba ïam , da kaba duwai katba nga ïalam ban wan phai pat . Ngan ïalam ïa ki sha ki wahduid , ha ka lynti kaba beit ha kaba kin ym jynthut . Nga long kum u kpa ïa ki Israel , bad u Ephraim u long u khun banyngkong eh jong nga .

translation.en: And said unto them , I see your father s countenance , that it is not toward me as before  ; but the God of my father hath been with me .
translation.kha: U ong ïa ki ,  Nga ithuh ba i pa jong phi im da leh jan shuh ïa nga kumba mynshuwa ; hynrei U Blei jong u kpa jong nga u la don lem bad nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said to Samuel , Behold , I will do a thing in Israel , at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Shisien ka sngi ngan leh ei ei kaba shyrkhei katta katta ïa ki briew ha Israel ba kita baroh kiba ïohsngew shaphang kata kin lyngngoh .

translation.en: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples , after that he was risen from the dead .
translation.kha: Kane , te , ka la long ka sien kaba lai ba U Jisu u la paw ha ki synran hadien ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: I am debtor both to the Greeks , and to the Barbarians ; both to the wise , and to the unwise .
translation.kha: Namar nga don ka kamram ba nga dei ban pyndep sha ki jaitbynriew baroh , ha ki briew baroh kiba la shai bad kiba dang sah dien , ha kiba don ka jingnang jingstad bad ki bym don ïa ka .

translation.en: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth , and spread it for her upon the rock , from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven , and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day , nor the beasts of the field by night .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Rispah , ka khun jong u Aïah , ka tnga kliar jong u Saul , ka la pyndonkam da ka jaiñ khain ban thaw jingda ïa lade halor u mawsiang ha kaba don ki metïap , bad ka la sah hangta naduh kaba sdang ka aïom ot haduh ban da hap u slap synrai . Ha ka por mynsngi ka ju beh ïa ki sim na ki metïap , bad ha ka por mynmiet ka ju ïada ïa ki na ki mradkhlaw .

translation.en: The sons of Manasseh  ; Asriel , whom she bare : ( but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead :
translation.kha: Na ka tnga kliar jong u , ka nong Aram , u Manasseh u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Asriel bad u Makhir . U Makhir u dei u kpa u Gilead .

translation.en: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost , that he should not see death , before he had seen the Lord s Christ .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la don bad u bad U la pynthikna ïa u ba un ym ïap ha shuwa ba un ïohi ïa U Messaïah ba la kular jong U Trai .

translation.en: And he said , Who art thou ? And she answered , I am Ruth thine handmaid : spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid  ; for thou art a near kinsman .
translation.kha: Pha dei kaei ?  u kylli .  Kynrad , nga dei ka Ruth ,  ka jubab .  Namar ba phi dei u ba-ha-ïing uba ïajan eh , phi don jingkitkhlieh ban ri sumar ïa nga . Kumta sngewbha ban shongkurim ïa nga .

translation.en: But bade them farewell , saying , I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem : but I will return again unto you , if God will . And he sailed from Ephesus .
translation.kha: Pynban , u la ong ïa ki ha shuwa ba un mihnoh ,  Lada ka long ka mon U Blei , ngan wan pat sha phi .  Bad kumta u la leit da ka lieng na Ephesos .

translation.en: Then he called for Solomon his son , and charged him to build an house for the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa u Solomon u khun jong u bad hukum ïa u ban tei ïa ka Templ U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh , that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaseng lang , bad haba nga ïashem ïa phi ha ka mynsiem jong nga , da ka bor jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi uba don ryngkat bad ngi , phi aiti noh ïa une u briew sha u Soitan ban pynjot ïa ka met jong u , khnang ba ïa ka mynsiem yn ïoh pynim ha ka Sngi jong U Trai .

translation.en: So that my soul chooseth strangling , and death rather than my life .
translation.kha: haduh ba nga sngew ba ka kham bha ban shah ksih ïap ban ïa kaba dang im ha kane ka met bajynjar sat .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If my covenant be not with day and night , and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la pynlong ka jutang bad ka sngi bad ka miet , bad nga la thaw ki aiñ kiba pynïaid ïa ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng .

translation.en: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end .
translation.kha: U diengkhap uba hapdeng , ïa uba la pynkhap hamar shiteng kita ki jingker , u dei ban kot na kawei ka tduh jong ka Ïingjaiñ sha kawei pat .

translation.en: They are all plain to him that understandeth , and right to them that find knowledge .
translation.kha: Ha u briew uba shemphang , ki long kiba shai ; ha uta uba tip bha , ki long kiba beit .

translation.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons , saying , This is the law of the sin offering : In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the  Lord  : it is most holy .
translation.kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun jong u ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Ïa u mrad ba la wanrah kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop dei ban pynïap ha ka bynta bashatei jong ka duwan , ha kaba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang . Kane ka long ka jingainguh kaba khuid bha .

translation.en: And Holon with her suburbs , and Debir with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: ka Holon , ka Debir ,

translation.en: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus , and shall present us with you .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa U Trai Jisu na kiba ïap , un pynmihpat ïa ngi ruh lem bad U Jisu bad un ïalam ïa ngi , ryngkat bad phi , sha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .

translation.en: He was born about October 1 , a time of year when shepherds kept their flocks out-of-doors at night .
translation.kha: La kha ïa u ha u ’nai Risaw , ka por ha kaba ki nongap langbrot ki ju ap ïa la ki kynhun shabar mynmiet .

translation.en: But the  Lord  , who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm , him shall ye fear , and him shall ye worship , and to him shall ye do sacrifice .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga , U  Trai  , uba la wallam ïa phi na Ijipt da ka borbah bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; phi dei ban dem khrup ha nga bad ban ai ki jingkñia ïa nga .

translation.en: For I heard the defaming of many , fear on every side . Report , say they , and we will report it . All my familiars watched for my halting , saying , Peradventure he will be enticed , and we shall prevail against him , and we shall take our revenge on him .
translation.kha: Nga ïohsngew uwei uwei baroh u ïa-pasiaw ,  Ka jingshyrkhei ka don ha kylleng ! Ïa ngin ïamudui ïa u sha ki bor pynïaid !  Wat ki paralok kiba ïajan eh ki ap khmih ïa ka jingkyllon jong nga .  Lehse lah ban pynthame ïa u ,  ki ong ;  te ngi lah ban kem ïa u bad ïoh pynhiarkput .

translation.en: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth : on the tops of their houses , and in their streets , every one shall howl , weeping abundantly .
translation.kha: Ki briew ha ki lynti bah ki la kup da ki jaiñ khain , ha ki jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah bad halor ki tnum ïing ki briew ki ïambriew bad kyang .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts concerning the prophets  ; Behold , I will feed them with wormwood , and make them drink the water of gall : for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land .
translation.kha: Kumta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga ong shaphang ki nongïathuhlypa ka Jerusalem :  Ngan ai ïa ki da ki jhur kthang ban bam , bad ka bih ba kin dih ; namar ba ki la pynsaphriang ïa ka jingbymriewblei kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all  ; first being by interpretation King of righteousness , and after that also King of Salem , which is , King of peace  ;
translation.kha: bad u Abraham u la ai ïa u kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na baroh kaba u la lum , ( ka jingmut kaba nyngkong jong ka kyrteng u Melkhisedek ka long  U syiem jong ka hok ;  bad namar ba u la long u syiem jong ka Salem , ka kyrteng jong u ruh ka mut  U syiem jong ka Jingsuk .  )

translation.en: Thrice was I beaten with rods , once was I stoned , thrice I suffered shipwreck , a night and a day I have been in the deep ;
translation.kha: Lai sien nga la shah paitlieng ; bad shisien nga la pynlut arphew saw kynta ha duriaw .

translation.en: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing , and shall add the fifth part thereto , and give it unto the priest : and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: U dei ban siew ïa kata baroh ïa kaba u la klet ban wallam bad un siew tam arphew bynta na ka shispah . Un ai ïa kata ha u lyngdoh , bad u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia da uta u mrad namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .

translation.en: No foot of man shall pass through it , nor foot of beast shall pass through it , neither shall it be inhabited forty years .
translation.kha: Yn ym don bynriew ne mrad ban ïaid lyngba jong ka . Na ka bynta sawphew snem yn ym don ban im hangta .

translation.en: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still  ; that the poor of thy people may eat : and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat . In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard , and with thy oliveyard .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba hynñiew ai jingjahthait ïa ka , bad wat ot ïa kaei kaei kaba mih ha ka . Kiba duk ki lah ban bam ïa kaei kaba mih hangta , bad ba ki mradkhlaw ruh kin ïoh bam ïa kaba la iehnoh . Leh kumjuh ïa ki bri sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki brisoh Olib jong phi .

translation.en: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah , and reigned over Israel two years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Nadab u khun jong u syiem Jeroboam u la long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar ar snem .

translation.en: Then Peter said , Lo , we have left all , and followed thee .
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Ngi la iehnoh ïa la ki ïing ban bud ïa me .

translation.en: And they said , Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ , and thou shalt be saved , and thy house .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  To ngeit ha U Trai Jisu , bad yn sa pynim ïa me — ïa me bad ïa ka longïing jong me .

translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , This people say , The time is not come , the time that the  Lord s  house should be built .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ong ha u Haggai ,  Kine ki briew ki ong ba kane kam dei ka por kaba biang ban tei pat ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: And should not I spare Nineveh , that great city , wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand  ; and also much cattle ?
translation.kha: Katno tam , te , ba ngan don ka jingsngewsynei ïa ka Ninebeh , kata ka nongbah bakhraw . La kumno kumno , ka don palat ïa ka shi lakh arphew hajar ngut ki khunlung balui lui ha ka , kumjuh ruh shibun ki mrad !

translation.en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died  ; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son , which was given him in mount Ephraim .
translation.kha: U Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron u la ïap , bad la tep ha Gibeah , ka shnong ha ka ri lum Ephraim ïa kaba la ai ha u khun jong u , u Phinehas .

translation.en: And while he yet talked with them , behold , the messenger came down unto him : and he said , Behold , this evil is of the  Lord   ; what should I wait for the  Lord  any longer ?
translation.kha: Katba un da dep kren ïa kane , haba u syiem u wan poi bad u la ong ,  U long U  Trai  uba la wallam ïa kane ka jingjynjar ha ngi ! Balei ba ngan ap slem ïa u ban leh ei ei ?

translation.en: For , lo , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah , saith the  Lord  : and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers , and they shall possess it .
translation.kha: namar ka por ka wan haba ngan pynneh pat ïa ki briew jong nga , ki Israel bad Judah . Ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad kin shim kynti biang ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: He that saith , I know him , and keepeth not his commandments , is a liar , and the truth is not in him .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u ong ba u ithuh ïa u , hynrei um kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , kum uta u briew u long u nongshukor bad ym don ka jingshisha ha u .

translation.en: And Reu lived two and thirty years , and begat Serug :
translation.kha: Haba u Reu u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Serug ;

translation.en: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets  ; I have slain them by the words of my mouth : and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth .
translation.kha: Namarkata , nga la phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga sha phi ryngkat ka khubor jong ka jingbishar bad ka jingpynjot . Kaei kaba nga kwah na phi ka long kaba shisha bad kaba shai .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place , that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray  ; but he shall not prevail .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Moab ki pynlwait ïa lade da kaba leit sha ki jaka mane ha ki lumbah bad sha ki templ jong ki ban duwai , hynrei kan ym manbha ïa ki .

translation.en: And they said every one to his fellow , Come , and let us cast lots , that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us . So they cast lots , and the lot fell upon Jonah .
translation.kha: Ki maji ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  To ngin ïakynting sbai bad wad mano ba long ka daw kaba la pynlong ïa ngi ban ngat ha kane ka jingma .  Ki la leh kumta , bad ka la hap ha ka kyrteng u Jonah .

translation.en: And I will make thee like the top of a rock : thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon  ; thou shalt be built no more : for I the  Lord  have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan ieh sa tang u mawsiang ha uba ki nongtong dohkha ki lah ban pynrkhiang ïa la ki jar . Ïa ka nongbah yn ym tei pat ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: Now when she saw that she had waited , and her hope was lost , then she took another of her whelps , and made him a young lion .
translation.kha: Ka la ap tad haduh ba ka la ïoh ba ka jingkyrmen baroh ka la duh . Nangta ka la pynheh pynsan sa ïa uwei pat na ki khun sing , bad u la san ban long u sing uba ishyrkhei .

translation.en: And when Judah looked back , behold , the battle was before and behind : and they cried unto the  Lord  , and the priests sounded with the trumpets .
translation.kha: Ki Judia ki peit sawdong bad ki ïohi ba la ker sawdong ïa ki . Ki kyang ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap , bad ki lyngdoh ki put ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: And Enoch also , the seventh from Adam , prophesied of these , saying , Behold , the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints ,
translation.kha: Dei u Enokh , uba hynriew na kiba hiarpateng beit na u Adam , uba la ïathuhlypa la slem bah ïa kane shaphang jong ki :  U Trai un wan lem bad ki hajar ki angel bakhuid jong u

translation.en: Gomer , and all his bands  ; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters , and all his bands : and many people with thee .
translation.kha: Baroh ki riewïaleh na ki ri jong ka Gomer bad Beth Togarmah na shaphang shatei ki don bad u , bad kumta ruh ki rangbah na shibun kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And it shall be , that the firstborn which she beareth shall succeed in the name of his brother which is dead , that his name be not put out of Israel .
translation.kha: Yn ñiew ïa u khun shynrang ba ki ïoh nyngkong kum u khun jong uta uba la ïap khnang ba ka kyrteng jong u kan ïaineh ha Israel .

translation.en: Therefore as I live , saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , Surely Moab shall be as Sodom , and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah , even the breeding of nettles , and saltpits , and a perpetual desolation : the residue of my people shall spoil them , and the remnant of my people shall possess them .
translation.kha: Kumba shisha nga long U  Trai  uba im , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga smai ba ka Moab bad ka Ammon kin shah pynjot kum ka Sodom bad Gomorrah . Kin long ka jaka jong ki thliew mluh bad ki jingjot bymjukut , kaba la tap da ki ñiut . Kito na ki briew jong nga kiba lait im kin lute ïa ki bad shim ïa ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: The  Lord  did not set his love upon you , nor choose you , because ye were more in number than any people  ; for ye were the fewest of all people :
translation.kha: U  Trai  um shym la ieit bad jied ïa phi namar ba phi kham bun paid ban ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ; ha ka jingshisha phi long ka jaitbynriew kaba rit tam ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane , and saith unto the disciples ,  Sit ye here , while I go and pray yonder .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit bad la ki synran sha ka jaka kaba la khot ka Gethsemane , bad u la ong ha ki ,  To shong hangne katba nga dang leit hangtai ban duwai .

translation.en: Now therefore fear ye not : I will nourish you , and your little ones . And he comforted them , and spake kindly unto them .
translation.kha: Phim donkam ban sheptieng . Ngan sumar sukher ïa phi bad ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi .  Kumta keiñ u la pynshngain ïa ki da ki ktien kiba sbun kiba ktah ïa ka dohnud jong ki .

translation.en: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread , which she had prepared , into the hand of her son Jacob .
translation.kha: Ka la ai ha u ïa kata ka jingbam ba-bang , lem bad ïa u kpu ba ka la pynkhreh .

translation.en: And teach customs , which are not lawful for us to receive , neither to observe , being Romans .
translation.kha: Ki hikai ïa ki dustur kiba long pyrshah ïa ka aiñ jong ngi ; ngi long ki traishnong jong ka Hima Rom , bad ngim lah ban pdiang ne pyndonkam ïa kine ki dustur .

translation.en: And as they were afraid , and bowed down their faces to the earth , they said unto them , Why seek ye the living among the dead ?
translation.kha: Ha ka jingtieng bakhraw , kita ki kynthei ki la dem khrup ha khyndew , katba ki rangbah ki la ong ha ki ,  Balei ba phi ïawad hapdeng kiba ïap ïa uta uba im ?

translation.en: His lord said unto him , Well done , thou good and faithful servant : thou hast been faithful over a few things , I will make thee ruler over many things : enter thou into the joy of thy lord .
translation.kha: ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba bha tam , me u shakri uba bha bad uba lah ban shaniah !’ la ong u kynrad jong u . ‘ Me la long uba lah ban shaniah ha kaba pynïaid ïa kaba khyndiat , kumta ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa kaba kham bun . To wan rung shapoh bad ïoh bynta lem na ka jingkmen jong nga !’

translation.en: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel , and for the stranger that sojourneth among them , that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither , and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood , until he stood before the congregation .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki nongbah jakarieh ïa kiba la jied na ka bynta ki paid Israel baroh , bad na ka bynta uno uno u nongwei uba shong hapdeng jong ki . Uno uno uba pynïap briew da ka jingjia ryngkhat u lah ban shem jingïada hangta na uta uba wad kput ; kim lah ban pynïap ïa u lymda u ïohpdiang shuwa ïa ka jingbishar paidbah .

translation.en: The men of Dedan were thy merchants  ; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand : they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Rhodes ki khaïi pateng bad pha ; ki briew jong ki jaka ha ki rud duriaw ba bun ki la ai ha pha ïa ki bniat hati bad ka dieng Ebony ban ïakylliang na ka bynta ki mar jong pha .

translation.en: And I will bless her , and give thee a son also of her : yea , I will bless her , and she shall be a mother of nations  ; kings of people shall be of her .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ka , bad ngan ai khun shynrang ïa me na ka . Ngan kyrkhu ïa ka , bad kan long ka kmie jong ki jaitbynriew ; bad yn don ruh napdeng ki khun ki ksiew ki ban long ki syiem .

translation.en: What is your name
translation.kha: i kyrteng kumno

translation.en: And what he did unto you in the wilderness , until ye came into this place  ;
translation.kha: Phi tip kumno U  Trai  u la leh na ka bynta jong phi ha ka ri shyiap shuwa ba phin poi hangne .

translation.en: The nakedness of thy sister , the daughter of thy father , or daughter of thy mother , whether she be born at home , or born abroad , even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka hynmen ne ka para , ne ka para kaba na ujuh u kpa , kam pher la ka heh ka san ryngkat bad me ha kajuh ka ïing ne shawei pat .

translation.en: And they have cast lots for my people  ; and have given a boy for an harlot , and sold a girl for wine , that they might drink .
translation.kha: Ki la kynting sbai ban rai mano ki ban ïoh ïa ki koidi . Ki la die mraw ïa ki khynnah shynrang bad khynnah kynthei ban siew na ka bynta ki nuti bad ka waiñ .

translation.en: And he asked the scribes ,  What question ye with them ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Shaphang kaei phi ïania bad ki ?

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , he shall fly as an eagle , and shall spread his wings over Moab .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kular ba ka hima kan hiar halor ka Moab kum u pukni lem bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong u ,

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples ,  Verily I say unto you , That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Nga pynthikna ïa phi : kan long kaba eh than ïa ki briew bariewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .

translation.en: David said moreover , The  Lord  that delivered me out of the paw of the lion , and out of the paw of the bear , he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine . And Saul said unto David , Go , and the  Lord  be with thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  uba la pyllait im ïa nga na ki sing bad na ki dngiem ; un pyllait im ïa nga na une u Philistia .   To kata ,  u Saul u jubab .  Khie leit , bad U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad me .

translation.en: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Kumta nga mareh beit sha pyrshah ka thong khnang ban ïoh ïa ka prais , kaba long ka jingkhot U Blei da U Khrist Jisu sha ka jingim kaba shaneng .

translation.en: How are you ?
translation.kha: Kumno Phi long ?

translation.en: So shall they fear the name of the  Lord  from the west , and his glory from the rising of the sun . When the enemy shall come in like a flood , the Spirit of the  Lord  shall lift up a standard against him .
translation.kha: Naduh mihngi shaduh sepngi baroh kin sheptieng ïa u bad ïa ka bor bakhraw jong u . Un wan kum ka um ba kyrthep , kum ka lyer kaba jur .

translation.en: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only , but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham , which he had being yet uncircumcised .
translation.kha: U long ruh u kpa jong kito ïa kiba la otsher , kata , jong kito kiba , nalor ba la otsher ïa ki , ki la im ruh ïa kajuh ka jingim jong ka jingngeit kaba u Abraham u kpa jong ngi u la im shuwa ba yn otsher ïa u .

translation.en: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites , Hittites , and Amorites , and Perizzites , and Hivites , and Jebusites :
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki paid Israel ki la shongduh hapdeng ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .

translation.en: So likewise ye , when ye see these things come to pass , know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand .
