translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , haba phi ïohi ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ba ki jia , phin tip ba ka Hima U Blei ka la jan wan .

translation.en: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him  ; for his heart was lifted up : therefore there was wrath upon him , and upon Judah and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Hesekaïah u sngewsarong palat ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewnguh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh namar jong u , bad ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ki mad jingjynjar na kata .

translation.en: And he goeth up into a mountain , and calleth unto him whom he would : and they came unto him .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha u lum bad u la khot bad u ïa ki rangbah kiba u kwah .

translation.en: A scorner seeketh wisdom , and findeth it not : but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba meng da lei lei kin ym long kiba stad , hynrei ki briew kiba shemphang ki ïoh hikai kloi .

translation.en: And they came near to the steward of Joseph s house , and they communed with him at the door of the house ,
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka jingkhang jong kata ka ïing , ki ong ha uta u shakri rangbah ,

translation.en: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly , and said , Who ? where is he that hath taken venison , and brought it me , and I have eaten of all before thou camest , and have blessed him ? yea , and he shall be blessed .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la sdang ban kyiuh bad khynñiuh baroh shi rynïeng , bad u la kylli ,  Te uei pat uto uba la pynïap mrad bad uba la wanrah ïa ka sha nga ? Nga la bam ïa ka shuwa ba men wan . Nga la ai ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu bakhatduh , bad kumta ka long ka jong u shi junom .

translation.en: And David came to his house at Jerusalem  ; and the king took the ten women his concubines , whom he had left to keep the house , and put them in ward , and fed them , but went not in unto them . So they were shut up unto the day of their death , living in widowhood .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la wan poi ha la ka ïingsyiem ha Jerusalem , u shim ïa ki shiphew ngut ki tnga kliar kiba u la iehnoh ban sumar ïa ka ïingsyiem , bad u buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingap phira . U la pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki , hynrei um shym ïathiah shongkha bad ki . La buh ïa ki hangta baroh ki sngi ka jingim jong ki , da kaba im kum ki kynthei ba la ïap lok .

translation.en: But when the first came , they supposed that they should have received more  ; and they likewise received every man a penny .
translation.kha: Kumta haba ki rangbah kiba la long kiba nyngkong ban shah khot bylla ki la wan ban ïoh ïa ka bainong , ki la pyrkhat ba kin ïoh kham bun ; hynrei ïa ki ruh la ai mar shi sbai rupa .

translation.en: I have seen an end of all perfection : but thy commandment is exceeding broad .
translation.kha: Nga la tip ba kiei kiei baroh ki don u pud ; hynrei ka hukum jong me ka long kaba janai .

translation.en: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , Behold , he is come out to fight against thee : he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Ka ktien ka leit poi sha ki Assyria ba ka kynhun shipai Ijipt , ba la ïalam da u Tirhakah u syiem ka Ithiopia , u wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki . Haba u nongsynshar u ïohsngew ïa kane , u phah ïa ka shithi sha u Hesekaïah u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: And Anab , and Eshtemoh , and Anim ,
translation.kha: ka Anab , ka Eshtemoa , ka Anim ,

translation.en: And Jacob asked him , and said , Tell me , I pray thee , thy name . And he said , Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name ? And he blessed him there .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la ong ,  Mynta ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka kyrteng jong me .  Hynrei u la jubab ,  Balei me kwah tip ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ?  Nangta u la kyrkhu ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: Happy art thou , O Israel : who is like unto thee , O people saved by the  Lord  , the shield of thy help , and who is the sword of thy excellency ! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee  ; and thou shalt tread upon their high places .
translation.kha: Suk shisha ma pha , ko Israel ! ym don kaba kum ma pha , ka jaitbynriew ba la pyllait im da U  Trai . U  Trai  hi u long ka stieh bad ka waitlam jong pha , ban ïada ïa pha bad ai ha pha ka jingjop . Ki nongshun jong pha kin wan dem wan nguh ïa pha , bad phan sa ïuhroit ïa ki .

translation.en: Let not then your good be evil spoken of :
translation.kha: To wat ai ba kaei kaba phi ñiew ba ka long kaba bha kan ïoh ïa ka kyrteng basniew .

translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea , and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared  ; and the Egyptians fled against it  ; and the  Lord  overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u kner ïa la ka kti halor ka duriaw , bad haba ka la kynjat shai ka duriaw ka dap biang kumba mynshuwa . Ki nong Ijipt ki la pyrshang ban lait im na ka um , hynrei U  Trai  u la bret ïa ki sha ka duriaw .

translation.en: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the  Lord  , with the two lambs : they shall be holy to the  Lord  for the priest .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un ai ïa uta u kpu bad ïa kita ki khunlangbrot ar tylli kum ki jingainguh kiba kyrpang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ki lyngdoh . Kine ki jingainguh ki long kiba kyrpang .

translation.en: And the seven had her , and left no seed : last of all the woman died also .
translation.kha: bad nangta ïa baroh ki para shynrang : Baroh hynñiew ngut shi para ki la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew bad ki la ïap noh khlem don khun . Khatduh , kata ka briew ka la ïap .

translation.en: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem : and many of the saints did I shut up in prison , having received authority from the chief priests  ; and when they were put to death , I gave my voice against them .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaei kaba nga la leh ha Jerusalem . Nga la ïohpdiang ka bor na ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ban thep phatok ïa kiba bun ki briew jong U Blei ; bad haba la rai pynïap ïa ki , nga ruh nga la mynjur pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise , as in a strange country , dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob , the heirs with him of the same promise :
translation.kha: Da ka jingngeit u la im kum u nongwei ha ka ri ha kaba U Blei u la kular ïa u . U la shong ha ki ïingjaiñ , kumta ruh u Isaak bad u Jakob , kiba la ïohpdiang ïa kajuh ka jingkular na U Blei .

translation.en: But he spake the more vehemently , If I should die with thee , I will not deny thee in any wise . Likewise also said they all .
translation.kha: U Petros u la kham ban ha kaba jubab ïa u ,  Da lei lei ngan ym ong kumta , wat lada ka dei ïa nga ban ïap bad me !  Bad baroh kiwei ki synran ki la ong kumjuh .

translation.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron , Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , Come near before the  Lord  : for he hath heard your murmurings .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha u Aaron ,  Ong ïa ka kynhun Israel baroh ban wan bad ïeng ha khmat U  Trai  , naba u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong ki .

translation.en: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba phraspah khyndaiphew san snem .

translation.en: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness : for the sword of the  Lord  shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land : no flesh shall have peace .
translation.kha: Sha shiliang ki jaka kynjang baroh jong ka ri shyiap ki rangbah ki la wan ban lute . Nga la phah ïa ka thma ban pynjot ïa ka ri baroh kawei ; yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban im ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments , and Israel thy law : they shall put incense before thee , and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar .
translation.kha: Kin hikai ïa ki briew jong me ban kohnguh ïa ka Aiñ jong me ; Kin ai ïa ki jingkñia ha ka duwan jong me .

translation.en: Therefore I endure all things for the elect s sakes , that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka ktien jong U Blei kam shah teh ha ki kynjri , bad kumta nga ïaishah ha kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , khnang ba ma ki ruh kin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingpynim kaba wan lyngba U Khrist Jisu bad kaba wallam ïa ka burom bymjukut .

translation.en: Then said the king to Ziba , Behold , thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth . And Ziba said , I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight , my lord , O king .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Siba ,  Baroh kaba dei ka jong u Mephibosheth ka long ka jong me .   Nga long u shakri jong phi ,  u Siba u jubab .  Ai ba ngan ïai pynsngewbha ïa U Syiem Kynrad .

translation.en: Because thou hast said , These two nations and these two countries shall be mine , and we will possess it  ; whereas the  Lord  was there :
translation.kha: Me la ong ba ki jaitbynriew baroh ar , ki Judah bad ki Israel , lem bad ki ri jong ki , ki long ki jong me bad ba men sa ïohkynti ïa ki , wat la ma nga , U  Trai  nga long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Be not ye therefore like unto them : for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of , before ye ask him .
translation.kha: Wat long kum ma ki . U Kpa jong phi u da tip lypa ïa kaei kaba phi donkam ha shuwa ba phin pan na u .

translation.en: And when Aaron saw it , he built an altar before it  ; and Aaron made proclamation , and said , To morrow is a feast to the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Aaron u tei ïa ka duwan ha khmat jong uta u khun masi ksiar , bad u la pynbna ,  Lashai kan don ka jingkhawai niam ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh : and he gave them in commandment all that the  Lord  had spoken with him in mount Sinai .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , ki Israel baroh ki leit hajan jong u , bad u Moses u ai ha ki ïa kita ki hukum baroh kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Lum Sinai .

translation.en: And they answered Jesus , and said , We cannot tell . And he said unto them ,  Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la jubab ïa U Jisu ,  Ngim tip .  Bad u la ong ha ki ,  Lymne ma nga ruh ngan ym ïathuh , te , da kaei ka hok ba nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall bring upon thee , and upon thy people , and upon thy father s house , days that have not come , from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah  ; even the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wallam halor jong phi , halor ki briew jong phi , bad halor ka longïing syiem baroh kawei , ïa ki sngi jingjynjar kiba kham sniew ban ïa kano kano kaba lah wan naduh ba ka hima Israel ka la khlad na ka Judah — un wallam ïa u syiem ka Assyria .

translation.en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David : and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death . And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka bynta ba-halor jong ka jingtep ki syiem . Baroh ki paid jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ki ai ka burom kaba khraw ha ka jingïap jong u . U Manasseh u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name s sake .
translation.kha: Bad nga hi ngan pyn-i ha u ïa baroh kaba u dei ban shah na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Behold , ye despisers , and wonder , and perish : for I work a work in your days , a work which ye shall in no wise believe , though a man declare it unto you .
translation.kha: ‘ Ha khmih , phi kiba beiñ briew ! To sngewlyngngoh bad to ïap ! Naba kaei kaba nga leh mynta ka long kaei kaei kaba phin ym ngeit , wat haba uno uno u batai ïa ka ha phi !’

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Where is your faith ?  And they being afraid wondered , saying one to another , What manner of man is this ! for he commandeth even the winds and water , and they obey him .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  Hangno ka jingngeit jong phi ?  Hynrei ki la sngewlyngngoh bad sheptieng , bad ki la ong uwei ïa uwei pat ,  Une u briew uba kumno ? U ai hukum ïa ki lyer bad ïa ki jingat phyllung , bad ki kohnguh ïa u !

translation.en: Saying , Fear not , Paul  ; thou must be brought before Caesar : and , lo , God hath given thee all them that sail with thee .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat sheptieng , ko Paul ! Me dei ban ïeng ha khmat u Patsha . Bad U Blei ha ka jingbha jong u ïa me u la pynsah ïa ka jingim jong kito baroh kiba ïaleit da ka lieng bad me .’

translation.en: For as the heavens are higher than the earth , so are my ways higher than your ways , and my thoughts than your thoughts .
translation.kha: Kumba ki bneng ki long kham shajrong ïa ka pyrthei , kumta ruh ki long ki lynti jong nga bad ki jingpyrkhat jong nga kham shajrong ïa phi .

translation.en: Hitherto is the end of the matter . As for me Daniel , my cogitations much troubled me , and my countenance changed in me : but I kept the matter in my heart .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaba kut jong ka jingïathuh . Nga la sheptieng haduh katta katta ba nga la kylla lieh blaid blaid , bad ba nga la set ïa kaei kaei baroh ha lade .

translation.en: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot , upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering :
translation.kha: Un pyndei ruh khyndiat ka umphniang ha kijuh ki jaka ha kiba u la tah snam : ha ka shkor kamon jong uta u briew , ka  tikmie kamon jong u , bad ha ka  jatkmie kamon jong u .

translation.en: And they said unto him , There came a man up to meet us , and said unto us , Go , turn again unto the king that sent you , and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Is it not because there is not a God in Israel , that thou sendest to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron ? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  La wan shem ïa ngi da uwei u briew uba ong ïa ngi ban wan phai noh bad ïathuh ha phi ba U  Trai  u ong ïa phi , ‘ Balei me phah ki nonglamktien ban kylli na u Baalsebub , u blei ka Ekron ? Hato ka dei namar ba me pyrkhat ba ym don blei ha Israel ? Men ym ïohkhiah na ki jingmynsaw jong me ; men ïap !’

translation.en: Only by pride cometh contention : but with the well advised is wisdom .
translation.kha: Kiba leh meng kim leh ei ei hynrei tang ban pynmih jingkulmar . Ka long kaba kham stad ban da pan ïa ka jingai jingmut .

translation.en: But do not thou yield unto them : for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men , which have bound themselves with an oath , that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him : and now are they ready , looking for a promise from thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat shahshkor ïa ki , namar don palat sawphew ngut ki briew ki ban rieh bad apthap ïa u . Ki la shim smai ban ym bam lane dih tad ynda ki la pynïap ïa u . Ki la khreh mynta ban leh ïa kata bad ki ap ïa ka rai jong me .

translation.en: A widely respected religious figure , Jesus Christ , indicated that false religion produces bad works , just as a “rotten tree produces worthless fruit .”
translation.kha: U riewniam ia uba la niewkor bha da baroh , u Jisu Krist , ula kdew ba kum kita ki niam ki pynmih ki kam kiba sniew , kumba “u dieng uba pyut u pynmih ki soh ki bym dondoreiei .”

translation.en: And Saul said unto his servants , Provide me now a man that can play well , and bring him to me .
translation.kha: U Saul u hukum ïa ki ,  Pynïoh ïa nga u briew uba nang bha ban tem bad wan ïalam ïa u sha nga .

translation.en: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law , It is good , my daughter , that thou go out with his maidens , that they meet thee not in any other field .
translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka ong ha ka Ruth ,  Ho-oid , ko khun kynthei jong nga ; kan kham bha shibun ïa phi ban trei bad ki kynthei ha ka lyngkha jong u Boas . Phi lah ban shah leh bymdei lada phi leit sha ka lyngkha jong kiwei .

translation.en: And the battle increased that day : howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even : and about the time of the sun going down he died .
translation.kha: Katba ka thma ka dang jur , u syiem Ahab u kyrshan tyngeh ïa lade ha ka kali ïapom jong u pyrshah ïa ki Syria . Ha ka por sep sngi u ïap noh .

translation.en: But that it spread no further among the people , let us straitly threaten them , that they speak henceforth to no man in this name .
translation.kha: Hynrei ban khanglad ïa kane ban phriang shuh shuh hapdeng ki briew , to ngin maham ïa kine ki briew ban ym kren da lei lei shuh hano hano ha ka kyrteng U Jisu .

translation.en: For I the  Lord  love judgment , I hate robbery for burnt offering  ; and I will direct their work in truth , and I will make an everlasting covenant with them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga ieit ïa ka jingbishar hok bad nga isih ïa ka jingbanbeiñ bad ka jingleh runar . Da shisha ngan sa ai bainong ïa ki briew jong nga bad ngan pynlong ka jutang kaba neh junom bad ki .

translation.en: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus , whom we have not preached , or if ye receive another spirit , which ye have not received , or another gospel , which ye have not accepted , ye might well bear with him .
translation.kha: Naba phi la ïaishah da kaba kmen ïa uno uno uba wan ha phi bad ïalap ïa uwei pat U Jisu , ym uta uba ngi la ïalap ; bad phi pdiang ïa u mynsiem bad ïa ka gospel kaba pher shibun na U Mynsiem bad ka gospel kaba phi la ïohpdiang na ngi!

translation.en: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed , and the needy shall lie down in safety : and I will kill thy root with famine , and he shall slay thy remnant .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un long u nongaplangbrot ïa kiba duk jong ki briew jong u bad un shah ïa ki ban shong ha ka jingshngain . Hynrei un phah ïa ka  nemsniew kaba shyrkhei ha phi ki Philistia , bad un ym pynsah im ïa uno uno ruh na phi .

translation.en: And Andrew , and Philip , and Bartholomew , and Matthew , and Thomas , and James the son of Alphaeus , and Thaddaeus , and Simon the Canaanite ,
translation.kha: u Andriw , u Philip , u Bartholomai , u Matthaïos , u Thomas , u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos , u Thaddaïos , u Simon uba shitrhem ,

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court , they shall be clothed with linen garments  ; and no wool shall come upon them , whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court , and within .
translation.kha: Haba ki rung ïa ka khyrdop sha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh ka Templ , kin phong ïa ki sopti jaiñ linen . Kim dei ban phong kano kano ba la thain na u  saiwul haba ki don ha ka kam ha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh lane hapoh ka Templ .

translation.en: But murmured in their tents , and hearkened not unto the voice of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki ïashong ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki bad ki ïakhñium bad kim sngap ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Namar phi tip ïa ki jingbatai kiba ngi la ai ha phi da ka iktiar jong U Trai Jisu .

translation.en: When Pilate heard of Galilee , he asked whether the man were a Galilaean .
translation.kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la kylli ,  Hato une u briew u dei u nong Galilaïa ?

translation.en: It is drawn , and cometh out of the body  ; yea , the glittering sword cometh out of his gall : terrors are upon him .
translation.kha: U khnam un sam lyngba ïa ka met jong u ; ka snam kan jaw na ka bynta banep jong u , bad ka jingshyrkhei kan khñiot ïa ka mynsiem jong u .

translation.en: If a man therefore purge himself from these , he shall be a vessel unto honour , sanctified , and meet for the master s use , and prepared unto every good work .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pynkhuid ïa lade na kiei kiei baroh kiba sniew , yn pyndonkam ïa ki na ka bynta ki jingthmu kiba kyrpang , namar la pynkyntang ïa ki bad ki long kiba myntoi ïa u Kynrad jong ki , kin long kiba bit ïa ka ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam babha baroh .

translation.en: And Laban called it Jegar–sahadutha : but Jacob called it Galeed .
translation.kha: U Laban u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Jegar Sahadutha , katba u Jakob pat u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Galeed .

translation.en: I am the  Lord  your God  ; walk in my statutes , and keep my judgments , and do them  ;
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . To kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  met Balaam , and put a word in his mouth , and said , Go again unto Balak , and say thus .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïakynduh ïa u Balaam , u la ïathuh ha u kumno ban kren , bad u la phah ïa u pat sha u Balak ban ai ïa ka khubor jong u .

translation.en: Yet shall he be brought to the grave , and shall remain in the tomb .
translation.kha: Haba la rah ïa u sha ka jingtep , sha ka jingtep ba la ap phira bha ,

translation.en: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab , and did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as did the house of Ahab : for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab .
translation.kha: Namar ba u Ahasaïah u don ka jingïadei bad u syiem Ahab da ka jingïashongkha , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , kumba ka longïing jong u Ahab ka la leh .

translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace , and spake , and said , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , ye servants of the most high God , come forth , and come hither . Then Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , came forth of the midst of the fire .
translation.kha: Kumta u Nebukhadnessar u la leit kiew sha ka jingkhang jong ka lawar ding baklang bad u la pyrta ,  Ko Shadrakh ! Ko Meshakh ! Ko Abednego ! Ko shakri jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh ! To mihnoh shabar !  Bad kumta hi ki la wan mih shabar .

translation.en: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah , nor a lawgiver from between his feet , until Shiloh come  ; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be .
translation.kha: U Judah un bat ïa u diengsynshar syiem , Bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai synshar . Ki jaitbynriew kin wanrah ha u ïa ka bai nguh syiem , kin dem bad kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears : and I told this unto the magicians  ; but there was none that could declare it to me .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ïa ki jingphohsniew ha ki nongleh myntor , hynrei ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban batai ïa ki ha nga .

translation.en: And they spit upon him , and took the reed , and smote him on the head .
translation.kha: Ki la bynthiew ïa u , bad ki la shim ïa u dieng bad ki la tied ïa U ha ka khlieh .

translation.en: For if the firstfruit be holy , the lump is also holy : and if the root be holy , so are the branches .
translation.kha: Lada ïa u kpu banyngkong la ai sha U Blei , te u kpu baroh uwei ruh u long u jong u ; bad lada ïa ki thied jong u dieng la ai ha U Blei , ki tnat ruh ki long ki jong U .

translation.en: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages , world without end . Amen .
translation.kha: ha U Blei to long ka burom ha ka balang bad ha U Khrist Jisu na ka bynta ki por baroh , junom la junom ! Amen .

translation.en: Be watchful , and strengthen the things which remain , that are ready to die : for I have not found thy works perfect before God .
translation.kha: Kumta kyndit bynriew noh , bad pynkhlaiñ ïa kaei pha kaba dang don ha shuwa ba kan jah noh khoit . Naba nga shem ba kaei kaba pha la leh kam long kaba janai ha khmat jong U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: But it came to pass , that when Sanballat , and Tobiah , and the Arabians , and the Ammonites , and the Ashdodites , heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up , and that the breaches began to be stopped , then they were very wroth ,
translation.kha: U Sanballat , u Tobiah bad ki briew ka Arabia , ka Ammon bad ka Ashdod ki la ïohsngew ba ngi ïaid shaphrang ha kaba tei pat ïa ka kynroh Jerusalem , bad ba ïa ki thliew jong ka kynroh la set , bad ki la ïabitar haduh katta katta .

translation.en: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem , Fear thou not : and to Zion , Let not thine hands be slack .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi haba kin ong ïa ka Jerusalem ,  Wat sheptieng , ko ka nongbah Seïon ! Wat ai ba ki kti jong pha kin noh kyrwep !

translation.en: Now Elisabeth s full time came that she should be delivered  ; and she brought forth a son .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ïa ka Elisabeth ban kha , bad ka la kha khun shynrang .

translation.en: And there were voices , and thunders , and lightnings  ; and there was a great earthquake , such as was not since men were upon the earth , so mighty an earthquake , and so great .
translation.kha: La don ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh bad jingtied pyrthat , bad u jumai uba shyrkhei . Ym pat ju don kum uta u jumai naduh ba la thaw ïa u khunbynriew ; une u la long u jumai uba jur tam na baroh !

translation.en: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment , than for you .
translation.kha: U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ha ka Sngi Bishar ïa ka Tyros bad ka Sidon ban ïa phi .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye be come into the land of your habitations , which I give unto you ,
translation.kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel ba kin bud ha ka ri kaba u mut ban ai ha ki .

translation.en: My bowels , my bowels ! I am pained at my very heart  ; my heart maketh a noise in me  ; I cannot hold my peace , because thou hast heard , O my soul , the sound of the trumpet , the alarm of war .
translation.kha: Ka jingpang ! Ngam lah shah ïa ka jingpang ! Ka dohnud jong nga ! Ka dohnud jong nga ka kyndeh jur ! Ngam lah ban sngap jar ; nga ïohsngew ïa ki turoi bad ki jingpyrta jong ka thma .

translation.en: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ki ktien u briew uba bha ki long ka umpohliew ka jingim , hynrei ki ktien u briew uba bymman ki buhrieh ïa ka jinglong ba leh jubor .

translation.en: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre , and found it even so as the women had said : but him they saw not .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ka kynhun jong ngi ki la leit sha ka jingtep bad ki la shem thik kumba ki kynthei ki la ïathuh , hynrei kim shym la ïohi ïa u .

translation.en: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand .
translation.kha: hynrei kata ka la lah pynïap arphew saw hajar ngut ki briew .

translation.en: And he said , Cursed be Canaan  ; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren .
translation.kha: u ong ,  Ka jingtim halor u Kanaan ! Un long u mraw ïa ki hynmen jong u .

translation.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei , and said unto him , Build thee an house in Jerusalem , and dwell there , and go not forth thence any whither .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u phah khot ïa u Shimei , bad u ong ha u ,  Shna ïing noh na ka bynta ïa lade hangne ha Jerusalem . Shong ha ka bad wat mihnoh na ka nongbah .

translation.en: And they which went before rebuked him , that he should hold his peace : but he cried so much the more , Thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sha khmat ki la kynhied ïa u bad ki la ong ïa u ban sngap jar . Hynrei u la pyrta kam jam shuh shuh ,  Ko khun u Dabid ! To isynei ïa nga !

translation.en: O house of Jacob , come ye , and let us walk in the light of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , to ngin ïaid ha ka jingshai kaba U  Trai  u ai ha ngi !

translation.en: And lest , when I come again , my God will humble me among you , and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already , and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed .
translation.kha: Nga sheptieng haba ha kawei ka por ba nga wan , U Blei jong nga un pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat jong phi , bad ngan ïam na ka bynta kiba bun kiba la leh pop mynshuwa bad ki bym pat shym kylla-kaba-mut na ki kam awria ba ki la leh — ki jingkwah brai bad ki pop awria jong ki .

translation.en: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple .
translation.kha: bad um shah ïano ïano ruh ban rah ei ei lyngba ki phyllaw jong ka Templ .

translation.en: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side , and forthwith came there out blood and water .
translation.kha: Pynban uwei na ki shipai , u la dung da u sum jong u na ka krung jong U Jisu , bad mar kumta ka snam bad ka um ka la mih shabar .

translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: For the priests and the Levites were purified together , all of them were pure , and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity , and for their brethren the priests , and for themselves .
translation.kha: Baroh ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki pynkhuid ïa lade bad ki khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam . Ki Lebi ki pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ka Niam Ka Jinglait ïa ki briew kiba la wan phai , ki lyngdoh , bad na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: And came out of the graves after his resurrection , and went into the holy city , and appeared unto many .
translation.kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ki jingtep bad hadien ba U Jisu u la mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la leit rung sha ka Nongbah Bakhuid , ha kaba shibun ki briew ki la ïohi ïa ki .

translation.en: And all the country wept with a loud voice , and all the people passed over : the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron , and all the people passed over , toward the way of the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la kyang jam katba ki nongbud jong u Dabid ki la mihnoh . U syiem u la jam ïa ka wahduid Kidron , ki rangbah jong u ki la bud nadien , bad ryngkat ki la ïaleit lang sha ka phang ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous : he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly .
translation.kha: U ai jingïarap bad jingïada ïa kiba hok , ki briew kiba im hok .

translation.en: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded , which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel , with the women , and the little ones , and the strangers that were conversant among them .
translation.kha: U Joshua u pule ïa kawei pa kawei na ki hukum u Moses ha kata ka jingïalang , ha kaba la kynthup ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah , lem bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: And in the cutting of stones , to set them , and in carving of wood , to make any manner of cunning work .
translation.kha: ban ot ïa ki mawlynnai bad ban pyndait ïa ki ; ban oh-shrong ïa ki dieng ; bad ban trei ïa kano kano ka jingthaw dur kaba pynitynnat .

translation.en: Now this I say , brethren , that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God ; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut , ko parabangeit , ka long ba kaei kaba la thaw da ka doh bad ka snam kam lah ban ïadon bynta ha ka Hima U Blei , bad kaei kaba dei ban ïap kan ym ïohkynti ïa ka jingbymïap shuh .

translation.en: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand , and the seven golden candlesticks . The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches : and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingmut barieh jong ki hynñiew tylli ki khlur kiba me ïohi ha ka kti kamon jong nga , bad ki hynñiew tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak ksiar : Ki hynñiew tylli ki khlur ki long ki angel jong ki hynñiew tylli ki balang , bad ki hynñiew tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak ki long ki hynñiew tylli ki balang .

translation.en: For ye are our glory and joy .
translation.kha: Naba phi long ka jingsarong bad ka jingkmeni !

translation.en: For there were that said , We , our sons , and our daughters , are many : therefore we take up corn for them , that we may eat , and live .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki ong ,  Ngi don ki longïing baheh , ngi donkam kew ban pynim ïa lade .

translation.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , u Sedekaïah , u khun jong u Khenaanah , u thaw ki reng nar bad u ong ha u Ahab ,  Kane ka dei kaba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Da kine phin ïaleh ïa ki Syria bad jop thiaw ïa ki .’

translation.en: And when thou art come in , thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons , and shalt pour out into all those vessels , and thou shalt set aside that which is full .
translation.kha: Nangta ma phi bad ki khun shynrang jong phi leit shapoh ïing , khang ïa ka jingkhang , bad sdang phylliew ïa ka umphniang ha ki khra . Buh sharud ïa uwei pa uwei kat uba nang dap .

translation.en: I say then , Hath God cast away his people ? God forbid . For I also am an Israelite , of the seed of Abraham , of the tribe of Benjamin .
translation.kha: Nga kylli te : Hato U Blei u la kyntait ïa la ki jong ki briew ? Em , kam long kumta! Ma nga hi nga long u nong Israel , uba hiarpateng na u Abraham , u dkhot jong ka jait Benjamin .

translation.en: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling , and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy ,
translation.kha: Ha uta uba lah ban ri kyndong ïa phi na ka jinghap noh , bad ban wallam ïa phi kiba khlem jingduna bad kiba kmen ha khmat ka burom ka jingdon ryngkat jong u —

translation.en: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people , and were drawn away from the city  ; and they began to smite of the people , and kill , as at other times , in the highways , of which one goeth up to the house of God , and the other to Gibeah in the field , about thirty men of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki Benjamin ki wan mih shabar ban ïaleh bad la ring pah ïa ki kham sha jngai na kata ka nongbah . Kum mynshuwa , ki la sdang ban pom katto katne ngut ki Israel ha ka jaka lum , ha ki lynti bah sha Bethel bad ha ka lynti bah sha Gibeah . Ki pynïap kumba laiphew ngut ki Israel .

translation.en: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house , The Master saith unto thee , Where is the guestchamber , where I shall eat the passover with my disciples ?
translation.kha: ‘ U Nonghikai u ong ha me ,  Hangno ka kamra    ha kaba ma nga bad ki synran jong nga ngin ïabam ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait ?  ’

translation.en: And the tongue is a fire , a world of iniquity : so is the tongue among our members , that it defileth the whole body , and setteth on fire the course of nature  ; and it is set on fire of hell .
translation.kha: Bad u thylliej u long kum ka ding . U long ka pyrthei jong ka jingsniew , uba shim ïa ka jaka ha ki met jong ngi bad uba pynphriang ïa kaba sniew ha ka met baroh kawei . U wiang ding ïa ka jingïaid lynti jong ka jingim da ka ding kaba wan sha u na ka dujok hi .

translation.en: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone : the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine  ; also his heavens shall drop down dew .
translation.kha: Kumta ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob ki shongsuk shongsaiñ , khlem jingkhuslai ha ka ri kaba dap da u kew bad da ka waiñ , ha kaba ka umjer na suiñbneng ka ai um ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: Again , When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness , and commit iniquity , and I lay a stumblingblock before him , he shall die : because thou hast not given him warning , he shall die in his sin , and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
translation.kha: Lada u briew uba da bha shisha u sdang leh ïa ka kam sniew bad nga buh ïa u ha kaba shong syier , un sa ïap , lada mem shym maham ïa u . Un sa ïap namar ki pop jong u — ngan ym kynmaw ïa ki kam babha ba u la leh — bad ngan pynkitkhlieh ha me namar ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: And to Seth , to him also there was born a son  ; and he called his name Enos : then began men to call upon the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Seth u la ïoh uwei u khun , ïa uba u la kyrteng , u Enosh . Dei ha kata ka por ba ki briew ki la sdang ban pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong U  Trai  ha ka jingmane Blei .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren , What is your occupation ? And they said unto Pharaoh , Thy servants are shepherds , both we , and also our fathers .
translation.kha: U syiem u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi trei phi ktah aïu ?   Kynrad , ngi dei ki nongap langbrot , kumba ju long ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: That they may walk in my statutes , and keep mine ordinances , and do them : and they shall be my people , and I will be their God .
translation.kha: Te kin sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad kin kohnguh hok ïa ki hukum jong nga . Kin long ki briew jong nga bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren , see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently :
translation.kha: Mynta ba da ka jingkohnguh jong phi ha ka jingshisha phi la pynkhuid ïa lade bad ïa ka ban don ka jingieit parabangeit ba khlem arsap , to phin da ieit shitrhem paralok da la ka dohnud baroh .

translation.en: But Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of the men that went to search the land , lived still .
translation.kha: Na ki khat-ar ngut ki nongsyntiat , tang u Joshua bad u Kaleb ki la lait im .

translation.en: Of the doctrine of baptisms , and of laying on of hands , and of resurrection of the dead , and of eternal judgment .
translation.kha: ha kaba hikai shaphang ki jingpynbaptis , bad kaba buh ïa ki kti ; shaphang ka jingmihpat jong kiba ïap bad shaphang ka jingbishar bymjukut .

translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God bringeth thee into a good land , a land of brooks of water , of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba seisoh — ka ri kaba don ki wah , ki pukri , bad ki umpohliew kiba tuid ha ki them bad ki lum ;

translation.en: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll : but he would not hear them .
translation.kha: Wat la u Elnathan , u Delaïah , bad u Gemaraïah ki la kyrpad ïa u syiem ban ym thang ïa ka kot kli , um patiaw satia ïa ki .

translation.en: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him , saying , Take away the filthy garments from him . And unto him he said , Behold , I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee , and I will clothe thee with change of raiment .
translation.kha: U angel u la ong ha la ki shakri ba kynja bneng ,  Shim noh ïa ki jaiñ bajakhlia kiba une u briew u phong .  Nangta u ong ha u Joshua ,  Nga la shim noh ïa ka pop jong me bad ngan ai ha me ki jaiñ bathymmai ban phong .

translation.en: Follow peace with all men , and holiness , without which no man shall see the Lord :
translation.kha: Ïaleh ban ïashongsuk bad ki briew baroh , bad pyrshang ban im ka jingim kaba khuid , namar khlem kata uno uno un ym lah ban ïohi ïa U Trai .

translation.en: Also before they burnt the fat , the priest s servant came , and said to the man that sacrificed , Give flesh to roast for the priest  ; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee , but raw .
translation.kha: Nalor kata , wat shuwa ban shim ïa ka khleiñ bad thang ïa ka ruh , u shakri u lyngdoh u ju wan bad ong ha uta u briew uba ai jingkñia ,  Ai ïa nga khyndiat ka doh na ka bynta u lyngdoh ban syang ; um treh shim ïa ka doh kaba la shet , hynrei tang ïa ka doh im .

translation.en: Kingdom Halls —Why and How Are They Built ?
translation.kha: Ki Ïing Hima—Balei bad Kumno la tei ïa ki ?

translation.en: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there , to the intent ye may believe  ; nevertheless let us go unto him .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ïathuh shai kdar ha ki ,  U Lasaros u la ïap , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi nga kmen ba ngam shym la don ryngkat bad u , khnang ba phin ïoh ngeit . Ïa ngin ïaleit sha u .

translation.en: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost , and to us , to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things  ;
translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ma ngi , ngi la ïamynjur ban ym buh kano kano ka jingkit halor jong phi nalor kine ki rukom kiba donkam :

translation.en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence , and given to the poor ?
translation.kha: Balei bym die noh ïa kane ka jingiwbih ha ka dor laispah ki sbai rupa bad ïa ka pisa ban ai sha kiba duk ?

translation.en: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again : but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release  ;
translation.kha: Phi lah ban dawa la ka ram kaba phi la ai ha u nongwei , hynrei phim dei ban leh kumta na la ki para jait .

translation.en: And Joshua said , Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you , and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Hivites , and the Perizzites , and the Girgashites , and the Amorites , and the Jebusites .
translation.kha: Katba phi nang tur sha khmat , un beh noh da shisha ïa ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Hib , ki Peris , ki Girgash , ki Amor , bad ki Jebus .

translation.en: And the flocks conceived before the rods , and brought forth cattle ringstraked , speckled , and spotted .
translation.kha: Kumta haba kita ki langbrot ki la seng khun ha khmat kita ki tnat dieng , ki kha ki khunlangbrot kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria , bad kiba thohbroin .

translation.en: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene , which , when they were come to Antioch , spake unto the Greeks , preaching the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki parabangeit , kiba na Sypros bad Kyrini , ki la leit sha Antiokh bad ki la pynbna ïa ka khubor ha ki Jentil ruh , da kaba ïathuh ha ki ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Trai Jisu .

translation.en: And the multitude sat about him , and they said unto him , Behold , thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee .
translation.kha: U paidbah u dang ïashong sawdong U Jisu , bad ki la ong ha u ,  Khmih ka kmie jong me bad ki para shynrang bad kynthei jong me ki don habar , bad ki donkam ïa me .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Why do ye such things ? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people .
translation.kha: Kumta u ong ha ki ,  Balei keiñ ba phi leh ïa kine kiei kiei ? Man la u briew u ïathuh ha nga ïa ki kam bymman jong phi .

translation.en: Halhul , Beth–zur , and Gedor ,
translation.kha: Don ka Halhul , ka Bethsur , ka Gedor ,

translation.en: And thus said Shimei when he cursed , Come out , come out , thou bloody man , and thou man of Belial :
translation.kha: U Shimei u la tim ïa u bad u ong ,  Phet noh ! Phet noh ! Me u nongpynïap briew ! Me u nongkamsniew !

translation.en: O ye Corinthians , our mouth is open unto you , our heart is enlarged .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit ha Korinth! Ngi la kren da kaba shai kdar ha phi ; ngi la plie ïar ïa la ki dohnud .

translation.en: And his second , Chileab , of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite  ; and the third , Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur  ;
translation.kha: u Khileab , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abigail , ka tnga jong u Nabal uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel ; u Absalom , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Maakah , ka khun jong u Talmai u syiem ka Geshur ;

translation.en: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee : thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen , and of the wheels , and of the chariots , when he shall enter into thy gates , as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach .
translation.kha: Ki lyoh pui pui ba pynmih da ki kulai jong ki , kin tap ïa pha . Ka jingsawa na ki kulai ba paring ïa ki kali kit mar bad ki kali ïapom kin pynkhynñiuh ïa ki kynroh jong pha katba ki dang ïaid lyngba ki khyrdop jong ka nongbah ba la pynjot .

translation.en: He sendeth out his word , and melteth them : he causeth his wind to blow , and the waters flow .
translation.kha: Hadien pat u ai ka hukum , bad u thah u um ; u phah ïa ka lyer , bad ka um ka tuid .

translation.en: And not by his coming only , but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you , when he told us your earnest desire , your mourning , your fervent mind toward me ; so that I rejoiced the more .
translation.kha: Kam shym la long tang ka jingwan jong u kaba la ai mynsiem ïa ngi , hynrei ruh da ka jingïathuh jong u ba kumno phi la pynshlur ïa u . U la ïathuh ïa ngi haduh katno ba phi kwah ban wan ïohi ïa nga , katno phi sngewsih , katno phi la kloi ban ïada ïa nga ; bad kumta nga la nang kham kmen mynta .

translation.en: God is a Spirit : and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth .
translation.kha: U Blei u long U Mynsiem , bad tang ha ka bor U Mynsiem jong u ba ki briew ki lah ban mane ïa u kumba u long hi .

translation.en: And at even , when the sun did set , they brought unto him all that were diseased , and them that were possessed with devils .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka sngi ka la sep bad ba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu ïa baroh kiba pang bad kito kiba shongksuid .

translation.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the  Lord  shall be offered , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Nalor kane ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh waiñ jong ka , kñia ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .

translation.en: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day , and fell down at the door of the man s house where her lord was , till it was light .
translation.kha: Ynda ka la kynjat shai kata ka briew ka wan bad ka kyllon ha jingkhang ïing jong uta u tymmen , ha kaba u tnga jong ka u don . Ka dang don hangta hi haba ka la step ruh .

translation.en: Then said they to him again , What did he to thee ? how opened he thine eyes ?
translation.kha: U la leh aïu ïa me ?  ki la kylli .  Kumno u la pynkoit ïa me na ka jingmatlah jong me ?

translation.en: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar , for the children of Issachar according to their families .
translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba saw la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Issakhar .

translation.en: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord , they returned into Galilee , to their own city Nazareth .
translation.kha: Haba U Joseph bad ka Mari ki la pyndep ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la dawa da ka aiñ jong U Trai , ki la leit phai pat sha Nasareth , ka shnong jong ki kaba ha Galilaïa .

translation.en: And he said unto him , We are passing from Beth–lehem–judah toward the side of mount Ephraim  ; from thence am I : and I went to Beth–lehem–judah , but I am now going to the house of the  Lord   ; and there is no man that receiveth me to house .
translation.kha: U Lebi u jubab ,  Ngi wan na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah , bad mynta ngin leit sha la ïing , kaba sha kyndong ka ri lum Ephraim . Ym don mano mano ba khot sahmiet ïa ngi ,

translation.en: And we went before to ship , and sailed unto Assos , there intending to take in Paul : for so had he appointed , minding himself to go afoot .
translation.kha: Ngi la nang leit sha khmat sha ka lieng bad ngi la leit da ka lieng sha Assos , ha kaba ngi la thmu ban kyntiew u Paul ha ka lieng . U la ong ïa ngi ban leh ïa kane , namar u la mut ban leit shata na ryngkew .

translation.en: Don't tell a lie . Be honest .
translation.kha: Wat thok . Iathuh hok .

translation.en: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Hallohesh , the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem , he and his daughters .
translation.kha: U Shallum , u khun jong u Hallohesh , u nongsynshar ïa kawei pat kaba shiteng jong ka Jerusalem distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . ( Ki khun kynthei ki la ïarap ha ka jingtrei . )

translation.en: Thou shalt eat , but not be satisfied  ; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee  ; and thou shalt take hold , but shalt not deliver  ; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword .
translation.kha: Phin bam , hynrei phin ym sngewhun — ha ka jingshisha phin dang ïai thngan hi . Phin rah bak ïa kiei kiei , hynrei phin ym lah ban ri ïa ki ; ïa kino kino kiba phi lah ban ri , ngan pynjot ïa ki ha ka thma .

translation.en: Who hath saved us , and called us with an holy calling , not according to our works , but according to his own purpose and grace , which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began ,
translation.kha: U la pynim ïa ngi bad u la khot ïa ngi ban long ki briew jong u hi , ym namar ïa kaei kaba ngi la leh , hynrei namar ka jingthmu jong u hi bad ka jingaiei .

translation.en: It tells us the truth about God—who he is and what he stands for .
translation.kha: Ka ïathuh ïa ngi ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei—U dei u ei bad u long u ba kumno .

translation.en: And when he had opened the fifth seal , I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God , and for the testimony which they held :
translation.kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba san . Nga la ïohi ha khrum ka duwan ïa ki mynsiem jong kito kiba la shah pynïap namar ba ki la pynbna ïa ka ktien U Blei bad ba ki la ïaineh ha ki jingphla jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them  ; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day , and let them not cease : for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach , with a very grievous blow .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban ïathuh ïa ki briew shaphang ka jingsngewsih jong nga bad ban ong :  Ai ba ki khmat jong nga kin tuid da ki ummat mynsngi bad mynmiet , ai ba da lei lei ngan ym sangeh ban ïam , namar ki briew jong nga ki la mynsaw jur bad ki la mong tyngeh .

translation.en: This is he that came by water and blood , even Jesus Christ  ; not by water only , but by water and blood . And it is the Spirit that beareth witness , because the Spirit is truth .
translation.kha: U Jisu Khrist u long uta uba la wan da ka um jong ka jingpynbaptis jong u bad ka snam jong ka jingïap jong u . U la wan ym tang da ka um , hynrei , da ka um bad ka snam ruh . Bad U Mynsiem da lade hi u phla ba kane ka long kaba shisha , namar U Mynsiem u long ka jingshisha .

translation.en: And , behold , this day I am going the way of all the earth : and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls , that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the  Lord  your God spake concerning you  ; all are come to pass unto you , and not one thing hath failed thereof .
translation.kha: Mynta , ka la dei ka por ïa nga ban ïap . Uwei pa uwei na phi u tip ha la ka dohnud bad ha la ka mynsiem ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba u la kular ha phi . Ïa kawei pa kawei ka kular la pyndep , ym don kawei ruh ka ban sep-ei .

translation.en: Then he openeth the ears of men , and sealeth their instruction ,
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa kaei ba u ong , bad ki sheptieng ïa ki jingmaham jong u .

translation.en: Now I beseech you , brethren , by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that ye all speak the same thing , and that there be no divisions among you ; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment .
translation.kha: Da ka bor jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi nga kyrpad ïa phi baroh , ki parabangeit jong nga , ba phin ïamynjur lang ïa kaei kaba phi ong , khnang ba yn ym don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong phi . To phin ïalong kawei , tang ha kawei ka jingpyrkhat bad kawei ka jingthmu .

translation.en: They shall lift up their voice , they shall sing for the majesty of the  Lord  , they shall cry aloud from the sea .
translation.kha: Kito kiba lait im kin rwai da ka jingkmen . Kito kiba don ha sepngi kin ïathuh katno ba U  Trai  u long uba khraw ,

translation.en: And when even was come , the ship was in the midst of the sea , and he alone on the land .
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , ka lieng ka la don hapdeng ka duriaw , katba U Jisu u dang don marwei ha ryngkew .

translation.en: In stripes , in imprisonments , in tumults , in labours , in watchings , in fastings ;
translation.kha: La sympat ïa ngi , la set byndi , bad la shah ktah kti ha u paidbhur ; ngi la trei palat bad ngi la duh thiah ne duh bam .

translation.en: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company , saying , Even to morrow the  Lord  will shew who are his , and who is holy  ; and will cause him to come near unto him : even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha u Korah bad ki nongbud jong u ,  Lashai mynstep U  Trai  un pyn-i ha ngi ïa uta uba long u jong u ; un sa shah ïa uta uba long u jong u , kata , uta keiñ ïa uba u la jied , ban leit sha u ha ka duwan .

translation.en: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him , and did hastily catch it : and they said , Thy brother Ben–hadad . Then he said , Go ye , bring him . Then Ben–hadad came forth to him  ; and he caused him to come up into the chariot .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Benhadad ki ap khmih ïa ka dak babha , bad haba u Ahab u ong  shi para ,  ki pynkloi shisyndon bad ong ,  Kumba phi ong , u Benhadad u long kum uba shi para jong phi !   Wallam ïa u sha nga ,  u Ahab u hukum . Haba u Benhadad u poi , u Ahab u khot sngewbha ïa u ban kiew ha ka kali ïapom bad u .

translation.en: I'm just joking .
translation.kha: Nga shu ongkai .

translation.en: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs : bright iron , cassia , and calamus , were in thy market .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Damaskos ki la thied ïa ki mar khaïi bad ïa ki jingmih jong pha , da kaba siewdor da ka waiñ na Helbon bad u  saiwul na Sahar . Ki ïakylliang da ki nar ba la shoh stang bad ki musli musla na ka bynta ki mar jong pha .

translation.en: Get wisdom , get understanding : forget it not  ; neither decline from the words of my mouth .
translation.kha: A to ïoh ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang ! Wat klet lane leh bymsuidñiew ïa ki ktien jong nga .

translation.en: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people , and praise him in the assembly of the elders .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ha ka jingïalang u paidbah bad ïaroh ïa u ha ka jingïalang ki nongïalam .

translation.en: But God commendeth his love toward us , in that , while we were yet sinners , Christ died for us .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pyn-i ha ngi haduh katno ba u ieit ïa ngi — ka la long mynba ngi dang long ki nongpop ba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta jong ngi !

translation.en: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house : and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them .
translation.kha: Nangta u Lebi u la pynlong ka jingkhawai kaba heh ha ka ïing jong u na ka bynta U Jisu , bad napdeng kiba shah khot sngewbha la don bun ngut ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei de ki briew .

translation.en: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread : and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the  Lord  thy God : thou shalt do no work therein .
translation.kha: Nangta sa hynriew sngi phin bam ïa u kpu khlem thiat , bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ïalumlang ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad wat trei ei ei ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: But after that I am risen , I will go before you into Galilee .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba nga la mihpat , ngan leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi .

translation.en: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin s neck , and wept  ; and Benjamin wept upon his neck .
translation.kha: U piam ïa u Benjamin u para jong u , bad u ïam . U Benjamin ruh u ïa-ïam lang katba u dang piam ïa u .

translation.en: Yea , he magnified himself even to the prince of the host , and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away , and the place of his sanctuary was cast down .
translation.kha: Ka la kyntait ban kohnguh wat ïa U Khun syiem jong ka kynhun shipai ba kynja bneng , ka la pynsangeh ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi ba la ai sha u , bad ka la pyntngit ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: Shall the companions make a banquet of him ? shall they part him among the merchants ?
translation.kha: Hato ki nongtong dohkha kin ïadait dor halor jong u ? Hato ki nongkhaïi kin ot doh ïa u ban die ?

translation.en: But the mountain shall be thine  ; for it is a wood , and thou shalt cut it down : and the outgoings of it shall be thine : for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites , though they have iron chariots , and though they be strong .
translation.kha: Ka ri lum kan long ka jong phi . Wat la ka dei ka khlaw , phin prat pynkhuid bad shim kynti ïa ka na kawei ka tduh sha kawei pat ka tduh . Shaphang ki Kanaan , phin beh noh ïa ki , wat la ki don ki kali ïapom da ka nar bad ba ki long ki briew kiba khlaiñ .

translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river , strong and many , even the king of Assyria , and all his glory : and he shall come up over all his channels , and go over all his banks :
translation.kha: ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan wallam ïa u patsha jong ka Assyria bad ïa ki kynhun shipai jong u baroh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . Kin tur shaphrang kum ki um bashlei jong ka wah Ïuphratis , kiba lyngkien ïa ki rud jong ka baroh .

translation.en: So , addressing the corpse , he commanded : “Young man , I say to you , Get up !”
translation.kha: U la ong ia u ta u ba la iap , “Ko samla nga ong ha me , to ïeng joit !”

translation.en: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled .
translation.kha: ki rnga barhem ki sei ding na ka leilieh ha shuwa jong u .

translation.en: And he said , I will make all my goodness pass before thee , and I will proclaim the name of the  Lord  before thee  ; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious , and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Ngan pynïaid ha khmat jong me ïa ka jingitynnat jong nga baroh , bad hangta haba me don , ngan pynbna ïa ka kyrteng kaba kyntang jong nga . Nga long U  Trai  bad ngan lehsbun bad leh-isynei ïa kito kiba nga jied .

translation.en: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil .
translation.kha: Nangta U Mynsiem u la ïalam ïa U Jisu sha ka ri shyiap ba yn pynshoi u da u Soitan .

translation.en: And they told to Mordecai Esther s words .
translation.kha: Haba u Mordekai u la ïoh ïa ka khubor , u phah ïa ka ïa kane ka jingmaham :

translation.en: And they said one to another , Behold , this dreamer cometh .
translation.kha: Ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Utai u nongphohsniew u la wan .

translation.en: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men , and went to the Ammonites .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ishmael bad phra ngut na ki briew jong u ki la kynriah na u Johanan bad phet sha ka ri ki Ammon .

translation.en: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh ; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit .
translation.kha: Kito kiba im kumba ka jinglong ba kynja doh ka ong ïa ki ban leh , ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki shah pynïaid da kaei kaba ka jinglong ba kynja doh ka kwah . Kito kiba im kat kum ka jingong U Mynsiem ïa ki , ki shah pynïaid ha kaei kaba U Mynsiem u kwah .

translation.en: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes , both we and our land ? buy us and our land for bread , and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh : and give us seed , that we may live , and not die , that the land be not desolate .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba ngin ïap , To leh ei ei ! Wat ai ba ki lyngkha jong ngi kin shu sah shrah . Thied noh ïa ngi , bad ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap jong ngi , ban ïa-bujli bad ka bam . Ngin mat long noh ki mraw u syiem , bad u pat un long trai ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap jong ngi . Ai kew ïa ngi ba ngin dup im , bad ai symbai ba ngin ïoh bet ha la ki lyngkha .

translation.en: Son of man , what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel , saying , The days are prolonged , and every vision faileth ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  balei ki paid Israel ki ïai-ong ïa kane ka proberb : ‘ Ka por ka leit noh , bad ki jingïathuh lypa kim urlong ?’

translation.en: But they and our fathers dealt proudly , and hardened their necks , and hearkened not to thy commandments ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la sarong bad eh dohnud bad kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: Let men of understanding tell me , and let a wise man hearken unto me .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba don ka jingmut jingpyrkhat kaba biang un mynjur da shisha ; bad uba stad haba u ïohsngew ïa nga un ong

translation.en: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry , and satisfy the afflicted soul  ; then shall thy light rise in obscurity , and thy darkness be as the noonday :
translation.kha: lada phi ai bam ïa kiba thngan , bad pynkdang ïa kito kiba kyrduh , te ka jingdum sawdong jong phi kan kylla jingtyngshaiñ kum shiteng sngi .

translation.en: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem , and fought with Abimelech .
translation.kha: U Gaal u ïalam ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad u ïaleh ïa u Abimelekh .

translation.en: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned two years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba sanphew jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Pekahaïah u khun jong u Menahem u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar ar snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  Let the dead bury their dead : but go thou and preach the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ai ba kiba ïap kin tep ïa kiba ïap jong ki . Khie leit ma me bad pynbna ïa ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: But when that which is perfect is come , then that which is in part shall be done away .
translation.kha: hynrei haba kata kaba janai kan wan , te kata kaba tang katto katne kan jah noh .

translation.en: Bezer , and Hod , and Shamma , and Shilshah , and Ithran , and Beera .
translation.kha: u Beser , u Hod , u Shamma , u Shilshah , u Ithran , bad u Beera .

translation.en: Ummah also , and Aphek , and Rehob : twenty and two cities with their villages .
translation.kha: ka Ummah , ka Aphek , bad ka Rehob : arphew ar tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , I will remove Judah also out of my sight , as I have removed Israel , and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen , and the house of which I said , My name shall be there .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan leh ïa ka Judah kumjuh kumba nga la leh ïa ka Israel : Ngan pynjah ïa ki briew ka Judah na khmat jong nga , bad ngan kyntait ïa ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah kaba nga la jied , bad ka Templ , ka jaka kaba nga la ong ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .

translation.en: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another : and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another .
translation.kha: Ki bteng lang san tylli na ki ba kin long shi sut , bad ki leh kumjuh ïa ki san tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .

translation.en: He fashioneth their hearts alike  ; he considereth all their works .
translation.kha: U saiñdur ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki baroh , bad u tip ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba ki leh .

translation.en: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about , like those windows : the length was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .
translation.kha: La don ki jingkhangïit baroh sawdong ha ki kamra jong kane ka khyrdop , katjuh kum ha kiwei pat ki khyrdop . Baroh shi lynter kata ka khyrdop ka la long arphew san mitar , bad ka pyngkiang khat-ar mitar shiteng .

translation.en: The  Lord  is my strength and song , and is become my salvation .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa nga uba donbor bad uba khlaiñ ; u la pynim ïa nga .

translation.en: They said moreover unto Pharaoh , For to sojourn in the land are we come  ; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks  ; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan : now therefore , we pray thee , let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen .
translation.kha: Ngi la wan ban sah ha kane ka ri , namar ha Kanaan ka don ka  nemsniew kaba jur katta katta haduh bym don phlang shuh ïa ki jingri jong ngi . Sngewbha ai jingbit ïa ngi ban shong ban sah ha ka thain Goshen .

translation.en: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen , a chariot of asses , and a chariot of camels  ; and he hearkened diligently with much heed :
translation.kha: Lada u ïohi ïa ki rangbah kiba wan halor ki kulai , shi jur shi jur , bad ki rangbah kiba shong halor ki kada bad ki ut , u dei ban da khmih bniah biang biang ïa ki .

translation.en: And David said to Abigail , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which sent thee this day to meet me :
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha ka ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba la phah ïa phi ha kane ka sngi ban ïashem bad nga !

translation.en: And it was so , when the king went into the house of the  Lord  , that the guard bare them , and brought them back into the guard chamber .
translation.kha: Man ba u syiem u leit rung sha ka Templ , ki nongap khyrdop ki rah ïa kita ki stieh , bad ki pynphai pat ïa ki sha ka kamra ki nongap khyrdop .

translation.en: Is not this the carpenter , the son of Mary , the brother of James , and Joses , and of Judas , and Simon ? and are not his sisters here with us ? And they were offended at him .
translation.kha: Hato um dei uto u misteri , u khun jong ka Mari , bad u hynmen jong u Jakob , u Josis , u Judas bad u Simon ? Hato ki para kynthei jong u kim shong kim sah hangne ?  Bad kumta ki la kyntait noh ïa u .

translation.en: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth , even with a band of iron and brass , in the tender grass of the field  ; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven , and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth :
translation.kha: Hynrei to ieh ïa ka dyngkhong jong u ha khyndew lem bad ka syrwiang nar bad rnong sawdong jong u . Iehnoh ïa u hangta ha pyntha bad u phlang .   ‘ Mynta ai ba ka umjer kan hap halor une u briew , bad shah ïa u ban im bad ki mrad bad ki jingthung .

translation.en: Cast away from you all your transgressions , whereby ye have transgressed  ; and make you a new heart and a new spirit : for why will ye die , O house of Israel ?
translation.kha: To iehnoh ïa kaba sniew baroh kaba phi leh bad pynïoh ïa lade ki jingmut bad ka dohnud kiba thymmai . Balei ma phi ki Israel phi kwah ban ïap ?

translation.en: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , my servant  ; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him .
translation.kha: Nga long uta uba la buh ïa kine ki jaitbynriew baroh hapoh ka bor jong u shakri jong nga , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia , bad nga la pynlong wat ïa ki mradkhlaw ban shakri ïa u .

translation.en: Salute Andronicus and Junia , my kinsmen , and my fellowprisoners , who are of note among the apostles , who also were in Christ before me .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa u Andronikos bad ka Junias , ki para Jiw kiba la ïadon lang bad nga ha byndi ; ki long ïa kiba la ithuh bha hapdeng ki apostol , bad ki la long Khristan shuwa ïa nga .

translation.en: And David enquired of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up to the Philistines ? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand ? And the  Lord  said unto David , Go up : for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand .
translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Hato ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ? Hato men ai ha nga ïa ka jingjop ?   Ho-oid , khie tur ïaleh !  U  Trai  u la jubab .  Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop !

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every soul , which will not hear that prophet , shall be destroyed from among the people .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa uta u nongïathuhlypa un shah pynkhlad na ki briew jong U Blei bad un shah pynjot .’

translation.en: Because thou hast spoiled many nations , all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee  ; because of men s blood , and for the violence of the land , of the city , and of all that dwell therein .
translation.kha: Phi la thombor ïa ki briew jong ki hima kiba bun , hynrei mynta kito kiba la lait im kin thombor ïa phi namar ki kam pynïap briew ba phi la leh bad namar ki jingleh jubor jong phi pyrshah ïa ki briew jong ka pyrthei bad ki nongbah jong ka .

translation.en: And when the sun was up , they were scorched  ; and because they had no root , they withered away .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka sngi ka la mih , ka thang ïa ki jingthung ba dang lung ; bad namar ba ki thied kim da ngam jylliew bha , shen ki jingthung ki la ïap tyrkhong .

translation.en: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence , and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor , and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Beth–el , one carrying three kids , and another carrying three loaves of bread , and another carrying a bottle of wine :
translation.kha: Men ïaid nangta haduh ba men poi ha u dieng uba kyntang ha Tabor ; hangta men ïakynduh lai ngut ki rangbah kiba leit kñia jingainguh ha U Blei ha Bethel . Uwei na ki un ïalam lai tylli ki khunblang , uwei pat un rah lai tylli ki kpu , bad uba lai un kieng ka pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .

translation.en: If it be possible , as much as lieth in you , live peaceably with all men .
translation.kha: To leh katbalah ïa kiei kiei baroh katba phi lah ban im ha ka jingïasuk bad ki briew baroh .

translation.en: And he said , My presence shall go with thee , and I will give thee rest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Nga hi ngan leit ryngkat bad me , bad ngan ai ha me ka jingjop .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  called unto him out of heaven , and said , Abraham , Abraham : and he said , Here am I .
translation.kha: Hynrei u angel U  Trai  u pyrta ïa u na bneng ,  Abraham , Abraham !  U jubab ,  Ho-oid , nga hangne .

translation.en: And the people repented them for Benjamin , because that the  Lord  had made a breach in the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la sngewsih na ka bynta ki Benjamin namar U  Trai  u la phiah ïa ka jingtylli kawei jong ki jait Israel .

translation.en: And he laid it upon my mouth , and said , Lo , this hath touched thy lips  ; and thine iniquity is taken away , and thy sin purged .
translation.kha: U la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong nga da u rnga barhem bad ong ,  Une u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong me , bad mynta ka jingkitpop jong me ka la jah noh , bad ïa ki pop jong me la map .

translation.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face , and holdest me for thine enemy ?
translation.kha: Balei ba me kiar na nga ? Balei ba me ñiew ïa nga kum u nongshun ?

translation.en: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank , which is upon the hollow of the thigh , unto this day : because he touched the hollow of Jacob s thigh in the sinew that shrank .
translation.kha: Wat haduh mynta mynne , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Israel kim ju bam ïa ka dohksah kaba halor ka shyieng skhep , namar dei ha kata ka dohksah ba u Jakob u la shah kura .

translation.en: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith  ; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby .
translation.kha: Lada phi trei ha ka par maw , phi ïoh jingmynsaw na ki maw . Lada phi thlieh dieng , phi ïoh jingmynsaw haba phi leh ïa ka .

translation.en: At the mouth of two witnesses , or three witnesses , shall he that is worthy of death be put to death  ; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death .
translation.kha: Hynrei lah ban pynïap ïa kita tang lada don ar ngut ne kham bun ki sakhi pyrshah ïa ki ; ym dei ban pynïap ïa ki lada don tang uwei u sakhi .

translation.en: Finally , my brethren , rejoice in the Lord . To write the same things to you , to me indeed is not grievous , but for you it is safe .
translation.kha: Ha kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong nga , to phin kmen ha U Trai . Ngam sngew ei ei ban ïai ban biang ïa kaei kaba nga la thoh mynshuwa , bad kan kham pynskhem ïa phi lada nga leh kumta .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he talked with him , that the king said unto him , Art thou made of the king s counsel ? forbear  ; why shouldest thou be smitten ? Then the prophet forbare , and said , I know that God hath determined to destroy thee , because thou hast done this , and hast not hearkened unto my counsel .
translation.kha: Naduh mynno ,  u Amasaïah u kynrup ktien ,  ba ngi la pynlong ïa me u nongai jingmut ïa u syiem ? Sangeh ban kren , ïoh ngan pynïap ïa me !  U nongïathuhlypa u la sngap , hynrei ym shuwa ba un ong ,  Mynta nga tip ba U Blei u la thmu ban pynjot ïa me namar ba me la leh ïa kane baroh bad ba mem shym sngap ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Again in this place , which is desolate without man and without beast , and in all the cities thereof , shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ong ,  Ha kane ka ri kaba long kum ka ri shyiap bad ha kaba ym don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im hangta , yn sa don biang ki jaka phlang ha kiba ki nongaplangbrot kin wallam ïa ki langbrot jong ki .

translation.en: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ruh , nga la kren ha phi shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba phi dei ban leh .

translation.en: For if Jesus had given them rest , then would he not afterward have spoken of another day .
translation.kha: Lada u Joshua u la ai ha ki briew ïa ka jingjahthait kaba U Blei u la kular , U Blei un ym kren hadien shaphang kata kawei pat ka sngi .

translation.en: If ye endure chastening , God dealeth with you as with sons  ; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not ?
translation.kha: To ïaishah ïa kaei kaba phi la shahshitom namar ka jingsneng sympat u kpa ; ka jingshahshitom jong phi ka pynpaw ba U Blei u ñiew ïa phi kum ki khun jong u . Hato la ju don ne em u khun u bym ju shah pynshitom ha la u kpa ?

translation.en: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love ; in honour preferring one another ;
translation.kha: To ieit iwei ïa iwei ha ka jingrhem mynsiem kum ki parabangeit , bad to long kiba da kwah hir hir ban pyn-i ka jingburom iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years .
translation.kha: Hadien kata ka jingshlei um , u Noah u la im sa laispah sanphew snem ,

translation.en: There failed not ought of any good thing which the  Lord  had spoken unto the house of Israel  ; all came to pass .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bat ïa kawei pa kawei na ki jingkular kiba u la pynlong ha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar , and set up the hanging of the court gate . So Moses finished the work .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynïeng sa ïa ka phyllaw kaba baroh sawdong ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad u wah ïa ka pyrda ha khyrdop jong ka phyllaw . Kumta keiñ u Moses u pyndep ïa kata ka kam baroh .

translation.en: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee to dwell there , saying ,
translation.kha: Ynda phi shong ha ki shnong ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , lada phi ïohsngew

translation.en: For the Father himself loveth you , because ye have loved me , and have believed that I came out from God .
translation.kha: U ieit ïa phi namar ba phi ieit ïa nga bad ba phi la ngeit ba nga la wan na U Blei .

translation.en: And thou shalt grope at noonday , as the blind gropeth in darkness , and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways : and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore , and no man shall save thee .
translation.kha: Phin shu tare ruma mynsngi kum u matlah , bad phin ym lap lynti . Kat kaba phi leh kan pulom . Phin shah lehbeiñ bad shah lute man ka por , bad yn ym don ba ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister , whose name was Tamar  ; and Amnon the son of David loved her .
translation.kha: U Absalom , u khun jong u Dabid u la don kawei ka para kaba bhabriew ka bym pat shongkurim , kaba kyrteng ka Tamar . U Amnon , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid , u ibha ïa ka .

translation.en: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side , and the space was one cubit on that side : and the little chambers were six cubits on this side , and six cubits on that side .
translation.kha: Ha khmat jong kawei pa kawei ka kamra ap phira la don kawei ka kynroh kaba tbian , sanphew sentimitar ka kynjang bad sanphew sentimitar ka jingrben . ( Kine ki kamra ki la long lai mitar sawdong . )

translation.en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered : the  Lord  is gracious and full of compassion .
translation.kha: U  Trai  um shah ïa ngi ban klet noh ïa ki jingleh baphylla jong u ; u long uba bha sbun bad uba isynei .

translation.en: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion , and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city .
translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew Israel kan ïuhroit ïa ki , Bad pynduh jait ïa kiba dang im baroh kiba dang sah .

translation.en: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun , Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father , that he hath sent comforters unto thee ? are not his servants come unto thee for to search , and to overthrow , and to spy out the land ?
translation.kha: ki nongïalam jong ki Ammon ki ong ïa u syiem ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ka long na ka bynta ka burom i pa jong phi ba u Dabid u phah ïa kine ki rangbah ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem ha phi ? Kam long kumta ! U phah ïa ki hangne kum ki nongsyntiat ban khmih ïa ka ri khnang ba un jop ïa ka !

translation.en: And she made him sleep upon her knees  ; and she called for a man , and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head  ; and she began to afflict him , and his strength went from him .
translation.kha: Ka Delilah ka kynoi thiah ïa u Samson ha pneh jong ka bad nangta ka khot ïa uwei u briew , uba khi noh ïa kita ki hynñiew tylli ki kynthrong shñiuh jong u Samson . Kumta ka sdang ban pynsaja ïa u , naba u la duh noh ïa ka bor jong u .

translation.en: What time she lifteth up herself on high , she scorneth the horse and his rider .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka sdang ban mareh , ka lah ban rkhiebeiñ ïa uno uno u kulai bad u nongshong kulai .

translation.en: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart , but feignedly , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad hadien kane baroh , ka Judah , ka para bymïaineh jong ka Israel , ka la shu leh mynleh ban wan phai sha nga , kam shym da mut shisha . Ma nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Then David said to Ornan , Grant me the place of this threshingfloor , that I may build an altar therein unto the  Lord  : thou shalt grant it me for the full price : that the plague may be stayed from the people .
