translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Die noh ha nga ïa ka jaka shoh kew jong me , ba kumta nga lah ban tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai  , ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem . Ngan siewdor pura ïa ka .

translation.en: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness , and are dead .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la bam ïa ka mana ha ri shyiap , hynrei ki la ïap .

translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  with thanksgiving  ; sing praise upon the harp unto our God :
translation.kha: To rwai ki jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  ; tem ïa ki sur ha ka duitara ha U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah , Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth–gilead ? And he answered him , I am as thou art , and my people as thy people  ; and we will be with thee in the war .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Phin leit bad nga ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?  U Jehoshaphat u jubab ,  Nga long uba la kloi haba phi la kloi , bad kumjuh ruh ka kynhun shipai jong nga . Ngin ïasnohkti lang bad phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Sa shisien pat to leh ïa ka bynta u nongaplangbrot , ha kane ka sien u bymmyntoi ei ei .

translation.en: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord . Wherefore I have brought him forth before you , and specially before thee , O king Agrippa , that , after examination had , I might have somewhat to write .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam don kano kano kaba dei thik shaphang jong u ban thoh sha u Patsha . Kumta nga la wallam ïa u hangne ha khmat jong phi — bad kyrpang ha khmat jong phi , ko syiem Agrippa ! — khnang ba , hadien ka jingtohkit ïa ka kam jong u , nga lah ban don ei ei ban thoh .

translation.en: Who remembered us in our low estate : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: Um shym la klet ïa ngi mynba ngi la shahjop ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: And it came to pass as they came , when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine , that the women came out of all cities of Israel , singing and dancing , to meet king Saul , with tabrets , with joy , and with instruments of musick .
translation.kha: Katba u Dabid u dang wan phai hadien ba u la pynïap ïa u Goliath bad katba ki shipai ki dang wan phai sha la ïing , ki kynthei na man la ka shnong ha Israel ki ïamih ban leit ïashem ïa u syiem Saul . Ki da ïarwai ïa ki jingrwai sngewkmen , ki da ïashad bad ki tem ïa ki kanjari bad ki jingtem ksai .

translation.en: Remove far from me vanity and lies : give me neither poverty nor riches  ; feed me with food convenient for me :
translation.kha: Pyllait ïa nga na ka jingshukor bad shah ïa nga ban ym riewspah lane duk . Kumta ai ïa nga ka jingbam kat ban biang ïa nga .

translation.en: And that day Joshua took Makkedah , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and the king thereof he utterly destroyed , them , and all the souls that were therein  ; he let none remain : and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la tur ïaleh bad kurup ïa ka Makkedah bad ïa u syiem jong ka ha kata ka sngi . U pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew ha ka nongbah ; ym don uwei ruh uba lait im . U leh ïa u syiem ka Makkedah kumba u la leh ïa u syiem ka Jerikho .

translation.en: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law , Blessed be he of the  Lord  , who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead . And Naomi said unto her , The man is near of kin unto us , one of our next kinsmen .
translation.kha: To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa u Boas !  ka Naomi ka pyrta .  U  Trai  borabor u bat ïa la ki kular ha kiba im bad kiba ïap !  Bad ka ong shuh shuh ,  Uta u briew u dei u ba-ha-ïing uba jan eh jong ngi , uwei na kito kiba kitkhlieh ban ri sumar ïa ngi .

translation.en: Neither repented they of their murders , nor of their sorceries , nor of their fornication , nor of their thefts .
translation.kha: Lymne kim shym la kylla-kaba-mut na ki jingpynïap briew jong ki , ki kam myntor jong ki , ki kam awria bajakhlia , ne ka kam tuh jong ki .

translation.en: And I will make her that halted a remnant , and her that was cast far off a strong nation : and the  Lord  shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth , even for ever .
translation.kha: Ki la long kiba dkoh bad jngai na ïing , hynrei ngan pynlong ka jingsdang kaba thymmai bad kito kiba sah , bad kin long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Ngan synshar halor jong ki ha u lum Seïon naduh kata ka por bad junom .

translation.en: And the elders of his house arose , and went to him , to raise him up from the earth : but he would not , neither did he eat bread with them .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar na ka ïingbishar jong u ki leit bad pyrshang ban pynkhie ïa u , hynrei um treh , bad um bam ei ei lem bad ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather , and they found none .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , don katto kane ngut ki briew kiba leit ban lum jingbam , hynrei kim shym shem ei ei ruh em .

translation.en: So shall ye know that I am the  Lord  your God dwelling in Zion , my holy mountain : then shall Jerusalem be holy , and there shall no strangers pass through her any more .
translation.kha: Te ko Israel , phan sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong pha . Nga shong ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga . Ka Jerusalem kan long ka nongbah bakyntang ; ki nongwei kin ym lah ban jop shuh ïa ka lano lano ruh .

translation.en: And he went out to meet Asa , and said unto him , Hear ye me , Asa , and all Judah and Benjamin  ; The  Lord  is with you , while ye be with him  ; and if ye seek him , he will be found of you  ; but if ye forsake him , he will forsake you .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Shahshkor ïa nga , ko syiem Asa , bad phi u paidbah baroh jong ka Judah bad Benjamin ! U  Trai  u long lem bad phi katba phi dang ïailong bad u . Lada phi ap khmih ïa u , un shah ba phin shem ïa u , hynrei lada phi phai na u , un iehnoh noh ïa phi .

translation.en: Behold the land of the Chaldeans  ; this people was not , till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness : they set up the towers thereof , they raised up the palaces thereof  ; and he brought it to ruin .
translation.kha: ( Ki dei ki nong Babilonia , ym ki nong Assyria , kiba la pynlong ba ki mradkhlaw kin tur ïa ka Tyros . Dei ki nong Babilonia kiba la tei ïa ki mot-kerkut , kiba la pyntwa ïa ki jingtei-kut ka Tyros bad ki la iehnoh ïa ka nongbah ha ka jingjot . )

translation.en: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim :
translation.kha: U Ahinadab , u khun jong u Iddo : ka distrik Mahanaim ;

translation.en: Come , my people , enter thou into thy chambers , and shut thy doors about thee : hide thyself as it were for a little moment , until the indignation be overpast .
translation.kha: To rung shapoh ki ïing jong phi , ko ki briew jong nga , bad to khang ïa ka jingkhang shadien jong phi . To buhrieh ïa lade katto katne por haduh ba ka jingbitar U Blei kan kut .

translation.en: And began to salute him , Hail , King of the Jews !
translation.kha: Nangta ki la sdang ban khublei ïa u :  Im slem U Syiem ki Jiw !

translation.en: And David said , Solomon my son is young and tender , and the house that is to be builded for the  Lord  must be exceeding magnifical , of fame and of glory throughout all countries : I will therefore now make preparation for it . So David prepared abundantly before his death .
translation.kha: U Dabid u pyrkhat ,  Ka Templ ba u Solomon u khun jong nga un tei ka dei ban long kaba ishongkun bad donnam ha ka pyrthei . Hynrei u dang samla bad um pat ju mlien , kumta nga dei ban pynkhreh lypa na ka bynta jong ka .  Kumta u Dabid u la pynbiang lypa shibun ki tiar shuwa ba un ïap .

translation.en: Terrors take hold on him as waters , a tempest stealeth him away in the night .
translation.kha: Ka jingshyrkhei kan sa shoh kum ka jingshlei bakynsan ; ka lyer mynmiet kan beh ïa ki baroh nangta ;

translation.en: Then stood up Phinehas , and executed judgment : and so the plague was stayed .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Phinehas u la ïeng bad pynshitom ïa kiba leh pop bad ïa ka khlam la pynsangeh .

translation.en: He shall build me an house , and I will stablish his throne for ever .
translation.kha: Un dei ma u , u ban tei ka templ ïa nga , bad ngan pynthikna ba ka longïing syiem jong u kan ïai bteng junom .

translation.en: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiwei pat ki jingjia ha ka jingsynshar jong u , naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : uno uno uba khmih ïa ka briew bad kwah ban ïoh ïa ka u la hap ha ka jingpynrem jong ka jingklim bad ka hapoh ka dohnud jong u .

translation.en: Then said Pilate unto him , Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat u la ong ïa u ,  Mem ïohsngew ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ki mudui ïa me ?

translation.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host  ; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud , recorder .
translation.kha: U Joab , uba shi para bad u Abishai u long u nongïalam jong ka kynhun shipai ; u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u Ahilud u khmih halor ki jingbuh jingthoh ;

translation.en: But when they deliver you up , take no thought how or what ye shall speak : for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak .
translation.kha: Haba ki tian bishar ïa phi , wat khuslai shaphang kaei kaba phin ong lane kumno phin ong ; haba ka por ka poi , yn sa ai ha phi ïa kaei kaba phin ong .

translation.en: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath–jearim , and the border went out on the west , and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah :
translation.kha: U pud uba shaphang shathie u sdang na tduh jong ka Kiriath Jearim bad u suh shaduh ki Umpohliew jong ka Nephtoah .

translation.en: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament .
translation.kha: Te , kane ka jingïapher , ka pynlong ruh ïa U Jisu u nongbahkhlieh ïa ka jutang kaba kham bha .

translation.en: This thou knowest , that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me ; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes .
translation.kha: Me tip ba uwei pa uwei uba don ha ka probins    jong ka Asia , ba kynthup ïa u Phygelos bad u Hermogenes , ki la iehnoh ïa nga .

translation.en: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari , throughout their families , by the house of their fathers ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter , neither shalt thou take her son s daughter , or her daughter s daughter , to uncover her nakedness  ; for they are her near kinswomen : it is wickedness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka khun ne ka ksiew jong kano kano ka briew kaba me la ïathiah shongkha ; ki long kiba dang ïadei jan bad me , bad kata ka long kaba shong sang .

translation.en: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered , yea , thy shame shall be seen : I will take vengeance , and I will not meet thee as a man .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïohi ba pha long kaba lyngkhuit ; kin ïohi ba la pynrit bad pynlehrain ïa pha . Ngan pynhiarkput , bad yn ym don ba lah ban pynsangeh ïa nga .

translation.en: But thou , Beth–lehem Ephratah , though thou be little among the thousands of Judah , yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel  ; whose goings forth have been from of old , from everlasting .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Bethlehem Ephrathah , pha long kaba rit tam na ki shnong ha Judah , hynrei na pha ngan pynmih ïa u nongsynshar ïa ki Israel , uba ka tynrai longïing jong u ka long na ki por mynbarim .

translation.en: And thou saidst , I shall be a lady for ever : so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart , neither didst remember the latter end of it .
translation.kha: Pha pyrkhat ba phan ïailong ka syiem , bad pham shym la shim khia ïa kine kiei kiei lane pyrkhat kumno ba kine baroh kin kut .

translation.en: Behold , he drinketh up a river , and hasteth not : he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth .
translation.kha: Um sheptieng ïa ka wah kaba tuid stet ; u long jai jai haba ka Jordan ka tynrah ïa ka durkhmat jong u .

translation.en: Who art thou , O great mountain ? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain : and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings , crying , Grace , grace unto it .
translation.kha: Ki jingjynthut kiba khraw kat ki lumbah kin jah noh ha khmat jong me . Men tei pat ïa ka Templ , bad katba me dang buh ïa u maw bakhatduh ha la ka jaka , ki briew kin pyrta ‘ Kaba itynnat , kaba itynnat !’

translation.en: And they drew nigh unto the village , whither they went : and he made as though he would have gone further .
translation.kha: Haba ki la jan poi hajan ka nongrit sha kaba ki thmu ban leit , U Jisu u la leh kumba u nang leit kham jngai ;

translation.en: And the meat of his table , and the sitting of his servants , and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel  ; his cupbearers also , and their apparel  ; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the  Lord   ; there was no more spirit in her .
translation.kha: Ka la ïohi ïa ka jingbam ba la sam ha ka miej jong u , ki jaka sah ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , ka jingpynbeit ryntih ïa ki nongtrei ha ka ïingsyiem jong u bad ki jingriam ba ki phong , ki jaiñ jong ki shakri jong u , kiba ap ha ki jingkhawai bad ki jingainguh ba u kñia ha ka Templ . Ka la shu lyngngoh ngaiñ bad sngewphylla .

translation.en: According to my earnest expectation and my hope , that in nothing I shall be ashamed , but that with all boldness , as always , so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body , whether it be by life , or by death .
translation.kha: Katkum ka jingkwah bajur bad ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka long ba ngan ym shah rem ha ka kamram jong nga , hynrei , ha ki por baroh , bad kyrpang ïa mynta hi , ngan da long uba dap da ka jingshlur , khnang ba da ka longrynïeng jong nga baroh , ngan wanrah burom ïa U Khrist , la nga im ne nga ïap .

translation.en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel : and this is it that their father spake unto them , and blessed them  ; every one according to his blessing he blessed them .
translation.kha: Kine ki long kita ki khat-ar jait Israel , bad kane ka long kaba u kpa jong ki u la ong katba u ai ïa ki kyntien khatduh kiba ïadei bad uwei pa uwei u khun .

translation.en: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign  ; Behold , a virgin shall conceive , and bear a son , and shall call his name Immanuel .
translation.kha: Te kumta , U  Trai  un ai hi ka dak ha phi : Ka theisotti kaba punkhun kan kha u khun bad kan khot kyrteng ïa u , ‘ U Immanuel .’

translation.en: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet  ; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept , and the priests , and the Levites , and all Judah and Israel that were present , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Naduh ki sngi jong u Samuel u nongïathuhlypa , ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ym pat ju rakhe kum kane . Ym don napdeng ki syiem ba-mynshuwa kiba la rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum kane ba la rakhe da u Syiem Josaïah , ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , bad ki paid Judah , Israel , bad Jerusalem

translation.en: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha , which is , being interpreted , The place of a skull .
translation.kha: Ki la ïalam ïa U Jisu sha ka jaka ba la khot Golgotha , kaba mut  Ka jaka ka Maloi Khlieh .

translation.en: And she called his name Joseph  ; and said , The  Lord  shall add to me another son .
translation.kha: To U  Trai  un ai ïa nga sa uwei u khun  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Joseph .

translation.en: And they shall come thither , and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence .
translation.kha: Haba ki wan phai , ki dei ban iehnoh noh ïa baroh ki bleithaw ba-isaitmet bad ba-ijli kiba ki shem .

translation.en: He shall not strive , nor cry  ; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets .
translation.kha: Un ym ïakajia lane pyrta , lane kren ki jingkren bajam ha ki lynti bah .

translation.en: And David arose , and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish , the son of Maoch , king of Gath .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u hynriewspah ngut ki leit sha u Akhish u khun jong u Maokh , u syiem ka Gath .

translation.en: David therefore calleth him Lord , how is he then his son ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u la khot ïa u ‘ U Trai’ ; kumno , te , U Messaïah u lah ban long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?

translation.en: Behold , we put bits in the horses  mouths , that they may obey us  ; and we turn about their whole body .
translation.kha: Ngi pyndait lakam ha ka shyntur jong u kulai lada ngi kwah ba un kohnguh ïa ngi , bad kumta ngi lah ban pynïaid ïa u kat shaba ngi mon .

translation.en: And the men turned their faces from thence , and went toward Sodom : but Abraham stood yet before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah ki la mihnoh nangta , bad ki la nang leit shaphang Sodom ; hynrei U  Trai  u dang don bad u Abraham .

translation.en: They were children of fools , yea , children of base men : they were viler than the earth .
translation.kha: Ki long ka kynhun bymdondor , ki briew bym don ba ñiew ! Ïa ki la beh noh na ka ri .

translation.en: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days , after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine :
translation.kha: Hadien ba phi la dep shoh kew bad dep khem ïa ki sohwaiñ , rakhe hynñiew sngi ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

translation.en: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel , who was shut up  ; and he said , Let us meet together in the house of God , within the temple , and let us shut the doors of the temple : for they will come to slay thee  ; yea , in the night will they come to slay thee .
translation.kha: Hamar kane ka por , nga leit ban jngoh ïa u Shemaïah , u khun jong u Delaïah bad u ksiew jong u Mehetabel , u bym shym lah ban mih na ïing jong u . U ong ïa nga ,  Ma phi bad nga , ngi dei ban ïaleit bad rieh lang ha ka Jaka Kyntang jong ka Templ bad khang tala ïa ki jingkhang , namar kin wan ban pynïap ïa phi .

translation.en: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time , because the  Lord  God of Israel fought for Israel .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la jop ïa kine ki syiem baroh bad ïa ka ri jong ki tang shisien ïaleh namar U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ïaleh na ka bynta ki Israel .

translation.en: So David slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid .

translation.en: But Jezebel his wife came to him , and said unto him , Why is thy spirit so sad , that thou eatest no bread ?
translation.kha: Ka Jesebel ka tnga jong u ka leit sha u , bad ka kylli ,  Balei phi khuslai katne katne ? Balei phim treh bam ?

translation.en: As the lily among thorns , so is my love among the daughters .
translation.kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong phi ki tap ïa nga da ki jingdoh ; ka jingieit jong phi ka kham bha ban ïa ka waiñ .

translation.en: Look upon Zion , the city of our solemnities : thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation , a tabernacle that shall not be taken down  ; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed , neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken .
translation.kha: Khmih ïa ka Seïon , ka nongbah ha kaba ngi rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong ngi . Peit ïa ka Jerusalem ! Katno ka long ka jaka kaba shngain ban shong ban sah ha ka ! Kan long kum ka ïingjaiñ ïa kaba yn ym pynkynriah shuh , kiba ïa ki snar ym shym la phut noh , bad ïa ki tyllai ym shym la pyndkut .

translation.en: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah  ;
translation.kha: U Toi u syiem ka Hamath u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la jop ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei jong u Hadadeser .

translation.en: The king answered unto Daniel , and said , Of a truth it is , that your God is a God of gods , and a Lord of kings , and a revealer of secrets , seeing thou couldest reveal this secret .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ong ,  U Blei jong me u long uba khraw tam na ki blei baroh , U Trai halor ki syiem , bad uta uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan . Nga tip ïa kane namar me la lah ban batai ïa kane ka jingmaïan .

translation.en: So he measured the court , an hundred cubits long , and an hundred cubits broad , foursquare  ; and the altar that was before the house .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la thew ïa ka phyllaw kaba shapoh bad ka la don sanphew mitar sawdong . Ka Templ ka don shaphang sepngi bad ha khmat jong ka , ka don ka duwan .

translation.en: And he sent away the multitude , and took ship , and came into the coasts of Magdala .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la phah noh ïa u paidbah , u la kiew ha ka lieng , bad u la leit sha ka thain Magadan .

translation.en: And all the city was gathered together at the door .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew jong ka shnong ki la ïalum ha khmat jong ka ïing .

translation.en: I also will choose their delusions , and will bring their fears upon them  ; because when I called , none did answer  ; when I spake , they did not hear : but they did evil before mine eyes , and chose that in which I delighted not .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan wallam jingjot halor jong ki — Ïa kita kiei kiei kiba ki sheptieng — namar ym don uwei ruh uba jubab haba nga khot lane shahshkor haba nga kren . Ki jied ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: And whence is this to me , that the mother of my Lord should come to me ?
translation.kha: Balei kane ka jingjia bakhraw ka wan jia ha nga , ba ka kmie jong U Trai jong nga ka wan ban jngoh ïa nga ?

translation.en: For in many things we offend all . If any man offend not in word , the same is a perfect man , and able also to bridle the whole body .
translation.kha: Baroh na ngi , ngi bakla bunsien . Hynrei lada u briew um ju bakla ha kaei kaba u kren , u long uba janai bad u long ruh uba lah ban synshar ïa lade nadong shadong .

translation.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Ai ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Ai ïa kine nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh waiñ jong ka .

translation.en: And they shall amerce him in an hundred shekels of silver , and give them unto the father of the damsel , because he hath brought up an evil name upon a virgin of Israel : and she shall be his wife  ; he may not put her away all his days .
translation.kha: Kin daiñ kuna ïa u shispah tylli ki sbai rupa bad ai ïa kata ka kuna ha u kpa jong kata ka samla , namar uta u briew u la pynjahburom ïa ka theisotti Israel . Nalorkata , ma ka , kan ïailong ka tnga jong u , bad un ym lah ban pyllait ïa ka katba u dang im .

translation.en: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah , and smote him , and slew him , and reigned in his stead , in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew jong ka jingsynshar u Jotham u khun jong u Ussaïah kum u syiem ka Judah , u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Pekah , u pynïap ïa u , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: When thou comest into thy neighbour s vineyard , then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure  ; but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaid lynti na ka bri sohwaiñ jongno jongno , phi lah ban bam sohwaiñ katba phi kwah , hynrei phim dei ban rah ïa ki ha la ka jingdiang .

translation.en: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened ; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling , and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints ,
translation.kha: Nga duwai ba yn plie ïa ki jingmut jong phi khnang ba phin ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong u , ba phin tip kaei kata ka jingkyrmen ïa kaba u la khot ïa phi , katno ki jingkynrei spah ki long kita ki jingkyrkhu baphylla kiba U Blei u la kular ïa la ki briew ,

translation.en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses , and to Eleazar the priest , and unto the princes of the congregation , saying ,
translation.kha: ki la leit sha u Moses , u Eleasar , bad kiwei pat ki nongïalam jong u paidlang , bad ki ong ,

translation.en: Both young men , and maidens  ; old men , and children :
translation.kha: ki samla kynthei bad ki samla shynrang , kiba la tymmen bad ki khynnah ruh .

translation.en: He hath led me , and brought me into darkness , but not into light .
translation.kha: U la beh ïa nga jylliew bad kham jylliew sha ka jingdum ,

translation.en: And now come I to thee  ; and these things I speak in the world , that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga wan noh sha me , bad nga ong ïa kine kiei kiei ha ka pyrthei khnang ba kin lah ban ïoh ïa ka jingkmen jong nga ha ki dohnud jong ki ha ka jingdap pura baroh .

translation.en: Obey them that have the rule over you , and submit yourselves : for they watch for your souls , as they that must give account , that they may do it with joy , and not with grief : for that is unprofitable for you .
translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa ki nongïalam jong phi da kaba bud ïa ki hukum jong ki . Ki sharai ïa ki mynsiem jong phi khlem da thait , namar ki dei ban ai jingkheiñ ïa ka kam jong ki sha U Blei . Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki , kin trei ïa ka kam da kaba kmen ; lada phim kohnguh , kin trei ïa ka kam da kaba sngewsih , bad kata kan ym ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: That they should seek the Lord , if haply they might feel after him , and find him , though he be not far from every one of us :
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane khnang ba kin wad ïa u , bad lehse kin shem ïa u haba ki tba shane shatai ïa u . Pynban U Blei da shisha um long jngai na uno uno na ngi ;

translation.en: The sun shall be no more thy light by day  ; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee : but the  Lord  shall be unto thee an everlasting light , and thy God thy glory .
translation.kha: Ka sngi kan ym long shuh ka jingshai jong pha mynsngi , lymne u bnai un long ka jingshai jong pha mynmiet , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan long ka jingshai bymjukut jong pha ; ka jingshai jong ka burom jong nga kan tyngshaiñ ha pha .

translation.en: If my people , which are called by my name , shall humble themselves , and pray , and seek my face , and turn from their wicked ways  ; then will I hear from heaven , and will forgive their sin , and will heal their land .
translation.kha: lada ki duwai sha nga bad ki kylla-kaba-mut bad phai noh na ki kam bymman ba ki leh , te ngan shahshkor ïa ki na bneng , ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki , bad ngan pynmanbha biang ïa ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: Which made heaven , and earth , the sea , and all that therein is : which keepeth truth for ever :
translation.kha: U Nongthaw jong ka bneng , ka pyrthei bad ka duriaw , bad baroh kiba don ha ki . U bat ïa ki jingkular jong u borabor ;

translation.en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U  Trai na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh ïa ki .

translation.en: Thou shalt not plow with an ox and an ass together .
translation.kha: Wat pynlur lyngkha lang ïa u masi bad ka kada .

translation.en: The foot shall tread it down , even the feet of the poor , and the steps of the needy .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la shah banbeiñ , ki ïaid halor jong ka mynta bad ki ïuh ïa ka hapoh ki kjat jong ki .

translation.en: At that time the  Lord  separated the tribe of Levi , to bear the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , to stand before the  Lord  to minister unto him , and to bless in his name , unto this day .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U  Trai  u thung ïa ki rangbah kiba na ka jait Lebi ban sumar ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ban shakri ïa u kum ki lyngdoh , bad ban ai ïa ki jingkyrkhu ha ka kyrteng jong u . Kine ki dang dei ki kamram jong ki haduh mynta .

translation.en: Blessed art thou , O land , when thy king is the son of nobles , and thy princes eat in due season , for strength , and not for drunkenness !
translation.kha: Hynrei ka ri ka long kaba donbok ban don u syiem uba pynlong ïa la ki jong ki rai bad ki nongïalam kiba bam ha ka por kaba dei , kiba bat synshar ïa lade bad ki bym buaid .

translation.en: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers  ; as Barnabas , and Simeon that was called Niger , and Lucius of Cyrene , and Manaen , which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch , and Saul .
translation.kha: Ha ka balang ha Antiokh la don katto katne ngut ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki nonghikai : U Barnabas , u Simeon ( ïa uba la khot u Niger ) , u Lukios ( na Kyrini ) bad u Manaen ( ïa uba la pynsan pynrangbah bad u Herod Antipas uba long u lyngskor ) bad u Saul .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the fourth day , when they arose early in the morning , that he rose up to depart : and the damsel s father said unto his son in law , Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread , and afterward go your way .
translation.kha: Ha ka step jong ka sngi kaba saw ki khie dang step bad ki khreh ban ïaleit noh . Hynrei u kpa jong ka kynthei u ong ha u Lebi ,  Da bam da dih shuwa . Kan bha ïa phi . Phi lah ban sa leit hadien .

translation.en: And the king said , Divide the living child in two , and give half to the one , and half to the other .
translation.kha: u ong ,  Phiah arliang ïa u khunlung uba dang im , bad ai shiliang ha kawei , bad shiliang ha kawei pat .

translation.en: And going on from thence , he saw other two brethren , James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , in a ship with Zebedee their father , mending their nets  ; and he called them .
translation.kha: U la nang ïaid u la ïohi ïa ar ngut kiwei pat shi para , ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi . Ki la don ha ka lieng lem bad u Sebedi u kpa jong ki , ba ki dang ïapynkhreh ïa ki jar jong ki . U Jisu u la khot ïa ki ,

translation.en: Go in , speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , that he let the children of Israel go out of his land .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad ong ha u Pharaoh ba u dei ban shah ïa ki Israel ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .

translation.en: But Saul had given Michal his daughter , David s wife , to Phalti the son of Laish , which was of Gallim .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Saul u la ai ïa ka Mikhal ka khun jong u , kaba la long ka tnga jong u Dabid , ha u Palti , u khun jong u Laish , uba na ka nongrit Gallim .

translation.en: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the  Lord  , how I hid an hundred men of the  Lord s  prophets by fifty in a cave , and fed them with bread and water ?
translation.kha: Phim shym ïohsngew ba katba ka Jesebel ka dang pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  , nga la buhrieh shispah ngut na ki ha ki krem , ha ki ar kynhun kiba sanphew ngut kawei kawei ka kynhun , bad pynbiang jingbam bad um ïa ki ?

translation.en: To him the porter openeth  ; and the sheep hear his voice : and he calleth his own sheep by name , and leadeth them out .
translation.kha: U nongap jingkhang u plie ïa ka jingkhang na ka bynta jong u ; ki langbrot ki ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u katba u dang khot ïa la ki langbrot da ka kyrteng , bad u ïalam ïa ki shabar .

translation.en: And he came by the Spirit into the temple : and when the parents brought in the child Jesus , to do for him after the custom of the law ,
translation.kha: Haba la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem , u Simeon u la leit sha ka Templ . Haba ki kmie ki kpa ki la wallam ïa u khunlung Jisu hapoh ka Templ ban pyndep na ka bynta jong u ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ,

translation.en: As every man hath received the gift , even so minister the same one to another , as good stewards of the manifold grace of God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei , kum u sordar babha jong ki jingai ba bun jait jong U Blei , u dei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingbha jong kiwei ïa ka jingai bakyrpang kaba u la ïohpdiang na U Blei .

translation.en: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language , but to the house of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ngam shym la phah ïa me sha ka jaitbynriew kaba kren ïa ka ktien nongwei kaba eh ban sngewthuh , hynrei sha ki Israel .

translation.en: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , the concubine of Saul , had done .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei ba ka Rispah ka la leh ,

translation.en: So we abode in the valley over against Beth–peor .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi ïashong sah ha kata ka them kaba marpyrshah ka Bethpeor .

translation.en: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat , the servant of Solomon the son of David , is risen up , and hath rebelled against his lord .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat u ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Solomon , u syiem jong u .

translation.en: They shall walk after the  Lord  : he shall roar like a lion : when he shall roar , then the children shall tremble from the west .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga kin sa wan bud ïa nga haba nga kyrhuh kum u sing ïa ki nongshun jong ki . Kin wan kyrkieh sha nga na sha sepngi .

translation.en: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened , neither would he let the children of Israel go  ; as the  Lord  had spoken by Moses .
translation.kha: bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah kren lyngba u Moses , u Pharaoh um shym pyllait ïa ki Israel ban leit .

translation.en: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter  ; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me , saying , Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof , and let us cut him off from the land of the living , that his name may be no more remembered .
translation.kha: Nga la long kum i khunlangbrot balui lui iba la shah ïalam sha ka jingpynïap , bad ngam shym tip ba ka la long pyrshah ïa nga ba ki la ïapynkhreh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Ki la ïa-ong ,  To ngin khet ïa u dieng katba u dang khlaiñ ; to ngin pynïap ïa u khnang ba yn ym don mano mano ba kynmaw shuh ïa u .

translation.en: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard , neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard  ; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat leit phai shuh sha ka brisoh ban khar ïa ki sohwaiñ ba la iehnoh lane tam ïa kito ki sohwaiñ kiba la hap ; ieh ïa ki na ka bynta kiba duk bad ki nongwei . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jehoram u khun jong u , u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Jesus , when he had cried again with a loud voice , yielded up the ghost .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la lynñiar biang bad u la ring pynhiar mynsiem khatduh .

translation.en: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles  ; and he did eat and drink , and rose up , and went his way : thus Esau despised his birthright .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ai kpu bad katto katne ka syrwa jhur ïa u . U ruh u la bam bad dih , bad nangta u ïeng joit bad u leit noh . Kata ka long kumno ba u Iso u sumar ïa la ki hok kum u khun nyngkong .

translation.en: So Paul departed from among them .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u Paul u la mihnoh na ka jingïalang .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that the city shall be built to the  Lord  from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner .
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba ïa ka Jerusalem baroh kawei yn tei pat kum ka nongbah jong nga , naduh u Mot Hananel shaphang sepngi haduh ka Khyrdop Kyndong .

translation.en: And the  Lord  rooted them out of their land in anger , and in wrath , and in great indignation , and cast them into another land , as it is this day .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar shla , bad ha kata ka jingbitar , u rat dyngkhong ïa ki na ka ri jong ki bad u bret ïa ki sha ka ri nongwei , bad hangta ki dang don haduh mynta .’

translation.en: And his disciples answered him , From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness ?
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa u ,  Nangno , ha kane ka ri shyiap ba uno uno u lah ban ïoh jingbam ka ban dap ban bsa ïa kine ki briew baroh ?

translation.en: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them  ; and they said unto the olive tree , Reign thou over us .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por , ki dieng ki ïamih ban jied u syiem na ka bynta jong ki . Ki ong ha u dieng Olib , ‘ To long u syiem jong ngi .’

translation.en: After many days thou shalt be visited : in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword , and is gathered out of many people , against the mountains of Israel , which have been always waste : but it is brought forth out of the nations , and they shall dwell safely all of them .
translation.kha: Hadien bun snem ngan hukum ïa u ba un hiarthma ïa ka ri ha kaba ïa ki briew la wallam biang napdeng shibun ki jaitbynriew bad kiba la im khlem jingsheptieng ïa ka thma . Un hiarthma ïa ki lumbah ka Israel kiba la sah kynjah bad sah shrah la slem bah , hynrei ha kaba mynta ki briew ki shong ha ka jingshngain .

translation.en: And Pathrusim , and Casluhim , ( out of whom came the Philistines , ) and Caphtorim .
translation.kha: ka Pathrus , ka Kasluh bad ka Krit na kiba la hiarpateng ki Philistia .

translation.en: Shall I not visit for these things ? saith the  Lord  : shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kine kiei kiei , ngan pynhiarkput halor kane ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: For if God spared not the natural branches , take heed lest he also spare not thee .
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la pyllait ïa ki Jiw , kiba long kum ki tnat tynrai ; hato phi pyrkhat un pyllait ïa phi ?

translation.en: Seek ye out of the book of the  Lord  , and read : no one of these shall fail , none shall want her mate : for my mouth it hath commanded , and his spirit it hath gathered them .
translation.kha: To wad ha ka kitab jong U  Trai  ïa ki jingthaw ba-im bad pule ïa kaei ba ka ong . Yn ym don tang kawei ruh na kine ki jingthaw ka ban jah noh , bad yn ym don tang kawei ruh ka ban ym don lok . U  Trai  u la hukum ba kan long kumta ; ma u hi da lade un wallam lang ïa ki .

translation.en: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , te , bad to ïoh jinghikai ïa kaei ba ka pharshi u nongbet ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah , two years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Elah u khun jong u Baasha u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar ar snem ha Tirsah .

translation.en: And the taskmasters of the people went out , and their officers , and they spake to the people , saying , Thus saith Pharaoh , I will not give you straw .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nongpyntrei mraw bad ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam ki la mihnoh bad ki la ong ha ki Israel ,  U Pharaoh u ong ba un ym ai phlangïap shuh ïa phi .

translation.en: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them , he said to the ruler of his house , Bring these men home , and slay , and make ready  ; for these men shall dine with me at noon .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u ïohi ïa u Benjamin lem bad ki , u ong ha u shakri uba peit ïa ka ïing jong u ,  Khie ïalam ïa kine ki briew sha ïing jong nga . Kin sa ïabam ryngkat bad nga ha ka por shiteng sngi ; kumta pynïap uwei na ki jingri bad shet ïa u .

translation.en: Thy kingdom come . Thy will be done in earth , as it is in heaven .
translation.kha: ai ba ka Hima jong me kan wan ; ai ba ka mon jong me yn leh ha ka khyndew kumba ka long ha bneng .

translation.en: And the men were afraid , because they were brought into Joseph s house  ; and they said , Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in  ; that he may seek occasion against us , and fall upon us , and take us for bondmen , and our asses .
translation.kha: Haba la ïalam ïa ki sha ka ïing , ki la sheptieng bad ki la ïa-pyrkhat ,  La ïalam ïa ngi shane imat namar kito ki pisa ba la pynphai ha ki byrni jong ngi ha ka sien kaba nyngkong . Kin sa kynrup kynsan ïa ngi , kin shim noh ïa ki kada jong ngi , bad kin pynlong ïa ngi ki mraw jong u .

translation.en: Who gave himself for our sins , that he might deliver us from this present evil world , according to the will of God and our Father :
translation.kha: Khnang ban pyllait ïa ngi na kane ka juk basniew kaba mynta , U Khrist u la aiti ïa lade na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , da kaba kohnguh ïa ka mon U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi .

translation.en: Whereof I am made a minister , according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you , to fulfil the word of God ;
translation.kha: Bad ïa nga la pynlong u shakri jong ka balang da U Blei , uba la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi . Ka long ka kam ban pynbna pura ïa ka khubor jong u ,

translation.en: That thou keep this commandment without spot , unrebukeable , until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ha khmat U Blei , uba ai jingim ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad ha khmat U Khrist Jisu , uba phla shai ïa la ka jingngeit ha khmat u Pontios Pilat , nga hukum ïa me ba men kohnguh ïa la ki hukum bad ban sumar hok ïa ki haduh kata ka Sngi haba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi un paw .

translation.en: Gather up thy wares out of the land , O inhabitant of the fortress .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , phi don hapoh ka jingshah kerkut ! To lumlang ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi .

translation.en: Thou art the  Lord  the God , who didst choose Abram , and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldeans , and gavest him the name of Abraham  ;
translation.kha: Ma me , A  Trai  U Blei me la jied ïa u Abram bad me ïalam ïa u na ka Ur ha Babilon ; me pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Abraham .

translation.en: From Aroer , which is by the brink of the river of Arnon , and from the city that is by the river , even unto Gilead , there was not one city too strong for us : the  Lord  our God delivered all unto us :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la shah ba ngin ïohknieh ïa ki shnong baroh naduh Aroer kaba harud ka Them Arnon , bad ïa ka nongbah hapdeng kata ka them , haduh Gilead . Ym don kawei ruh ka shnong ïa kaba ngim shym jop .

translation.en: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness ; whose end shall be according to their works .
translation.kha: Kumta kam long kaei kaei kaba khraw lada ki shakri jong u ki thawdur ïa lade ban i kum ki shakri jong ka hok . Ha kaba khatduh kin ïoh thik kumta ïa kaei kaba ki jingleh jong ki , ki dei hok .

translation.en: And Ruth said , Entreat me not to leave thee , or to return from following after thee : for whither thou goest , I will go  ; and where thou lodgest , I will lodge : thy people shall be my people , and thy God my God :
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Ruth ka jubab ,  Wat ong ïa nga ban iehnoh ïa phi ! Shah ba ngan leit bad phi . Kat shaba phi leit , ngan leit ; kat haba phi shong phi sah , hangta ngan shong ngan sah . Ki briew jong phi kin long ki briew jong nga , bad U Blei jong phi un long U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: Now if Timothy come , see that he may be with you without fear : for he worketh the work of the Lord , as I also do .
translation.kha: Lada u Timothi un wan poi ïaid lynti sha phi , da pynthikna ba un sngew ba phi pdiang sngewbha hapdeng jong phi , namar u trei na ka bynta U Trai , kum ma nga .

translation.en: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God any bullock , or sheep , wherein is blemish , or any evilfavouredness : for that is an abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Wat kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa u masi lane ka langbrot kiba don kano kano ka jingduna ; U  Trai  u isih ïa kaba kum kata .

translation.en: And he said , If the  Lord  do not help thee , whence shall I help thee ? out of the barnfloor , or out of the winepress ?
translation.kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Lada U  Trai  um ïarap ïa pha , Kaei ka jingïarap nga lah ban ai ? Hato nga don kew ei ei lane ka waiñ ?

translation.en: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes , which should be over the whole kingdom  ;
translation.kha: U Darius u la rai ban thung shispah arphew ngut ki lat ban bat kam ha kylleng ka hima jong u .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that their rulers , and elders , and scribes ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw , ki tymmen ki san , bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach , he runneth upon me like a giant .
translation.kha: U ïai pynmynsaw ïa nga ; u tur ïaleh kum u shipai ba la lamwir da ka jingisih .

translation.en: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time .
translation.kha: Ki long na ka bynta jong phi , kiba da ka jingngeit la ri kyndong da ka bor U Blei ïa ka jingpynim kaba la pynkhreh ban sa pynpaw ha kaba kut jong ka por .

translation.en: There shall none of his meat be left  ; therefore shall no man look for his goods .
translation.kha: Haba u bam , ym ju don jingpynsah tam , hynrei mynta um don shuh ka jingpahuh pahai .

translation.en: So they ran both together : and the other disciple did outrun Peter , and came first to the sepulchre .
translation.kha: Baroh ar ngut ki la shu mareh , hynrei uta uwei pat u synran u la kham mareh stet ban ïa u Petros bad u la poi nyngkong ha ka jingtep .

translation.en: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads , and shall have linen breeches upon their loins  ; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat .
translation.kha: Khnang ba kin ym mih syep , kin phong ki jingspong jaiñ linen bad ki patlun jaiñ linen , khlem ki panpoh .

translation.en: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy .
translation.kha: U la tip bha ba ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la aiti ïa U Jisu ha u namar ki la sngewpihuiñ .

translation.en: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel : and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel–meholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room .
translation.kha: pynsleh ïa u Jehu u khun jong u Nimshi kum u syiem ka Israel , bad pynsleh ïa u Elisha u khun jong u Shaphat na Abel Meholah ban long nongïathuhlypa hadien jong me .

translation.en: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named ,
translation.kha: na uba man la ka longïing ha bneng bad ha ka pyrthei ka ïohpdiang ïa la ka kyrteng kaba shisha .

translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled , they likewise fled before Abishai his brother , and entered into the city . Then Joab came to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba ki Ammon ki ïohi ba ki Syria ki phet ïap , ki phet ïap na u Abishai bad ki kynran sha ka nongbah . Nangta u Joab u leit phai noh sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Why doesn't he eat lunch with me anymore ?
translation.kha: Balei um ju bamjasngi shuh bad nga ?

translation.en: Why will ye die , thou and thy people , by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence , as the  Lord  hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon ?
translation.kha: Balei ba ma phi bad ki briew jong phi phin ïap ha ka thma lane ha ka jingïapthngan lane ha ka jingpang ? Kata ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia ïa kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka bym pyndem ha u syiem ka Babilonia .

translation.en: And I went out after him , and smote him , and delivered it out of his mouth : and when he arose against me , I caught him by his beard , and smote him , and slew him .
translation.kha: nga buddien ïa u , nga ïaleh bad u , bad nga pyllait im ïa uta u khunlangbrot . Bad lada u sing ne ka dngiem ki kynrup ïa nga , nga kem na ka ryndang bad nga tangon haduh ba kin da ïap .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  also came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And he stayed yet other seven days  ; and sent forth the dove  ; which returned not again unto him any more .
translation.kha: Nangta u ap sa hynñiew sngi , bad u pyllait biang ïa kata ka paro ; ha kane ka sien kam shym la wan phai shuh .

translation.en: And I heard , but I understood not : then said I , O my Lord , what shall be the end of these things ?
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u la ong , hynrei ngam shemphang ïa ka . Kumta nga la kylli ,  Hynrei , ko rangbah , kumno kane baroh kan kut ?

translation.en: But exhort one another daily , while it is called To day  ; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin .
translation.kha: Pynban , khnang ba ym don uwei na phi u ban shah shukor ha ka pop bad eh dohnud ; phi dei ban ïarap iwei ïa iwei pat ha la ka sngi , katba ka ktien  Mynta  ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kren ïa ngi .

translation.en: He pursued them , and passed safely  ; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet .
translation.kha: U bud ha ka jingbeh bad u ïaid ryntih ha ka jingshngain stet katta katta ba um shym la dei satia ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: But when he saw Jesus afar off , he ran and worshipped him ,
translation.kha: Kham na jngai u la ïohi ïa U Jisu ; kumta u la mareh , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la lynñiar ha ka sur bajam ,

translation.en: For they be thy people , and thine inheritance , which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt , from the midst of the furnace of iron :
translation.kha: Naba ki dei ki briew jong me , kiba me la wan ïalam na Ijipt , napdeng ka lawar ding baklang .

translation.en: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine , when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la dap khyndaiphew khyndai snem mynba la otsher ïa u ,

translation.en: On the seventh day , when the heart of the king was merry with wine , he commanded Mehuman , Biztha , Harbona , Bigtha , and Abagtha , Zethar , and Carcas , the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew jong ka jingkhawai jong u , u syiem u dang dih bad sngewkmen , kumta u khot ïa ki hynñiew ngut ki ïunukh kiba long ki shakri ba ju shakri ha syndah jong u , ïa u Mehuman , u Bistha , u Harbona , u Bigtha , u Abagtha , u Sethar bad u Karkas .

translation.en: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath : they cry not when he bindeth them .
translation.kha: Kito ki bym don blei ki ïai bitar , bad wat haba la pynshitom ïa ki , kim ju duwai ban ïoh ka jingïarap .

translation.en: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah .
translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u la long u syiem ka Judah ha ka snem kaba khatwei ha kaba u Joram u khun jong u Ahab , u la long u syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: It is being used by God to do his will .
translation.kha: La pyndonkam da U Blei ban leh ïa ka mon jong u .

translation.en: After that he poureth water into a basin , and began to wash the disciples  feet , and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded .
translation.kha: Nangta u la theh khyndiat ka um ha ka dabor bad u la sdang ban sait ïa ki kjat jong ki synran bad ñiad pynrkhiang ïa ki da kata ka jaiñ ñiad ba la teh ha la ka syngkai .

translation.en: And the sons of Reuben  ; Hanoch , and Pallu , and Hezron , and Carmi .
translation.kha: bad ki khun shynrang jong u Reuben : u Hanokh , u Pallu , u Hesron , bad u Karmi .

translation.en: And Reuben returned unto the pit  ; and , behold , Joseph was not in the pit  ; and he rent his clothes .
translation.kha: Haba u Reuben u leit phai pat sha kata ka pukri bad shem ba u Joseph um don shuh hangta , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih .

translation.en: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldeans , who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary , and had no compassion upon young man or maiden , old man , or him that stooped for age : he gave them all into his hand .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u wallam ïa u syiem ka Babilonia bad tur ïaleh ïa ki . U syiem u pynïap ïa ki samla shynrang ka Judah , wat hapoh ka Templ hi . Um don jingsngewsynei ïano ïano , samla ne tymmen , shynrang ne kynthei , uba pang ne uba koit . U Blei u aiti ïa ki baroh ha u .

translation.en: Where no oxen are , the crib is clean : but much increase is by the strength of the ox .
translation.kha: Khlem ki masi kyrtong ban tan ïa ka lyngkor , ka lyngkha jong phi kan ym don ei ei , hynrei da ki yn pyndap shoiñ ïa ki thiar da u kew .

translation.en: He hath turned aside my ways , and pulled me in pieces : he hath made me desolate .
translation.kha: U beh krad ïa nga sharud surok , u tar lyngkhot ïa nga , bad u iehnoh ïa nga .

translation.en: All the presidents of the kingdom , the governors , and the princes , the counsellors , and the captains , have consulted together to establish a royal statute , and to make a firm decree , that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days , save of thee , O king , he shall be cast into the den of lions .
translation.kha: Baroh ma ngi kiba pynïaid ïa ka hima jong phi — ki nongpynïaidkam , ki lat , ki lat kiba kham hapoh , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah pynïaidkam — ki la ïamynjur ba u Syiem Kynrad u dei ban pynmih ka hukum ban pyntreikam pyrkhing ïa ka . To ai ki hukum ba haduh laiphew sngi yn ym shah ïano ïano ban kyrpad ei ei na uno uno u blei lane na uno uno u briew lait noh tang na u Syiem Kynrad . Ïa uno uno uba pynkheiñ ïa kane ka hukum dei ban bret shapoh ka thliew kaba la dap da ki sing .

translation.en: Then saith he to the disciple ,  Behold thy mother !  And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha uta u synran ,  Kane ka long ka kmie jong me .  Naduh kata ka por uta u synran u la ïalam ïa ka ban sah noh ha ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: They deck it with silver and with gold  ; they fasten it with nails and with hammers , that it move not .
translation.kha: bad la pynitynnat da ka rupa bad ka ksiar . La pynskhem ïa ka da ki preg ban pyllait ïa ka na ka jingkyllon .

translation.en: And enquired not of the  Lord  : therefore he slew him , and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  U pynïap ïa u , bad u ai synshar noh ïa ka hima sha u Dabid u khun jong u Jesse .

translation.en: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body , the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee , in the siege , and in the straitness , wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee :
translation.kha: Ynda ki nongshun jong phi ki kerkut ïa ki shnong jong phi , phin sa kyrduh jingbam kat ban hap bam wat ïa la ki jong ki khun ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ïa phi .

translation.en: And Baalath , and all the store cities that Solomon had , and all the chariot cities , and the cities of the horsemen , and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem , and in Lebanon , and throughout all the land of his dominion .
translation.kha: ka nongbah Baalath , baroh ki nongbah ha kiba u kynshew jingbam , bad ki nongbah ha kiba u buh ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong u . U pyndep ïa baroh ki jingthmu jong u ban tei ha Jerusalem , ha Lebanon , bad ha kylleng ka jaka kaba u synshar .

translation.en: And to know the love of Christ , which passeth knowledge , that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God .
translation.kha: Bad ban tip ïa ka jingieit jong U Khrist wat la kam long kaba lah ban tip pura ïa ka , bad kumta to long kiba dap pura da ka jinglong jong U Blei hi .

translation.en: And he said unto Aaron , Take thee a young calf for a sin offering , and a ram for a burnt offering , without blemish , and offer them before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Aaron ,  Shim ïa uwei u masi lyngraw bad uwei u langbrot ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  , ïa u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ïa u langbrot kum ka jingkñia ainguh thang .

translation.en: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee , and they come unto thee , and say unto thee , Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king , hide it not from us , and we will not put thee to death  ; also what the king said unto thee :
translation.kha: Lada ki rangbah synshar ki ïohsngew ba nga la ïakren bad me , kin sa wan bad kylli ïa me kaei kaba ngi la ïakren . Kin sa kular ban ym pynïap ïa me lada me ïathuh ïa ki ïa baroh kiei kiei .

translation.en: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka riewkynthei kaba im ha ki jingsngewbha ka la lah ïap lypa , wat haba ka dang im .

translation.en: Fret not thyself because of evil men , neither be thou envious at the wicked  ;
translation.kha: Wat ai ba ki briew basniew kin pynkhuslai ïa phi ; wat bishni ïa ki .

translation.en: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: Uta uba pynkheiñ ïa kane ka aiñ yn ym ñiew shuh kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .

translation.en: And he put garrisons in Edom  ; throughout all Edom put he garrisons , and all they of Edom became David s servants . And the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .
translation.kha: U la pynïeng ki dara sah shipai ha kylleng ka Edom , bad ki briew hangta ki kylla long ki raïot jong u . U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban jop kylleng kylleng .

translation.en: Then sought they for Jesus , and spake among themselves , as they stood in the temple , What think ye , that he will not come to the feast ?
translation.kha: Ki la wad ïa U Jisu , bad katba ki dang ïalum ha ka Templ , ki la ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei phi pyrkhat ? Ka long kaba thikna ba un ym wan sha ka Jingkhawai Niam , hato un wan ?

translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt , which dwell at Migdol , and at Tahpanhes , and at Memphis , and in the country of Pathros , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga shaphang ki Israel baroh kiba shong ha Ijipt , ha ki nongbah Migdol , Tahpanhes , bad Memphis , bad ki bynta bashathie jong ka ri .

translation.en: And every meat offering , mingled with oil , and dry , shall all the sons of Aaron have , one as much as another .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingainguh bam baroh ki bym shym la shet , la ki long kiba la khleh ne kiba khlem khleh umphniang , ki dei jong ki lyngdoh na ka ïing u Aaron , bad ki dei ban ïasam lang mar katjuh .

translation.en: And there came an angel of the  Lord  , and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah , that pertained unto Joash the Abi–ezrite : and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress , to hide it from the Midianites .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel jong U  Trai  u la wan sha ka nongrit Ophrah bad u shong ha trai u dieng Sning jong u Joash , u briew na ka kur u Abieser . U Gideon u khun jong u , u dang shoh kew jar jar ha ka thliew khem um sohwaiñ , khnang ba ki Midian kin ym ïohi ïa u .

translation.en: But with thee will I establish my covenant  ; and thou shalt come into the ark , thou , and thy sons , and thy wife , and thy sons  wives with thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynlong ka jutang bad me . Khie rung shapoh kata ka lieng bad la ka tnga jong me , ki khun shynrang jong me lem bad ki tnga jong ki .

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka jaka jong ki , nga dawa ïa ki Lebi baroh ba kin long ki jong nga . Nga long U  Trai  ! Nga dawa ruh ïa ki jingri jong ki Lebi ha ka jaka jong kito baroh kiba la kha nyngkong na ki jingri jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shewed signs and wonders , great and sore , upon Egypt , upon Pharaoh , and upon all his household , before our eyes :
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohi da la ki khmat ba u la leh ïa ki kamphylla bad ïa kiei kiei kiba ishyrkhei pyrshah ïa ki Ijipt , ïa u syiem jong ki , bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh .

translation.en: ( It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment , and wiped his feet with her hair , whose brother Lazarus was sick . )
translation.kha: ( Kane ka Mari ka dei kato kaba la pynsleh ïa ki kjat U Trai da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih bad kaba la ñiad ïa ki da u shñiuh khlieh jong ka ; u dei u Lasaros u para jong ka uba la pang . )

translation.en: O  Lord  , why hast thou made us to err from thy ways , and hardened our heart from thy fear ? Return for thy servants  sake , the tribes of thine inheritance .
translation.kha: Balei me shah ba ngin sakma na ki lynti jong me ? Balei ba me pynlong mutlop ïa ngi ba ngin phai lyndet na me ? To wan phai noh , na ka bynta kito kiba shakri ïa me , na ka bynta u paidlang uba la ju long u jong me .

translation.en: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur , that is over against Egypt .
translation.kha: U Saul u jop ïa ki Amalek , da kaba ïaleh shi lynter lynti naduh Habilah haduh Shur , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Ijipt ;

translation.en: I will feed my flock , and I will cause them to lie down , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Nga hi da lade ngan long u nongaplangbrot ïa ki langbrot jong nga , bad ngan wad ka jaka shongthait ïa ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity , and that divine lies : they shall not be in the assembly of my people , neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel , neither shall they enter into the land of Israel  ; and ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Nga la jan ban pynshitom ïa phi ki nongïathuhlypa kiba don ki jingïohipaw ba bakla bad kiba thaw ki jingïathuhlypa kiba ïalam bakla . Phin ym don hangta haba ki briew jong nga ki ïalumlang ban ïashim ïa ki rai ; ïa ki kyrteng jong phi yn ym kynthup ha ka thup kyrteng jong ki traishnong ka Israel ; phin ym wan phai shuh da lei lei sha ka ri ka jong phi . Nangta phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: And when his disciples were come to the other side , they had forgotten to take bread .
translation.kha: Haba ki synran ki la jam sha shiliang jong ka duriaw , ki la klet ban rah jingbam .

translation.en: Therefore they sought again to take him : but he escaped out of their hand ,
translation.kha: Sa shisien ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa U Jisu , hynrei u la lait noh na ki kti jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven , that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt , upon man , and upon beast , and upon every herb of the field , throughout the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Rah ïa la ka kti shajrong , bad u phria un hap ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei — ha ki briew , ha ki mrad , bad ha ki jingthung baroh kiba ha lyngkha .

translation.en: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David , if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall .
translation.kha: To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam shym pynïap ïa uba khatduh eh na kito ki briew ha shuwa ban mih ka step !

translation.en: Simon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles , to take out of them a people for his name .
translation.kha: U Simon u dang shu dep batai kumno ba U Blei u la pyn-i nyngkong ïa ka jingpyrkhat na ka bynta ki Jentil da kaba shim napdeng jong ki ïa u paidlang ban long u jong u .

translation.en: For he is our God  ; and we are the people of his pasture , and the sheep of his hand . To day if ye will hear his voice ,
translation.kha: U long U Blei jong ngi , ngi long ki briew kiba u sumar , ka kynhun langbrot kaba u pyndap . To sngap ha kane ka sngi ïa kaei kaba u ong :

translation.en: That day is a day of wrath , a day of trouble and distress , a day of wasteness and desolation , a day of darkness and gloominess , a day of clouds and thick darkness ,
translation.kha: Kan long ka sngi jong ka jingbitar shla , ka sngi ka jingjynjar bad ka jingnoh mynsiem , ka sngi ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot , ka sngi ka jingdum bad ka jingsngewsih , kaba dum bad ka sngi ba kah lyoh ,

translation.en: And Moses said , Behold , I go out from thee , and I will entreat the  Lord  that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people , to morrow : but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Nga tang shu mih nangne , ngan kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ba la shai ka sngi ki skain kin phet noh na phi , na ki rangbah synshar jong phi , bad na ki briew jong phi . Hynrei phim dei ban shukor shuh ïa ngi bad khang ïa ki briew ban leit kñia ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And he measured the wall thereof , an hundred and forty and four cubits , according to the measure of a man , that is , of the angel .
translation.kha: U angel u la thew ruh ïa ka kynroh , bad ka la don hynriewphew mitar ka jingkynjang , kat kum ka jingthew ba la pdiang ïa kaba u la pyndonkam .

translation.en: And when Paul s sister s son heard of their lying in wait , he went and entered into the castle , and told Paul .
translation.kha: Hynrei u khun jong ka para jong u Paul u la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingïasylla ; kumta u la leit shapoh ka kut shipai bad u la ïathuh ha u Paul .

translation.en: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom , but none shall be there , and all her princes shall be nothing .
translation.kha: Yn ym don syiem u ban synshar ïa ka ri , bad ki nongïalam baroh kim don shuh .

translation.en: When the even was come , there came a rich man of Arimathaea , named Joseph , who also himself was Jesus  disciple :
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , u briew uba riewspah na Arimathaïa u la wan poi ; ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Joseph , bad u la long ruh u synran jong U Jisu .

translation.en: Then contended I with the rulers , and said , Why is the house of God forsaken ? And I gathered them together , and set them in their place .
translation.kha: Nga la sneng ïa ki rangbah synshar namar ba ki la ailad ban leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka Templ . Bad nga la wallam biang ïa ki Lebi bad ki nongtem nongput sha ka Templ bad buh biang ïa ki ha ka kam .

translation.en: But unto the Son he saith , Thy throne , O God , is for ever and ever : a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa U Khun , U Blei u la ong :  Ka hima jong me , A Blei , kan neh junom la junom ! Me synshar halor la ki briew da ka hok .

translation.en: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these  ; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these .
translation.kha: Kito kiei kiei , ïa kiba la shim nuksa na kita kiba la sdang ha bneng , la dei ban pynkhuid ha kata ka rukom . Hynrei kita kiba kynja bneng hi ki donkam ïa ki jingkñia kiba kham bha shuh shuh .

translation.en: Then spake Jesus to the multitude , and to his disciples ,
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la kren ha ki paidbah bad ha ki synran jong u .

translation.en: Lift up thine eyes round about , and behold : all these gather themselves together , and come to thee . As I live , saith the  Lord  , thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all , as with an ornament , and bind them on thee , as a bride doeth .
translation.kha: Khmih baroh sawdong bad peit kaei kaba jia ! Ki briew jong pha ki ïalumlang — ki ïawan sha la ïing ! Kumba nga long U Blei uba im , phan sngewsarong ïa la ki briew , kumba sngewsarong ka nongleitkurim ïa la ki mawlynnai .

translation.en: And she named the child I–chabod , saying , The glory is departed from Israel : because the ark of God was taken , and because of her father in law and her husband .
translation.kha: Ka pynkyrteng ïa uta u khunlung u Ikhabod , ka da batai ,  Ka burom U Blei ka la phet na Israel !  — kaba thew ïa ka jingshah knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad ka jingïap u kthaw kurim bad u tnga jong ka .

translation.en: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things : moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass .
translation.kha: Husiar na ki briew kiba shri bad khapbrip khmat ïa phi ; ki don ka jingpyrkhat kaba sniew .

translation.en: And all the elders of Israel came , and the priests took up the ark .
translation.kha: Haba baroh ki nongïalam ki la ïalumlang , ki lyngdoh ki rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ki bah ïa ka sha ka Templ .

translation.en: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him  ; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him , lest they should be put out of the synagogue :
translation.kha: Wat la katta ruh , kiba bun na ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ngeit ha U Jisu ; hynrei namar ki Pharisi kim shym la kren shaphang jong ka ha kaba paw , ba kin ym shah beh noh na ka synagog .

translation.en: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken : but on whomsoever it shall fall , it will grind him to powder .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba hap halor une u maw un shah ot lyngkhot ; bad lada u maw u hap halor uno uno , un pynlwet jin ïa uta .

translation.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she ? for seven had her to wife .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ba kiba ïap ki mihpat , kan long ka tnga jongno ? Baroh hynñiew ngut ki la shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: He hath shewed his people the power of his works , that he may give them the heritage of the heathen .
translation.kha: U la pynpaw ïa la ka bor ha ki briew bor jong u , da kaba ai ha ki ïa ki ri jong ki nongwei .

translation.en: Let him take his rod away from me , and let not his fear terrify me :
translation.kha: To sangeh na kaba pynshitom ïa nga A Blei . Buh sha jngai ïa ki jingpynsheptieng jong me !

translation.en: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered , neither the sand of the sea measured : so will I multiply the seed of David my servant , and the Levites that minister unto me .
translation.kha: Ngan pynroi ïa ki nonghiarpateng jong u shakri jong nga u Dabid bad ïa ka jingdon ki lyngdoh na ka jait Lebi , ba kumta yn ym lah ban ñiew ïa ki kumba long ki khlur ha sahit bneng lane u shyiap harud duriaw .

translation.en: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday , before the men and the women , and those that could understand  ; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka jaka basawdong hajan ka khyrdop u pule ïa ka Hukum ha ki naduh dang step phyrngab haduh shiteng sngi , bad baroh ki ïasngap bha .

translation.en: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart : and a good report maketh the bones fat .
translation.kha: Ki khmat kiba phuh samrkhie ki pynlong ïa phi ban kmen , bad ki khubor ki babha ki pynsngewtynnat shuh shuh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Israel was strong , that they put the Canaanites to tribute , and did not utterly drive them out .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki la khlaiñbor , ki la pynbor ïa ki Kanaan ban trei na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei kim shym la beh noh ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And answered them after the advice of the young men , saying , My father made your yoke heavy , but I will add thereto : my father chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
translation.kha: kumba ki samla ki la ai jingmut . U ong ,  I pa jong nga i la buh ki jingkit kiba khia , nga ngan pynlong ïa ki , kiba kham khia shuh shuh . I la sympat ïa phi da u shabuk , nga ngan sympat ïa phi ïa u shabuk kulai !

translation.en: And when Zacharias saw him , he was troubled , and fear fell upon him .
translation.kha: Haba u Sekharaïah u la ïohi ïa u , u la kyndit bad u la sngewsheptieng .

translation.en: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son . And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison , and to bring it .
translation.kha: Katba u Isaak u dang ïakren ha u Iso , ka Rebekka ka pynshahshkor .

translation.en: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the  Lord  , that is in the tabernacle of the congregation , and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering , which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Un tah snam khyndiat ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan ka jingiwbih thang kaba hapoh ka ïingjaiñ bad un theh ïa ka snam kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan ki jingkñia ainguh thang , kiba don ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Ye sent unto John , and he bare witness unto the truth .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u long uta ha uba phi phah ïa ki nonglamktien jong phi , bad u kren na ka bynta ka jingshisha .

translation.en: And Saul said , Thus shall ye say to David , The king desireth not any dowry , but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines , to be avenged of the king s enemies . But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: bad u Saul u hukum ïa ki ban ong ïa u Dabid ,  Baroh kaba u syiem u kwah na phi kum ka dor jong ka nongleitkurim ka long shispah tylli ki doh otsher jong ki Philistia , kum ka jingpynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong u .  ( Kane ka long kumno u Saul u thmu khnang ba yn ïoh pynïap ïa u Dabid da ki Philistia . )

translation.en: Enquire , I pray thee , of the  Lord  for us  ; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us  ; if so be that the  Lord  will deal with us according to all his wondrous works , that he may go up from us .
translation.kha: Sngewbha ban kren ha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ngi , namar u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la wan kerkut ïa ka nongbah . Lehse U  Trai  un leh kawei na ki kambah jong u na ka bynta jong ngi , bad un pynbor ïa u Nebukhadnessar ba un kynran dien noh .

translation.en: But I know , that even now , whatsoever thou wilt ask of God , God will give it thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip ba wat mynta ruh U Blei un ai ha me ïa kaei kaei kaba me pan na u .

translation.en: And afterward they desired a king : and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis , a man of the tribe of Benjamin , by the space of forty years .
translation.kha: Bad haba ki la pan syiem , U Blei u la ai ha ki ïa u Saul u khun jong u Kish na ka jait Benjamin , ban long u syiem jong ki haduh sawphew snem .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham , the son of Uzziah , king of Judah , that Rezin the king of Syria , and Pekah the son of Remaliah , king of Israel , went up toward Jerusalem to war against it , but could not prevail against it .
translation.kha: Haba u Syiem Ahas , u khun jong u Jotham bad u ksiew jong u Ussaïah , u synshar ïa ka Judah , la khie ka thma . U Resin , u syiem ka Syria , bad u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah , u syiem ka Israel , ki tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem , hynrei kim shym lah ban kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: Because that , when they knew God , they glorified him not as God , neither were thankful ; but became vain in their imaginations , and their foolish heart was darkened .
translation.kha: Ki tip ïa U Blei , hynrei kim ai ïa u ka burom kaba dei ka jong u , lymne kim shym sngewnguh ïa u . Pynban , ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki la long ki bym don jingmut ei ei , bad ïa ki jingmut ba-thylli jong ki la pyndap da ka jingdum .

translation.en: The silver is mine , and the gold is mine , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh ha ka pyrthei ka long ka jong nga .

translation.en: But he knoweth not that the dead are there  ; and that her guests are in the depths of hell .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ngat ha ka jingriam jong ka kim tip ba ki briew kiba leit ha ïing jong ka ki ïap , bad kito kiba la rung mynshuwa ki don mynta ha kaba jylliew bha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: And he was angry , and would not go in : therefore came his father out , and entreated him .
translation.kha: U hynmen u la bitar haduh katta katta ba um shym leit shapoh ïing ; kumta u kpa jong u , u la mih shabar bad kyrpad ïa u ban rung shapoh .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Uzza  ; and God smote him there for his error  ; and there he died by the ark of God .
translation.kha: Hangta hi U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa u Ussah bad u la pynïap ïa u namar ka jingbymburom jong u . U Ussah u la ïap hangta hajan ka Synduk ka Jutang ,

translation.en: And the little chambers thereof , and the posts thereof , and the arches thereof , were according to these measures : and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about : it was fifty cubits long , and five and twenty cubits broad .
translation.kha: Ki kamra ap phira , ki kynroh bashapoh bad ka kamra rung jong ka ki heh katjuh kat kito kiba ha kiwei pat ki khyrdop . La don ki jingkhangïit baroh sawdong , bad ha ka kamra rung ruh . Baroh shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar , bad ka pyngkiang khat-ar mitar shiteng .

translation.en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains , Fall on us  ; and to the hills , Cover us .
translation.kha: Kata kan long ka por ha kaba ki briew kin ong ha ki lumbah , ‘ To hap halor jong ngi !’ bad ha ki lumrit , ‘ To buhrieh ïa ngi !’

translation.en: Holding faith , and a good conscience ; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck :
translation.kha: To pyndonkam ïa kito ki ktien kum ki jingkieng atiar khnang ba me lah ban ïaleh shlur , bad sumar ïa la ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingïatiplem bakhuid . Don ki briew ki bymshahskhor ïa la ka jingïatiplem bad ki la pyntroiñ ïa la ka jingngeit .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans , and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and he shall take it :
translation.kha: Ngan sa ai ïa kane ka nongbah ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ; kin kurup ïa ka bad thang ïa ka da ka ding .

translation.en: Saying , Prophesy unto us , thou Christ , Who is he that smote thee ?
translation.kha: ki la ong ,  To ïathuh lypa na ka bynta jong ngi , ko Messaïah ! To antad mano ba shoh ïa me ?

translation.en: And as Esaias said before , Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed , we had been as Sodom , and been made like unto Gomorrha .
