translation.kha: Ka long kumba u Isaïah u la lah ong mynshuwa ,  Lada U Trai Badonbor Baroh um shym la ieh ïa ngi katto katne kiba hiarpateng , ngin jin da la long kum ka Sodom , ngin jin da la long kum ka Gomorrah .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingtyrkhong ,

translation.en: Behold , thy people in the midst of thee are women : the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies : the fire shall devour thy bars .
translation.kha: Ki shipai jong pha ki long kum ki kynthei , bad ka ri jong pha ka ïeng khlem ka jingïada ha khmat ki nongshun jong pha . Ka ding kan pynjot ïa ki dieng khang khyrdop jong pha .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king heard the words of the woman , that he rent his clothes  ; and he passed by upon the wall , and the people looked , and , behold , he had sackcloth within upon his flesh .
translation.kha: Haba ïohsngew ïa kane , u syiem u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingkhuslai , bad ki briew kiba sah hajan ka kynroh ki lah ban ïohi ba u phong da ka jaiñ khain hapoh ki jaiñ jong u .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , that they turn and encamp before Pi–hahiroth , between Migdol and the sea , over against Baal–zephon : before it shall ye encamp by the sea .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki Israel ban phai dien bad ban sher dara ha khmat ka Pi Hahiroth , hapdeng ka Migdol bad ka Duriaw Basaw , hajan ka Baal Sephon .

translation.en: And they did all eat , and were filled .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u la bam bad u la ïoh ha ban da biang .

translation.en: For he received from God the Father honour and glory , when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased .
translation.kha: Ngi la don hangta mynba la ai ïa ka burom bad ïa ka jingpyndonburom ha u da U Blei uba U Kpa , haba ka sur ka la wan sha u na ka Burom Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , kaba ong ,  Une u long U Khun ba-ieit jong nga hi , ha uba nga sngewbha eh !

translation.en: Fear , and the pit , and the snare , shall be upon thee , O inhabitant of Moab , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingshyrkhei , ki liewlep , bad ki jingriam ki ap ïa ki briew ka Moab . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the  Lord  , saying , The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ha ki paid Israel ïa kane ka hukum na U  Trai . U ong ,  Kaei kaba ka jait Manasseh ka ong ka long kaba dei ,

translation.en: And Solomon loved the  Lord  , walking in the statutes of David his father : only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places .
translation.kha: U Solomon u ieit ïa U  Trai  bad u bud ïa ki jingbthah jong u Dabid , u kpa jong u , hynrei u la pynïap ruh ïa ki mrad bad u la ai ïa ki kum ki jingkñia ha ki duwan kiba bun .

translation.en: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret .
translation.kha: ( Ka long da shisha kaba lehrain eh wat ban ïakren ïa kita kiei kiei ïa kiba ki leh ha kaba rieh ) .

translation.en: Whereas angels , which are greater in power and might , bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ki angel , kiba kham khlaiñ bad kham khraw ban ïa kine ki nonghikai balamler , kim pynrem ïa ki da ki jingkrenbeiñ ha khmat U Trai .

translation.en: And the trees said to the fig tree , Come thou , and reign over us .
translation.kha: Nangta ki dieng ki ong ïa u dieng Dumbur , ‘ Ale wan bad long u syiem jong ngi .’

translation.en: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the  Lord   ; because he is good , for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel . And all the people shouted with a great shout , when they praised the  Lord  , because the foundation of the house of the  Lord  was laid .
translation.kha: Ki rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , da kaba ïai rwai ïa ka banktien    :  U  Trai  u long uba bha , bad ka jingieit jong u ïa ki Israel ka long bymjukut .  Baroh ki pyrta jam katba don ka bor , da kaba ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar ka jingtei ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ ka la sdang .

translation.en: And I took the little book out of the angel s hand , and ate it up  ; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey : and as soon as I had eaten it , my belly was bitter .
translation.kha: Nga la shim ïa kata ka kot kli barit na ka kti jong u bad nga la bam ïa ka ; bad ha ka shyntur ka thiang kum ka ngap . Hynrei hadien ba nga la nguid ïa ka , ka la kylla jew ha ka  nierbah jong nga .

translation.en: Behold , thou hast instructed many , and thou hast strengthened the weak hands .
translation.kha: Me la hikai ïa kiba bun ki briew bad me pynkhlaiñ ïa ki kti kiba tlot .

translation.en: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it , with all these vessels .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam laiphew san kilo ka ksiar nylla ban thaw ïa uta u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar baroh kiba ïadei bad u .

translation.en: This is the dream  ; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king .
translation.kha: Kane ka la long ka jingphohsniew . Mynta ngan ïathuh ha u Syiem Kynrad aïu ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: Meditate upon these things ; give thyself wholly to them ; that thy profiting may appear to all .
translation.kha: To leh minot ha kine kiei kiei bad to aiti ïa lade ha ki , ba baroh kin ïohi ïa ka jingroi jong me .

translation.en: And Samson said , Let me die with the Philistines . And he bowed himself with all his might  ; and the house fell upon the lords , and upon all the people that were therein . So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life .
translation.kha: bad u pyrta ,  Ai ngan ïap bad ki Philistia !  U khynñiat da ka bor jong u baroh , bad kata ka ïing ka la khyllem halor ki san ngut ki syiem bad ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka . U Samson u la pynïap kham bun ha ka por ba u ïap ban ïa kita kiba u la pynïap mynba u dang im .

translation.en: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel  ; and they said , Nay  ; but we will have a king over us  ;
translation.kha: Ki briew kim shahshkor ïa u Samuel , hynrei ki ong ,  Em ! Ngi kwah da u syiem ,

translation.en: Then arose Peter , and ran unto the sepulchre  ; and stooping down , he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves , and departed , wondering in himself at that which was come to pass .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ïeng joit bad u la mareh sha ka jingtep ; u la dem shapoh bad u la ïohi ïa ki jingsop linen hynrei ym kano kano kawei pat . Nangta u la leit phai pat sha ïing da ka jinglyngngoh ïa kaei kaba la jia .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Follow after me : for the  Lord  hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand . And they went down after him , and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab , and suffered not a man to pass over .
translation.kha: U ong ha ki ,  Bud ïa nga ! U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor ki Moab , ki nongshun jong phi .  Kumta ki la bud arsut ïa u Ehud bad ki la ïohknieh ïa ka jaka ha kaba ki Moab ki dei ban jam ïa ka Jordan ; kim shym pyllait wat tang uwei u briew ruh ban jam .

translation.en: And they rose up the same hour , and returned to Jerusalem , and found the eleven gathered together , and them that were with them ,
translation.kha: Ki la ïeng joit shisyndon bad ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem , ha kaba ki la shem ïa ki khatwei ngut ki synran kiba la ïalumlang bad kiwei pat kiba ong ,

translation.en: And had a wall great and high , and had twelve gates , and at the gates twelve angels , and names written thereon , which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Ka la don ka kynroh kaba khraw , kaba jrong bad khat-ar tylli ki khyrdop lem bad ki khat-ar ngut ki angel kiba khmih ïa ki khyrdop . Ha ki khyrdop la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar jait ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And after these things he went forth , and saw a publican , named Levi , sitting at the receipt of custom : and he said unto him ,  Follow me .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la mihnoh bad u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna uba kyrteng u Lebi , uba shong ha la ka jaka treikam . U Jisu u la ong ïa u ,  Bud ïa nga .

translation.en: Against Moab thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Woe unto Nebo ! for it is spoiled : Kiriathaim is confounded and taken : Misgab is confounded and dismayed .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong shaphang ka Moab :  Isynei ïa ki briew jong ka Nebo — ïa ka shnong jong ki la pynjot ! La kurup ïa ka Kiriathaim , ïa ka kut baskhem la pynpra , bad ïa ki briew jong ka la pynlehrain ; ka burom jong ka Moab ka la jah noh .

translation.en: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea : and if one look unto the land , behold darkness and sorrow , and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , kin kyrhuh halor ka Israel da kaba jam kum ka duriaw . Ha khmih ïa kane ka ri ! Ka jingdum bad ka jinglyng-a ! Ïa ka jingshai la nguid da ka jingdum .

translation.en: And a mixed multitude went up also with them  ; and flocks , and herds , even very much cattle .
translation.kha: Kiwei ki briew ruh kiba bun lem bad ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki masi , ki leit ryngkat bad ki .

translation.en: The curse of the  Lord  is in the house of the wicked : but he blesseth the habitation of the just .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u buh ka jingtim ha ki longïing jong ki riewbymman , hynrei u kyrkhu ïa ki longïing jong kiba hok .

translation.en: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son , saying , Behold , I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta haba u Iso u la leit ban behmrad , ka la ong ha u Jakob ,  Nga ïohsngew myntan ïa i pa jong phi ba i ong ha u Iso ,

translation.en: Arise , go to Paddan–aram , to the house of Bethuel thy mother s father  ; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother s brother .
translation.kha: To leit pynban sha Mesopotamia , sha ka ïing jong u Bethuel u parad jong me , bad shongkurim ïa kawei na ki samla kynthei hangta , kawei na ki khun kynthei jong u Laban , u kñi jong me .

translation.en: For he beholdeth himself , and goeth his way , and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was .
translation.kha: U peit bha ïa lade bad nangta u leit noh bad kumta hi u klet noh ba u long kum uei .

translation.en: And after all this the  Lord  smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease .
translation.kha: Nangta hadien kane baroh , U  Trai  u pynngat ha u syiem da ka jingpang kaba jur ha ki snier .

translation.en: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight , twenty shekels a day : from time to time shalt thou eat it .
translation.kha: Yn shah ba men bam arspah laiphew gram u kpu shi sngi , bad ka dei ban neh haduh ka sngi kaba bud .

translation.en: Behold , I have refined thee , but not with silver  ; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction .
translation.kha: Nga la tynjuh ïa phi ha ka ding jong ka jingshah shitom , kum ka rupa ba saiñ ha ka lawar ding . Hynrei nga la shem ïa phi ba phi long ki bymdondor .

translation.en: Rejoice ye in that day , and leap for joy : for , behold , your reward is great in heaven : for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets .
translation.kha: To kmen haba kata ka jia , bad to shad da ka jingkmen , namar ïa ka bainong kaba khraw la buh na ka bynta jong phi ha bneng . Naba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la leh ïa kajuh ha ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death , he shall ask , and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death . There is a sin unto death : I do not say that he shall pray for it .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïohi ïa la u parabriew ba u leh ïa ka pop ka bym ïalam sha ka jingïap , phi dei ban duwai ha U Blei , u ban ai ha u ïa ka jingim . Kane ka ïadei ïa kito kiba ki pop jong ki , kim ïalam sha ka jingïap . Hynrei ka don ka pop kaba ïalam sha ka jingïap , bad ngam ong ba phi dei ban duwai sha U Blei shaphang kata .

translation.en: If I laughed on them , they believed it not  ; and the light of my countenance they cast not down .
translation.kha: Nga phuh samrkhie ha ki haba kim don jingshaniah ; ka khmat ba-ikmen jong nga ka pynshlur ïa ki .

translation.en: And he brought me to the porch of the house , and measured each post of the porch , five cubits on this side , and five cubits on that side : and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side , and three cubits on that side .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka kamra rung jong ka templ . U la thew ïa ka tyngkong : ka la long ar mitar shiteng ka jingjylliew bad hynñiew mitar ka pyngkiang , lem bad ki kynroh kiba rben shi mitar shiteng ha baroh arliang .

translation.en: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart , when he goeth in unto the holy place , for a memorial before the  Lord  continually .
translation.kha: Haba u Aaron u rung sha ka Jaka Kyntang , un phong ïa kane ka jingdeng shadem ha kaba la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar jait Israel , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïai kynmaw ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of the Hebrews , How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me ? let my people go , that they may serve me .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Pharaoh , bad ki ong ha u ,  U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u ong , ‘ Sa katno te men kyntait ban pyndem ha nga ? Pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga ba kin ïoh mane ïa nga .

translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  I told you , and ye believed not : the works that I do in my Father s name , they bear witness of me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la lah ïathuh ïa phi , hynrei phim ngeit ïa nga . Ki kam kiba nga leh ha ka bor u Kpa jong nga ki kren na ka bynta jong nga ;

translation.en: But they obeyed not , neither inclined their ear , but made their neck stiff , that they might not hear , nor receive instruction .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ki kim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane pynleit jingmut ei ei . Pynban ki la kylla long kiba mutlop ; kin ym kohnguh ïa nga lane ïoh jinghikai na nga .

translation.en: And the people said unto Samuel , Who is he that said , Shall Saul reign over us ? bring the men , that we may put them to death .
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Israel ki ong ha u Samuel ,  Shano kito kiba ong ba u Saul um dei ban long u syiem jong ngi ? Aiti ïa ki ha ngi , ba ngin pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: And Joab came into the house to the king , and said , Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants , which this day have saved thy life , and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters , and the lives of thy wives , and the lives of thy concubines  ;
translation.kha: U Joab u leit sha ïing jong u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  Ha kane ka sngi phi la pynlehrain ïa ki rangbah jong phi — ki rangbah kiba la pyllait im ïa phi , ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi , bad ïa ki tnga bad ki tnga kliar jong phi .

translation.en: ( Now the man Moses was very meek , above all the men which were upon the face of the earth . )
translation.kha: ( U Moses u long u briew uba sngewrit ; uba kham sngewrit ban ïa uno uno u briew ha ka pyrthei . )

translation.en: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel , spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel , whom I commanded to feed my people , saying , Why have ye not built me an house of cedars ?
translation.kha: Ha ki jingïaid lynti jong nga bad ki paid Israel , ngam ju kylli ïano ïano na ki nongïalam kiba nga la thung balei kim shym la thaw ïa nga ka templ ba la shna da ki dieng Kedar .’

translation.en: He delivereth the poor in his affliction , and openeth their ears in oppression .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u hikai ïa ki briew lyngba ki jingshah shitom , bad u pyndonkam ïa ka jingjynjar ban plie ïa ki khmat jong ki .

translation.en: And ye shall perish among the heathen , and the land of your enemies shall eat you up .
translation.kha: Phin ïap ha ka jinglongmraw , phin shah nguid ha ka khyndew ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people  ; as Mordecai had charged her : for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai , like as when she was brought up with him .
translation.kha: Ka Esther kam pat shym la ïathuh ba ka dei ka Jiw . U Mordekai u la ong ïa ka ban ym ïathuh hano hano ruh , bad ka kohnguh ïa u ha kane , kumba ka la ju kohnguh ïa u mynba ka dang long ka khynnah rit hapoh ka jingsumar jong u .

translation.en: But when they came to Jesus , and saw that he was dead already , they brake not his legs :
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki la ïohi ba u la lah ïap lypa , kumta kim shym la pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: And Mephibosheth said unto the king , Yea , let him take all , forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house .
translation.kha: Ai ba u Siba un ïoh ïa ka baroh ,  u Mephibosheth u la jubab .  Ka la biang ïa nga ba U Syiem Kynrad u la wan phai suk sha la ïing .

translation.en: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy , which he had afore prepared unto glory ,
translation.kha: Bad u la kwah ruh ban pynpaw ïa ka burom bakhraw jong u , ïa kaba la theh halor jong ngi kiba long ka jingisynei jong u , kito na ngi ïa kiba u la pynkhreh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom jong u .

translation.en: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone , he hath made my paths crooked .
translation.kha: nga thap kyllon katba nga ïaid ; ki kynroh maw ki khang ïa nga kat shaba nga phai .

translation.en: And he made two cherubims of gold , beaten out of one piece made he them , on the two ends of the mercy seat  ;
translation.kha: U thaw ruh ar tylli ki Kherub da ka ksiar tylli kaba la shoh .

translation.en: Pray without ceasing .
translation.kha: duwai ha ki por baroh ,

translation.en: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not , neither ye nor your fathers  ; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night  ; where I will not shew you favour .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ngan bret ïa phi shabar jong kane ka ri sha ka ri kaba ma phi lymne ki kpa tymmen jong phi , phim pat ju tip . Bad hangta phin shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei mynsngi bad mynmiet , bad ngan ym pyn-i jingisynei ïa phi .’

translation.en: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day : and if it be spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u lyngdoh un peit bniah biang ïa u , bad lada ka la pur , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives .
translation.kha: U la pynlong ïa baroh ki nongbanbeiñ jong ki ban sngewsynei ïa ki .

translation.en: In the morning sow thy seed , and in the evening withhold not thine hand : for thou knowest not whether shall prosper , either this or that , or whether they both shall be alike good .
translation.kha: Thung ïa ki jingthung jong phi mynstep bad janmiet ruh . Da lei lei phin ym tip la baroh kin san bha lane la kawei ka rukom thung kan kham bha ban ïa kawei pat .

translation.en: And when the days of his mourning were past , Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh , saying , If now I have found grace in your eyes , speak , I pray you , in the ears of Pharaoh , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba la kut ka por ïambriew , u Joseph u ong ha ki rangbah synshar u syiem ,  Sngewbha rah ïa kane ka khubor sha u syiem :

translation.en: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand , and rejoice in hope of the glory of God .
translation.kha: U la wallam ïa ngi da ka jingngeit sha kane ka jingshem mynsiem jong ka jingaiei U Blei , ha kaba mynta ngi im . Bad kumta ngi sngewsarong ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ka jingïadon bynta ha ka burom jong U Blei!

translation.en: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand , and caught him , and said unto him ,  O thou of little faith , wherefore didst thou doubt ?
translation.kha: Shisyndon U Jisu u la kner bad u la batskhem ïa u bad U la ong ,  Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit me don ! Balei ba me artatien ?

translation.en: In the multitude of people is the king s honour : but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhraw jong u syiem ka shong ha ki katno ngut ki briew kiba u synshar ; khlem kita um long ei ei .

translation.en: And I saw in my dream , and , behold , seven ears came up in one stalk , full and good :
translation.kha: Nga la phohsniew ruh ba nga ïohi hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba met bad ih , ba ki san ha uwei u jyntang .

translation.en: And when he saw a fig tree in the way , he came to it , and found nothing thereon , but leaves only , and said unto it ,  Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever .  And presently the fig tree withered away .
translation.kha: U la ïohi ïa u dieng Dumbur harud ka lynti bad u la leit sha u , hynrei um shem ei ei ha u lait noh tang ki sla . Kumta u la ong ha u dieng ,  Men ym pynmih soh shuh !  Mar kumta hi u dieng Dumbur u la ïap tyrkhong .

translation.en: Bow down thine ear , and hear the words of the wise , and apply thine heart unto my knowledge .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , bad ngan hikai ïa phi ïa kaei ba ki riewstad ki la ong . Pule bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong ki ,

translation.en: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people , to the men , and to the women , and to all the people which had given him that answer , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga ong ha ki rangbah bad ki kynthei baroh kiba la jubab ïa nga ha kane ka rukom ,

translation.en: Then the angel of the  Lord  put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand , and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes  ; and there rose up fire out of the rock , and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes . Then the angel of the  Lord  departed out of his sight .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel jong U  Trai  u kner bad u pyndei ha ka doh bad u kpu da ka tduh jong u diengduh ba u bat . Ka ding ka la mih na u mawsiang bad ka la thang ïa kata ka doh bad ïa u kpu . Nangta u angel u jah noh jar .

translation.en: Then sent Joseph , and called his father Jacob to him , and all his kindred , threescore and fifteen souls .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u la phah khubor sha u Jakob , u kpa jong u , da kaba ong ïa u bad ïa ka longïing baroh kawei , baroh hynñiewphew san ngut , ban wan sha Ijipt .

translation.en: A devout man , and one that feared God with all his house , which gave much alms to the people , and prayed to God alway .
translation.kha: U la long u briew uba riewblei ; ma u lem bad ka longïing jong u baroh kawei ki la mane ïa U Blei . U la leh ruh shibun ban ïarap ïa ki Jiw kiba duk bad u ïai duwai ha U Blei .

translation.en: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked .
translation.kha: Bad mynta ngi ïa-ud , kaba khraw ka long ka jingkwah hir hir jong ngi ba ïa kata ka ïing kaba wan na bneng dei ban pynkup halor jong ngi ; ba haba la pynkup da ka , ngin ym long shuh kiba khlem ka met .

translation.en: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken  ; but on whomsoever it shall fall , it will grind him to powder .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba hap halor uta u maw un shah ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ; bad lada uta u maw u hap halor jongno jongno , un pynlwet phum ïa uta .

translation.en: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom , and apply thine heart to understanding  ;
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingstad bad pyrshang ban shemphang ïa ka ;

translation.en: And Abraham stood up , and bowed himself to the people of the land , even to the children of Heth .
translation.kha: Te u Abraham u la nguh ha khmat jong ki bad u ong ,

translation.en: And except those days should be shortened , there should no flesh be saved : but for the elect s sake those days shall be shortened .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynduna ïa ka jingbun ki sngi ; lada um shym la leh kumta , yn ym don mano mano ruh uba lah ban lait im . Na ka bynta ki briew jong u kiba u la jied , U Blei un pynduna ïa ki sngi .

translation.en: And Abraham said , My son , God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering : so they went both of them together .
translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  U Blei hi un sa pynbiang ïa uwei .  Bad baroh ar ngut ki nang ïa-ïaid lang .

translation.en: But when thou art bidden , go and sit down in the lowest room  ; that when he that bade thee cometh , he may say unto thee , Friend , go up higher : then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee .
translation.kha: Pynban , haba la khot sngewbha ïa phi , khie leit bad shong ha ka jaka ba hapoh eh , khnang ba u nongpdiang ïa phi un wan ha phi bad ong , ‘ Ale kiew shane , ko paralok jong nga , sha ka jaka ba kham kyrpang .’ Kane kan wanrah ka burom ïa phi ha khmat jong baroh kiwei pat kiba shah khot sngewbha .

translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga ,

translation.en: Then shall ye return , and discern between the righteous and the wicked , between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki briew jong nga kin ïohi ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng kaei kaba jia ïa kiba hok bad ïa ki bymman , ha u briew uba shakri ïa nga bad ha uta u bym leh kumta .

translation.en: To speak evil of no man , to be no brawlers , but gentle , shewing all meekness unto all men .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki ban ym kren sniew ïano ïano , hynrei ban long kiba shongsuk bad ïadei paralok , bad ban pyn-i borabor da ka jinglong bajemnud sha baroh .

translation.en: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers , that floweth with milk and honey  ; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves , and waxen fat  ; then will they turn unto other gods , and serve them , and provoke me , and break my covenant .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba nga la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Hangta kin ïoh bam katba ki kwah , bad kin im pahuh pahai . Hynrei kin phai noh sha kiwei pat ki blei bad kin mane ïa ki . Kin sa kyntait ïa nga bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga ,

translation.en: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes : also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah .
translation.kha: Ha Riblah u la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Sedekaïah katba u Sedekaïah u dang peit , bad u la pynïap ruh ïa ki rangbah synshar jong ka Judah .

translation.en: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years . And the prophet Jeremiah went his way .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki briew baroh :  U  Trai  u la ong ba kane ka dei kumno ba un pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la buh halor ka ryndang jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad un leh ïa kane hapoh ar snem .  Nangta nga la leit noh .

translation.en: Said unto them , Ye have brought this man unto me , as one that perverteth the people : and , behold , I , having examined him before you , have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him :
translation.kha: Phi la wallam ïa une u briew ha nga bad phi la ong ba u ïalam bakla ïa u paidbah . Mynta , nga la jurip bha ïa u hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong phi , bad ngam shym shem ïa u ba u shah rem ha kano kano ka kam runar kaba phi mudui ïa u .

translation.en: But I would ye should understand , brethren , that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel ;
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban tip , ko parabangeit jong nga , ba kiei kiei kiba la jia ha nga ki la ïarap da shisha ïa ka jingpynroi ïa ka gospel .

translation.en: Hear , O our God  ; for we are despised : and turn their reproach upon their own head , and give them for a prey in the land of captivity :
translation.kha: Nga duwai ,  To sngap ïa ki ba ki krenbeiñ ïa ngi , A Blei ! Ai ba ka jingkrenbeiñ jong ki kan hap halor ki khlieh jong ki hi . Ai ba yn lute ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki don , bad ai ba yn ring koidi ïa ki sha ka ri nongwei .

translation.en: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains , saith the Lord  God  : every man s sword shall be against his brother .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsheptieng ïa u Gog da bun jait ki jingjia basniew . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ki briew jong u kin thew ïa la ki waitlam pyrshah uwei ïa uwei pat .

translation.en: A righteous man hateth lying : but a wicked man is loathsome , and cometh to shame .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki isih ïa kaba lamler , hynrei ki ktien jong ki briew kiba bymman ki long ka jinglehrain bad jingjahburom .

translation.en: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign , and he reigned two years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Meshullemeth , the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah .
translation.kha: U Amon u la dap arphew ar snem ka rta haba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Meshullemeth , ka khun u Harus , na ka shnong Jotbah .

translation.en: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table .
translation.kha: Ki kyrwoh ban bsuh ïa ki dieng jingbah ïa ka miej ki dei ban don hajan ka rmiang .

translation.en: When they went , they went upon their four sides : and they turned not when they went .
translation.kha: kumta ba ki shalyntem ki lah ban tyllun sha kano kano na ki saw tylli ki dong .

translation.en: And they rejected his statutes , and his covenant that he made with their fathers , and his testimonies which he testified against them  ; and they followed vanity , and became vain , and went after the heathen that were round about them , concerning whom the  Lord  had charged them , that they should not do like them .
translation.kha: Ki kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u , kim shym sumar ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad kim suidñiew ïa ki jingmaham jong u . Ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw bym shongdor bad ïa lade ki long ki bymdondor , bad ki bud ïa ki rukom jong ki hima ba don sawdong , khlem kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  ban pyrthuh bud ïa ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram s wife .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba u syiem u la shim ïa ka Sarai , U  Trai  u la phah ki jingpang bashyrkhei halor jong u bad halor ki briew ha ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: Arise , go down to meet Ahab king of Israel , which is in Samaria : behold , he is in the vineyard of Naboth , whither he is gone down to possess it .
translation.kha: Phin shem ïa u ha ka bri sohwaiñ u Naboth , ba u leit ban shimti ïa ka .

translation.en: But afterward they turned , and caused the servants and the handmaids , whom they had let go free , to return , and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids .
translation.kha: Ki la pyllaitluid shisha ïa ki , hynrei hadien ki la kylla jingmut , ki la shim pat ïa ki , bad ki la pynbor ïa ki ban long mraw biang .

translation.en: Where should I go ?
translation.kha: Shaei ba nga hap ban leit ?

translation.en: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ka long kaba bha tam ïa ngi ban ap ha ka jingïaishah — ban ap ïa u ban pynim ïa ngi —

translation.en: Of the sons of Gershom , Shebuel was the chief .
translation.kha: U nongïalam napdeng ki khun shynrang jong u Gershom u dei u Shebuel .

translation.en: Above all , taking the shield of faith , wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ha ki por baroh to bat ïa ka jingngeit kum ka stieh ; naba da ka phi lah ban pynlip ïa ki sum bameh ding baroh jong u bymman .

translation.en: And the  Lord  their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people : for they shall be as the stones of a crown , lifted up as an ensign upon his land .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa ki briew jong u , kumba u nongaplangbrot u pyllait im ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u na ka jingma . Kin tyngshaiñ ha ka ri jong u kum ki mawlynnai ha ka pansngiat .

translation.en: And saith unto them ,  Go your way into the village over against you : and as soon as ye be entered into it , ye shall find a colt tied , whereon never man sat  ; loose him , and bring him .
translation.kha: Leit sha ka nongrit hangta ha shuwa jong phi . Phi tang shu poi hangta , phin shem ïa u khun kada ba la teh ïa u , u bym pat ju don uba shong halor jong u . Law ïa u bad wallam ïa u hangne .

translation.en: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad , and rivers of waters in the streets .
translation.kha: Ki khun kiba phi la ïoh na kiwei pat ki kynthei kin ym wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa phi .

translation.en: But Abimelech had not come near her : and he said , Lord , wilt thou slay also a righteous nation ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abimelekh um pat shym la leit hajan jong ka bad u ong ,  Ko Kynrad , ngam shym tip ! Hato men shu pynïap ïa nga bad ïa ki briew jong nga ?

translation.en: Since those days were , when one came to an heap of twenty measures , there were but ten : when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press , there were but twenty .
translation.kha: phi leit sha ka thup kew da kaba khmih lynti ban shem arspah kilo , hynrei yn don hangta tang shispah . Phin leit ban tong shispah litar ka waiñ na ka jingbuh hynrei phi shem tang sawphew .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , in the ninth month , that they proclaimed a fast before the  Lord  to all the people in Jerusalem , and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha u bnai bakhyndai jong ka snem kaba san ba u Jehoïakim u la long u syiem ka Judah , ki briew ki la shahjingit ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha U  Trai . Ïa ka jingshahjingit la leh da baroh kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem bad da baroh kito kiba la wan hangta na ki shnong ka Judah .

translation.en: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ , and make not provision for the flesh , to fulfil the lusts thereof .
translation.kha: Hynrei to kieng ïa ki atiar jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai , bad to sangeh na kaba pynleit jingmut sha ki jinglong jong ka pop kiba pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai jong ka .

translation.en: Give us this day our daily bread .
translation.kha: To ai ha ngi mynta ka jingbam kaba ngi donkam .

translation.en: And the company shall stone them with stones , and dispatch them with their swords  ; they shall slay their sons and their daughters , and burn up their houses with fire .
translation.kha: To ai ba u paidbhur un lynthem maw ïa ki bad tur ïaleh ïa ki da ki waitlam , ban pynïap ïa ki khun jong ki , bad ban thang ïa ki ïing jong ki .

translation.en: And he put the mitre upon his head  ; also upon the mitre , even upon his forefront , did he put the golden plate , the holy crown  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U buh ïa ka jaiñspong ha ka khlieh jong u , bad ha khmat jong ka u pyndait ïa ka jingdeng ksiar , kaba long ka dak jong ka jingpynkyntang , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Behold , he is in thine hand  ; but save his life .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ha u Soitan ,  Kam pher , ai un long hapoh ka bor jong me , hynrei men ym shim ïa ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: In weariness and painfulness , in watchings often , in hunger and thirst , in fastings often , in cold and nakedness .
translation.kha: Nga la thait na ka jingtrei shitom ; bunsien ngam ju ïohthiah ; nga la thngan bad sliang ; bunsien ngam shym la don ka jingbam kaba biang , ka jakarieh , lane khlem jaiñkup .

translation.en: Wherefore , my beloved , as ye have always obeyed , not as in my presence only , but now much more in my absence , work out your own salvation with fear and trembling .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki paralok ba-ieit , kumba phi la kohnguh borabor ïa nga mynba nga la don bad phi , ka long kaba donkam shuh shuh ba phi kohnguh ïa nga mynta haba nga don jngai na phi . To ïai trei da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkhynñiuh ban pyndep noh ïa ka jingpynim jong phi ,

translation.en: And as for thy nativity , in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut , neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee  ; thou wast not salted at all , nor swaddled at all .
translation.kha: Haba la kha ïa pha , ym don mano mano ban ot ïa u sohpet jong pha lane pynsum ïa pha lane kyllan mluh ïa pha lane sop ïa pha da ka jaiñ .

translation.en: For the  Lord  our God , he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage , and which did those great signs in our sight , and preserved us in all the way wherein we went , and among all the people through whom we passed :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la wallam ïa ki kpa jong ngi bad ïa ngi ruh na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt , bad ngi la ïohi ïa ki kambah ba u la leh . U la ri pynim ïa ngi shano shano shaba ngi leit hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ba ngi la ïaid lyngba .

translation.en: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers , ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God  ; and are become such as have need of milk , and not of strong meat .
translation.kha: Ka la dei ka por kaba la biang bha ïa phi ban long ki nonghikai — pynban , phi dang donkam ïa uwei pat ban hikai ïa phi ïa ki jinghikai banyngkong jong ka khubor U Blei . Ha ka jaka ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba eh , phi dang ïai donkam ban dih da ka dud .

translation.en: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones , and lay away their robes , and put off their broidered garments : they shall clothe themselves with trembling  ; they shall sit upon the ground , and shall tremble at every moment , and be astonished at thee .
translation.kha: Baroh ki syiem jong ki hima ba don hajan ka duriaw kin wan hiar na ki khet jong ki . Kin law noh ïa ki jaiñkup bad ki jaiñ ba-itynnat jong ki bad kin shong kyiuh ha ka khyndew . Kin sngewtriem haduh katta katta ha ka kupar jong pha kat haduh ba kim lah ban sangeh na jingkyiuh .

translation.en: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David , that cometh in the name of the Lord : Hosanna in the highest .
translation.kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa ka jingwan ka hima jong u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong ngi ! Ïaroh ïa U Blei !

translation.en: And now am I their song , yea , I am their byword .
translation.kha: Mynta ki wan bad ki ïa-rkhie ïa nga ; ngam long ei ei shuh hynrei ka jingbiria ïa ki .

translation.en: But Zadok the priest , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and Nathan the prophet , and Shimei , and Rei , and the mighty men which belonged to David , were not with Adonijah .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Sadok u lyngdoh , u Benaïah u khun jong u Jehoïada , u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa , u Shimei , u Rei , bad ki nongïada jong u Dabid , kim don ha ka liang jong u Adonijah .

translation.en: But now , after that ye have known God , or rather are known of God , how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements , whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage ?
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ba phi la ithuh ïa U Blei — lane , nga dei ban ong , mynta ba U Blei u la ithuh ïa phi — kumno ka long kata ba phi dang kwah ban phai pat sha kita ki bor mynsiem kiba tlot bad kiba isangsot ? Balei phi kwah ban long mraw pat sa shisien ha ki ?

translation.en: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah , of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin :
translation.kha: Kane ka kitab ka dei ka jingïathuh ïa kaei kaba la kren da u Jeremaïah , u khun jong u Hilkaïah , uwei na ki lyngdoh jong ka shnong Anathoth ha ka thain Benjamin .

translation.en: For truly my words shall not be false : he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee .
translation.kha: Ym don kaei kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi kaba long kaba bakla ; phi ïohi ha khmat jong phi ïa u briew uba stad shisha .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  God of our fathers , which hath put such a thing as this in the king s heart , to beautify the house of the  Lord  which is in Jerusalem :
translation.kha: U Esra u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ! U la pynlong ïa u patsha da ka mon sngewbha ban burom ha kane ka rukom ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai  ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Why are ye troubled ? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts ?
translation.kha: Hynrei , u la ong ha ki ,  Balei ba phi ïasheptieng ? Balei ba kine ki jingartatien ki wan ha ki jingpyrkhat jong phi ?

translation.en: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments , and of the fishes .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la ïalum khat-ar tukri kiba dap da kaei kaba la sah tam na u kpu bad ki dohkha .

translation.en: How did you write ?
translation.kha: Kumno phi thoh ?

translation.en: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law , That the man which doeth those things shall live by them .
translation.kha: U Moses u la thoh ïa kane , shaphang ka jingïadei bad U Blei da kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum :  Uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong ka Hukum un ïap .

translation.en: And I saw an angel come down from heaven , having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel ba u wan hiar na bneng , u da bat ha ka kti ïa u shabi jong ka  liewlong khlem trai bad u kynjri uba khia .

translation.en: If thou be righteous , what givest thou him ? or what receiveth he of thine hand ?
translation.kha: Hato me ïarap ïa U Blei da kaba me long uba hok ? Kam don kano kano kaba U Blei u donkam na me .

translation.en: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon , and took the royal city .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Joab u nang bteng ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Rabbah , ka nongbah jong ki Ammon , bad u la jan ïohknieh ïa ka .

translation.en: Which also they did , and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul .
translation.kha: Te ki la leh ïa kane , bad ki la phah ïa ka pisa sha ki tymmen basan jong ka balang lyngba u Barnabas bad u Saul .

translation.en: And they shall drive thee from men , and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field : they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen , and seven times shall pass over thee , until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men , and giveth it to whomsoever he will .
translation.kha: Ïa me yn beh noh na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew , men shong men sah bad ki mradkhlaw , bad bam phlang kum u masi dab haduh hynñiew snem . Nangta men pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u don ka bor halor baroh ki hima ki briew bad ba u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .

translation.en: As the nations which the  Lord  destroyeth before your face , so shall ye perish  ; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Lada phim kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , phin shah pynjot kumjuh kumba kita ki jaitbynriew kin shah pynjot ha U  Trai  katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat .

translation.en: And when he had said this , he breathed on them , and saith unto them ,  Receive ye the Holy Ghost :
translation.kha: Nangta u la pyrsad halor jong ki bad u la ong ,  To pdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god , that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword  ; and they escaped into the land of Armenia : and Esar–haddon his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u dang mane ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong u , u Nisrokh ; ar ngut na ki khun shynrang jong u , u Adrammelekh bad u Shareser , ki la pynïap ïa u da ki waitlam bad nangta ki la phet ban lait im sha ka ri Ararat . Uwei pat na ki khun shynrang jong u , u Esarhaddon u la long u patsha hadien jong u .

translation.en: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him , even a pillar of stone : and he poured a drink offering thereon , and he poured oil thereon .
translation.kha: Hangta , ha kaba U Blei u la ïakren bad u , u Jakob u pynïeng ïa u maw pynsah kynmaw bad u la pynkyntang ïa u da kaba theh ïa ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib halor jong u .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite , and his seed : he shall not have a man to dwell among this people  ; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people , saith the  Lord   ; because he hath taught rebellion against the  Lord .
translation.kha: ban phah sha ki koidi baroh ha Babilon ïa kane ka khubor shaphang u Shemaïah :  Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynshitom ïa u Shemaïah bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u baroh . Ngam shym la phah ïa u , hynrei u la kren ha phi kumba u la long u nongïathuhlypa , bad la pynlong ïa phi ban ngeit ïa ki jinglamler . Un ym don kino kino ki khun ki ksiew hapdeng jong phi . Un ym im ban ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba ngan leh na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , namar u la ong ïa ki ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Is the law then against the promises of God ? God forbid : for if there had been a law given which could have given life , verily righteousness should have been by the law .
translation.kha: Hato kane ka mut ba ka Hukum ka long pyrshah ïa ki jingkular U Blei ? Em , ym dei kumta! Naba lada u khunbynriew u la ïohpdiang ïa ka Hukum kaba lah ban wanrah jingim , te uwei pa uwei u lah ban long uba la pynksan ha U Blei da kaba kohnguh ïa ka .

translation.en: And he shall send Jesus Christ , which before was preached unto you :
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , ki por jong ka jingkhlaiñ ba kynja mynsiem kin wan na U Trai , bad un phah ïa U Jisu , uba long U Messaïah ïa uba u la lah jied na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: His roots are wrapped about the heap , and seeth the place of stones .
translation.kha: Ki thied jong ki , ki kyllaiñ sawdong ïa ki maw , bad ki batskhem ha man la u mawsiang .

translation.en: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths , when I brought them out of the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: khnang ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin ïoh tip ba U  Trai  u la pynshong ïa ki Israel ha ki ïingtrep mynba u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Exalt her , and she shall promote thee : she shall bring thee to honour , when thou dost embrace her .
translation.kha: Ieit ïa ka jingstad , te kan pynkhraw ïa phi ; pdiang ïa ka , te kan ai burom ïa phi .

translation.en: Blessed are the peacemakers : for they shall be called the children of God .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba trei na ka bynta ka jingsuk ; U Blei un khot ïa ki , ki khun jong u !

translation.en: And this voice which came from heaven we heard , when we were with him in the holy mount .
translation.kha: Ngi hi da lade ngi la ïohsngew ïa kane ka sur kaba wan na bneng , haba ngi la ïadon lem bad u ha u lum bakhuid .

translation.en: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and began to speak with other tongues , as the Spirit gave them utterance .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki baroh da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ban kren ha kiwei pat ki ktien , kat kumba U Mynsiem u pynlah ïa ki ban kren .

translation.en: And this is the Father s will which hath sent me , that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing , but should raise it up again at the last day .
translation.kha: Bad ka long ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga ba ngam dei ban duh noh ïa uno uno na kita baroh kiba u la ai ha nga , hynrei ba nga dei ban pynmihpat ïa ki baroh ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

translation.en: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal , saying , Let Baal plead against him , because he hath thrown down his altar .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ïa u Gideon la tip kum u Jerubbaal , namar u Joash u ong ,  Ieh u Baal un ïasaid da hi ïa lade ; ka dei ka duwan jong u ïa kaba la pynkhyllem .

translation.en: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near , and accused the Jews .
translation.kha: Ka dei ha kata ba katto katne ki nong Babilonia ki la shim kabu ban kren pyrshah ïa ki Jiw .

translation.en: His sons , and his sons  sons with him , his daughters , and his sons  daughters , and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki shim ruh ïa la ki jingri bad ki jingdon jingem baroh kiba ki la lum ha Kanaan , bad ki leit noh sha Ijipt . U Jakob u leit sha Ijipt lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u baroh , ki khun shynrang ki ksiew shynrang ki khun kynthei bad ki ksiew kynthei .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Thou shalt drink of thy sister s cup deep and large : thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision  ; it containeth much .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Phan dih na ka khuri jong ka hynmen jong pha ; kaba heh bad kaba jylliew . Baroh kin ñiewbeiñ bad krenbeiñ ïa pha ; ka khuri ka dap pura .

translation.en: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom , Go in unto thy father s concubines , which he hath left to keep the house  ; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father : then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong .
translation.kha: U Ahithophel u jubab ,  Khie leit ïathiah shongkha bad ki tnga kliar u kpa jong phi , ïa kiba u la iehnoh shadien ban sumar ïa ka ïingsyiem . Te uwei pa uwei ha Israel un tip ba u kpa jong phi u kheiñ ïa phi kum u nongshun jong u , bad ïa ki nongbud jong phi yn pynshlur shibun eh .

translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites , as it is written , This people honoureth me with their lips , but their heart is far from me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  A katno kaba dei ba u Isaïah u la ïathuhlypa shaphang jong phi ! Phi long kiba arsap , thik kumba u la thoh :   ‘ Kine ki briew , ong U Blei , ki burom ïa nga da ki ktien jong ki , hynrei ka dohnud jong ki , ka long jngai shisha na nga .

translation.en: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people , thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen : a people which I knew not shall serve me .
translation.kha: Me la pyllait im ïa nga na ki briew jong nga kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad me la pynneh ïa ka jingsynshar jong nga halor ki jaitbynriew ; ki briew kiba ngam ju ithuh ki la long mynta ki raïot jong nga .

translation.en: Hast not thou made an hedge about him , and about his house , and about all that he hath on every side ? thou hast blessed the work of his hands , and his substance is increased in the land .
translation.kha: Me la ïada ïa u borabor bad ïa ka longïing jong u bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u don . Me la kyrkhu ïa baroh kiba u leh , bad me la ai ha u shibun ki masi ban pyndap ha baroh ka ri .

translation.en: My skin is black upon me , and my bones are burned with heat .
translation.kha: Ka sniehdoh jong nga ka la kylla ïong ; ïa nga la thang da ka jingpang shit .

translation.en: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight , and left their tents , and their horses , and their asses , even the camp as it was , and fled for their life .
translation.kha: Kumta ha kata ka janmiet ki Syria ki la phet ban lait im , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ki ïingjaiñ , ki kulai , bad ki kada , bad ki la iehnoh ruh ïa ka jaka shong dara kumba ka long .

translation.en: Grace be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: To ka jingaiei U Blei kan long lem bad phi baroh .

translation.en: There is misunderstanding between he and her
translation.kha: kha Ladon ymsngewthuh ha pdeng arngud

translation.en: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies ? yea , they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart  ;
translation.kha: Slem haduh katno kita ki nongïathuhlypa kin ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga da ki jinglamler kiba ki shu thaw ?

translation.en: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared , that thou hast lied , and hast not remembered me , nor laid it to thy heart ? have not I held my peace even of old , and thou fearest me not ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kiei kine ki blei kiba pynsheptieng ïa phi , kumta ba phi ïathuh ïa nga ïa kaba lamler bad klet syndon ïa nga ? Hato phim shym la ai burom shuh ïa nga namar ba nga la shu sngap la slem bah ?

translation.en: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore , and among the sons of Merari .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingbate kam ïa ki nongap phira kiba na ka kur u Korah bad na ka kur u Merari .

translation.en: As you continue studying the Bible , you will learn how to use the Bible to explain your faith in Jehovah and the good news . —Read Romans 10 :13-15 .
translation.kha: Katba phi dang ïaibteng ban pule ïa ka Baibl , katta phin sa nang ban pyndonkam ïa ka Baibl ban batai ïa la ka jingngeit ha U Jehobah bad ha ka khubor babha .—Pule Rom 10 :13-15 .

translation.en: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth , and hid his lord s money .
translation.kha: Hynrei u shakri uba la ïohpdiang shihajar tylli ki sbai u la leit noh , u la tih ka thliew ha ka khyndew , bad u la buhrieh ïa ka pisa jong u kynrad jong u .

translation.en: The place of the scripture which he read was this , He was led as a sheep to the slaughter  ; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer , so opened he not his mouth :
translation.kha: Ka bynta jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba u dang pule ka la long kane :  Kum ka langbrot ïa kaba la ïalam ban shah pynïap , kum u khunlangbrot uba sngap jar haba khap ïa u shñiuh jong u , um shym kren wat shikyntien .

translation.en: Therefore let no man glory in men . For all things are yours ;
translation.kha: Kumta wat ai ba uno uno un sngewsarong shaphang kaei kaba u bynriew u lah ban leh . Ha ka jingshisha baroh kiei kiei ki long ki jong phi :

translation.en: Howbeit the high places were not removed : the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places . He built the higher gate of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynpra , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta . U dei u Jotham uba la tei ïa ka Khyrdop Bashaneng jong ka Templ .

translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  God of Israel saith , I said indeed that thy house , and the house of thy father , should walk before me for ever : but now the  Lord  saith , Be it far from me  ; for them that honour me I will honour , and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la kular mynshuwa ba ka ïing jong me bad ka kur ka jait jong me kin shakri ïa nga junom kum ki lyngdoh . Hynrei mynta ngam shah shuh ba kan long kumta . Pynban , ngan pyndonburom ïa kito kiba pyndonburom ïa nga , bad ngan ibeiñ ïa kito kiba ibeiñ ïa nga .

translation.en: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house  ; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins , he shall build the house unto my name .
translation.kha: hynrei men ym ïoh ban tei ïa ka ; dei u khun jong me , u khun jong me hi u ban tei ïa ka Templ jong nga .’

translation.en: And Elisha said unto him , Take bow and arrows . And he took unto him bow and arrows .
translation.kha: Pynïoh ïa ka ryntieh bad katto katne tylli ki khnam ,  u Elisha u hukum ïa u . U Jehoash u pynïoh ïa ki ,

translation.en: And the mean man boweth down , and the great man humbleth himself : therefore forgive them not .
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynlehrain bad yn pynjahburom . Wat map ïa ki , A  Trai  !

translation.en: Thou gavest me no kiss : but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet .
translation.kha: Mem shym la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga da ka jingdoh , hynrei kam shym la sangeh ban doh ïa ki kjat jong nga naduh ba nga la wan .

translation.en: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon : for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them : therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them .
translation.kha: Namar ka bynta jong ka Judah ka kham heh ban ïa kaba ka donkam , shi bynta na ka jaka jong ka la ai ha ka jait Simeon .

translation.en: And it came to pass also on another sabbath , that he entered into the synagogue and taught : and there was a man whose right hand was withered .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu u la leit sha ka synagog bad u la hikai . La don u briew hangta uba ka kti kamon jong u ka la ïapshiliang .

translation.en: Yea , the light of the wicked shall be put out , and the spark of his fire shall not shine .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingshai jong u briew basniew yn pynlip sah ; ki thylliej ding jong ka kin ym meh shuh .

translation.en: Behold , I have received commandment to bless : and he hath blessed  ; and I cannot reverse it .
translation.kha: Ïa nga la bthah ban kyrkhu , Bad haba U Blei u kyrkhu , ngam lah ban pynkylla da kumwei pat .

translation.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering , to make an atonement for you :
translation.kha: Kñia ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa u paidbah .

translation.en: This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded , Gather of it every man according to his eating , an omer for every man , according to the number of your persons  ; take ye every man for them which are in his tents .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ba uwei pa uwei na phi un lum katba u lah ban bam , ar kilo ïa uwei uwei u briew ha ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: For her sins have reached unto heaven , and God hath remembered her iniquities .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ki pop jong ka la kynton shajrong kat shaduh bneng , bad U Blei u kynmaw ïa ki kam bymman jong ka .

translation.en: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek , and Latin , and Hebrew , THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS .
translation.kha: Shalor jong u la thoh ïa kine ki kyntien :  Une u long U Syiem ki Jiw .

translation.en: That the land spue not you out also , when ye defile it , as it spued out the nations that were before you .
translation.kha: te kata ka ri kan ym kyntait ïa phi , kumba ka la leh ïa kita ki briew ki bymngeit Blei kiba im hangta ha shuwa jong phi .

translation.en: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine : and he was the priest of the most high God .
translation.kha: Bad u Melkhisedek , uba long u syiem jong ka Salem bad uba long ruh u lyngdoh jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , u la wallam ïa u kpu bad ka waiñ ha u Abram ,

translation.en: And it came to pass at midnight , that the man was afraid , and turned himself : and , behold , a woman lay at his feet .
translation.kha: Ha ka por mynmiet u kyndit thiah kynsan , u phai , bad u lyngngoh ban shem ïa ka kynthei kaba thiah ha ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: And Gideon made an ephod thereof , and put it in his city , even in Ophrah : and all Israel went thither a whoring after it : which thing became a snare unto Gideon , and to his house .
translation.kha: U Gideon u shna ka bleithaw na ka ksiar bad u buh ïa ka ha la shnong , ha Ophrah . Baroh ki Israel ki la iehnoh ïa U Blei bad ki la leit shata ban mane ïa ka bleithaw . Ka la long ka jingriam ïa u Gideon bad ïa ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth , and forgetteth the covenant of her God .
translation.kha: kaba iehnoh ïa la u jong u tnga bad klet ïa la ka jutang kaba kyntang .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; When the whole earth rejoiceth , I will make thee desolate .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan sa pynlong ïa me ka ri kaba kynjah katta katta ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan shadkmen namar ka jingkyllon jong me ,

translation.en: Ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth  ; but how is it that ye do not discern this time ?
translation.kha: A kiba arsap ! Phi lah ban khmih ïa ka khyndew bad ïa ka suiñbneng bad ïathuh lypa ïa ka jinglong ka suiñbneng ; balei , te , phim tip ïa ka jingmut jong kane ka por ba mynta ?

translation.en: For he that is dead is freed from sin .
translation.kha: Naba haba u briew u ïap , la pyllait noh ïa u na ka bor jong ka pop .

translation.en: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul : but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil .
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba sngewtynnat ban ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ! Ki briew kiba mutlop ki kyntait ban phai noh na kaba sniew .

translation.en: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly : therefore shall he leave his blood upon him , and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la pynbitar kthang ïa U  Trai  ; ki dei hok ban shah pynïap namar ki kam sniew jong ki . U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingpynjahburom kaba ki la wanlam ha u .

translation.en: And they are informed of thee , that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses , saying that they ought not to circumcise their children , neither to walk after the customs .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha ki , ba me la hikai ïa ki Jiw baroh kiba shong basah ha ki ri jong ki Jentil ban iehnoh ïa ka Hukum u Moses , da kaba ong ïa ki ban ym otsher ïa ki khun jong ki lane bud ïa ki dustur jong ki Jiw .

translation.en: And he said , They were my brethren , even the sons of my mother : as the  Lord  liveth , if ye had saved them alive , I would not slay you .
translation.kha: U Gideon u ong ,  Ki dei ki para jong nga , ki khun shynrang i mei jong nga . Nga smai da kaba kyntang ba lada phin shym la pynïap ïa ki , ngan ym pynïap ïa phi .

translation.en: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof  ; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat pyndonkam ïa ka snam jong ki kum ka jingbam ; pynban , theh noh ïa ka ha khyndew kumba theh um .

translation.en: But meat commendeth us not to God : for neither , if we eat , are we the better ; neither , if we eat not , are we the worse .
translation.kha: Pynban , ka jingbam , kan ym lah ban nang pynbha ïa ka jingïadei jong ngi bad U Blei ; ngin ym duh ei ei lada ngim bam , lymne ngin ym ïohnong ei ei lada ngi bam .

translation.en: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords , and took him up out of the dungeon : and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison .
translation.kha: Nga la leh ïa kane , bad ki la tan ïa nga shalor shabar ka pung . Hadien kata ïa nga la buh ha ka phyllaw ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals unto one bullock , two tenth deals unto one ram ,
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,

translation.en: Saying , I will declare thy name unto my brethren , in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee .
translation.kha: U ong ha U Blei ,  Ngan pynbna ha ki para jong nga , ïa kaei kaba me la leh ; ngan rwai ïaroh ïa me ha ki jingïamane lang jong ki .

translation.en: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought . And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon .
translation.kha: nalor ki khajna ba la siew da ki nongkhaïi bad ki mahajon . Ki syiem Arabia bad ki lat jong ki jylla Israel ruh ki wanrah ïa u ka rupa bad ka ksiar .

translation.en: See therefore , and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself , and come ye again to me with the certainty , and I will go with you : and it shall come to pass , if he be in the land , that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah .
translation.kha: Wad bha ïa ki jaka ha kiba u rieh , bad da kynmaw ban wanrah khubor beit beit sha nga . Te ngan sa leit bad phi ; bad lada u dang don ha kata ka thain , ngan kthong ïa u , wat la nga hap ban wad ha ka ri Judah baroh kawei .

translation.en: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is , and he shall shut it up seven days more :
translation.kha: un hukum ba dei ban sait ïa ka , bad buh kyrpang ïa ka sa hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: But we are all as an unclean thing , and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags  ; and we all do fade as a leaf  ; and our iniquities , like the wind , have taken us away .
translation.kha: Baroh na ngi , ngi long kiba pop ; wat ki kam babha tam jong ngi ki long ki bymkhuid shi lynter . Namar ki pop jong ngi , ngi long kum ki sla ba la tlor bad ba la rong noh da ka lyer .

translation.en: And they shall be mine , saith the  Lord  of hosts , in that day when I make up my jewels  ; and I will spare them , as a man spareth his own son that serveth him .
translation.kha: Kin long ki briew jong nga ,  ong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .  Ha ka sngi ba ngan trei ïa ka kam , kin long ki jong nga hi . Ngan leh-isynei ïa ki kumba u kpa u leh-isynei ïa u khun uba shakri ïa u .

translation.en: Thou shalt have none other gods before me .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat mane ïa uwei pat u blei lait na nga .

translation.en: Children s children are the crown of old men  ; and the glory of children are their fathers .
translation.kha: Ki riewtymmen ki sngewsarong ïa la ki jong ki ksiew , kumba ki khynnah ki sngewsarong ïa la ki jong ki kpa .

translation.en: So every man of Israel went up from after David , and followed Sheba the son of Bichri : but the men of Judah clave unto their king , from Jordan even to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Israel ki la iehnoh ïa u Dabid bad ki la leit bad u Sheba ; hynrei ki rangbah Judah ki la ïaineh bad ki bud ïa u Dabid na Jordan sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Traitors , heady , highminded , lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God ;
translation.kha: kin long kiba shetkylla , kiba leh thurmur , bad kiba hangamei ; kin ieit ïa ka jingsngewbha ban ïa U Blei ;

translation.en: And David my servant shall be king over them  ; and they all shall have one shepherd : they shall also walk in my judgments , and observe my statutes , and do them .
translation.kha: U syiem uba kum u Dabid , u shakri jong nga un long u syiem jong ki . Kin ïalong kawei hapoh uwei u nongsynshar bad kin kohnguh hok ïa ki aiñ jong nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron , that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation : and , behold , the cloud covered it , and the glory of the  Lord  appeared .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la ïalumlang baroh ban pynpaw pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , ki la phai shaphang ka Ïingjaiñ bad ki la ïohi ba u lyoh u la tap ïa ka bad ba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka la paw .

translation.en: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court , which was at the side of the north gate  ; and their prospect was toward the south : one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north .
translation.kha: Te u la wallam ïa nga sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . La don ar tylli ki kamra ha ka phyllaw bashapoh , kawei kaba phai shaphang shathie harud ka khyrdop bashatei bad kawei kaba phai shatei harud ka khyrdop bashathie .

translation.en: And they departed , and went through the towns , preaching the gospel , and healing every where .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la mihnoh bad ki la leit lyngba ki nongrit baroh , ki da ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha bad ki da pynkhiah ïa ki briew ha kylleng .

translation.en: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb , as Moses said : and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak .
translation.kha: Kumba u Moses u la hukum , la ai ïa ka Hebron ha u Kaleb , uba la beh noh na ka nongbah ïa ki lai tylli ki kur kiba hiarpateng na u Anak .

translation.en: And they said , Thou hast not defrauded us , nor oppressed us , neither hast thou taken ought of any man s hand .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la jubab ,  Em , phim shym la shukor ïa ngi , lane banbeiñ ïa ngi , lane shim ei ei nano nano .

translation.en: But he said , As the  Lord  liveth , before whom I stand , I will receive none . And he urged him to take it  ; but he refused .
translation.kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , uba nga shakri , nga smai ba ngan ym pdiang ïa ka jingai sngewbha .  U Naaman u ïai ban ba un pdiang , hynrei um treh .

translation.en: Lay not wait , O wicked man , against the dwelling of the righteous  ; spoil not his resting place :
translation.kha: Wat long kum ki riewsniew kiba thmu ban lute ïa u briew uba hok ne ban knieh noh ïa ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: If his children be multiplied , it is for the sword : and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread .
translation.kha: Ki lah ban don shibun ki khun shynrang , hynrei baroh kin sa ïap ha ka thma ; ki khun jong ki kin ym ïoh ka jingbam kaba biang .

translation.en: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals : they shall be of fine flour  ; they shall be baken with leaven  ; they are the firstfruits unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka longïing ka dei ban wallam ar tylli ki kpu ban pynlong ka jingainguh kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai . Kita ki kpu ki dei ban long kiba ar kilo uwei uwei , kiba la pynkhreh na u  purew , bad kiba la shet bad u thiat , bad yn ai ïa ki kum ki soh nyngkong sha U  Trai .

translation.en: To whom then will ye liken me , or shall I be equal ? saith the Holy One .
translation.kha: Badno lah ban ïanujor ïa U Blei bakhuid ? Don uno uno ba kum ma u ?

translation.en: And Laban had two daughters : the name of the elder was Leah , and the name of the younger was Rachel .
translation.kha: U Laban u don ar ngut ki khun kynthei ; kaba heh ka kyrteng ka Leah , bad kaba rit pat ka Rakhel .

translation.en: Thou shalt plant vineyards , and dress them , but shalt neither drink of the wine , nor gather the grapes  ; for the worms shall eat them .
translation.kha: Phin thung ki dieng sohwaiñ ha bri , bad phin sumar ïa ki , hynrei phin ym ïoh kheit ïa ki sohwaiñ lane dih waiñ na ki , namar ki khñiang kin bam ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ .

translation.en: Yes , of course .
translation.kha: Haoid Shim Seh .

translation.en: And his sons went and feasted in their houses , every one his day  ; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Job ki ju pynlong da ka pali ïa ka jingkhawai , sha kaba baroh kiwei ki ïawan , bad borabor ki ju khot sngewbha ïa ki lai ngut ki para kynthei ban ïadon lang bad ki .

translation.en: If thou buy an Hebrew servant , six years he shall serve : and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing .
translation.kha: Lada phi thied ïa u mraw Hebru , u dei ban shakri ïa phi hynriew snem . Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew , u dei ban ïoh laitluid khlem da hap siew ei ei .

translation.en: He was taken from prison and from judgment : and who shall declare his generation ? for he was cut off out of the land of the living : for the transgression of my people was he stricken .
translation.kha: La kem ïa u bad la bishar bad ïalam noh ban shah pynïap , bad ym don ba salia ïa kaei ka ban jia ïa u . La pynïap ïa u na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew jong ngi .

translation.en: Thus did Uriah the priest , according to all that king Ahaz commanded .
translation.kha: U Uriah u leh kumba u syiem u la hukum .

translation.en: Therefore pray not thou for this people , neither lift up a cry or prayer for them : for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble .
translation.kha: Ko Jeremaïah , wat duwai ha nga lane ïasaid bad nga na ka bynta kine ki briew . Haba ki don ha ka jingjynjar bad ki pyrta sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap , ngan ym shahshkor ïa ki .

translation.en: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence , and have been given to the poor . And they murmured against her .
translation.kha: Yn jin da la die ïa ka palat laispah ki sbai rupa bad ïa ka pisa ban ai ha kiba duk !  Bad ki la kem daw tyngeh ïa ka .

translation.en: They are all grievous revolters , walking with slanders : they are brass and iron  ; they are all corrupters .
translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki long ki nongïaleh pyrshah ba-mutlop , kiba eh kum ka rnong bad u nar . Ma ki baroh ki long kiba sniew , ki da ïaid kylleng bad pynsaphriang ïa ka lorni .

translation.en: And the people said unto Joshua , Nay  ; but we will serve the  Lord .
translation.kha: U paidbah u ong ha u Joshua ,  Em ! Ngin shakri ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth , ere it was chewed , the wrath of the  Lord  was kindled against the people , and the  Lord  smote the people with a very great plague .
translation.kha: Katba kata ka doh ka dang bun ba kin bam , U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa kita ki briew bad u pynngat ka jingïapthem kaba jur hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father , he strengthened himself , and slew all his brethren with the sword , and divers also of the princes of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u Jehoram u la skhem ha ka jingsynshar ïa ka hima , u la pynïap ïa ki para shynrang jong u baroh , bad ruh ïa ki katto katne ngut ki nong Israel kiba dei ki rangbah synshar .

translation.en: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven .
translation.kha: Hynrei u shñiuh u sdang ban san biang .

translation.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel baroh ki ïaleit noh ,

translation.en: Ye that put far away the evil day , and cause the seat of violence to come near  ;
translation.kha: Phi kyntait ban pdiang ba ka sngi jong ka jingjot ka wan , hynrei kaei ba phi leh ka long tang ban pynjan ïa kata ka sngi .

translation.en: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang nyngkong jong ki nong Ijipt ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: And , behold , there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue , Jairus by name  ; and when he saw him , he fell at his feet ,
translation.kha: U Jairos , u rangbah synshar ka synagog hangta , u la wan poi , bad haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu , u la dem ha ki kjat jong u ,

translation.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away : as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places .
translation.kha: Um shym pyntwa noh ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai ki jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .

translation.en: And devils also came out of many , crying out , and saying , Thou art Christ the Son of God . And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak : for they knew that he was Christ .
translation.kha: Ki ksuid ruh ki la mihnoh na kiba bun ki briew , ki da lynñiar ,  Me long U Khun jong U Blei !  U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ksuid bad um shah ïa ki ban kren , namar ba ki la ithuh ba u la long U Messaïah .

translation.en: Then Peter said unto him , Lord , speakest thou this parable unto us , or even to all ?
translation.kha: U Petros u la ong ,  Ko Trai hato kane ka pharshi ka dei na ka bynta jong ngi , ne me mut ïa ka na ka bynta uwei pa uwei baroh ?

translation.en: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off , and to them that were nigh .
translation.kha: Bad U wan bad u la ïalap ïa ka khubor babha jong ka jingsuk sha phi kiba la jngai bad ha kiba long hajan .

translation.en: But the Spirit of the  Lord  departed from Saul , and an evil spirit from the  Lord  troubled him .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa u Saul , bad u mynsiem bymman ba la phah da U  Trai  u pynjynjar ïa u .

translation.en: Then there arose a question between some of John s disciples and the Jews about purifying .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la sdang ban ïatainia bad u Jiw shaphang ki bynta ba ïadei bad ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid .

translation.en: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people : for the people shouted with a loud shout , and the noise was heard afar off .
translation.kha: Ym don ba lah ban pynïapher hapdeng ki jingpyrta jong ka jingkmen bad ka jingïam , namar ka jingsawa kaba ki la pynlong ka long kaba haduh katta katta , ba lah ban ïohsngew shaduh sha jngai .

translation.en: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud , and as the early dew that passeth away , as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor , and as the smoke out of the chimney .
translation.kha: Bad kumta kine ki briew kin sa jah kum u lyoh khyndew mynstep , kum ka umjer kaba jah noh shen dang step phyrngab . Kin long kum u stait ba ka lyer ka rong noh na ka kyntem , kum ka tdem kaba mih na ka dpei .

translation.en: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Koz another piece , from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib .
translation.kha: U Meremoth , u khun jong u Uriah bad u ksiew jong u Hakkos , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh kaba kut ka ïing u Eliashib .

translation.en: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ha U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi , long ka burom junom la junom! Amen .

translation.en: Be careful for nothing ; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God .
translation.kha: Wat khuslai shaphang kaei kaei , hynrei ha ki jingduwai jong phi baroh , to pan na U Blei ïa kaei kaba phi donkam bad da pan borabor na u da ka dohnud kaba sngewnguh .

translation.en: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee  ; before it came to pass I shewed it thee : lest thou shouldest say , Mine idol hath done them , and my graven image , and my molten image , hath commanded them .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la ïathuh lypa ïa ka lawei jong phi lah slem bah , da kaba pynbna ïa ki jingjia ha shuwa ba kin wan jia , ban khang ïa phi na kaba kam ba ki bleithaw bad ki durblei jong phi , ki la pynjia ïa ki .

translation.en: Let us go , we pray thee , unto Jordan , and take thence every man a beam , and let us make us a place there , where we may dwell . And he answered , Go ye .
translation.kha: Shah ba ngin leit sha Jordan ba ngin ïapom katto katne tylli ki dieng ba ngi lah ban shna ka jaka ba ngin shong .  U Elisha u jubab ,  Khie leit .

translation.en: And for his sister a virgin , that is nigh unto him , which hath had no husband  ; for her may he be defiled .
translation.kha: lane ka hynmen ka para ka bym pat shongkurim kaba shong basah ha ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: Then said his servants unto him , What thing is this that thou hast done ? thou didst fast and weep for the child , while it was alive  ; but when the child was dead , thou didst rise and eat bread .
