translation.kha: Ngim shemphang satia ïa kane ,  ki rangbah synshar ki ong ha u .  Katba i khunlung i dang im , phi la ïam na ka bynta jong i bad phim treh ban bam ; hynrei mar ïa-ïap ma i , phi la khie joit bad phi la bam !

translation.en: And they come to Jerusalem : and Jesus went into the temple , and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves  ;
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Jerusalem , U Jisu u la rung shapoh ka Templ bad u la sdang ban beh noh shabar ïa baroh kito kiba dang ïathied bad ïadie . U la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki miej jong ki nongïapeiñ pisa bad ïa ki jaka shong jong kito kiba ïadie paro ,

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Lymne nga ruh ngan ïathuh ha phi , te , da kaei ka hok ba nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat , and the wine that they should drink  ; and gave them pulse .
translation.kha: Kumta naduh kata u nongap phira u la shah ïa ki ban bteng ban bam da ki jhur ha ka jaka jong kaei kaba u syiem u la pynbiang .

translation.en: And they ran and fetched him thence : and when he stood among the people , he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward .
translation.kha: Kumta ki mareh bad ki wan ïalam ïa u Saul hapdeng kita ki paidbah , bad ki ïohi ba ka khlieh jong u ka khamtam ban ïano ïano ruh .

translation.en: And thou shalt set the table without the veil , and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south : and thou shalt put the table on the north side .
translation.kha: Habar jong ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam buh ïa kata ka miej ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ha ka liang kaba shaphang shathie .

translation.en: Nor thieves , nor covetous , nor drunkards , nor revilers , nor extortioners , shall inherit the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: lane kiba tuh lane kiba kwah lalot lane kiba buaid lane kiba kren thadrong ïa kiwei lane ki nongtuh — yn ym don uno uno na kine u ban ïohkynti ïa ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity , in Ur of the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: bad u Haran u la ïap ha la ka jong ka shnong , ka Ur ha ka ri Babilonia , mynba u kpa jong u , u dang im .

translation.en: King Agrippa , believest thou the prophets ? I know that thou believest .
translation.kha: Ko syiem Agrippa , hato me ngeit ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ? Nga tip ba me ngeit !

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that she was sick , and died : whom when they had washed , they laid her in an upper chamber .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka la pang bad ka la ïap . Ïa ka met jong ka la pynsum bad la pynthiah ïa ka ha ka kamra kaba haneng .

translation.en: But those mine enemies , which would not that I should reign over them , bring hither , and slay them before me .
translation.kha: Mynta , ïa kito ki nongshun jong nga ki bym kwah ïa nga ban long u syiem jong ki , to wallam ïa ki hangne bad pynïap ïa ki ha khmat jong nga !’

translation.en: And the children of Benjamin said , They are smitten down before us , as at the first . But the children of Israel said , Let us flee , and draw them from the city unto the highways .
translation.kha: Ki Benjamin ki ïa-ong ,  Ngi la jop ïa ki kum mynshuwa .  Hynrei ki Israel ki la ïasylla lypa ban randien bad ban ring pah ïa ki shabar ka nongbah shaduh ki lynti bah .

translation.en: That they may want bread and water , and be astonished one with another , and consume away for their iniquity .
translation.kha: Kin sa kyrduh ïa u kpu bad ka um ; kin long kiba duh jingkyrmen , bad kin ringsdot noh namar ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp , and burn him as he burned the first bullock : it is a sin offering for the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta un shim ïa uta u masi lyngraw shabar ka jaka shong dara bad thang ïa u kumba u thang ïa u masi lyngraw ïa uba la kñia ainguh namar la ka jong ka pop . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ainguh ban map noh ïa ka pop jong uta u paidlang .

translation.en: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt , and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros , into the land of their habitation  ; and they shall be there a base kingdom .
translation.kha: bad ngan shah ïa ki ban im ha ka bynta bashathie ka Ijipt , ka shnong trai jong ki . Hangta kin long ka hima kaba tlot bor ,

translation.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and saddled his ass , and took two of his young men with him , and Isaac his son , and clave the wood for the burnt offering , and rose up , and went unto the place of which God had told him .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Abraham u thlieh ki dieng na ka bynta ka jingkñia , u la pynkit halor ka kada , bad u la ïalam ïa u Isaak lem bad ar ngut ki shakri . Ki la ïamihnoh ban leit sha ka jaka ba U Blei u la ïathuh ha u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt , and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters  ; for I know their sorrows  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la ïohi haduh katno la pynshitom beiñ ïa ki briew jong nga ha Ijipt ; nga la ïohsngew ruh ba ki ud ban ïohlait noh na ki nongpyntrei mraw jong ki . Nga tip ïa ki jingshah shitom jong ki baroh ,

translation.en: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold , I cannot go beyond the commandment of the  Lord  , to do either good or bad of mine own mind  ; but what the  Lord  saith , that will I speak ?
translation.kha: ba wat lada phi ai lut ha nga ïa ka ksiar ka rupa kaba don ha ka ïingsyiem jong phi , ngan ym ïaid palat ïa ka hukum U  Trai  da kaba leh ïa kaei kaei da la ka mon . Ngan kren tang ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ha nga ban kren .

translation.en: And king Herod heard of him  ; ( for his name was spread abroad : ) and he said , That John the Baptist was risen from the dead , and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him .
translation.kha: Mynta u syiem Herod u la ïohsngew shaphang kane baroh , namar ka nam U Jisu ka la phriang kylleng . Katto katne ngut ki briew ki ïa-ong ,  U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la im pat ! Dei na kata ka daw balei u don ïa kane ka bor ban leh ki kambah .

translation.en: And after they had tarried there a space , they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la pynlut katto katne por hangta , la phah noh ïa ki ha kaba suk da ki parabangeit bad ki la leit phai pat sha kito kiba la phah ïa ki .

translation.en: ( Yea , a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also , ) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingsngewsih , kum ka waitlam banep , kan pynlwet ïa ka dohnud jong pha hi .

translation.en: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person , to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom : but he shall come in peaceably , and obtain the kingdom by flatteries .
translation.kha: U angel u la bteng ban batai :  U syiem uba bud jong ka Syria un long u briew uba sniew u bym don ka hok ban long syiem , hynrei un wan khlem khmih lynti bad un knieh ïa ka bor da ka buit shukor .

translation.en: He shall lean upon his house , but it shall not stand : he shall hold it fast , but it shall not endure .
translation.kha: Lada ki shaniah ha ka snur thapbawa , hato ka lah ban shan ïa ki ? Lada ki kynrup ïa u ksai , hato u lah ban ïarap ïa ki ban ïeng ?

translation.en: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah , and carried away captives .
translation.kha: Ki Edom ki la sdang wan hiarthma biang ïa ka Judah bad ki la ïoh kurup shibun ki koidi . Kumta u syiem Ahas u la ong ïa u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha jong ka Assyria ban phah jingïarap .

translation.en: And thou shalt offer them before the  Lord  , and the priests shall cast salt upon them , and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kin synreit mluh halor jong ki bad thang ïa ki kum ki jingkñia ha nga .

translation.en: Simon Peter went up , and drew the net to land full of great fishes , an hundred and fifty and three : and for all there were so many , yet was not the net broken .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la leit kiew ha ka lieng bad u la tan sha ryngkew ïa ka jar kaba la dap da ki dohkha kiba heh , baroh ki don shispah sanphew lai tylli ; wat la ki la bun katta , pynban kata ka jar kam shym la kad .

translation.en: If any man have ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba don ki shkor ban sngew , to un sngew .

translation.en: They shall not take a wife that is a whore , or profane  ; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband : for he is holy unto his God .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh namar ba u long uba khuid , um bit ban shongkurim ïa ka briew kaba la ïaid nuti , lane ka bym dei ka theisotti , lane kaba la ïapyllait tnga .

translation.en: But the same servant went out , and found one of his fellowservants , which owed him an hundred pence : and he laid hands on him , and took him by the throat , saying , Pay me that thou owest .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u briew u la mihnoh bad u la ïakynduh ïa uwei na ki para shakri jong u uba la shahram ïa u katto katne tyngka . U la bat trait bad u la ksih ïa u . ‘ Siew noh ïa ka ram jong nga !’ u la ong .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when all the people were clean passed over Jordan , that the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka la lah jam ïa ka Jordan , U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,

translation.en: The sword without , and terror within , shall destroy both the young man and the virgin , the suckling also with the man of gray hairs .
translation.kha: Ka thma kan wallam ka jingïap ha ki lynti , ka jingshyrkhei kan lynshop ha ki ïing . Ki rangsamla bad ki theisamla kin ïap ; yn ym map ïa ki khunlung ne ïa ki tymmen ruh .

translation.en: And Kish was the father of Saul  ; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel .
translation.kha: U Kish , u kpa jong u Saul bad u Ner , u kpa jong u Abner ki dei ki khun shynrang jong u Abiel .

translation.en: O death , where is thy sting ? O grave , where is thy victory ?
translation.kha: A ka Jingïap , hangno ka jingjop thiaw jong pha ? A , ka Jingïap , hangno ka bor jong pha ban pynmong ?

translation.en: And to them it was given that they should not kill them , but that they should be tormented five months : and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion , when he striketh a man .
translation.kha: Ym shym la shah ïa ki puit ban pynïap ïa kine ki briew , hynrei tang ban shu pynsaja ïa ki san bnai . Ka jingkynjut na kata ka jingpynsaja ka long kum na ka sni jong ka  ñianglartham .

translation.en: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day , and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u pynlong ka jutang na ka bynta u paidbah ha kata ka sngi , bad hangta ha Shekhem u la ai ha ki ïa ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ba kin bud .

translation.en: And when he had landed at Caesarea , and gone up , and saluted the church , he went down to Antioch .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha Kaisaria , u la leit sha Jerusalem bad u la ai khublei ïa ka balang , bad nangta u la leit sha Antiokh .

translation.en: Now ye are full , now ye are rich , ye have reigned as kings without us : and I would to God ye did reign , that we also might reign with you .
translation.kha: Hato phi la don lypa ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi donkam ? Hato phi la riewspah lypa ? Hato phi la long ki syiem , wat la ngi ngim long ? A , nga da kwah ba phin da long shisha ki syiem , khnang ba ngin ïoh long ki syiem lem bad phi .

translation.en: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them  ; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows , or concerning the bond of her soul , shall not stand : her husband hath made them void  ; and the  Lord  shall forgive her .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u tnga jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata . U  Trai  un map ïa ka , namar ba u tnga jong ka , u khang ïa ka na kaba bat ïa ka kular .

translation.en: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee , and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee , and give them compassion before them who carried them captive , that they may have compassion on them :
translation.kha: Map ïa ki pop jong ki baroh bad ïa ki jingleh pyrshah jong ki ïa me , bad pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban iehnoh ïa ki ha ka jingsbun .

translation.en: But Simon s wife s mother lay sick of a fever , and anon they tell him of her .
translation.kha: Ka kiaw kurim jong u Simon ka thiah pang ha jingthiah na ka jingpang shit , bad mar ïapoi u Jisu , la ïathuh shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: Accuse not a servant unto his master , lest he curse thee , and thou be found guilty .
translation.kha: Wat ju kren pyrshah ïa u shakri ha u kynrad jong u . Phin long uba la tim bad jynjar na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: Epaphras , who is one of you , a servant of Christ , saluteth you , always labouring fervently for you in prayers , that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God .
translation.kha: Ki jingai khublei na u Epaphras , uwei pat u dkhot jong ka kynhun jong phi bad u shakri jong U Khrist Jisu . U ïai duwai shitrhem borabor na ka bynta jong phi , da kaba kyrpad ïa U Blei ban pynlong ïa phi kiba ïeng skhem , kum kiba la san rangbah bha bad kiba skhem pura , ha ka jingkohnguh pura ïa ka mon U Blei .

translation.en: And Joseph dreamed a dream , and he told it his brethren : and they hated him yet the more .
translation.kha: Shisien u Joseph u la phohsniew , bad haba u la ïathuh ïa ka ha la ki hynmen shynrang , ki la kham isih shuh shuh ïa u .

translation.en: And they made two ouches of gold , and two gold rings  ; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate .
translation.kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki shrong ksiar bad ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar , bad ki pyndait ïa kita ki kyrwoh ar tylli ha ki dong kiba shaneng jong ka jingdeng shadem .

translation.en: And Israel said , It is enough  ; Joseph my son is yet alive : I will go and see him before I die .
translation.kha: U Joseph u khun jong nga u dang im !  u ong ,  Ngan pan aïu shuh nalor kane ! Nga dei ban leit ïakynduh ïa u shuwa ba ngan ïap .

translation.en: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death . And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Set thine house in order  ; for thou shalt die , and not live .
translation.kha: Hamar kane ka por u syiem Hesekaïah u kem pang bad u la jan ïap . U nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos u leit peit ïa u bad ong ha u ,  U  Trai  u ong ïa phi ba phin buh ryntih ïa kiei kiei baroh , namar ba phin ym ïohkhiah . Pynkhreh ban ïap .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat , that they said , It is the king of Israel . Therefore they compassed about him to fight : but Jehoshaphat cried out , and the  Lord  helped him  ; and God moved them to depart from him .
translation.kha: Kumta haba ki ïohi ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat , baroh ki tharai ba u dei u syiem Israel , bad ki phai ban tur ïaleh ïa u . Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u la pyrta , bad U  Trai  U Blei u la pyllait im ïa u bad pynphai noh ïa ka jingtur ïaleh na u .

translation.en: And they lay wait for their own blood  ; they lurk privily for their own lives .
translation.kha: hynrei ki briew kiba kum kita ki riam ïa lade hi , ka jingriam ka ban pynïap ïa ki hi .

translation.en: And these things , brethren , I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes ; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written , that no one of you be puffed up for one against another .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , nga la pynshisha ïa kane baroh ha u Apollos bad ha nga , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ngi baroh ar ngut kum ka nuksa , khnang ba phi lah ban tip kaei ka jingmut jong ka jingong ,  Kohnguh ïa ki kyndon kiba dei .  Uno uno na phi um dei ban ñiewkor ïa uwei u briew bad ibeiñ ïa uwei pat .

translation.en: Behold , thou art wiser than Daniel  ; there is no secret that they can hide from thee :
translation.kha: Me pyrkhat ba me kham stad ban ïa u Daniel , ba ym don ka barieh ba lah ban buhrieh na me .

translation.en: Jesus answered him ,  I spake openly to the world  ; I ever taught in the synagogue , and in the temple , whither the Jews always resort  ; and in secret have I said nothing .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la ju kren ha kaba paw ha baroh ; ki jinghikai jong nga baroh ki la long ha ki synagog bad ha ka Templ , ha kaba ki briew baroh ki ïawanlang . Ngam ju ong ïa kano kano ha kaba rieh .

translation.en: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far , and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth : and , behold , they shall come with speed swiftly :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai dak ban khot ïa ka jaitbynriew na jngai . U siaw ïa ki ban wan na kiba kut ka pyrthei . Bad kine ki wan ha ka jingstet bad kloi lan .

translation.en: Unto you first God , having raised up his Son Jesus , sent him to bless you , in turning away every one of you from his iniquities .
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Blei u la jied ïa la u Shakri bad u la phah ïa u nyngkong ha phi , ban kyrkhu ïa phi da kaba pynlong ïa uwei pa uwei na phi ban phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong u .

translation.en: Then the king of Assyria commanded , saying , Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence  ; and let them go and dwell there , and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land .
translation.kha: Te u patsha u hukum :  Phah pat ïa uwei na ki lyngdoh kiba ngi wallam kum ki koidi ; pynlong ïa u ban leit phai biang bad sah hangta , khnang ban hikai ïa ki briew ïa ka aiñ u blei jong kata ka ri .

translation.en: The owner of the pit shall make it good , and give money unto the owner of them  ; and the dead beast shall be his .
translation.kha: u trai jong kata ka thliew u dei ban buria da ka pisa ïa u trai jong uta u jingri , bad un ïoh ïa ka metïap jong u .

translation.en: For the great day of his wrath is come  ; and who shall be able to stand ?
translation.kha: Ka sngi batriem jong ka jingbitar jong ki ka la poi , bad uei uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ka ?

translation.en: For thou hast had five husbands  ; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband : in that saidst thou truly .
translation.kha: Pha la shongkurim ïa ki san ngut ki rangbah , bad u briew uba pha ïashong mynta um dei u tnga trai jong pha . Pha la ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him , he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords , to break through even unto the king of Edom : but they could not .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem ka Moab u sngewthuh ba u la rem thma , u la shim bad u hynñiewspah ngut ki rangbah kieng waitlam bad u pyrshang ban ïaid lyngba ki syrtap nongshun bad ban lait phet sha u syiem Syria , hynrei um shym lah .

translation.en: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah , city by city ,
translation.kha: U thung ki nongbishar ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ba la tei kut jong ka Judah bad u bthah ïa ki :

translation.en: Therefore they could not believe , because that Esaias said again ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta kim shym lah ban ngeit , namar u Isaïah u la lah ong ruh :

translation.en: Beware of the scribes , which desire to walk in long robes , and love greetings in the markets , and the highest seats in the synagogues , and the chief rooms at feasts  ;
translation.kha: To sumar bha pyrshah ïa ki nonghikai ka Hukum , kiba sngewtynnat ban ïaid kylleng ha ki jaiñkup bajynsur bad kiba ieit ban ïoh jingkhublei da kaba burom ha ki jaka ïew ; kiba jied ïa ki jaka ba la pynkyrpang ha ki synagog bad ïa ki jaka bakynsai tam ha ki jingkhawai ;

translation.en: Whereunto I also labour , striving according to his working , which worketh in me mightily .
translation.kha: Ban pyndep ïa kane nga ïaleh tyngeh bad nga ïaksaid , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingkhlaiñ badonbor kaba U Khrist u ai bad kaba treikam hapoh jong nga .

translation.en: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king , it is because the people have made me afraid : and thy handmaid said , I will now speak unto the king  ; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko Syiem Kynrad , ka daw ba nga la wan ban kren ïa phi ka long ba ki paidbah ki la byrngem ïa nga , bad kumta nga la ong ha lade ba nga dei ban kren ha phi da ka jingkyrmen ba phin leh ïa kaei kaba nga kyrpad .

translation.en: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him , and a voice came from heaven , which said , Thou art my beloved Son  ; in thee I am well pleased .
translation.kha: bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la hiar halor jong u ha ka dur kum ka paro . Bad ka sur ka la wan na bneng ,  Me long u khun ba-ieit jong nga . Nga la sngewbha bad me .

translation.en: God cares about you .
translation.kha: U Blei u phikir ïa phi .

translation.en: All my inward friends abhorred me : and they whom I loved are turned against me .
translation.kha: Ki paralok bajan tam jong nga ki peit ïa nga da ka jingisih ; kito kiba nga ieit eh ki pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And the ransomed of the  Lord  shall return , and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads : they shall obtain joy and gladness , and sorrow and sighing shall flee away .
translation.kha: Kin poi sha Jerusalem da ka jingkmen , kin rwai bad kin pyrta da ka jingkmen . Kin long kiba kmen junom , kiba la lait junom na ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingpangnud .

translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Do ye now believe ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Hato phi ngeit mynta ?

translation.en: And he answered and told them ,  Elias verily cometh first , and restoreth all things  ; and how it is written of the Son of man , that he must suffer many things , and be set at nought .
translation.kha: Ka jingjubab jong u ka long ,  U Elijah u wan shisha nyngkong khnang ban pynkhreh ïa kiei kiei baroh . Pynban balei ba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ba U Khun U Briew un hap shahshitom shibun bad shah kyntait ?

translation.en: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah , and all that were therein , and the coasts thereof from Tirzah : because they opened not to him , therefore he smote it  ; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up .
translation.kha: Katba u Menahem u dang don ha lynti na Tirsah , u pynjot thiaw ïa ka nongbah Tappuah , ki nongshong shnong jong ka , bad ki ri ba-marjan , namar ka nongbah kam shym pyndem wait ha u . U patar wat ïa ki kpoh jong ki kynthei ba-armet baroh .

translation.en: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience , in signs , and wonders , and mighty deeds .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kiba bun kiba pynshisha ba nga long u apostol la pynpaw hapdeng jong phi da ka jingïaishah bakhraw .

translation.en: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee  ; thou shalt be a terror , and never shalt be any more .
translation.kha: Pha la jah noh , la jah noh junom , bad ki nongkhaïi na baroh kawei ka pyrthei ki la sngewtriem , ki la sheptieng ba ki ruh kin mad ïa ka kupar jong pha .

translation.en: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house :
translation.kha: U briew uba don ha tnum ka ïing jong u , um dei shuh ban pynlut por ban hiar shapoh bad shim ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u na ka ïing .

translation.en: And that their children , which have not known any thing , may hear , and learn to fear the  Lord  your God , as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki bym pat ju ïohsngew ïa ka Aiñ U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kin ïohsngew ïa ka . Te kin sa nang ban kohnguh ïa u katba ki dang im ha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti ha shiliang ka Jordan .

translation.en: Jesus then cometh , and taketh bread , and giveth them , and fish likewise .
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la leit sha khmat , u la shim ïa u kpu , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki ; u leh kumjuh ruh bad kita ki dohkha .

translation.en: Took branches of palm trees , and went forth to meet him , and cried , Hosanna : Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kdiah ïa ki tnat dieng Tlai bad ki la mih ban leit ïakynduh ïa u , ki da pyrta ,  Ïaroh ïa U Blei ! To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa u Syiem ki Israel !

translation.en: Therefore , ye shepherds , hear the word of the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Mynta , ko phi ki nongsharai , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  nga ong ïa phi .

translation.en: And unto one he gave five talents , to another two , and to another one  ; to every man according to his several ability  ; and straightway took his journey .
translation.kha: U la ai ha uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jinglah jong u : Ha uwei u la ai san hajar tylli ki sbai ksiar , ha uwei pat u la ai ar hajar tylli , bad ha uwei pat u la ai shihajar tylli . Nangta u la mih ban leit jingleit .

translation.en: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken , because they were elder than he .
translation.kha: Namar ba u Elihu u dei uba khynnah tam na kiba don hangta , u la hap ban ap haduh ba baroh kiwei ki la dep kren .

translation.en: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel , after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them  ; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u shim jingkheiñ ïa ki nongwei baroh kiba shong ha ka ri Israel , syriem kum ka jingkheiñbriew kaba la shim da u Dabid u kpa jong u . La don shi lakh sanphew lai hajar hynriewspah ngut ki nongwei kiba shong basah .

translation.en: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion : whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul .
translation.kha: To sheptieng ïa u syiem uba bitar kumba phi leh ïa u sing bakyrhuh ; kaba pynbitar ïa u ka long kaba pynïap ïa lade .

translation.en: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did , when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee .
translation.kha: Kane ka la long ka kambah kaba ar kaba U Jisu u la leh hadien ba u la wan na Judia sha Galilaïa .

translation.en: Wherefore putting away lying , speak every man truth with his neighbour : for we are members one of another .
translation.kha: Nangta , ym don shuh ka jinglamler! Uwei pa uwei u dei ban kren ïa ka jingshisha ha la u parabangeit , namar baroh ngi long ki dkhot ba ïalong lang ha ka met U Khrist .

translation.en: And when it was told David , he gathered all Israel together , and passed over Jordan , and came to Helam . And the Syrians set themselves in array against David , and fought with him .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u tip ïa kata , u lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai Israel baroh , u jam sha shiliang ka wah Jordan , bad u ïaid sha Helam ha kaba ki Syria ki ïeng ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa u . Ka jingïaleh ka la sdang ,

translation.en: And one said to the man clothed in linen , which was upon the waters of the river , How long shall it be to the end of these wonders ?
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la kylli ïa u angel uba ïeng kham pajih shatei shaneng wah ,  Slem katno kan long tad haduh ba kine ki jingjia kiba phylla kin poi sha kaba kut ?

translation.en: And it shall be to me a name of joy , a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth , which shall hear all the good that I do unto them : and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it .
translation.kha: Ka Jerusalem kan long ka thymmei jong ka jingkmen , ka burom bad ka jingsngew sarong ïa nga ; bad ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei kin sheptieng bad khynñiuh haba kin ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba nga leh ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem bad shaphang ka jingroi jingpar kaba nga wallam ha ka nongbah .

translation.en: And I went unto the prophetess  ; and she conceived , and bare a son . Then said the  Lord  to me , Call his name Maher–shalal–hash–baz .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , ka tnga jong nga ka la armet . Haba la kha ïa u khun jong ngi , U  Trai  u ong ha nga ,  Jer kyrteng ïa u , ‘ u Maher-shalal-hash-bas .’

translation.en: I denounce unto you this day , that ye shall surely perish , and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land , whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it .
translation.kha: yn pynjot thiaw ïa phi — nga maham ïa phi hangne mynta . Phin ym im slem ha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti ha shiliang ka Jordan .

translation.en: And what can David say more unto thee ? for thou , Lord  God  , knowest thy servant .
translation.kha: Sa kaei shuh nga lah ban ong ha me ! Me ithuh ïa nga u shakri jong me .

translation.en: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind , and with many tears , and temptations , which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews :
translation.kha: Da ka jingsngewrit baroh bad shibun ki ummat nga la trei ïa ka kam jong nga kum u shakri jong U Trai ha ki por kiba eh kiba la wan ha nga namar ki jingïasylla jong ki katto katne ngut ki Jiw .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will give Pharaoh–hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies , and into the hand of them that seek his life  ; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , his enemy , and that sought his life .
translation.kha: Ngan aiti noh ïa u Hophra u syiem ka Ijipt ha ki nongshun jong u kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa u , kumba nga la aiti ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia , uba la long u nongshun jong u bad uba kwah ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king s forest , that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house , and for the wall of the city , and for the house that I shall enter into . And the king granted me , according to the good hand of my God upon me .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ruh ïa ka shithi sha u Asaph , u nongsumar ïa ki khlaw u syiem , da kaba bthah ïa u ban ai ïa nga ki dieng na ka bynta ki khyrdop ka kut kaba ïada ïa ka Templ , na ka bynta ki kynroh ka nongbah , bad na ka bynta ka ïing kaba ngan shong ngan sah . U patsha u la ai ïa nga ïa baroh kaba nga pan , namar U Blei u la long ryngkat bad nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take unto thee sweet spices , stacte , and onycha , and galbanum  ; these sweet spices with pure frankincense : of each shall there be a like weight :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shim mar katjuh na kine ki jingiwbih suhsieng — ka stakte , ka onikha , ka galbanum , bad ka jingiwbih basngur .

translation.en: And when he was full forty years old , it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la dap sawphew snem ka rta , u la kut jingmut ban wad kumno la ju leh ïa ki para Israel jong u .

translation.en: They stoop , they bow down together  ; they could not deliver the burden , but themselves are gone into captivity .
translation.kha: Ki bleithaw kim lah ban pynim ïa lade ; ïa ki la kurup bad la rah noh bak . Kane ka dei kaba kut jong ki blei ka Babilon !

translation.en: And he took some of his brethren , even five men , and presented them unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Nangta u pynithuh ïa kita ki hynmen jong u ha u syiem .

translation.en: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba ïa u Abraham , lyngba ka jingngeit ,  La pdiang kum uba hok da U Blei .

translation.en: Submit yourselves therefore to God . Resist the devil , and he will flee from you .
translation.kha: Kumta te , to pyndem ha U Blei . To ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Bymman , bad un phet ïap noh na phi .

translation.en: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour .
translation.kha: ka mynsiem jong nga ka shadkmen namar U Blei U Nongpynim jong nga ,

translation.en: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price , and that for all thy sins , even in all thy borders .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ngan phah ïa ki nongshun ban kit noh ïa ka spah bad ïa ki jingkynshew jong ki briew jong nga , khnang ban pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta ki pop kiba ki la leh ha kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: And the damsel ran , and told them of her mother s house these things .
translation.kha: Kata ka samla ka la mareh sha ka ïing ka kmie jong ka bad ka ïathuh ïa kaba la jia baroh .

translation.en: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites , the king of Jerusalem , the king of Hebron , the king of Jarmuth , the king of Lachish , the king of Eglon , gathered themselves together , and went up , they and all their hosts , and encamped before Gibeon , and made war against it .
translation.kha: Kine ki san ngut ki syiem Amor , ki syiem ka Jerusalem , ka Hebron , ka Jarmuth , ka Lakhish , bad ka Eglon , ki ïasoh lang kawei , ki kerkut ïa ka Gibeon , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that David enquired of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah ? And the  Lord  said unto him , Go up . And David said , Whither shall I go up ? And he said , Unto Hebron .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Hato ngan leit bad shimti noh ïa kawei na ki nongrit jong ka Judah ?   Ho-oid ,  U  Trai  u jubab .  Ïa kano ?  U Dabid u kylli .  Ka Hebron  U  Trai  u ong .

translation.en: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle  ; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold , and their faces were as the faces of men .
translation.kha: Kita ki puit ki long kum ki kulai kiba la khreh na ka bynta ka thma ; halor ki khlieh jong ki , ki la phong ïa kaei kaba syriem kum ki pansngiat ksiar ; bad ki durkhmat jong ki , ki long kum ki durkhmat briew .

translation.en: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel .
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh , U Trai u la hukum ba kito kiba ïalap ïa ka gospel kin dei ban ïoh ïa la bam na ka .

translation.en: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria : the planters shall plant , and shall eat them as common things .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat phin thung ki dieng sohwaiñ ha ki lum ka Samaria , bad kito kiba thung ïa ki kin ïoh bam ïa kaei kaba ki bri sohwaiñ kin pynmih .

translation.en: And she lay at his feet until the morning : and she rose up before one could know another . And he said , Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor .
translation.kha: Kumta ka thiah hangta ha ki kjat jong u , hynrei ka la khie ha shuwa ban kynjat shai ïoh don ba ïohi ïa ka , namar ba u Boas um kwah ïano ïano ban tip ba ka la don hangta .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Come and dine .  And none of the disciples durst ask him , Who art thou ? knowing that it was the Lord .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To wan bad to ïabam .  Ym don uwei ruh na ki synran uba la nud ban kylli ïa u ,  Me dei uei ?  namar ki la tip ba u dei U Trai .

translation.en: Come ye near unto me , hear ye this  ; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning  ; from the time that it was , there am I : and now the Lord  God  , and his Spirit , hath sent me .
translation.kha: Mynta to wan sha jan jong nga bad sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong . Naduh mynnyngkong nga la kren da kaba shai , bad borabor nga la pynlong ba ki ktien jong nga kin wan urlong shisha .  ( Mynta U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ai ha nga ïa ka bor jong u bad u la phah ïa nga . )

translation.en: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes  ; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes .
translation.kha: Uno uno ruh uba thiah lane bam ha kata ka ïing u dei ban da sait ïa la ki jaiñ .

translation.en: While Peter yet spake these words , the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word .
translation.kha: Katba u Petros u dang kren , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan hiar halor kita baroh kiba shahshkor ïa ka khubor jong u .

translation.en: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses : and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki la kohnguh , bad ki la pynïap kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: They are as stubble before the wind , and as chaff that the storm carrieth away .
translation.kha: bad ban pyrsad noh ïa ki kum ïa ki phlangïap ha ka lyer , lane kum ïa u pui pui ba la rah noh ha ka  erïong ?

translation.en: And after certain days , when Felix came with his wife Drusilla , which was a Jewess , he sent for Paul , and heard him concerning the faith in Christ .
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , u Pheliks u la wan lem bad ka tnga jong u , ka Drusilla , kaba long ka Jiw . U la phah khot ïa u Paul bad u la shahshkor ïa u katba u nang kren shaphang ka jingngeit ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And the  Lord  looked upon him , and said , Go in this thy might , and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites : have not I sent thee ?
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u ,  Khie leit da la ka bor bakhraw bad pyllait ïa ki Israel na ki Midian . Nga hi nga phah ïa me .

translation.en: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place  ; thou , and thy sons , and thy daughters with thee : for they be thy due , and thy sons  due , which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me bad ki longïing jong me , phi lah ban bam ïa ka shadem bad ïa ka kjat-dien ïa kiba la ai kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang bad ka jingsynñiang bakyrpang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ki lyngdoh . Phi lah ban bam ïa ka ha ka jaka ïa kaba la ñiew ba ka long kaba khuid . Ïa kine ki jingkñia ainguh la ai ha me bad ha ki khun jong me kum ka bynta kaba dei ka jong me na ki jingainguh ïasyllok jong ki paid Israel .

translation.en: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi ïohi ba kim shym la lah ban leit rung shapoh kata ka ri , namar kim shym la ngeit .

translation.en: Ye shall not go after other gods , of the gods of the people which are round about you  ;
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ïa kino kino ki blei jong kita ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong phi .

translation.en: And Hadadezer sent , and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river : and they came to Helam  ; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadadezer went before them .
translation.kha: U Syiem Hadadeser u la phah khot ïa ki Syria kiba don ha ka phang mihngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis , bad ki la wan sha Helam ha ka jingïalam u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Hadadeser u syiem Sobah .

translation.en: And because ye are sons , God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts , crying , Abba , Father .
translation.kha: Ban pyn-i ba phi dei ki khun jong u , U Blei u la phah ïa U Mynsiem jong U Khun jong u ha ki dohnud jong ngi , U Mynsiem uba kyang ,  Ko Pa , Pa jong nga .

translation.en: But Israel , which followed after the law of righteousness , hath not attained to the law of righteousness .
translation.kha: katba ki briew ki jong U Blei , kiba la wad ïa ka hukum ka ban pynlong jingïasuk bad U Blei , kim shym la shem ïa ka .

translation.en: And there was found at Achmetha , in the palace that is in the province of the Medes , a roll , and therein was a record thus written :
translation.kha: Hynrei ka la long ha ka nongbah Ekbatana ha ka probins    jong ka Media ba ïa ka kot kli la shem kaba don ïa kane ka jingbuh jingthoh :

translation.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead ,
translation.kha: To ngin ainguh ïa U Blei bad ïa U Kpa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi . Namar ka jingisynei bakhraw jong u , u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingim bathymmai da kaba pynmihpat ïa U Jisu Khrist na ka jingïap .

translation.en: I am the rose of Sharon , and the lily of the valleys .
translation.kha: Ka jingrwai basngewtynnat tam na ki jingrwai , da u Solomon .

translation.en: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another , What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon ? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead .
translation.kha: Hangta ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki jait Israel ki kylli para ma ki ,  Mano ban ïalam ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Ammon ? Uno uno uba leh un long u nongïalam jong uwei pa uwei ha Gilead .

translation.en: It is better to go to the house of mourning , than to go to the house of feasting : for that is the end of all men  ; and the living will lay it to his heart .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban leit sha ka ïing ha kaba don ka jingïambriew ban ïa kata ha kaba don ka jingïaleh-sngewbha , namar kiba im ki dei ban pynkynmaw ïa lade ba ka jingïap ka ap ïa ngi baroh .

translation.en: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess ? So whomsoever the  Lord  our God shall drive out from before us , them will we possess .
translation.kha: Hato men dang leit ban shim biang ïa ka ? Me lah ban bat kat ïa kaba u Khemosh u blei jong me u la ai ha me . Hynrei ngi te ngin bat ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , u la ai ha ngi .

translation.en: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria , which is called Sychar , near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph .
translation.kha: Ha Samaria u la leit poi ha ka shnong kaba kyrteng ka Sikhar , ka bym jngai na ka lyngkha kaba u Jakob u la ai ha u Joseph , u khun jong u .

translation.en: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city , and the gates thereof , and the wall thereof .
translation.kha: U angel uba la kren ha nga u la don u diengthew uba da ka ksiar ban thew ïa ka nongbah , ïa ki khyrdop jong ka , bad ïa ki kynroh jong ka .

translation.en: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice , the villages that Kedar doth inhabit : let the inhabitants of the rock sing , let them shout from the top of the mountains .
translation.kha: Ai ba ka ri shyiap bad ki shnong jong ka kin ïaroh ïa U Blei ; ai ba ki briew jong ka Kedar kin ïaroh ïa U ! Ai ba kito kiba shong ha ka nongbah Sela kin risa da ka jingkmen na ki kliar jong ki lumbah !

translation.en: Israel is a scattered sheep  ; the lions have driven him away : first the king of Assyria hath devoured him  ; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki long kum ki langbrot , ba la shah beh bad pynsakma da ki sing . Nyngkong , la tur ïaleh da u patsha ka Assyria , bad nangta u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u ktha ïa ki shyieng jong ki .

translation.en: Unless thy law had been my delights , I should then have perished in mine affliction .
translation.kha: Lada ka aiñ jong me kam shym la long ka tyllong jong ka jingkmen jong nga , ngan jin da la ïap na ki jingshitom jong nga .

translation.en: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people .
translation.kha: Ha kiba bun rukom u Ïoannis u la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki briew bad u la kyntu jur ïa ki ban pynkylla ïa ki rukom im jong ki .

translation.en: Lo , thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed , on Egypt  ; whereon if a man lean , it will go into his hand , and pierce it : so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him .
translation.kha: Phi khmih lynti ba ka Ijipt kan ïarap ïa phi , hynrei kata kan long kumba pyndonkam ïa u khah kum u diengduh ban ïaid — un kdiah bad un dung ïa ka kti jong phi . Kata kan long kaei kaba u syiem Ijipt u long haba uno uno u shaniah ha u .

translation.en: But Barak pursued after the chariots , and after the host , unto Harosheth of the Gentiles : and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword  ; and there was not a man left .
translation.kha: U Barak u beh kthong ïa ki kali ïapom bad ïa ka kynhun shipai sha Harosheth-jong-ki-Jentil , bad la pynïap plain ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u Sisera . Ym don uwei ruh u briew uba lait im .

translation.en: Neither said they , Where is the  Lord  that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , that led us through the wilderness , through a land of deserts and of pits , through a land of drought , and of the shadow of death , through a land that no man passed through , and where no man dwelt ?
translation.kha: Kim shym salia ïa nga , wat haba nga la pyllait ïa ki na Ijipt bad ïalam ïa ki lyngba ka ri khlaw : Ka jaka ki ri shyiap bad ki thliew shyiap , ka ri kaba tyrkhong bad kaba ma ha kaba ym don mano mano bashong basah bad ba ym don mano mano wat ban ïaid lyngba .

translation.en: And they sought to lay hold on him , but feared the people : for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them : and they left him , and went their way .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa U Jisu , namar ki la tip ba u la ong ïa kane ka pharshi pyrshah ïa ki . Hynrei ki la sheptieng ïa u paidbah , kumta ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la leit noh .

translation.en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power , they were dismayed and confounded : they were as the grass of the field , and as the green herb , as the grass on the housetops , and as corn blasted before it be grown up .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong hangta ki long ki bymdonbor ; ki long kiba khaw-eit bad sah lyngngoh . Ki long kum u phlang ha ka madan ne ki ñiut kiba san halor tnum haba ka lyer khluit na mihngi ka shoh ïa ki .

translation.en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den : he lieth in wait to catch the poor : he doth catch the poor , when he draweth him into his net .
translation.kha: u ap ha la ka jakarieh kum u sing . U dem ban ap ïa kiba duk , u kem ïa ki ha ki jingriam jong u bad u paring ïa ki sharud .

translation.en: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds , and with every leader .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u ïamir jingmut bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam baroh jong ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut .

translation.en: I tell thee , thou shalt not depart thence , till thou hast paid the very last mite .
translation.kha: Hangta phin sah , nga ong ha phi , tad ynda phi siew ïa pisa bakhatduh jong ka kuna jong phi .

translation.en: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom , and wrote it in a book , and laid it up before the  Lord . And Samuel sent all the people away , every man to his house .
translation.kha: U Samuel u pynshai ha uta u paidbah ïa ki hok bad ki kamram u syiem , bad u thoh ïa ki ha ka kitab bad u buh ïa ka ha ka jaka kyntang . Nangta u phah ïa ki ba kin leit noh sha la ïing .

translation.en: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind .
translation.kha: Naduh myn dang long ka pyrthei ym pat don mano mano ba la ïohsngew ba uno uno u ai jingïoh imat pat ïa u briew uba la kha matlah .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  , that hath given rest unto his people Israel , according to all that he promised : there hath not failed one word of all his good promise , which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant .
translation.kha: U da ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  uba la ai ka jingsuk ïa ki briew jong u , kumba u la kular ban leh . U la bat ïa baroh ki jingkular basbun kaba u la pynlong lyngba u Moses u shakri jong u .

translation.en: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him , yet judgment is before him  ; therefore trust thou in him .
translation.kha: Ko Job , me ong ba mem lah ban ïohi ïa U Blei ; hynrei to ïaishah ban ap — ka kam jong me ka don ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane : and he saith to his disciples ,  Sit ye here , while I shall pray .
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha ka jaka ba la khot Gethsemane , bad U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran ,  Shong hangne katba nga dang duwai .

translation.en: And I asked her , and said , Whose daughter art thou ? And she said , The daughter of Bethuel , Nahor s son , whom Milcah bare unto him : and I put the earring upon her face , and the bracelets upon her hands .
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ïa ka , ‘ Uei u kpa jong phi ?’ Bad ka la jubab , ‘ U kpa jong nga u dei u Bethuel , u khun jong u Nahor bad ka Milkah .’ Nangta nga pyndait ïa ka sati ha ka khmut jong ka , bad nga pyndeng ruh ïa ki khadu ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka .

translation.en: And if he have no brethren , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father s brethren .
translation.kha: Lada um don hynmen ne para shynrang , ki hynmen ki para shynrang u kpa jong u kin ïohpateng ïa ka .

translation.en: To deliver thee from the strange woman , even from the stranger which flattereth with her words  ;
translation.kha: Phi lah ban pyllait ïa lade na kano kano ka kynthei awria kaba pyrshang ban pynngop ïa phi da ki ktien jali ja-um jong ka ,

translation.en: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities : but fear thou God .
translation.kha: Kam pher haduh katno phi phohsniew , haduh katno phi trei ïa ka kam bymmyntoi , lane haduh katno phi kren , phi dei ban ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .

translation.en: What's your name ?
translation.kha: Phi kyrteng aiu ?

translation.en: And the high priest stood up in the midst , and asked Jesus , saying , Answerest thou nothing ? what is it which these witness against thee ?
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la ïeng ha khmat jong ki baroh bad u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Hato mem don ka jubab ïa ka jingmudui kaba ki la wanrah pyrshah ïa me ?

translation.en: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul s daughter should have been given to David , that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka por ka poi ba yn ai ïa ka Merab ha u Dabid , la ai pynban ïa ka sha u briew uba kyrteng u Adriel uba na Meholah .

translation.en: Who knowing the judgment of God , that they which commit such things are worthy of death , not only do the same , but have pleasure in them that do them .
translation.kha: Ki tip ba ka Hukum U Blei ka ong ba ki briew kiba im ha kane ka rukom ki dei hok ban ïap . Pynban , ym tang ba ki ïai leh ïa kine hi kiei kiei , hynrei ki mynjur wat ïa kiwei kiba leh ïa ki .

translation.en: When ye go , ye shall come unto a people secure , and to a large land : for God hath given it into your hands  ; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth .
translation.kha: Ynda phi poi hangta , phin shem ba ki briew kim suba sniew ei ei . Ka long ka ri kaba heh , ka don lut kiei kiei kiba u briew u lah ban kwah , bad U Blei u la ai ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: And when inquisition was made of the matter , it was found out  ; therefore they were both hanged on a tree : and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingtohkit , bad la shem ba ka jingïathuh ka long kaba dei , kumta ïa baroh ar ngut ki briew la sdien phasi . U syiem u la hukum ba ïa kane ka jingjia dei ban thoh ha ki jingbuh jingthoh jong ka hima .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when they had brought them forth abroad , that he said , Escape for thy life  ; look not behind thee , neither stay thou in all the plain  ; escape to the mountain , lest thou be consumed .
translation.kha: Uwei na kita ki angel u ong ,  Phet ïap noh ! Wat kyrtiang dien bad wat sangeh ha ka them . Phet ïap sha ki lum , ba phin ym shah pynïap .

translation.en: Thou also , which hast judged thy sisters , bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they : they are more righteous than thou : yea , be thou confounded also , and bear thy shame , in that thou hast justified thy sisters .
translation.kha: Bad mynta pha dei ban shah ïa ka jingjahburom jong pha . Ki pop jong pha ki kham sniew katta katta ban ïa kito ki jong ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha kumta ba ki i lui lui hajan jong pha . Mynta to sawkyr-ang bad shah ïa ka jinglehrain jong pha , namar pha pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha ban paw ba ki long kiba sngur .

translation.en: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the  Lord  , and it shall be the priest s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings .
translation.kha: U dei ban wallam shi bynta na uwei pa uwei u jait kpu kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  ; kata ka dei ka bynta jong u lyngdoh uba shim ïa ka snam jong u mrad bad uba theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .

translation.en: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth , saith the Lord  God  : wherefore turn yourselves , and live ye .
translation.kha: Ngam kwah ïano ïano ban ïap ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to im .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he reigned , that he smote all the house of Jeroboam  ; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed , until he had destroyed him , according unto the saying of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite :
translation.kha: Shisyndon u la sdang ban pynïap ïa ki dkhot baroh na ka longïing jong u Jeroboam . Kat kum ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong lyngba u shakri jong u , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh , ïa baroh ka longïing jong u Jeroboam la pynïap ; ym don shuh ba lait im .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that whosoever shall call on the name of the  Lord  shall be delivered : for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance , as the  Lord  hath said , and in the remnant whom the  Lord  shall call .
translation.kha: Hynrei baroh uba kyrpad ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingïarap , yn pynim . Kumba U  Trai  U la ong , ‘ Katto katne ha Jerusalem , kin lait im ; kito ïa kiba nga jied , kin im .’

translation.en: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it  ; every male shall eat it : it shall be holy unto thee .
translation.kha: Me dei ban bam ïa kine kiei kiei ha ka jaka kyntang , bad tang ki shynrang kiba lah ban bam ïa ki ; ñiew ïa ki , kiba khuid .

translation.en: And the people journeyed from Kibroth–hattaavah unto Hazeroth  ; and abode at Hazeroth .
translation.kha: Na kata ka jaka ki paidbah ki la kynriah noh sha Haseroth , ha kaba ki la sher dara .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  were come up out of the midst of Jordan , and the soles of the priests  feet were lifted up unto the dry land , that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place , and flowed over all his banks , as they did before .
translation.kha: bad haba ki lyngdoh ki la poi ha ka rudwah , ka wah ka la sdang ban tuid biang bad ka la pynshlei ïa ki rud jong ka baroh sa shisien pat .

translation.en: This also cometh forth from the  Lord  of hosts , which is wonderful in counsel , and excellent in working .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka jingstad ka wan na U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ki jingthmu U Blei ki long kiba stad bad ki long borabor kiba wallam jingjop !

translation.en: Who can count the dust of Jacob , and the number of the fourth part of Israel ? Let me die the death of the righteous , and let my last end be like his !
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Israel ki long kum u pui pui — Ki la ïabun palat , ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki . Shah ba ngan pynkut ïa la ki sngi kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei , Shah ba ngan ïap ha ka jingsuk kum u riewhok .

translation.en: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy , God shall take away his part out of the book of life , and out of the holy city , and from the things which are written in this book .
translation.kha: Bad lada uno uno u shim noh ïa kano kano na ki kyntien jingïathuhlypa jong kane ka kitab , U Blei un shim noh na u ïa ka bhah jong u na u soh jong u dieng ka jingim bad jong ka Nongbah Bakhuid , ïa kiba la batai ha kane ka kitab .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when all the kings which were on this side Jordan , in the hills , and in the valleys , and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon , the Hittite , and the Amorite , the Canaanite , the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite , heard thereof  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingjop jong ki Israel la bna ha baroh ki syiem kiba shaphang sepngi jong ka Jordan — ha ki lumrit , ha trai ki lum , bad ha ka pyntha rud duriaw jong ka Duriaw Mediterranian haduh ka Lebanon ha ka phang bashatei ; kine ki dei ki syiem jong ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .

translation.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud : for the glory of the  Lord  had filled the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: uba tyngshaiñ da ka jingshai kaba thaba na ka jingdon U  Trai  , bad kim shym lah shuh ban leit shapoh ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki .

translation.en: And to them which were in Hormah , and to them which were in Bor–ashan , and to them which were in Athach ,
translation.kha: bad sha ki briew ha ki nongrit ka Hormah , Borashan , Athakh , bad Hebron .

translation.en: These things also belong to the wise . It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki don ruh ban ong ïa kine kiei kiei : Ka long ka bymdei ïa u nongbishar ban leh shiliang khmat .

translation.en: From thence it passed toward Azmon , and went out unto the river of Egypt  ; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea : this shall be your south coast .
translation.kha: ter ter sha Asmon , bad ka bud ïa ka wahduid ha ka pud jong ka Ijipt sha ka Duriaw Mediterranian , ha kaba kut u . Kata ka long ka pud kaba shaphang shathie jong ka Judah .

translation.en: And they entered into a covenant to seek the  Lord  God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul  ;
translation.kha: Ki pynlong ka jutang ha kaba ki mynjur ban mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , da ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong ki baroh .

translation.en: He went in therefore , and shut the door upon them twain , and prayed unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U la khang ïa ka jingkhang bad u duwai ha U  Trai .

translation.en: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth : and a word spoken in due season , how good is it !
translation.kha: Katno ka pynkmen haba ïoh ïa ka kyntien kaba dei kaba ïahap bad ka por .

translation.en: For laying aside the commandment of God , ye hold the tradition of men , as the washing of pots and cups : and many other such like things ye do .
translation.kha: Phi la kyntait noh ïa ka hukum U Blei bad phi kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong ki briew .

translation.en: For the fields of Heshbon languish , and the vine of Sibmah : the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof , they are come even unto Jazer , they wandered through the wilderness : her branches are stretched out , they are gone over the sea .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kper hajan ka Heshbon bad ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong ka Sibmah la pynjot — kito ki bri sohwaiñ kiba ïa ka waiñ jong ki la pyndonkam ban pynbuaid ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki hima . Ha kawei ka sien ki dieng sohwaiñ ki saphriang kat shaduh ka nongbah Jaser , bad shaphang mihngi sha ka ri shyiap , bad shaphang sepngi sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Duriaw Baïap .

translation.en: And David took the crown of their king from off his head , and found it to weigh a talent of gold , and there were precious stones in it  ; and it was set upon David s head : and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city .
translation.kha: U Molekh , u bleithaw jong ki Ammon u don ka pansngiat ksiar kaba khia kumba laiphew saw kilo . Ha ka don u mawlynnai , ïa uba u Dabid u shim bad buh ha la ka jong ka pansngiat . U rah ruh shibun ka jinglute na ka nongbah .

translation.en: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man , neither raising up the people , neither in the synagogues , nor in the city :
translation.kha: Ki Jiw kim shym lap ïa nga ba nga ïasaidnia badno badno hapoh ka Templ , lymne ba ki shem ïa nga ba nga pynkhih ïa u paidbah , la ka long ha ki synagog ne hangno hangno hawei pat hapoh ka nongbah .

translation.en: When your fear cometh as desolation , and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind  ; when distress and anguish cometh upon you .
translation.kha: haba ka wan ha phi kum ka  erïong , bad ka pynjynjar ïa phi kum ka  erlangthari , bad haba phi don ha ka jingpang bad ka jinglanot .

translation.en: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee , I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath , and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men , and skilful to destroy .
translation.kha: Phin mad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga haba nga phai jar jar ha phi kum ka ding baklang . Bad ngan aiti ïa phi ha ki briew bashyrkhei , kiba tbit ha ka ban pynjot .

translation.en: And then shall that Wicked be revealed , whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth , and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming :
translation.kha: Te ïa Uta u Basniew yn sa pynpaw , hynrei haba U Trai Jisu u wan , Un pynïap ïa u da ka jingpynhiar mynsiem na ka shyntur jong U bad pynjot ïa u da ka jingthaba ka jingdon ryngkat jong U .

translation.en: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life : as I was with Moses , so I will be with thee : I will not fail thee , nor forsake thee .
translation.kha: Joshua , yn ym don mano mano uba lah ban jop ïa me katba me dang im . Ngan don ryngkat lem bad me kumba nga la don bad u Moses . Ngan ïailong lem bad me borabor ; ngan ym iehnoh ïa me .

translation.en: And Nehemiah , which is the Tirshatha , and Ezra the priest the scribe , and the Levites that taught the people , said unto all the people , This day is holy unto the  Lord  your God  ; mourn not , nor weep . For all the people wept , when they heard the words of the law .
translation.kha: Haba u paidbah u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ïa ki , la pynkhih ïa ki dohnud jong ki bad ki sdang ban ïam . Kumta u Nehemaïah , uba long u lat , u Esra , uba long u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ka Hukum , bad ki Lebi kiba dang batai ïa ka Hukum , ki la ong ha u paidbah ,  Kane ka sngi ka long kaba khuid ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , kumta phim dei ban sngewsih ne ïam .

translation.en: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment , because he willingly walked after the commandment .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kin shah ka jingshah banbeiñ ; ka la duh noh ïa ka khyndew kaba dei hok jong ka , namar ka ïai kwah ban wad jingïarap na kito ki bym don ei ei ban ai .

translation.en: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book , and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity , and out of darkness .
translation.kha: Ynda kata ka sngi kan wan , kiba kyllut kin sa lah ban ïohsngew ba la pule jam ïa ka kot , bad ba kiba matlah , kiba ju im ha ka jingdum , kin plie ïa la ki khmat bad ïohi .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Destroy this temple , and in three days I will raise it up .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Pynpra ïa kane ka Templ , bad ha ki lai sngi ngan tei pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And they worshipped him , and returned to Jerusalem with great joy :
translation.kha: Ki la mane ïa u bad ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem , kiba la pyndap da ka jingkmen bakhraw ,

translation.en: Our cattle also shall go with us  ; there shall not an hoof be left behind  ; for thereof must we take to serve the  Lord  our God  ; and we know not with what we must serve the  Lord  , until we come thither .
translation.kha: Em , ngin ïalam ïa ki mrad jong ngi lem bad ngi ; yn ym don kawei ruh ïa ka ban iehnoh shadien . Ngin sa jied hi ïa ki mrad da kiba ngin mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Bad katba ngim pat poi hangta , ngin ym tip ki jingri kiba kumno ngin kñia ha u .

translation.en: And he returned back from him , and took a yoke of oxen , and slew them , and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen , and gave unto the people , and they did eat . Then he arose , and went after Elijah , and ministered unto him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elisha u la leit sha ki shi jur ki masi dab jong u , u pynïap ïa ki masi dab bad u shet ïa ka doh da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka lyngkor kum ki diengthang ban pynmeh ding . U ai ïa ka doh ha ki briew bad ma ki ruh ki bam ïa ka . Hadien kata u leit ban bud ïa u Elijah kum u nongïarap jong u .

translation.en: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man , and oil to make his face to shine , and bread which strengtheneth man s heart .
translation.kha: bad pynmih um sohwaiñ ban pynsngewbha ïa u , ka umphniang Olib ban pynkmen ïa u , bad u kpu ban ai jingkhlaiñ ïa u .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto the twelve ,  Will ye also go away ?
translation.kha: Kumta u la kylli ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran ,  Bad ma phi — hato phi ruh phi kwah ban leit noh ?

translation.en: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow ? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail ,
translation.kha: Hato me la ju leit jngoh ïa ki kamra buh tiar , ha kaba nga la buh ïa ka ïor bad ïa u phria ?

translation.en: And they had tails like unto scorpions , and there were stings in their tails : and their power was to hurt men five months .
translation.kha: Ki don ki tdong bad ki sni kum kito ki jong ka  ñianglartham , bad ka long da ki tdong jong ki ba ki don ka bor ban pynmong ïa ki briew haduh san bnai .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God  , the Holy One of Israel  ; In returning and rest shall ye be saved  ; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength : and ye would not .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar , U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel , u ong ha ki briew ,  Phai noh bad to shaniah jar jar ha nga . Te phin long khlaiñ bad skhem .  Hynrei phi kyntait ban leh ïa kata !

translation.en: He sent from above , he took me  ; he drew me out of many waters  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kner najrong bad u shim ïa nga , bad u sei ïa nga na ki um bajylliew .

translation.en: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven , and will give unto thy seed all these countries  ; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed  ;
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ki khun ki ksiew kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng , bad ngan ai ha ki ïa kane ka ri baroh . Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin kyrpad ïa nga ba ngan kyrkhu ïa ki kumba nga la kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me .

translation.en: But the fearful , and unbelieving , and the abominable , and murderers , and whoremongers , and sorcerers , and idolaters , and all liars , shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone : which is the second death .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki khawpud , ki nongshetkylla , ki riewkhyllah , ki nongpynïap briew , kiba leh awria , kito kiba leh byrtong , kito kiba mane bleithaw , bad kiba lamler baroh — ka jaka na ka bynta jong ki ka long ka pung kaba klang da ka ding bad u kyndok , kaba long ka jingïap kaba ar .

translation.en: And Judah said unto Onan , Go in unto thy brother s wife , and marry her , and raise up seed to thy brother .
translation.kha: Nangta u Judah u ong ha u Onan , u para jong u Er ,  Khie leit bad thiah bad ka tnga u hynmen jong me uba la ïap . Pyndep ïa ka kamram kaba me dei ban leh kum u para kynsi jong ka , khnang ba u hynmen jong me un ïoh ki nongmih pateng .

translation.en: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest ; and so falling down on his face he will worship God , and report that God is in you of a truth .
translation.kha: Yn bishar ïa u da kiei kiei baroh kiba u ïohsngew ; ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong u yn pynpaw madan , bad un dem ngon bad mane ïa U Blei , da kaba phla ,  Da shisha U Blei u don hangne hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: I have stuck unto thy testimonies : O  Lord  , put me not to shame .
translation.kha: Nga la bud ïa ki jingbthah jong me , A  Trai  ; wat shah ba yn buh ïa nga ha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: And again I say unto you , It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Nga ban biang : ka long kaba kham eh ïa u briew uba riewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ban ïa kaba ka ut ka rung lyngba i thliew thyrnia .

translation.en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth , and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven ?
translation.kha: Kim phai sha U Blei , uba pynlong ïa ngi kiba stad , kham stad ban ïa u mrad ne ka sim .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go unto the people , and sanctify them to day and to morrow , and let them wash their clothes ,
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit sha ki paidbah bad ong ïa ki ba kin pynkhuid ïa lade mynta ka sngi bad la shai ruh khnang ba ki lah ban mane .

translation.en: Go and speak to Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring my words upon this city for evil , and not for good  ; and they shall be accomplished in that day before thee .
translation.kha: ban ïathuh ïa u Ebedmelekh u nong Sudan ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Kumba nga la ong ba ngan leh , ngan wallam ka jingjot ha kane ka nongbah bad ym ïa ka jingmanbha . Bad haba kane kan jia , men don hangta ban ïohi ïa kata .

translation.en: And it came to pass the same day , that Isaac s servants came , and told him concerning the well which they had digged , and said unto him , We have found water .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , ki shakri jong u Isaak ki la wan ïathuh ha u shaphang ka pukri kaba ki la ïatih . Ki ong ,  Ngi la shem ïa ka um .

translation.en: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren , and said , Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses , ye cannot be saved .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la wan na Judia sha Antiokh bad ki la sdang ban hikai ïa ki parabangeit ,  Phim lah ban lait im lymda la otsher ïa phi kumba ka Hukum u Moses ka dawa .

translation.en: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark , and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above .
translation.kha: Ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong ki , ki tap ïa ka synduk bad ïa ki dieng jingbah jong ka .

translation.en: Saying , Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan , the lot of your inheritance  ;
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan ,  u ong .  Kan long ka jingïohkynti jong phi hi .

translation.en: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people , and there will I plead with you face to face .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa phi sha ‘ Ka ri shyiap jong ki jaitbynriew’ , bad hangta ngan pynrem ïa phi sha ka jinglehrain jong phi .

translation.en: Ye yourselves bear me witness , that I said , I am not the Christ , but that I am sent before him .
translation.kha: Phi hi phi long ki sakhi jong nga ba nga la ong , ‘ Ngam dei u Messaïah , hynrei , ïa nga la phah ha shuwa jong u .’

translation.en: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city : and their contentions are like the bars of a castle .
translation.kha: Ïarap ïa la u para bad un ïada ïa phi kum ka kynroh kaba khlaiñ jong ka nongbah , hynrei lada phi ïakajia bad u , un khang khyrdep ki jingkhang jong u ïa phi .

translation.en: And he said , I am God , the God of thy father : fear not to go down into Egypt  ; for I will there make of thee a great nation :
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei , U Blei jong u kpa jong me ,  u ong .  Wat sheptieng ban leit hiar sha Ijipt ; hangta ngan pynlong ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .

translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , saying , I will open my mouth in parables  ; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong :  Ngan pyndonkam da ki pharshi haba nga kren ha ki , ngan ïathuh ha ki ïa kiei kiei ki bymtip naduh ba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Use hospitality one to another without grudging .
translation.kha: To plie kylluid ïa ki ïing jong phi iwei ïa iwei pat khlem jingkhñium .

translation.en: The Son of man indeed goeth , as it is written of him : but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed ! good were it for that man if he had never been born .
translation.kha: U Khun U Briew un ïap kumba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki la ong ba un ïap ; hynrei katno kan long kaba sngewshyrkhei na ka bynta uta u briew uba shetkylla ïa U Khun U Briew ! Kan jin da la kham bha na ka bynta uta u briew lada ym shym la kha ïa u !

translation.en: Then Asa the king took all Judah  ; and they carried away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha was building  ; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Asa u lum ïa ki rangbah na baroh sawdong ka Judah bad hukum ïa ki ban rah noh ïa ki maw bad ki dieng sawdong kiba u Baasha u pyndonkam ha Ramah , bad ki pyndonkam ïa ki ban tei kut ïa ki nongbah ka Geba bad Mispah .

translation.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge ?
translation.kha: Me dei uei uba kylli ïa ka jingstad jong nga da ka jingbymtip jong me , ki ktien ba-thylli ?

translation.en: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall , and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers .
translation.kha: Nangta ki shipai jong u Pilat ki la ïalam ïa U Jisu shapoh ka ïing paki dulan u lyngskor , bad ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u .

translation.en: He made also posts of threescore cubits , even unto the post of the court round about the gate .
translation.kha: Ka kamra kaba ha tduh eh ka lam sha kawei ka phyllaw . U la thew ïa kata ka kamra bad u la shem ba ka long shiphew mitar ka pyngkiang .

translation.en: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen  ; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation .
translation.kha: Khie leit kyang jam sha ki blei kiba phi la jied . Ai ba kita kin pyllait ïa phi ha ka por ba phi jynjar .

translation.en: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved , let us have grace , whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear :
translation.kha: Te , to ngin long kiba sngewnguh , namar ngi ïohpdiang ïa ka hima ka bymlah pynkhih . To ngin long kiba sngewnguh bad mane ïa U Blei ha ka rukom ka ban pynsngewbha ïa u , da ka jingsngew burom bad ka jingtiengburom ;

translation.en: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers : but the sheep did not hear them .
translation.kha: Baroh kita kiwei kiba la wan ha shuwa jong nga ki long ki nongtuh bad nonglute , hynrei ki langbrot kim shym la shahshkor ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will this once cause them to know , I will cause them to know mine hand and my might  ; and they shall know that my name is The  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta te ,  ong U  Trai  ,  Tang shisien keiñ ngan pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban tip ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga ; kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king : Solomon built Millo , and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingïathuhkhana shaphang kata ka jingïaleh pyrshah . U Solomon u la nang pyndap khyndew ha ki jaka kiba ha mihngi jong ka Jerusalem bad u moramot ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: Therefore shall the land mourn , and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish , with the beasts of the field , and with the fowls of heaven  ; yea , the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka ri kan sa tyrkhong , kiei kiei baroh kiba im ha ka kin ïap . Baroh ki mrad bad ki sim , bad wat ki dohkha ruh , kin ïap .

translation.en: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster , and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs , and an hundred thousand rams , with the wool .
translation.kha: U Mesha u syiem ka Moab u ri pynroi langbrot , bad man ka snem u ai ka jingnguh ïa u syiem Israel shi lakh tylli ki khunlangbrot , bad u  saiwul na ki shi lakh tylli ki langbrot .

translation.en: I have said to corruption , Thou art my father : to the worm , Thou art my mother , and my sister .
translation.kha: Ngan sa khot ïa ka jingtep , u kpa jong nga , bad baroh ki ksaiñ kiba bam ïa nga ngan khot ïa ki ba ki dei ka kmie bad ki para kynthei jong nga .

translation.en: So he went another way , and returned not by the way that he came to Beth–el .
translation.kha: Kumta um shym leit phai na kajuh ka lynti kaba u la wan , hynrei na kawei pat ka lynti .

translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself  ; and the second year that which springeth of the same : and in the third year sow ye , and reap , and plant vineyards , and eat the fruit thereof .
translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u la ong ha u syiem Hesekaïah ,  Kane ka long ka dak ïa kaei ka ban jia . Kane ka snem bad hadien men ïoh tang u symboh kew khlaw ba men bam , hynrei ha ka snem kaba bud me lah ban bet ïa u kew jong me bad ban ot ïa u , bad men thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .

translation.en: Herein is love , not that we loved God , but that he loved us , and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ka jingieit ka long : Kam dei ba ngi la ieit ïa U Blei , hynrei , ba u la ieit ïa ngi bad u la phah ïa la U Khun ban long ka lynti ha kaba map ïa ki pop jong ngi .

translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Daughter , thy faith hath made thee whole  ; go in peace , and be whole of thy plague .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Ko khun jong nga , ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkhiah ïa pha . Khie leit ha kaba suk , bad to long kaba la khiah na ka jingshitom jong pha .

translation.en: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house , and on thy gates .
translation.kha: Thoh ruh ïa ki ha ki shawkad jong ki ïing bad ha ki khyrdop jong phi .

translation.en: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you , that ye also may have fellowship with us : and truly our fellowship is with the Father , and with his Son Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaba ngi la ïohi bad la ïohsngew ngi pynbna ha phi ruh , khnang ba phin ïasnoh bad ngi ha ka jingïasyllok kaba ngi don bad U Kpa lem bad U Jisu Khrist U Khun jong u .

translation.en: And the devil said unto him , All this power will I give thee , and the glory of them : for that is delivered unto me  ; and to whomsoever I will I give it .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa kane ka bor baroh bad ïa kane ka spah baroh ,  u Soitan u la ong ïa u .  La ai ïa kane baroh ha nga , bad nga lah ban ai ïa ka ha uno uno uba nga jied .

translation.en: What mean ye , that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel , saying , The fathers have eaten sour grapes , and the children s teeth are set on edge ?
