translation.kha: bad u ong ,  Kaei kane ka proberb kaba ki briew ki ïai kren ha ka ri Israel ?   ‘ Ki kmie ki kpa ki bam ïa ki sohwaiñ bajew , hynrei ki khun ki la ïoh ka jingmad bajew .’

translation.en: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine :
translation.kha: Hynrei me dei ban hikai ïa kaei kaba ïahap bad ka jinghikai shongtynrai kaba skhem .

translation.en: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day , David sware , saying , So do God to me , and more also , if I taste bread , or ought else , till the sun be down .
translation.kha: Baroh shi sngi ki briew ki wan kyntu ïa u Dabid ban bam ei ei , hynrei u Dabid u la pynlong ka kular kaba shongkhia ,  Ieh U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada nga bam ei ei shuwa ba ka sngi kan sep !

translation.en: Even to day is my complaint bitter : my stroke is heavier than my groaning .
translation.kha: Nga dang ïaleh pyrshah bad khñium pyrshah ïa U Blei ; ngam lah ban kun ïa ka jingud jong nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as I made my journey , and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon , suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang leit lynti bad wan poi hajan ka Damaskos , hamar shiteng sngi ka jingshai baphyrnai na sahit bneng ka la thaba kynsan sawdong jong nga .

translation.en: Then David enquired of the  Lord  yet again . And the  Lord  answered him and said , Arise , go down to Keilah  ; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u kylli sa shisien na U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Keilah , namar ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor ki Philistia .

translation.en: And Jesus asked him , saying ,  What is thy name ?  And he said , Legion : because many devils were entered into him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ?   Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long ‘ U Paidbah ,’   u la jubab — naba shibun ki ksuid ki la rung hapoh jong u .

translation.en: And when they were gone aside , they talked between themselves , saying , This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds .
translation.kha: bad hadien ba ki la mihnoh , ki la ïakren para ma ki ,  Une u briew um shym leh kaei kaei kaba u dei ban ïap ne ban shah set phatok .

translation.en: That which I speak , I speak it not after the Lord , but as it were foolishly , in this confidence of boasting .
translation.kha: Da shisha ïa kaei kaba nga ong mynta kam long kaei kaba U Trai u kwah ïa nga ban ong ; ha kane ka kam ban sngewsarong nga kren shisha kum uba bieit .

translation.en: For I would not , brethren , that ye should be ignorant of this mystery , lest ye should be wise in your own conceits ; that blindness in part is happened to Israel , until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingshisha barieh , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , kaba nga kwah ïa phi ban tip , naba kan pynlong ïa phi ban ym pyrkhat katno uba stad phi long . Kata ka long ba ka jingmutlop jong ki paid Israel kam neh sah , hynrei kan neh tang haduh kata ka por ba baroh ki Jentil kin wan sha U Blei .

translation.en: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea , and Nymphas , and the church which is in his house .
translation.kha: To ai ïa ka jingkhublei bakyrpang jong ngi ïa ki parabangeit ha Laodikaïa , bad ïa ka Nympha bad ïa ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother s brother , and the sheep of Laban his mother s brother , that Jacob went near , and rolled the stone from the well s mouth , and watered the flock of Laban his mother s brother .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u ïohi ïa ka Rakhel bad ka kynhun langbrot u kñi jong u , u Laban , u leit sha ka pukri , u pyntyllun sharud ïa u maw , bad u la ai um ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: Whose fan is in his hand , and he will thoroughly purge his floor , and gather his wheat into the garner  ; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire .
translation.kha: U don la ka byrsha pynher stait ban shoh ïa u kew baroh . Un lumlang ïa u kew ha ka thiar jong u , hynrei un thang ïa u stait ha ka ding ka bym ju lip .

translation.en: Then said Jonathan , Behold , we will pass over unto these men , and we will discover ourselves unto them .
translation.kha: To ,  u Jonathan u ong .  Ngin leit shatai sha shiliang bad shah ïa ki Philistia ban ïohi ïa ngi .

translation.en: God is faithful , by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba dei ban shaniah , U Blei uba la khot ïa phi sha ka jingïasyllok bad U Jisu Khrist u khun jong u , uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half was the length thereof , and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof .
translation.kha: U thaw ïa ka jingtap da ka ksiar nylla , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , bad hynriewphew sentimitar ka pyngkiang .

translation.en: And let it come to pass , that the damsel to whom I shall say , Let down thy pitcher , I pray thee , that I may drink  ; and she shall say , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also : let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac  ; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master .
translation.kha: Ngan ong ha kawei na ki , ‘ Sngewbha pynhiar ïa u khiew um jong phi bad to ai ba ngan ïoh dih um .’ Lada ka ong , ‘ Dih , bad ngan sa wanrah um ruh ïa ki ut jong phi ,’ to ai ba kan dei ma ka kaba me la jied na ka bynta u shakri jong me u Isaak . Lada kane kan jia , ngan tip ba me la batskhem ïa la ka kular ha u kynrad jong nga .

translation.en: For every one that asketh receiveth  ; and he that seeketh findeth  ; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba pan un ïohpdiang , bad uta uba wad un shem , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie ïa uno uno uba tied .

translation.en: Paul , and Silvanus , and Timothy , unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ : Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u Silas , bad u Timothi — Ha ki parabangeit jong ka balang ha Thessaloni , kiba long ki jong U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai : Ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk kan long ka jong phi .

translation.en: And the whole multitude of them arose , and led him unto Pilate .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la ïeng joit bad ka la ïalam ïa U Jisu ha khmat u Pilat , ha kaba ki la sdang ban mudui ïa u :

translation.en: Whom we preach , warning every man , and teaching every man in all wisdom ; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Kumta ngi ïalap ïa U Khrist ha uwei pa uwei . Da ka jingstad baroh katba lah ngi maham bad hikai ïa ki khnang ban pynïeng ïa uwei pa uwei ha khmat U Blei kum u briew uba la san pura ha U Khrist .

translation.en: And Nebo , and Baal–meon , ( their names being changed , ) and Sibmah : and gave other names unto the cities which they builded .
translation.kha: Ka Nebo , ka Baal Meon ( ïa kane ka kyrteng la pynkylla , ) bad ka Sibmah . Ki la ai kyrteng thymmai ïa ki shnong kiba ki la tei biang .

translation.en: And his sister stood afar off , to wit what would be done to him .
translation.kha: Ka hynmen jong uta u khunlung ka ap khmih kham na pajih ban ïohi kan jia aïu ïa u .

translation.en: And I heard the man clothed in linen , which was upon the waters of the river , when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven , and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time , times , and an half  ; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people , all these things shall be finished .
translation.kha: U angel u la rah ïa la ki kti sha bneng bad u la pynlong ka jingkular kyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U Blei Bymjukut . Nga la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ,  Kan long lai snem shiteng . Haba ka jingpynshitom beiñ ïa ki briew jong U Blei ka kut , kine kiei kiei baroh kin hap ban jia .

translation.en: Then I sent unto him , saying , There are no such things done as thou sayest , but thou feignest them out of thine own heart .
translation.kha: Nga phah ka jubab sha u :  Ym don na kaei kaba phi ong ba ka long kaba dei . Phi la shu thaw hi da lade .

translation.en: My sheep hear my voice , and I know them , and they follow me :
translation.kha: Ki langbrot jong nga ki shahshkor ïa ka sur jong nga ; nga ithuh ïa ki , bad ki bud ïa nga .

translation.en: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God ! how unsearchable are his judgments , and his ways past finding out !
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba khraw ka spah jong U Blei ! Katno ki long kiba jylliew ka jingstad bad ka jingtip jong u ! Uei uba lah ban batai ïa ki jingrai jong U ? Uei uba lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki lynti jong u ?

translation.en: My God will cast them away , because they did not hearken unto him : and they shall be wanderers among the nations .
translation.kha: U Blei uba nga shakri un kyntait ïa ki briew jong u , namar ba kim shym la shahshkor ïa u . Kin kylla long ki nongïaidwir hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea  ; and there he tarried with them , and baptized .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la leit sha ka probins    jong ka Judia , ha kaba u la pynlut katto katne por bad ki bad u la pynbaptis .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight , and shall go forth : they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby : he shall cover his face , that he see not the ground with his eyes .
translation.kha: U khun syiem uba synshar ïa ki un tawah ïa la ka song ha ka tyrpeng jong u bad un phet lyngba ka thliew kaba ki la tih na ka bynta jong u ha ka kynroh . Un tap ïa ki khmat jong u , bad um ïohi shano ba u leit .

translation.en: But he refused , and said , I will not eat . But his servants , together with the woman , compelled him  ; and he hearkened unto their voice . So he arose from the earth , and sat upon the bed .
translation.kha: U Saul um treh , bad u ong ba un ym bam ei ei . Hynrei ki rangbah synshar jong u ki kyrpad ïa u ban bam . Khatduh eh u kohnguh , u ïeng nangta na madan , bad u shong halor jingthiah .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , This generation shall not pass away , till all be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba kine kiei kiei baroh kin jia ha shuwa ba ki briew kiba im mynta kin ïap baroh .

translation.en: Now David had said , Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness , so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him : and he hath requited me evil for good .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ju pyrkhat ,  Balei ba nga ïada ïa ka jingdon jingem jong utai u briew hangne ha ka ri khlaw ? Ym shym don kano kano kaba dei ka jong u ïa kaba la tuh , bad da kumne u siew kylliang ïa nga na ka bynta ka jingïarap kaba nga la ai ïa u !

translation.en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Shem  ; and Canaan shall be his servant .
translation.kha: Ai ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Shem ! U Kanaan un long u mraw jong u Shem .

translation.en: And , behold , I will give to thy servants , the hewers that cut timber , twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat , and twenty thousand measures of barley , and twenty thousand baths of wine , and twenty thousand baths of oil .
translation.kha: Kum ka jingpynbiang ïa ki nongtrei jong phi , ngan phah sha phi ar hajar ton u kew , ar hajar ton u barli , saw lakh litar ka waiñ bad saw lakh litar ka umphniang Olib .

translation.en: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies , and not to covetousness .
translation.kha: To ai ha nga ka jingangnud ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me ban ïa kaba ïoh spah .

translation.en: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus , for to seek Saul :
translation.kha: Nangta u Barnabas u la leit sha Tarsos ban wad ïa u Saul .

translation.en: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know , to teach them war , at the least such as before knew nothing thereof  ;
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane khnang ban hikai ïa kawei pa kawei ka pateng jong ki Israel shaphang ka thma , khamtam ïa kito ki bym pat ju mad ïa ka thma mynshuwa .

translation.en: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him , and behaved himself wisely : and Saul set him over the men of war , and he was accepted in the sight of all the people , and also in the sight of Saul s servants .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la pyndep hok ïa ki kam baroh ïa kiba u Saul u la phah ïa u , bad kumta u Saul u pynlong ïa u , u nongïalam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u . Kane ka la pynsngewbha ïa baroh ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah jong u Saul .

translation.en: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God : that of the king s goods , even of the tribute beyond the river , forthwith expenses be given unto these men , that they be not hindered .
translation.kha: Da kane nga hukum ïa phi ban ïarap ïa ki ban tei biang ïa ka . Ïa ki jingpynlut pynsep dei ban ai khlem pynslem na ka ïing jingkynshew syiem ba la ïoh na ki khajna ha Ïuphratis Sepngi , khnang ban ym pynthut ïa ka kam .

translation.en: After these things were ended , Paul purposed in the spirit , when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia , to go to Jerusalem , saying , After I have been there , I must also see Rome .
translation.kha: Hadien ba kine kiei kiei ki la jia , u Paul u la kut jingmut ban leit lyngba ka Makedonia bad ka Akhaïa bad ban nang leit sha Jerusalem .  Hadien ba nga leit shata ,  u la ong ,  nga dei ban ïohi ruh ïa ka Rom .

translation.en: So Hazael king of Syria died  ; and Ben–hadad his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïap jong u Hasael u syiem ka Syria u khun jong u , u Benhadad u long syiem .

translation.en: And there will I nourish thee  ; for yet there are five years of famine  ; lest thou , and thy household , and all that thou hast , come to poverty .
translation.kha: Lada phi don ha Goshen , nga lah ban peit ban sumar ïa phi . Ka  nemsniew kan neh sa san snem , bad ngam kwah ba ma phi , ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi , bad ki jingri jingdup jong phi baroh kin shahthngan .’

translation.en: Also I heard the voice of the Lord , saying , Whom shall I send , and who will go for us ? Then said I , Here am I  ; send me .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ba U Trai u ong ,  Ïano ngan phah ? Mano ban long u nonglamktien jong ngi ?  Nga la jubab ,  Ngan leit ! To phah ïa nga !

translation.en: And every open vessel , which hath no covering bound upon it , is unclean .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u khra bad u khiew hapoh ka ïingjaiñ u bym don jingtap u long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: Who gave himself for us , that he might redeem us from all iniquity , and purify unto himself a peculiar people , zealous of good works .
translation.kha: U la aiti ïa lade na ka bynta jong ngi , ban pyllait ïa ngi na ka jingbymman baroh bad ban pynlong ïa ngi ki briew kiba khuid kiba dei ki jong U hi bad kiba kwah hir hir ban leh ïa kaba bha .

translation.en: Surely there is a vein for the silver , and a place for gold where they fine it .
translation.kha: Ki don ki par ha kaba la tih ïa ka rupa ; Ki don ki jaka ha kiba la saiñ ïa ka ksiar .

translation.en: In my distress I called upon the  Lord  , and cried to my God : and he did hear my voice out of his temple , and my cry did enter into his ears .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar nga la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , nga la khot kyrpad ïa U Blei jong nga ban ïoh jingïarap . Ha ka templ jong u , u ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong nga , u shahshkor ïa ka jingkyang jong nga ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And Gideon said unto God , If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand , as thou hast said ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u ong ha U Blei ,  Me ong ba me la kut jingmut ban pyndonkam ïa nga ban pyllait ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: My Father , which gave them me , is greater than all  ; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father s hand .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ka long kham khraw ban ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban knieh noh ïa ki na ka jingsumar U Kpa .

translation.en: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past , and it hath been testified to his owner , and he hath not kept him in , but that he hath killed a man or a woman  ; the ox shall be stoned , and his owner also shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uta u masi kyrtong mynshuwa ruh u dei uba la tynrah briew teng , bad u trai jong u um shym set ïa u wat haba la maham ïa u — te , lada u tynrah ïano ïano , shynrang ne kynthei haduh ban da ïap , dei ban lynthem maw ïa u , bad u trai jong u ruh u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: They answered again and said , Let the king tell his servants the dream , and we will shew the interpretation of it .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab biang ïa u syiem ,  Lada u Syiem Kynrad un shu ïathuh ïa ngi ïa ka jingphohsniew , ngin batai ïa ka .

translation.en: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance  ; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock , that it should not be covered .
translation.kha: Nga la pynsah ïa ka snam hangta , ïa kaba ym lah ban buhrieh , kaba dawa ïa ka jingpynhiarkput kaba jur .

translation.en: There is no peace , saith the  Lord  , unto the wicked .
translation.kha: Ym don jingshngain ïa ki nongpop ,  ong U  Trai .

translation.en: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges  ; he shall also bring him to the door , or unto the door post  ; and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl  ; and he shall serve him for ever .
translation.kha: te u kynrad jong u un ïalam ïa u sha ka jaka mane Blei . Hangta un pynïeng ïa u ha ka jingkhang ne ha ka shawkad bad un sam shkor ïa u . Te un sa long u mraw jong u shi rta .

translation.en: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth  ; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger  ;
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ki nongwei kin ïohknieh ïa ka spah jong phi baroh , bad kaei kaba phi la trei shitom kan long ka jong kiwei pat .

translation.en: How did you drive ?
translation.kha: Kumno phi ngiah ?

translation.en: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Silas u la kut jingmut ban sah hangta .

translation.en: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron , and to his sons , according to all things which I have commanded thee : seven days shalt thou consecrate them .
translation.kha: Leh ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u hynñiew sngi lynter kumba nga la hukum ïa me .

translation.en: Remember thy servants , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob  ; look not unto the stubbornness of this people , nor to their wickedness , nor to their sin :
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa la ki shakri , ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad wat thew ïa ka jingmutlop , ka jingbymman , bad ka pop jong une u paidlang .

translation.en: With good will doing service , as to the Lord , and not to men :
translation.kha: Trei ïa la ka kam kum ki mraw da kaba kmen , kumba phi shakri ïa U Trai , bad ym tang ïa ki briew .

translation.en: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk , of blind , halt , withered , waiting for the moving of the water .
translation.kha: U paid uba bun jong ki briew kiba pang ki ïathiah ha ki baranda — kiba matlah , kiba dkoh , bad kiba ïapshiliang .

translation.en: When thou hast eaten and art full , then thou shalt bless the  Lord  thy God for the good land which he hath given thee .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh bam kat ïa kaba phi kwah , bad phin ainguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi na ka bynta kata ka ri kaba seisoh ba u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Servants , be subject to your masters with all fear  ; not only to the good and gentle , but also to the froward .
translation.kha: Phi ki shakri , to pynrit ha ki kynrad jong phi bad pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingtiengburom baroh , ym tang ha kito kiba lehbha bad kiba lehsbun , hynrei ruh ha kito kiba dukhi .

translation.en: And he would not : but went and cast him into prison , till he should pay the debt .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kyntait ; pynban , u la phah thep byndi ïa u tad haduh ba u dei ban siew ïa ka ram .

translation.en: But they that escape of them shall escape , and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys , all of them mourning , every one for his iniquity .
translation.kha: Ki don ki ban phet ïap sha ki lumbah kumba ki lyngdkhur kiba sheptieng na ki jaka them . Baroh na ki kin ïam sngewsih namar ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  left those nations , without driving them out hastily  ; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la shah ïa kine ki jaitbynriew ban ïaisah ha ka ri ; um shym la ai ha u Joshua ka jingjop halor jong ki , lymne beh noh shen ïa ki hadien ka jingïap jong u Joshua .

translation.en: If we say that we have no sin , we deceive ourselves , and the truth is not in us .
translation.kha: Lada ngi ong ba ngim don pop , ngi shukor ïa lade , bad ka jingshisha kam don ha ngi .

translation.en: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate , and an helmet of salvation upon his head  ; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing , and was clad with zeal as a cloak .
translation.kha: Un kup ïa ka hok kum ka jingïada shadem , bad ïa ka bor bapynim kum ka jingda khlieh . U kup ïa lade da ka jingangnud kaba khraw ban buh ryntih ïa kiei kiei bad ban pynshitom bad pynhiarkput ïa ki jingsniew kiba ki briew ki leh .

translation.en: He said therefore ,  A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom , and to return .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ong ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba heh kyrdan uba dang leit sha ka ri kaba jngai bah ban shah thung syiem , hadien kata , u la thmu ban wan phai pat sha ïing .

translation.en: But the  Lord  said unto me , Say not , I am a child : for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee , and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha nga ,  Wat ong ba me dang khynnah eh , hynrei khie leit sha ki briew kiba nga phah ïa me , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga hukum ïa me ban ong .

translation.en: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things , but will walk contrary unto me  ;
translation.kha: Lada wat hadien kat kane ka jingpynshitom phim pat shahshkor ïa nga , hynrei phi ïai pyrshah ïa nga ,

translation.en: Is it fit to say to a king , Thou art wicked ? and to princes , Ye are ungodly ?
translation.kha: U Blei u pynrem ïa ki syiem bad ïa ki nongsynshar haba kim long jingmyntoi ne ki long kiba bymman .

translation.en: And they took strong cities , and a fat land , and possessed houses full of all goods , wells digged , vineyards , and oliveyards , and fruit trees in abundance : so they did eat , and were filled , and became fat , and delighted themselves in thy great goodness .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong me ki la jop ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh , ki ri baseisoh , ki ïing ba-dap da ka spah , ki pukri ba la dep tih lypa , ki dieng Olib , ki diengsoh , ki bri sohwaiñ . Ki bam ïa baroh kaba ki kwah bad ki man sngaid ; ki lehkmen ha baroh kiei kiei kiba bha kiba me la ai ïa ki .

translation.en: As the thief is ashamed when he is found , so is the house of Israel ashamed  ; they , their kings , their princes , and their priests , and their prophets ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kumba u nongtuh u shah pynjahburom haba la kem ïa u , kumta ïa phi baroh ki paid Israel yn pynjahburom — ki syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong phi , ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi .

translation.en: And he washed his face , and went out , and refrained himself , and said , Set on bread .
translation.kha: Ynda u la dep bta khmat , u wan mih biang ; nangta da kaba pynjai jai ïa lade , u hukum ban sam ïa ka jingbam .

translation.en: He had come .
translation.kha: U la wan Ma u .

translation.en: Then they that feared the  Lord  spake often one to another : and the  Lord  hearkened , and heard it , and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the  Lord  , and that thought upon his name .
translation.kha: Te ki briew kiba sheptieng ïa U  Trai  ki la ïakren iwei ïa iwei pat , bad U  Trai  u shahshkor bad ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ki ong . Ha khmat jong u , hangta la thoh ha ka kitab ka jingbuh jingthoh ïa kito kiba sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad kiba ñiewkor ïa u .

translation.en: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation , about the most holy things :
translation.kha: hynrei u Nadab bad u Abihu ki la shah pynïap mynba ki ainguh da ka ding bymkhuid sha U  Trai  ha ka ri Shyiap Sinai . Kine kim don khun don kti , kumta u Eleasar bad u Ithamar ki la shakri kum ki lyngdoh katba u Aaron u dang im .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , See , thou sayest unto me , Bring up this people : and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me . Yet thou hast said , I know thee by name , and thou hast also found grace in my sight .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha U  Trai  ,  Ka long kaba shisha ba me la ong ïa nga ban ïalam ïa kine ki briew sha kata ka ri ; hynrei mem pat shym ïathuh ha nga ïano men phah ryngkat bad nga . Me la ong ba me tip bha shaphang jong nga , bad me sngewbha eh ruh ïa nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , take thy journey before the people , that they may go in and possess the land , which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa nga ban leit bad ïalam ïa phi , khnang ba phi lah ban kam kynti ïa kata ka ri ba u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: And Lot also , which went with Abram , had flocks , and herds , and tents .
translation.kha: U Lot ruh u la don ki langbrot , ki blang , ki masi , bad kumjuh ruh la ka jong ka longïing longsem bad ki shakri shakor .

translation.en: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered , and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan , until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan .
translation.kha: Ki thom sa thom pyrshah ïa u haduh ba ki da pynjot thiaw ïa u .

translation.en: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ ? shall tribulation , or distress , or persecution , or famine , or nakedness , or peril , or sword ?
translation.kha: Uei te , uba lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingieit U Khrist ? Hato ka jingjynjar ka lah , lane ka jingshitom lane ka jingpynshitom beiñ lane ka jingthngan lane ka jingduk lane ka jingma lane ka jingïap ?

translation.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people  ; and aforetime I was as a tabret .
translation.kha: Bad mynta ki briew ki pyndonkam ïa kane ka proberb pyrshah ïa nga ; ki wan bad ki bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .

translation.en: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail , and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child , the voice of the daughter of Zion , that bewaileth herself , that spreadeth her hands , saying , Woe is me now ! for my soul is wearied because of murderers .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam , kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha , ka jinglynñiar kum ka kynthei kaba kha ïa i khun nyngkong jong ka . Ka la long ka jingïam jong ka Jerusalem kaba kwah eh ban ring mynsiem , ka da kner noh ïa ka kti jong ka bad ong ,  Nga long kaba la tim ! Ki wan ban pynïap ïa nga !

translation.en: The king of Makkedah , one  ; the king of Beth–el , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Makkedah , ka Bethel ,

translation.en: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel , to the captains of thousands and of hundreds , and to the judges , and to every governor in all Israel , the chief of the fathers .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u la ai hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba khmih ïa ki kynhun ba shihajar ngut ki rangbah bad ïa ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut ki rangbah , ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar ka sorkar , ïa baroh ki khlieh jong ki longïing longsem , bad ki briew basah baroh , da kaba hukum ïa ki ban leit bad u sha ka jaka mane ha Gibeon .

translation.en: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women : and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the  Lord  of hosts , which he shaketh over it .
translation.kha: Ka por ka wan haba ki briew jong ka Ijipt kin long kiba khawpud kum ki kynthei . Kin khynñiuh ha ka jingsngewtriem haba ki ïohi ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: Ye are my friends , if ye do whatsoever I command you .
translation.kha: Bad phi long ki paralok jong nga lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba nga hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , but not with a perfect heart .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , hynrei u leh ïa kata da ka jingbymmon .

translation.en: So the king of Israel went , and the king of Judah , and the king of Edom : and they fetched a compass of seven days  journey : and there was no water for the host , and for the cattle that followed them .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Joram bad ki syiem ka Judah bad Edom ki la ïamih . Hadien ka jingïaid kaba hynñiew sngi , ki la kyrduh um , bad ym don ei ei shuh na ka bynta ki rangbah lane na ka bynta ka kynhun ki mrad .

translation.en: And the ark of the  Lord  was in the country of the Philistines seven months .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka la don ha ka ri ki Philistia hynñiew bnai ,

translation.en: Saying with a loud voice , Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power , and riches , and wisdom , and strength , and honour , and glory , and blessing .
translation.kha: bad ki la rwai ha ka sur bajam :  U Khunlangbrot uba la shah pynïap u long uba dei hok ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bor , ka spah , ka jingstad , bad ka jingkhlaiñ , ka jingpyndonburom , ka burom , bad ka jingïaroh !

translation.en: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God , we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold , or silver , or stone , graven by art and man s device .
translation.kha: Namar ba ngi long ki khun U Blei , ngim dei ban tharai ba ka jinglong jong u ka long kaei kaei kaba kum ka dur da ka ksiar lane rupa lane maw , ba la pynwandur da ka jingstad bad ka buit briew .

translation.en: O ye simple , understand wisdom : and , ye fools , be ye of an understanding heart .
translation.kha: Hato phi dang long kiba lung jingmut ? Hikai ban long kiba rangbah jingmut . Hato phi long kiba dang bieit ? Hikai ban long kiba shemphang .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob , How old art thou ?
translation.kha: bad u syiem u kylli ïa u ,  Phi la dap katno ka rta ?

translation.en: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour , and of her that sojourneth in her house , jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment : and ye shall put them upon your sons , and upon your daughters  ; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Man la ka kynthei Israel kan pan ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad jingdeng rupa , bad ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem ruh , na la ka paramarjan nong Ijipt bad na ka kynthei Ijipt kaba shong basah ha ïing jong ka . Ki Israel kin buh ïa kine kiei kiei ha la ki khun shynrang bad kynthei bad kit noh ïa ka spah jong ki nong Ijipt .

translation.en: And she said unto him , I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah , which she bare unto Nahor .
translation.kha: U kpa jong nga u dei u Bethuel u khun jong u Nahor bad ka Milkah ,  ka la jubab .

translation.en: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded : and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath , with them that should go out on the sabbath , and came to Jehoiada the priest .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u Jehoïada bad ki wallam ïa ki rangbah jong ki sha u — kito ki bym dei ban leit trei ha ka sngi Sabbaton bad kito kiba dei ban leit trei .

translation.en: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the  Lord   ; and they prepared them ,
translation.kha: Ha ki hukum ki jong u syiem ki pynkhreh ha ka jaka jong ka Templ ïa ki kamra buh jingbuh

translation.en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem , saying , Ye shall have peace  ; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , me la shukor la biang ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ! Me la ong ba kan don ka jingsuk , hynrei ka waitlam ka ha ki pdot jong ki .

translation.en: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators :
translation.kha: Ha ka shithi kaba nga la thoh sha phi nga la ong ba phim dei ban ïakhleh bad ki briew kiba awria .

translation.en: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near , the tribe of Benjamin was taken .
translation.kha: Te u Samuel u pynwan sha khmat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jait , bad U Trai u la jied ïa ka jait Benjamin .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day , that the  Lord  thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth :
translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad sumar hok ïa ki hukum jong u baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , un kyntiew ïa phi ha khlieh eh jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram , on every side : and Dathan and Abiram came out , and stood in the door of their tents , and their wives , and their sons , and their little children .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kynriah noh na ki ïingjaiñ jong u Korah , u Dathan , bad u Abiram . U Dathan bad u Abiram ki la mih shabar bad ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ki dara jong ki lem bad ki tnga bad ki khun ki kti jong ki .

translation.en: Her children arise up , and call her blessed  ; her husband also , and he praiseth her .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong ka , ki pynpaw ïa ka jingsngew burom ïa ka , u tnga jong ka u ïaroh ïa ka .

translation.en: Also the  Lord  was angry with me for your sakes , saying , Thou also shalt not go in thither .
translation.kha: Dei namar jong phi keiñ ba U  Trai  u la bitar ïa nga ruh , bad u ong , ‘ Wat me ruh , Moses , men ym ïohrung ha kata ka ri .

translation.en: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain , by which he obtained witness that he was righteous , God testifying of his gifts : and by it he being dead yet speaketh .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Abel ban ainguh ha U Blei ïa ka jingkñia kaba kham bha ban ïa ka jong u Kain . Lyngba ka jingngeit jong u , u la ïohpdiang ka jingsngewbha U Blei kum u briew uba hok , namar U Blei hi u la pdiang ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong u . Da kata ka jingngeit , u Abel u dang ïai kren wat haba u la ïap .

translation.en: Whereupon , O king Agrippa , I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision :
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko syiem Agrippa , ngam shym la long u bymkohnguh ïa ka jingïohipaw kaba nga la ïoh na bneng .

translation.en: But thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt , and the  Lord  thy God redeemed thee thence : therefore I command thee to do this thing .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt bad ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyllait ïa phi ; dei namar kata ba nga la ai ha phi ïa kane ka hukum .

translation.en: And I will for this afflict the seed of David , but not for ever .
translation.kha: Namar ka pop u Solomon ngan pynshitom ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid , hynrei kan nym long ha ki por baroh .’

translation.en: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever .
translation.kha: Ma phi bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , phin bud pyrkhing junom ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .

translation.en: God forbid . How shall we , that are dead to sin , live any longer therein ?
translation.kha: Kam long kumta! Ngi la ïap ïa ka pop — kumno te ngi lah ban ïai im ha ka ?

translation.en: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God , what shall we say ? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance ? ( I speak as a man )
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei ka ban long lada ka jingleh bymdei jong ngi ka pyn-i kham shai ïa kaei kaba dei kaba U Blei u leh ? Hato ngi lah ban ong ba U Blei u bakla haba u pynshitom ïa ngi ? ( Kane kan long ka jingkylli kaba dei ban kylli . )

translation.en: And after a time he returned to take her , and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion : and , behold , there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion .
translation.kha: Katto katne sngi hadien , u Samson u leit phai pat ban shongkurim ïa ka . Ha ka jingleit jong u , u leit sharud lynti ban khmih ïa ka metïap jong uta u sing , bad u sngewlyngngoh ban lap shi kiaw u ngap bad khyndiat ka ngap hapoh kata ka metïap .

translation.en: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold , and grave upon it , like the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE  LORD .
translation.kha: Thaw ruh ïa ka jingdeng da ka ksiar nylla bad thoh ha ka , ‘ La Pynkyntang sha U  Trai .’

translation.en: And Samson went down to Timnah , and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Samson u leit hiar sha Timnah , ha kaba u ïohi ïa kawei ka kynthei Philistia .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Have we not power to lead about a sister , a wife , as well as other apostles , and as the brethren of the Lord , and Cephas ?
translation.kha: Hato ngim don hok ban bud ïa ki nuksa jong kiwei pat ki apostol bad jong ki para jong U Trai bad u Petros , da kaba ïalam ïa ka tnga kaba long ka parabangeit ha ki jingleit lynti jong nga ?

translation.en: And the prophet Gad said unto David , Abide not in the hold  ; depart , and get thee into the land of Judah . Then David departed , and came into the forest of Hareth .
translation.kha: Nangta , u Gad u nongïathuhlypa u la wan ha u Dabid bad u ong ,  Wat sah hangne ; leit noh shisyndon sha ka ri Judah .  Kumta u Dabid u mihnoh bad u leit sha ka khlaw Hereth .

translation.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt , I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house , that my name might be therein  ; but I chose David to be over my people Israel .
translation.kha: ‘ Naduh ka por ba nga la wan ïalam ïa ki briew jong nga na Ijipt , ngam shym la jied kano kano ka nongbah na baroh ka ri Israel ban tei hangta ïa ka Templ ha kaba yn mane ïa nga . Hynrei nga la jied ïa me , u Dabid , ban synshar ïa ki briew jong nga .’

translation.en: Be of the same mind one toward another . Mind not high things , but condescend to men of low estate . Be not wise in your own conceits .
translation.kha: To don ïa kajuh ka jingsngewkhia ïa baroh . To wat long kiba sarong , hynrei to pdiang ïa ki kam kiba kham hapoh . To wat pyrkhat ïa lade kum kiba stad .

translation.en: And Herod said , John have I beheaded : but who is this , of whom I hear such things ? And he desired to see him .
translation.kha: U Herod u la ong ,  Nga la phah khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis ; hynrei uei une u briew uba nga ïohsngew shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh ?  Bad u la ïai pyrshang ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: That ye may be blameless and harmless , the sons of God , without rebuke , in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation , among whom ye shine as lights in the world ;
translation.kha: khnang ba phi lah ban long kiba lui lui bad kiba khuid kum ki khun kiba janai jong U Blei , kiba im ha ka pyrthei jong ki briew kiba bamsap bad kiba pop . Phi dei ban tyngshaiñ hapdeng jong ki kum ki khlur kiba pynshai ïa ka sahit bneng , kumba phi tyrwa ha ki ïa ka khubor jong ka jingim .

translation.en: They went out from us , but they were not of us  ; for if they had been of us , they would no doubt have continued with us : but they went out , that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew da shisha kim don ha ka jingïasyllok jong ngi , bad kata ka long balei ba ki la iehnoh ïa ngi ; lada ki la don ha ka jingïasyllok bad ngi , kin jin da la sah bad ngi . Hynrei ki mihnoh , ba kan paw shai ba ym don napdeng jong ki kiba dei shisha ki jong ngi .

translation.en: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall , at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea .
translation.kha: Haba ka Edom kan kyllon , kan don ka jingsawa kaba jur kat haduh ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan khynñiuh , bad ïa ki jingkyang tieng yn ïohsngew jngai shaduh ka khmut duriaw Akaba .

translation.en: The river of Kishon swept them away , that ancient river , the river Kishon . O my soul , thou hast trodden down strength .
translation.kha: Ka jingshlei um ha ka Kishon ka la rong noh ïa ki — Ka lat lat ka wah Kishon . Ngan nang ïaid , nang ïaid shaphrang , da ka jingkhlaiñ !

translation.en: They soon forgat his works  ; they waited not for his counsel :
translation.kha: Hynrei shen ki klet noh ïa kaei kaba u la leh bad ki la leh khlem ap ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u .

translation.en: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay , and that there is black hair grown up therein  ; the scall is healed , he is clean : and the priest shall pronounce him clean .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ha ka jingkhmih jong u lyngdoh ka prum kam shym pur , bad u shñiuh uba ïong u la sdang mih hangta , kata ka prum ka la jem , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid .

translation.en: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me , saying , What are these , my lord ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kylli ïa u angel ,  Kine kiei kiei ki ïeng na ka bynta kaei , ko rangbah ?

translation.en: Then came the day of unleavened bread , when the passover must be killed .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la poi ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ha kaba ïa ki khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait la dei ban pynïap .

translation.en: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus .
translation.kha: Ïa u Tukhikos nga la phah sha Ephesos .

translation.en: Come against her from the utmost border , open her storehouses : cast her up as heaps , and destroy her utterly : let nothing of her be left .
translation.kha: To tur ïaleh ïa ka na ki liang baroh bad pynpra phom ïa ki jaka ha kaba la buh ïa u kew ! Kynton ïa ki jinglute kum ki kynton kew ! Pynjot ïa ka ri ! Wat ieh ei ei ruh !

translation.en: And Nobah went and took Kenath , and the villages thereof , and called it Nobah , after his own name .
translation.kha: U Nobah u la tur ïaleh bad ïohknieh ïa ka Kenath bad ki shnong jong ka , bad u la khot kyrteng thymmai ïa ka , ka Nobah , kaba dei ka kyrteng jong u hi .

translation.en: The beast that thou sawest was , and is not  ; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit , and go into perdition : and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder , whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world , when they behold the beast that was , and is not , and yet is .
translation.kha: Uta u mradkhlaw u la ju im shisien , hynrei um shym im shuh ; u la jan wan kiew na ka liewlong khlem trai bad un mih ban shah pynjot . Ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki ym shym la thoh ha ka kitab jong kiba im ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei , kin ïasngew kyndit lut katba ki dang khmih ïa u mradkhlaw . U la ju im shisien ; mynta um shym im shuh , hynrei un wan mih biang .

translation.en: And as they were loosing the colt , the owners thereof said unto them , Why loose ye the colt ?
translation.kha: Katba ki dang loit ïa u khun kada , u trai jong u , u la ong ha ki ,  Balei phi ïalaw ïa u ?

translation.en: I make a decree , That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel : for he is the living God , and stedfast for ever , and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed , and his dominion shall be even unto the end .
translation.kha: Nga hukum ba ha kylleng ka hima jong nga uwei pa uwei u dei ban sheptieng bad burom ïa U Blei jong u Daniel .  U long U Blei uba im bad un synshar junom . Ïa ka hima jong u yn ym pynjot lano lano ruh , bad ka bor jong u kan ym poi lano lano ruh sha ka jingkut .

translation.en: And it was known throughout all Joppa  ; and many believed in the Lord .
translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang kane ka la par kylleng ka Joppa , bad bun ki briew ki la ngeit ha U Trai .

translation.en: And I will plant them upon their land , and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them , saith the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Ngan thung ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri ba nga la ai ïa ki , bad yn ym jynrat shuh ïa ki ,  U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kren .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved .
translation.kha: Bad nangta , ïa uno uno uba khot kyrpad sha U Trai ban ïoh jingïarap yn pynim .’

translation.en: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel , and the battle was sore : but they knew not that evil was near them .
translation.kha: Shiphew hajar ngut ki rangdajied ïa kiba la jied kyrpang na baroh ki Israel , ki tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeah , bad ka jingïaleh ka la long kaba jur . Ki Benjamin kim pat shym poi pyrkhat ba kin sa shah pynjot noh .

translation.en: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign  ; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Zibiah of Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jehu u syiem ka Israel , u Joash u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Sibiah na ka nongbah Beersheba .

translation.en: Then Darius the king made a decree , and search was made in the house of the rolls , where the treasures were laid up in Babylon .
translation.kha: Kumta u patsha Darius u la pynmih ïa ki hukum ban wad ha ki jingthoh syiem ba la buh ha Babilon .

translation.en: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall , the terrible of the nations , all of them : and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt , and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed .
translation.kha: Ngan shah ïa ki shipai jong ki jaitbynriew kiba runar ban sei ïa ki waitlam jong ki ban pynïap ïa baroh ki briew jong me . Baroh ki briew jong me bad kiei kiei de kiba me sarong yn sa pynjot thiaw .

translation.en: I will ransom them from the power of the grave  ; I will redeem them from death : O death , I will be thy plagues  ; O grave , I will be thy destruction : repentance shall be hid from mine eyes .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pyllait ïa kine ki briew na ka ri kiba ïap lane pyllait im ïa ki na bor ka jingïap . Wanlam ïa ki khlam jong pha , ko jingïap ! Wanlam ïa ka jingpynjot jong pha , ko ka pyrthei kiba ïap ! Ngan ym don jingisynei shuh ïa kine ki briew .

translation.en: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest , and did eat the shewbread , which is not lawful to eat but for the priests , and gave also to them which were with him ?
translation.kha: kumta u la rung shapoh ka Ïing U Blei bad bam ïa u kpu ba ainguh ha U Blei . Kane ka la long mynba u Abiathar u long u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Kat kum ka Hukum jong ngi tang ki lyngdoh ki lah ban bam ïa une u kpu — hynrei u Dabid u la bam ïa u bad u la ai ïa u wat ha ki rangbah kiba bad u .

translation.en: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son , saying ,
translation.kha: U Dabid u la hukum ïa baroh ki nongïalam Israel ban ïarap ïa u Solomon .

translation.en: Arise thou therefore , get thee to thine own house : and when thy feet enter into the city , the child shall die .
translation.kha: Bad u Ahijah u ïai bteng ban ong ha ka tnga u Jeroboam ,  Mynta , khie leit phai sha la ïing . Tang mar ïarung shapoh shnong u khun jong pha un ïap .

translation.en: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord . So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God ; but with the flesh the law of sin .
translation.kha: Ka jingnguh ïa U Blei , uba leh ïa kane lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ! Kane te , ka long ka jinglong jong nga : Da lade hi nga lah ban leh ïa ka hukum U Blei tang da ka jingmut jong nga , katba ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong nga ka leh ïa hukum jong ka pop .

translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God shall enlarge thy border , as he hath promised thee , and thou shalt say , I will eat flesh , because thy soul longeth to eat flesh  ; thou mayest eat flesh , whatsoever thy soul lusteth after .
translation.kha: Ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynïar ïa ka ri jong phi , kumba u la kular , lada phi kwah bam doh phi lah ban bam katba phi mon .

translation.en: ( As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir , and the Moabites which dwell in Ar , did unto me  ; ) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the  Lord  our God giveth us .
translation.kha: haduh ba ngin da jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ai ha ngi , kumba ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , kiba shong ha Edom , bad ki Moab kiba shong ha Ar , ki la shah ïa ngi ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong ki .’

translation.en: And one goat for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , and his meat offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: And I will wait upon the  Lord  , that hideth his face from the house of Jacob , and I will look for him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la buhrieh ïa lade na ki briew jong u , hynrei nga shaniah ha u bad buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha u .

translation.en: Give glory to the  Lord  your God , before he cause darkness , and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains , and , while ye look for light , he turn it into the shadow of death , and make it gross darkness .
translation.kha: To pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong phi , ha shuwa ba un wallam ïa ka jingdum , bad ba phi jynthut halor ki lumbah ; ha shuwa ba un pynkylla sha ka jingdum synñia ïa ka jingshai kaba phi la kyrmen .

translation.en: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel , all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal , and every mouth which hath not kissed him .
translation.kha: Pynban ngan pynsah hynñiew hajar ngut ki briew ha Israel — kito kiba ïaineh ha nga bad ki bym shym la dem ïa u Baal ne doh ïa u bleithaw jong u .

translation.en: Son of man , thy brethren , even thy brethren , the men of thy kindred , and all the house of Israel wholly , are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said , Get you far from the  Lord  : unto us is this land given in possession .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem ki ïakren shaphang jong me bad shaphang ki para Israel kiba don ha ka jinglongmraw . Ki ong , ‘ Kiba shah ringmraw ki la jngai eh ban mane ïa U  Trai . U la ai ha ngi ban ïohkynti ïa ka ri .’

translation.en: Why did they sit there ?
translation.kha: Balei ki ia shong hangtei ?

translation.en: Therefore also I have lent him to the  Lord   ; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the  Lord . And he worshipped the  Lord  there .
translation.kha: Namarkata , nga aiti noh ïa u ha U  Trai . Katba u dang im , un long u jong U  Trai .  Te ki ïanguh ïadem ïa U  Trai  hangta .

translation.en: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even , he shall burn incense upon it , a perpetual incense before the  Lord  throughout your generations .
translation.kha: Un leh kumjuh haba u wan ban pynmeh ïa kita ki sharak ha ka por janmiet . Ïa kane ka jingainguh iwbih dei ban ïai leh khlem sangeh ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth–gath : the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko ki paid ka Judah , to khublei khatduh ïa ka shnong Moresheth Gath . Ki syiem ka Israel kin ym ïoh jingïarap na ka shnong Akhsib .

translation.en: Rejoice , O young man , in thy youth  ; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth , and walk in the ways of thine heart , and in the sight of thine eyes : but know thou , that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment .
translation.kha: Ko samla , to lehkmen ïa ka jinglong samla jong phi . To kmen katba phi dang samla . Leh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban leh , bad bud ïa ka jingkwah ka dohnud jong phi . Hynrei kynmaw ba U Blei un bishar ïa phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi leh .

translation.en: The king answered and said , I know of certainty that ye would gain the time , because ye see the thing is gone from me .
translation.kha: Ha kata , u syiem u la kren jam ,  Kumba nga la pyrkhat ! Phi pyrshang ban ïoh por , namar phi ïohi ba nga la kut jingmut

translation.en: And Solomon told her all her questions : there was not any thing hid from the king , which he told her not .
translation.kha: U Solomon u jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong ka baroh ; ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba eh kaba um lah ban pynshai .

translation.en: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Herod , u nongsynshar jong ka Galilaïa , u la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu .

translation.en: No man taketh it from me , but I lay it down of myself . I have power to lay it down , and I have power to take it again . This commandment have I received of my Father .
translation.kha: Ym don u ban shim noh ïa ka jingim jong nga na nga . Nga aiti ïa ka da la ka mon sngewbha hi . Nga don ka hok ban aiti noh ïa ka , bad nga don ka hok ban shim pat ïa ka . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga u la hukum ïa nga ban leh .

translation.en: That no flesh should glory in his presence .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ba ym don uba lah ban sngewsarong ha khmat jong U Blei .

translation.en: And he called the name of the place Taberah : because the fire of the  Lord  burnt among them .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Taberah , namar dei hangta ba ka ding U  Trai  ka la klang hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: I was also upright before him , and have kept myself from mine iniquity .
translation.kha: U tip ba ngam don jingpalat , ba nga la sumar ïa lade na kaba leh bakla .

translation.en: For by me thy days shall be multiplied , and the years of thy life shall be increased .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad kan nang pynjrong ïa ki snem ka jingim jong phi .

translation.en: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor ïa kaba la pynbna ha ka snem kaba u Syiem Ahas u la ïap .

translation.en: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning  ; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban pynsah ei ei haduh mynstep ; lada don kaba sah , dei ban thang noh ïa ka .

translation.en: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him , Master , behold , the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away .
translation.kha: U Petros u la kynmaw ïa kaei kaba la lah jia bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Khmih , ko Nonghikai , u dieng Dumbur uba me la tim u la ïap !

translation.en: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house . After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah , the keeper of the east gate .
translation.kha: U Sadok , u khun jong u Immer , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u . U Shemaïah , u khun jong u Shekanaïah , u nongpeit ïa ka Khyrdop Mihngi , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

translation.en: There came then his brethren and his mother , and , standing without , sent unto him , calling him .
translation.kha: Nangta ka kmie U Jisu bad ki para jong u ki la wan poi . Ki la ïeng shabar jong ka ïing bad ki phah khubor shapoh , ban kylli shaphang jong u .

translation.en: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab : and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart .
translation.kha: Na ka ïing u Abinadab ki wanrah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ki pynkit ïa ka ha ka kali kaba thymmai . U Ussah bad u Ahio ki sumar ïa kata ka kali ,

translation.en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses , so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony , to be kept .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses , u Aaron u buh ïa uta u khiew ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang ba yn ïoh sumar ïa u .

translation.en: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon , even all these words that are written against Babylon .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh ha ka kot ïa ka jingthoh shaphang ka jingpynjot baroh ka ban wan hap ha Babilonia , ryngkat bad kine baroh kiei kiei kiwei pat shaphang ka Babilonia .

translation.en: But he , willing to justify himself , said unto Jesus , And who is my neighbour ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u nonghikai ka Hukum u la kwah ban pynksan ïa lade , kumta u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Uei u paramarjan jong nga ?

translation.en: And afterward , saith the  Lord  , I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah , and his servants , and the people , and such as are left in this city from the pestilence , from the sword , and from the famine , into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of their enemies , and into the hand of those that seek their life : and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword  ; he shall not spare them , neither have pity , nor have mercy .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , ki rangbah synshar jong phi bad ki briew kiba lait im na ka thma , ka khlam bad ka  nemsniew — ngan ai ïa baroh na phi ban shahjop ha u syiem Nebukhadnessar bad da ki nongshun jong phi , kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa phi . U Nebukhadnessar un phah pynïap ïa phi . Un ym pynsah ïano ïano na phi lane un ym isynei lane sngewlem ïano ïano na phi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: In mine ears said the  Lord  of hosts , Of a truth many houses shall be desolate , even great and fair , without inhabitant .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Baroh kine ki ïing kiba heh bad kiba itynnat kin long kiba la pra bad thylli .

translation.en: The rich man shall lie down , but he shall not be gathered : he openeth his eyes , and he is not .
translation.kha: Tang shisien khatduh ïawai , kin thiah kum kiba riewspah , hynrei ynda ki kyndit na kaba ïohthiah , kin shem ba baroh ka spah jong ki kam don shuh .

translation.en: And there was no deliverer , because it was far from Zidon , and they had no business with any man  ; and it was in the valley that lieth by Beth–rehob . And they built a city , and dwelt therein .
translation.kha: Hadien , ki rangbah na Dan ki shim ïa u lyngdoh bad ïa kiei kiei kiba u Mikah u la thaw , ki leit ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Laish , kata ka shnong jong kiba shongsuk , ki briew kiba jar jar , kaba don ha kajuh ka them kum ka Bethrehob . Ki pynïap ïa ki nongshong shnong bad ki thang ïa ka shnong . Ym don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa ki , naba ka Laish ka don jngai na Sidon , bad ki ruh kim don jingïadei bad kiwei pat ki briew . Ki rangbah na Dan ki tei pat ïa ka shnong bad ki shongduh hangta .

translation.en: He smote the Philistines , even unto Gaza , and the borders thereof , from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city .
translation.kha: U jop ïa ki Philistia , bad u thombor ïa ki jaka sah jong ki , na ki shnong kiba rit tam haduh ki nongbah kiba heh tam , kaba kynthup ïa ka Gasa bad ki ri kiba marjan .

translation.en: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite , Rechab and Baanah , went , and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish–bosheth , who lay on a bed at noon .
translation.kha: U Rekhab bad u Baanah ki leit sha ka ïing u Ishbosheth bad ki poi hangta ha ka por shiteng sngi , katba u dang pynjahthait ïa lade ha ka por shiteng sngi .

translation.en: The disciple is not above his master : but every one that is perfect shall be as his master .
translation.kha: Ym don u shah hikai uba kham khraw ban ïa u nonghikai jong u ; hynrei uwei pa uwei u shah hikai , haba u la pyndep ïa ka jingshah hikai , un long kum u nonghikai jong u .

translation.en: Three bowls made like unto almonds , with a knop and a flower in one branch  ; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch , with a knop and a flower : so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick .
translation.kha: Lai tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew almond lem bad ki shylluit bad ki dop-syntiew    ba la oh-shrong itynnat ki dei ban don ha kawei kawei ka tnat .

translation.en: Also I set watchmen over you , saying , Hearken to the sound of the trumpet . But they said , We will not hearken .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  un thung ki rangbah nongap phira ban shahshkor ïa ka jingmaham jong ka turoi . Hynrei ki ong ,  Ngin ym shahshkor .

translation.en: Professing themselves to be wise , they became fools ,
translation.kha: Ki ong ba ki long kiba stad , hynrei ki long kiba bieit ;

translation.en: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender , which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan .
translation.kha: Ki masi kyrtong bad ki kada kiba lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi kin ïoh bam ïa u phlang bakynsai tam .

translation.en: And Hazor Hadattah , and Kerioth , and Hezron , which is Hazor ,
translation.kha: ka Hasor Hadattah , ka Kerioth Hesron ( lane ka Hasor ) ,

translation.en: And they shall say unto the elders of his city , This our son is stubborn and rebellious , he will not obey our voice  ; he is a glutton , and a drunkard .
translation.kha: bad kin ong ha ki , ‘ Une u khun jong ngi te uba da mutlop bad uba tamsneng , um kohnguh ïa kaba ngi ong , uba im lutphut bad dih buaid .’

translation.en: Her cities are a desolation , a dry land , and a wilderness , a land wherein no man dwelleth , neither doth any son of man pass thereby .
translation.kha: Ki shnong ki la long kiba ishyrkhei ban peit bad ki long kum ka ri shyiap bym don um , ha kaba ym don ba sah lane wat ban ïaid nangta .

translation.en: There were giants in the earth in those days  ; and also after that , when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men , and they bare children to them , the same became mighty men which were of old , men of renown .
translation.kha: Ha kito ki sngi , bad wat hadien kata ruh , la don ki ramhah ha ka pyrthei kiba long ki khun ki ksiew jong kita ki khun kynthei jong ki briew bad kita ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng . Ki la long ki riewshlur bakhraw bad ki briew kiba pawnam ha ki por mynbarim .

translation.en: I sleep , but my heart waketh : it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh , saying , Open to me , my sister , my love , my dove , my undefiled : for my head is filled with dew , and my locks with the drops of the night .
translation.kha: Ki bniat jong phi ki lieh kum ka langbrot ba dang shu dep ot shñiuh bad ba la shah pynsum . Ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba jah ; baroh ki long kiba ïaryntih bha .

translation.en: But if ye will not obey the voice of the  Lord  , but rebel against the commandment of the  Lord  , then shall the hand of the  Lord  be against you , as it was against your fathers .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim shahshkor ïa U  Trai  bad phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , un long pyrshah ïa phi bad ïa u syiem jong phi .

translation.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass , and took the five loaves , and the two fishes , and looking up to heaven , he blessed , and brake , and gave the loaves to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitude .
translation.kha: U la hukum ïa ki paidbah ban shong halor u phlang ; nangta u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu bad ïa ki ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei . U la kdiah ïa ki kpu bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synran , bad ki synran ki la ai ïa ki ha u paidbah .

translation.en: Speak , I pray you , in the ears of all the men of Shechem , Whether is better for you , either that all the sons of Jerubbaal , which are threescore and ten persons , reign over you , or that one reign over you ? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh .
translation.kha: ban kylli ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ,  Kano phi kham mon ? Ba baroh ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon kin synshar ïa phi ne tang da uwei u briew ? Kynmaw ba u Abimelekh u dei u para doh para snam jong phi .

translation.en: Little children , yet a little while I am with you . Ye shall seek me : and as I said unto the Jews , Whither I go , ye cannot come  ; so now I say to you .
translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , ngan ym don shuh bad phi slem nangne . Phin ïawad ïa nga ; hynrei nga ïathuh ïa phi mynta ïa kaei kaba ba nga la ïathuh ha ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw , ‘ Phim lah ban leit shano sha ba nga ngan leit .’

translation.en: Moreover they reckoned not with the men , into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen : for they dealt faithfully .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka kam ki long kiba da khuid hok , te kim donkam ban hap ai jingkheiñ ïa ka jingmih .

translation.en: It shall blossom abundantly , and rejoice even with joy and singing : the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it , the excellency of Carmel and Sharon , they shall see the glory of the  Lord  , and the excellency of our God .
translation.kha: Ka ri shyiap kan rwai bad pyrta da ka jingkmen ; kan long kaba itynnat kat ki lumbah ka Lebanon bad kaba seisoh kat ki pyntha ka Karmel bad Sharon . Baroh kin ïohi ïa ka jingitynnat U  Trai  , kin ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ïa ka bor jong u .

translation.en: Brethren , if a man be overtaken in a fault , ye which are spiritual , restore such an one in the spirit of meekness ; considering thyself , lest thou also be tempted .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , lada lap ïa uno uno ha kano kano ka jingpalat , kito na phi kiba kynja mynsiem ki dei ban pynbha pat ïa u ; hynrei phi dei ban leh ïa ka ha ka rukom ka jingjemnud . Bad da husiar bha ïa lade , khnang ba ma phi ruh phin ym shah pynshoi .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle , ( not of men , neither by man , but by Jesus Christ , and God the Father , who raised him from the dead ; )
translation.kha: Na u Paul , uba ka jingkhot ban long u Apostol kam shym la wan na u briew ne da ka rukom briew , hynrei na U Jisu Khrist bad U Blei uba U Kpa , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap .

translation.en: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus , and disputed against the Grecians : but they went about to slay him .
translation.kha: U la kren ruh bad u la ïatainia bad ki Jiw kiba kren Grik , hynrei ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And he said ,  I tell thee , Peter , the cock shall not crow this day , before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha me , ko Petros ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  u syiar un ym kyn-ih ha kane ka miet tad ynda me la ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .

translation.en: A man s heart deviseth his way : but the  Lord  directeth his steps .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban don la ki jingthmu , hynrei dei U Blei uba ïalam ïa ki jingpyntreikam jong phi .

translation.en: Let the wicked forsake his way , and the unrighteous man his thoughts : and let him return unto the  Lord  , and he will have mercy upon him  ; and to our God , for he will abundantly pardon .
translation.kha: To ai ba ki bymman kin iehnoh ïa la ka rukom im bad ban kylla ïa ka rukom pyrkhat . To ai ba kin phai sha U  Trai . U Blei jong ngi u long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba kloi ban map ei .

translation.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels , and the laver and his foot .
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan na ka bynta ka jingainguh thang lem bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh , bad ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go in unto Pharaoh , and tell him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of the Hebrews , Let my people go , that they may serve me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit sha u Pharaoh bad ïathuh ha u ba U Trai , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u ong , ‘ Pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga khnang ba ki lah ban mane ïa nga .

translation.en: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird .
translation.kha: Kam myntoi ban pynap jar haba ka sim ba me riam ka nang peit shin ;

translation.en: And they had in their inheritance Beer–sheba , or Sheba , and Moladah ,
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Beersheba , ka Sheba , ka Moladah ,

translation.en: The merchants of these things , which were made rich by her , shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment , weeping and wailing ,
translation.kha: Ki nongkhaïi , kiba la kylla riewspah na kaba ïakhaïi ha kata ka nongbah , kin ïeng sha jngai bah , namar ki sngewsheptieng ban ïoh bynta lem na ki jingshitom jong ka . Kin lynñiar bad ïambriew , bad ong ,

translation.en: Then the princes , the governors , and captains , the judges , the treasurers , the counsellors , the sheriffs , and all the rulers of the provinces , were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up  ; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up .
translation.kha: Haba kine ki rangbah synshar baroh ki la ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang bad ba ki la ïeng ha khmat jong ka durbriew ,

translation.en: But Peter took him up , saying , Stand up  ; I myself also am a man .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la pynïeng ïa u .  To ïeng ,  u la ong ,  nga hi nga long tang u briew .

translation.en: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor , and be sold unto thee  ; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant :
translation.kha: Lada u para Israel uba shong marjan bad phi u kylla duk kat haduh ba un da die mraw ïa lade ha phi , phim dei ban pyntrei ïa u kum ïa u mraw .

translation.en: Set your affection on things above , not on things on the earth .
translation.kha: To pynneh ïa ki jingmut jong phi ha kiei kiei kiba hangta , ym ha kiei kiei kiba hangne ha khyndew .

translation.en: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month , in the second year of Darius the king .
translation.kha: ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba hynriew ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jinglong Patsha u Darius .

translation.en: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters , it shall be determined in a lawful assembly .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada don ei ei shuh shuh kaba phi kwah , dei ban ïapynbeit ïa ka ha ka dorbar aiñ jong ki traishnong .

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Though Moses and Samuel stood before me , yet my mind could not be toward this people : cast them out of my sight , and let them go forth .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Wat lada u Moses bad u Samuel kin ïeng hangne ban ïasaid bad nga , ngan ym pyn-i jingisynei ei ei ïa kine ki briew . Pynlong ïa ki ban leit noh ; pynlong ïa ki ban phet noh na khmat jong nga .

translation.en: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer , and to the ministry of the word .
translation.kha: Ma ngi hi , te , ngin ai ïa ka por jong ngi baroh ha ka jingduwai bad ha ka kam ka jingïalap .

translation.en: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew , and the earth is stayed from her fruit .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw ym shym don slap bad ym shym mih ei ei .

translation.en: And we are his witnesses of these things  ; and so is also the Holy Ghost , whom God hath given to them that obey him .
translation.kha: Ngi long ki sakhi ïa kine kiei kiei — ma ngi bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba long ka jingai jong U Blei ha kita baroh kiba kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel , from Ekron even unto Gath  ; and the coasts thereof did Israel deliver out of the hands of the Philistines . And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah baroh ba ki Philistia ki la ïohknieh hapdeng ka Ekron bad ka Gath la pynphai pat sha ki Israel , bad kumta ki Israel ki la ïoh biang ïa ka ri jong ki baroh . Bad ka la don ruh ka jingshongsuk hapdeng ki Israel bad ki Kanaan .

translation.en: Then it shall be , if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation , that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord  , with his meat offering , and his drink offering , according to the manner , and one kid of the goats for a sin offering .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka jingbakla ka long namar ba ki paidbah kim tip , ki dei ban wanrah ïa u masi kum ka jingainguh thang , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , lem bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh dih . Nalor kita , ki dei ban wanrah ïa u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .

translation.en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father , and given them to me .
translation.kha: U Blei u la shim noh ïa ki kynhun jingri na i pa jong phi bad u la ai ïa ki ha nga .

translation.en: Behold , the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the  Lord s  thy God , the earth also , with all that therein is .
translation.kha: Wat ka bneng kaba jrong tam ka long ka jong U  Trai  ; ka khyndew ruh ka long ka jong u , bad kiei kiei ruh kiba don ha ka .

translation.en: Neither be ye called masters : for one is your Master , even Christ .
translation.kha: Lymne ba yn khot ïa phi ‘ u Nongïalam ,’ namar ba u nongïalam jong phi uba tang ma u hi u long u Messaïah .

translation.en: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name , he hath done evil to this people  ; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all .
translation.kha: Naduh ba nga la leit sha u Pharaoh ban ïakren na ka bynta jong me , u la lehbeiñ tyngeh ïa ki . Bad mem shym la leh ei ei ban ïarap ïa ki !

translation.en: But all these things will they do unto you for my name s sake , because they know not him that sent me .
translation.kha: Hynrei kin leh ïa kane baroh ïa phi namar ba phi long ki jong nga ; naba kim ithuh ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: Likewise , ye husbands , dwell with them according to knowledge , giving honour unto the wife , as unto the weaker vessel , and as being heirs together of the grace of life  ; that your prayers be not hindered .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom phi ki shynrang to da shong ryngkat bad la ki tnga da ka jingshemphang ba dei biang ba ki long kiba kham tlot ban ïa phi . To ñiewburom ïa ki , namar ki ruh kin ïohpdiang , lem bad phi , ka jingim kaba long ka jingai jong U Blei . To leh ïa kane ba kan ym don kano kano ka ban tuklar ïa ki jingduwai jong phi .

translation.en: If I speak of strength , lo , he is strong : and if of judgment , who shall set me a time to plead ?
translation.kha: Hato ngan pyrshang da ka bor ? Hato ngan pyrshang da ka bor ïa U Blei ? Hato ngan rah ïa u sha ïingbishar ? Don uba lah ban pynlong ïa u ban leit ?

translation.en: We have been with child , we have been in pain , we have as it were brought forth wind  ; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth  ; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen .
translation.kha: Ngi don ha ka jingpang bad ka jingkordit , hynrei ngim pynmih ei ei . Ngim shym la ïoh jingjop na ka bynta ka ri jong ngi ; ngim shym la ïoh jingjop ei ei .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  , It shall not stand , neither shall it come to pass .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga , U  Trai  , nga pynbna ba kane kan ym jia da lei lei .

translation.en: To the extent that each family member applies the Bible’s counsel , family life will benefit .
translation.kha: Kat ba lah u wei pa u wei u dkhot jong ka ïng ka sem u dei ban pyndonkam ia ki jinghikai jong ka Baibl , khnang ba ka longing longsem kan bit kan biang .

translation.en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn  ; because that the famine was so sore in all lands .
translation.kha: Ki briew na kylleng ka pyrthei ki la ïawan sha Ijipt ban thied kew na u Joseph , namar ka  nemsniew ka la ktah jur ha kylleng ki ri .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe unto the foolish prophets , that follow their own spirit , and have seen nothing !
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Kine ki nongïathuhlypa ba-bieit ki long kiba la tim ! Ki ai jaka ïa la ki jong ki jingpyrsad mynsiem bad ki thaw ïa la ki jong ki jingïohipaw .

translation.en: And he blessed Joseph , and said , God , before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk , the God which fed me all my life long unto this day ,
translation.kha: Nangta u kyrkhu ïa u Joseph u da ong ,  To U Blei uba ki kpa jong nga , U Abraham bad u Isaak , ki la shakri , Un kyrkhu ïa kine ki khun ! To U Blei uba la ïalam ïa nga haduh kane ka sngi , un kyrkhu ïa ki !

translation.en: And my master made me swear , saying , Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , in whose land I dwell :
translation.kha: U kynrad jong nga u la pynkular ïa nga da kaba smai ba ngan kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u . U la ong , ‘ Wat ym jied ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga na ki samla kynthei ha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: For he was wiser than all men  ; than Ethan the Ezrahite , and Heman , and Chalcol , and Darda , the sons of Mahol : and his fame was in all nations round about .
translation.kha: U long uba stad tam na ki rangbah baroh : kham stad ban ïa u Ethan u nong Esrah , bad ïa u Heman , u Kalkol , bad u Darda , ki khun jong u Mahol , bad ka nam jong u ka phriang kylleng ki ri kiba marjan baroh .

translation.en: And when he was gone out into the porch , another maid saw him , and said unto them that were there , This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth .
translation.kha: bad u la leit noh sha ka jaka rung shapoh ka phyllaw . Kawei pat ka shakri ka la ïohi ïa u bad ka la ong ha ki rangbah hangta ,  U la long lem bad U Jisu u nong Nasareth .

translation.en: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps , they blessed the  Lord  , and his people Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Hesekaïah bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïohi katno ba la ai , ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai  bad ki ïaroh ïa ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And when he shall stand up , his kingdom shall be broken , and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven  ; and not to his posterity , nor according to his dominion which he ruled : for his kingdom shall be plucked up , even for others beside those .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u la khlaiñbor bha , ka hima jong u kan pait bad yn phiah ha ki saw bynta . Ki syiem ki bym shym hiarpateng na u kin synshar ha ka jaka jong u , hynrei kin ym don ïa ka bor kaba u la don .

translation.en: Art thou greater than our father Jacob , which gave us the well , and drank thereof himself , and his children , and his cattle ?
translation.kha: Dei u Jakob , u kpa tymmen jong ngi uba la ai ïa ngi ïa kane ka pukri ; ma u bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki jingri jong u baroh ki la dih na ka . Hato me kam ba me long kham khraw ban ïa u Jakob ?
