translation.en: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side  ; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath–shiloh , and passed by it on the east to Janohah  ;
translation.kha: bad nangta sha ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Ka Mikhmethath ka don ha ka bynta bashatei jong ki . Shaphang mihngi jong kata , u pud u khun sha Taanath Shiloh bad u ïaid lyngba jong ka ha ka phang mihngi shaduh Janoah .

translation.en: And he said unto Moses , Come up unto the  Lord  , thou , and Aaron , Nadab , and Abihu , and seventy of the elders of Israel  ; and worship ye afar off .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Wan kiew sha nga shalor lum , ma me , u Aaron , u Nadab , u Abihu , lem bad hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ; bad katba phi dang ïadon kham ha pajih , dem bad mane ïa nga .

translation.en: Every wise woman buildeth her house : but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands .
translation.kha: Ïa ki rympei ïing la pynlong da ka jingstad jong ki kynthei , hynrei la pynjot da ka jingleh bieit .

translation.en: For I beheld , and there was no man  ; even among them , and there was no counsellor , that , when I asked of them , could answer a word .
translation.kha: Haba nga peit napdeng ki blei , ym don na ki uba don ei ei ban ong ; ym don uwei u ban jubab ïa ki jingkylli ba nga kylli .

translation.en: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi  ; and called them after his own name , Bashan–havoth–jair , unto this day .
translation.kha: U Jair , uba na ka jait Manasseh , u la kam kynti ïa ka thain Argob baroh kawei , kata ka mut ïa ka Bashan , haduh u pud jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah . U khot ïa kine ki shnong da ka kyrteng la jong , bad haduh mynta la dang tip ïa ki kum ki shnong u Jair . )

translation.en: For thou , O my God , hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house : therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee .
translation.kha: Nga don ka jingshlur ban duwai ïa kane ka jingduwai ha me , U Blei jong nga , namar me la pynpaw ïa kane ha nga , u shakri jong me , bad ba me la ong ïa nga ba men pynlong syiem ïa kiba hiarpateng na nga .

translation.en: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Mynsiem u la ai ha u Stephan ïa ka jingstad kum kane ba haba u la kren , kim shym lah ban pynrem ïa u .

translation.en: For if I make you sorry , who is he then that maketh me glad , but the same which is made sorry by me ?
translation.kha: Naba lada ka long ba nga pynsngewsih ïa phi , mano pat ban pyntngen ïa nga ? Lait tang da kita hi ïa kiba nga la pynsngewsih .

translation.en: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon , saying , What hast thou to do with me , that thou art come against me to fight in my land ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Jephthah u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u syiem Ammon ban ong ,  Me don daw aïu bad ngi ? Balei ba me wan hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi ?

translation.en: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea  ; and the  Lord  caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night , and made the sea dry land , and the waters were divided .
translation.kha: U Moses u kner ïa la ka kti halor ka duriaw , bad U  Trai  u kyndat ïa kata ka duriaw da ka lyer mihngi kaba jur . Kata ka lyer ka beh jur baroh shi miet bad ka pynlong dewryngkhiang ïa ka duriaw .

translation.en: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred .
translation.kha: Ïa ka kynhun shipai la ai hukum da ki ar hajar hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah pynïaidkam .

translation.en: And Moses answered and said , But , behold , they will not believe me , nor hearken unto my voice : for they will say , The  Lord  hath not appeared unto thee .
translation.kha: Te U Moses u jubab ïa U  Trai  ,  Hynrei tharai ki Israel kin ym ngeit ïa nga , bad kin ym shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Ngan leh kumno lada ki ong ba mem shym la paw ha nga ?

translation.en: Now therefore come , let me , I pray thee , give thee counsel , that thou mayest save thine own life , and the life of thy son Solomon .
translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ban pyllait im ïa la ka jingim bad ïa ka jingim u Solomon u khun jong phi , ngan ai jingmut ïa phi ban

translation.en: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me : now also will I give sentence against them .
translation.kha: ka lyer kaba wan ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  kan long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa kata ! U dei U  Trai  hi uba pynbna ïa ka jingbishar halor ki briew jong u .

translation.en: And ye shall keep my statutes , and do them : I am the  Lord  which sanctify you .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , namar nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang khuid ïa phi .

translation.en: And he said , Thy brother came with subtilty , and hath taken away thy blessing .
translation.kha: U Isaak u jubab ,  U para jong me u la wan bad shukor ïa nga . U la shim noh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong me .

translation.en: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things : but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves .
translation.kha: Kim shym la khmih bha ïa ki jinglehniam bakyntang ha ka Templ jong nga , hynrei pynban ki la buh da ki nongwei ban khmih .

translation.en: But if thou refuse to go forth , this is the word that the  Lord  hath shewed me :
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la pyn-i ha nga ha ka jingïohipaw ïa kaei ka ban jia lada phi kyntait ban pyndem .

translation.en: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Canaan , and great affliction : and our fathers found no sustenance .
translation.kha: Nangta ka la don ka  nemsniew ha baroh ka Ijipt bad ka Kanaan , kaba la pynshitom shikatdei eh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , As the new wine is found in the cluster , and one saith , Destroy it not  ; for a blessing is in it : so will I do for my servants  sakes , that I may not destroy them all .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ym ju don ba pynjot ïa ki sohwaiñ kiba bha ; pynban , ki shna waiñ na ki . Lymne ngan ym pynjot ruh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh — ngan ïada ïa kito kiba shakri ïa nga .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall smite thee in the knees , and in the legs , with a sore botch that cannot be healed , from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tap ïa ki kjat jong phi baroh da ki prum ki bym lah ban pynkhiah bad kiba tyrha ; ki tohjaw kin tap ïa phi naduh khlieh haduh kjat .

translation.en: And the man brought the men into Joseph s house , and gave them water , and they washed their feet  ; and he gave their asses provender .
translation.kha: Uta u shakri u ïalam ïa kita shi para shapoh ka ïing . U ai um ïa ki ba kin sait ïa la ki kjat , bad u ai bam ïa ki kada jong ki .

translation.en: For we are not as many , which corrupt the word of God : but as of sincerity , but as of God , in the sight of God speak we in Christ .
translation.kha: Ngim long kum kita kiba bun , kiba pynlong ïa ka khubor U Blei kum ka mar khaïi kaba tad dor ; hynrei namar ba U Blei u la phah ïa ngi , ngi kren da ka jingsngur ha khmat jong u , kum ki shakri U Khrist .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall make thee plenteous in goods , in the fruit of thy body , and in the fruit of thy cattle , and in the fruit of thy ground , in the land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers to give thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ai ha phi kyrhai ki khun ki kti , kyrhai ki masi , bad kyrhai ki soh ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ban ai ha phi .

translation.en: And the king said , Let him turn to his own house , and let him not see my face . So Absalom returned to his own house , and saw not the king s face .
translation.kha: Pynban u syiem u la ai hukum ba u Absalom um dei ban sah hapoh ïingsyiem .  Ngam kwah ban ïohi ïa u !  u syiem u ong . Kumta u Absalom u sah ha ka ïing jong u hi bad um shym leit mih ha khmat u syiem .

translation.en: Stay me with flagons , comfort me with apples : for I am sick of love .
translation.kha: Ko kynthei Jerusalem , nga long uba ïong hynrei uba bhabriew , ka jingïong kum ki ïingjaiñ ha ka ri shyiap Kedar , hynrei ka jingbhabriew kum ki pyrda ba la wah ha ka ïingsyiem jong u Solomon .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Write thou these words : for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Thoh ïa kine ki ktien , namar dei ha ka nongrim jong kine ki ktien ba nga pynlong ka jutang bad me bad ki Israel .

translation.en: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver , and his idols of gold , which they made each one for himself to worship , to the moles and to the bats  ;
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , kin bret sharud ïa ki bleithaw ksiar bad rupa ba ki la thaw , bad kin iehnoh ïa ki ha ki khnai tynjit bad ha ki lymbit .

translation.en: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the  Lord  than sacrifice .
translation.kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba beit ; kaba kham pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  ban ïa kaba wallam sha u ïa ki jingkñia .

translation.en: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ , let him be Anathema Maranatha .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym ieit ïa U Trai — to long ka jingtim ïa u ! Marana tha  — U Trai jong ngi , u wan !

translation.en: And when the man rose up to depart , he , and his concubine , and his servant , his father in law , the damsel s father , said unto him , Behold , now the day draweth toward evening , I pray you tarry all night : behold , the day groweth to an end , lodge here , that thine heart may be merry  ; and to morrow get you early on your way , that thou mayest go home .
translation.kha: Haba uta u briew , ka tnga kliar jong u , bad u shakri jong u sa shisien ki khreh ban leit noh , u kpa u ong ,  Khmih , ka sngi ka la jan sep ; kan bha ba phin sah sa shi miet . Kan sa dum shen ; sah hangne bad pynsngewbha ïa lade . Lashai phi lah ban khie dang step ban leit ha ka jingleit sha la ïing .

translation.en: And the man that lieth with his father s wife hath uncovered his father s nakedness : both of them shall surely be put to death  ; their blood shall be upon them .
translation.kha: U briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad kawei na ki tnga jong u kpa jong u , u pynjahburom ïa la u kpa ; ma u bad kata ka kynthei kin shah pynïap baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa .
translation.kha: Ym shym don thma shuh haduh ka snem kaba laiphew san jong ka jingsynshar jong u .

translation.en: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit , how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks , seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest ?
translation.kha: Haba phi ainguh ha U Blei tang ha ka mynsiem , da kumno u riewpaidbah uba shim bynta ha ka jingïaseng u lah ban ong  Amen  ha kata ka jingduwai ainguh jong phi ? Kim don lynti ban sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba phi kren .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as the angels were gone away from them into heaven , the shepherds said one to another , Let us now go even unto Bethlehem , and see this thing which is come to pass , which the Lord hath made known unto us .
translation.kha: Haba ki angel ki la leit noh pat na ki sha bneng , ki nongaplangbrot ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit sha Bethlehem bad ban ïohi ïa kane kaei kaei kaba la lah jia , kaba U Trai u la ïathuh ha ngi .

translation.en: Therefore say I unto you , The kingdom of God shall be taken from you , and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ,  U Jisu u la bynrap ,  ïa ka Hima U Blei yn shim noh na phi bad yn ai ha ki briew ki ban pynmih ki soh kiba dei .

translation.en: If ye then be risen with Christ , seek those things which are above , where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God .
translation.kha: Ïa phi la pynmihpat lem bad U Khrist , kumta pynbeit ïa ka dohnud jong phi ha kiei kiei kiba ha bneng , ha kaba U Khrist u shong ha la ka khet ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .

translation.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood , and sprinkle it seven times before the  Lord  , even before the veil .
translation.kha: un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha kata ka snam , bad un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha khmat ka jingkah jong ka Jaka Kyntang .

translation.en: And hereby we do know that we know him , if we keep his commandments .
translation.kha: Lada ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei , te ngi sngewskhem ba ngi ithuh ïa u .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani , who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoshaphat u la leh , naduh kaba sdang jong ka jingsynshar jong u haduh kaba kut , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori u Jehu u khun jong u Hanani  , kaba long shi bynta jong  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: Much every way : chiefly , because that unto them were committed the oracles of God .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , don shibun , ha kiba bun ki liang! Ha kaba nyngkong , U Blei u la aiti ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki Jiw .

translation.en: And I said , What is it ? And he said , This is an ephah that goeth forth . He said moreover , This is their resemblance through all the earth .
translation.kha: Ka dei kaei ?  Nga la kylli . U la jubab ,  Ka dei ka shang , bad ka ïeng na ka bynta ka pop jong ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: Was returning , and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet .
translation.kha: Kumta u Philip u la khreh bad u la leit . Mynta , u ïunukh na Ithiopia , uba dei u rangbah synshar ba ha khmat eh uba dei khmih ïa ka jaka kynshew jong ka syiem jong ka Ithiopia , u dang don ha ka lynti sha ïing . U la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane ïa U Blei bad ba u dang leit phai pat sha la ïing ha ka kali kulai jong u . Katba u dang leit phai , u la pule na ka kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth , and my right hand hath spanned the heavens : when I call unto them , they stand up together .
translation.kha: Ki ksang ti jong nga ki la buh ïa ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei bad kiba pyiar sha ki bneng . Haba nga phah khot ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa ka suiñbneng , ki wan kumne kumne bad aiti ïa lade .

translation.en: And will make an offering by fire unto the  Lord  , a burnt offering , or a sacrifice in performing a vow , or in a freewill offering , or in your solemn feasts , to make a sweet savour unto the  Lord  , of the herd , or of the flock :
translation.kha: Ïa u masi , u langbrot , ka langbrot lane ka blang lah ban wanrah ha U  Trai  kum ka jingainguh thang lane kum ka jingkñia ha kaba pyndep ïa ka jingsmai lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha lane kum ka jingainguh ha ki Jingkhawai Niam kiba man ka por ; ka jingiw jong kine ki jingainguh bam ka pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: For they all saw him , and were troubled . And immediately he talked with them , and saith unto them ,  Be of good cheer : it is I  ; be not afraid .
translation.kha: Ki la sheptieng haduh katta katta haba ki la ïohi ïa u . Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la kren ïa ki ,  Long shlur !  u la ong .  Dei ma nga . Wat sheptieng !

translation.en: Whereunto he called you by our gospel , to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: U Blei u la khot ïa phi sha kane lyngba ka Khubor Babha kaba ngi la ïalap ha phi ; u la khot ïa phi ban ïohkynti ïa la ka bynta jong ka burom jong U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: For I know this , that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you , not sparing the flock .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba hadien ba nga leit noh , ki suri barunar sat kin wan hapdeng jong phi , bad kin ym map ïa ka kynhun .

translation.en: But I say , Did not Israel know ? First Moses saith , I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people , and by a foolish nation I will anger you .
translation.kha: Ngan kylli biang : Hato ki paid Israel kim shym la sngewthuh ? U Moses hi u long uba nyngkong ban jubab :  Ngan pyndonkam ïa kata ka jaitbynriew ban pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga ban bishni ; bad da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jaitbynriew jong ki bieit ngan pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga ban bitar .

translation.en: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them : for the king s word was abominable to Joab .
translation.kha: Namar u Joab um pdiang ïa ka hukum jong u syiem , um shym la shim jingkheiñ ïa ki jait Lebi bad Benjamin .

translation.en: Again , the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain , and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world , and the glory of them  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u la ïalam ïa U Jisu sha u lumbah uba kynjang bad u la pyn-i ha U ïa baroh ki Hima jong ka pyrthei ha ka jingkhrawbor jong ki .

translation.en: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone , and smote the Philistine , and slew him  ; but there was no sword in the hand of David .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , khlem ka waitlam , u Dabid u jop bad u pynïap ïa u Goliath da ka jingshat maw bad da u maw !

translation.en: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna , which thy fathers knew not , that he might humble thee , and that he might prove thee , to do thee good at thy latter end  ;
translation.kha: Ha kata ka ri shyiap u la ai ha phi ïa ka manna ban bam , ka jingbam kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim ju ïoh mynno mynno . U la pyndem bad tynjuh ïa phi , khnang ba ha kaba kut un pynmanbha ïa phi da kiei kiei kiba bha .

translation.en: Hearken unto me , O Jacob and Israel , my called  ; I am he  ; I am the first , I also am the last .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor ïa nga , ko Israel , ka jaitbynriew kaba nga la khot ! Nga long U Blei , Uba nyngkong , Uba khatduh , tang ma nga hi U Blei !

translation.en: Let the heathen be wakened , and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat : for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki dei ban long kiba la kloi bad wan sha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Hangta ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan shong ban bishar ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ba don sawdong .

translation.en: And she said , Behold , thy sister in law is gone back unto her people , and unto her gods : return thou after thy sister in law .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Naomi ka ong ha ka ,  Ruth , ka para kynsi jong pha ka la leit phai sha la ki briew bad sha la u blei . Khie leit phai sha ïing bad ka .

translation.en: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul  ;
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ka Jabesh kiba ha Gilead ki ïohsngew aïu ki Philistia ki la leh ïa u Saul ,

translation.en: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha , Behold now , the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ha kaba u Elisha u dei peit ïa ki , ki ud ha u ,  Ka jaka ha kaba ngi shong ka long kaba rit than eh !

translation.en: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light , and kings to the brightness of thy rising .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin wan bud ïa ka jingshai jong pha , bad ki syiem sha ka jingshai jong ka step phyrngab jong pha .

translation.en: And seekest thou great things for thyself ? seek them not : for , behold , I will bring evil upon all flesh , saith the  Lord  : but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest .
translation.kha: Hato me khmih lynti ïa ka jingleh bakyrpang na ka bynta ïa lade ? Wat leh ïa kata . Nga wallam ïa ka jingjot ha u khunbynriew baroh , hynrei men pyllait ïa ka jingim kat shaba me leit . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And Balaam lifted up his eyes , and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes  ; and the spirit of God came upon him .
translation.kha: bad u ïohi ïa ki paid Israel ba ki sher dara shi jait shi jait . U mynsiem U Blei u wan rung ha u ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  gave them rest round about , according to all that he sware unto their fathers : and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them  ; the  Lord  delivered all their enemies into their hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha ki ka jingshongsuk ha kata ka ri baroh kawei , kumba u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ym don uwei ruh na ki nongshun jong ki baroh uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki , namar U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop ïa ki nongshun jong ki baroh .

translation.en: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens , and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains  ;
translation.kha: U Solomon u don ruh phraphew hajar ngut ki nongshtah maw ha ri lum , bad hynñiewphew hajar ngut ki nongkit maw ,

translation.en: And Jesus took the loaves  ; and when he had given thanks , he distributed to the disciples , and the disciples to them that were set down  ; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shim ïa u kpu , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , bad u la sam ïa ki ha ki briew kiba la ïashong hangta . U la leh kumjuh ruh ïa ki dohkha , bad baroh ki la ïabam kat kaba ki kwah .

translation.en: But the men put forth their hand , and pulled Lot into the house to them , and shut to the door .
translation.kha: Hynrei kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba don hapoh ki la mih shabar , ki la ring ïa u Lot shapoh ïing , bad ki khang ïa ka jingkhang .

translation.en: Which when the brethren knew , they brought him down to Caesarea , and sent him forth to Tarsus .
translation.kha: Haba ki parabangeit ki la tip shaphang kata , ki la ïalam ïa u Saul sha Kaisaria bad ki la phah noh ïa u sha Tarsos .

translation.en: And he said , What cities are these which thou hast given me , my brother ? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day .
translation.kha: Kumta u ong ha u Solomon ,  Ko para , kine seh ki shnong ba phi la ai ïa nga !  Na kane ka daw ïa kane ka jaka la dang khot ka Kabul .

translation.en: Then said I , Ah Lord  God  ! they say of me , Doth he not speak parables ?
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la pyrshah ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , wat pynlong ïa nga ban leh ïa kata ! Uwei uwei baroh u la lah khñium ba nga ju kren borabor ha ki jingkyntip .

translation.en: If you harmonize your life with the standards set out in the Bible , God will give you everlasting life .—Romans 6 :23 .
translation.kha: Lada phi pyniahap ka jingim jong phi katkum ka kyrdan ba buh ha ka Baibl , u Blei un ai ïa phi ka jingimbymjukut . —Rom 6 :23 .

translation.en: How then can man be justified with God ? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman ?
translation.kha: Hato don mano mano uba lah ban long uba hok bad uba khuid ha khmat U Blei ?

translation.en: For he must reign , till he hath put all enemies under his feet .
translation.kha: Naba U dei ban synshar haduh ba Un da pyndem ïa ki nongshun baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: For nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom : and there shall be famines , and pestilences , and earthquakes , in divers places .
translation.kha: Ki ri kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , ki hima kin tur ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat . Kin don ki  nemsniew bad ki jingkhynñiuh jumai ha kylleng .

translation.en: That he might present it to himself a glorious church , not having spot , or wrinkle , or any such thing ; but that it should be holy and without blemish .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynkyntang ïa ka balang sha U Blei da ka ktien jong u , hadien ba la pynkhuid ïa ka da kaba sait ïa ka ha ka um , khnang ban aiti ïa ka balang sha lade hi , ha ka jingitynnat jong ka baroh — kaba khuid bad khlem shah kynnoh pop , khlem ka jingthohbria ne ka jingsti ne kano kano ka jingbymjanai .

translation.en: Even as I please all men in all things , not seeking mine own profit , but the profit of many , that they may be saved .
translation.kha: To leh kumba leh ma nga ; nga pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa baroh ha kiei kiei baroh kiba nga leh , khlem da pyrkhat ïa ka jingbha jong nga hi , hynrei ïa ka jingbha jong kiba bun , khnang ba yn pynim ïa ki .

translation.en: And thou , my lord , O king , the eyes of all Israel are upon thee , that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him .
translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad , baroh ki paid Israel ki khmih sha phi ban ïathuh ha ki uei u ban long syiem hadien jong phi .

translation.en: Moreover whom he did predestinate , them he also called : and whom he called , them he also justified : and whom he justified , them he also glorified .
translation.kha: Bad kumta kito ïa kiba U Blei u la pynkyrpang , u la khot ; bad ïa kito kiba u la khot , u la pynlong ka hok ïa ki bad u hi , bad u ai bynta ïa ki ha ka burom jong u .

translation.en: And she bare him a son , and he called his name Gershom : for he said , I have been a stranger in a strange land .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha lade ,  nga long u sohshnong ha kane ka ri , bad kumta nga kyrteng ïa u , u Gershom .

translation.en: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning , that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope .
translation.kha: Ïa kiei kiei ba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , la thoh ban hikai ïa ngi , khnang ba ngin don ïa ka jingkyrmen lyngba ka jingïaishah bad ka jingpynshlur kiba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ai ïa ngi .

translation.en: The length of a board was ten cubits , and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka jingker ka long saw mitar ka jingjrong bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang ,

translation.en: Take the choice of the flock , and burn also the bones under it , and make it boil well , and let them seethe the bones of it therein .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ka doh na ka langbrot bakynsai tam ; kynton ïa ka dieng na tbian u khiew . To ai ba yn shet ïa ka um ; shet ïa ki shyieng bad ïa ka doh .

translation.en: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling , and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second .
translation.kha: Buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud eh jong kata ka jaiñ jingtap kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli ha rmiang jong ka jaiñ jingtap kaba ar .

translation.en: And Joshua did unto them as the  Lord  bade him : he houghed their horses , and burnt their chariots with fire .
translation.kha: U Joshua u leh ïa ki kumba U  Trai  u la hukum : u pyndkoh ïa ki kulai jong ki bad u thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .

translation.en: Then I will set my face against that man , and against his family , and will cut him off , and all that go a whoring after him , to commit whoredom with Molech , from among their people .
translation.kha: nga hi ngan phai pyrshah ïa uta u briew bad ïa ka ïing jong u baroh bad ïa kito baroh kiba ïadon kti bad u ha kaba leh lyndet ïa nga bad ha kaba mane ïa u Molekh . Ngan ym ñiew shuh ïa ki ba ki dei ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And I will set my face against that man , and will cut him off from among his people  ; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech , to defile my sanctuary , and to profane my holy name .
translation.kha: Nga hi ngan phai pyrshah ïa uta u briew bad ngan ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga , namar u la ai ïa uwei na ki khun jong u ha u Molekh , bad kumta u pynbyrsieh ïa ka jaka kyntang jong nga bad u pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong nga .

translation.en: A fool s lips enter into contention , and his mouth calleth for strokes .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno uba bieit u sdang ïa ka jingïania , u pan kwah ïa ka jingshah sympat .

translation.en: And when he is come , he will reprove the world of sin , and of righteousness , and of judgment :
translation.kha: Bad haba un wan , un pynshisha ïa briew jong ka pyrthei ba ki bakla shaphang ka pop bad shaphang kaei kaba dei bad shaphang ka jingbishar jong U Blei .

translation.en: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man , then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak , saying ,
translation.kha: Te mynta , lada me pynïap lut ïa ki briew jong me baroh , ki jaitbynriew kiba la tip ïa ka nam jong me kin ïa-ong

translation.en: Nevertheless , brethren , I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort , as putting you in mind , because of the grace that is given to me of God ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kane ka shithi nga la kren kham shlur shaphang katto katne ki phang kiba nga la pynkynmaw ïa phi . Nga la shlur namar ka kabu ba U Blei u la ai ïa nga ban long u shakri jong U Khrist Jisu ban trei na ka bynta ki Jentil .

translation.en: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day , and I will forsake them , and I will hide my face from them , and they shall be devoured , and many evils and troubles shall befall them  ; so that they will say in that day , Are not these evils come upon us , because our God is not among us ?
translation.kha: Te ngan bitar lep ïa ki ; ngan kyntait bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki . Shibun ki jingjynjar kiba sngewshyrkhei kin wan ngat ha ki , ba kumta kin sa sngewthuh ba kita kiei kiei ki wan jia ha ki namar ba nga , U Blei jong ki , ngan ym don ryngkat shuh bad ki .

translation.en: Hast thou with him spread out the sky , which is strong , and as a molten looking glass ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban ïarap ïa U Blei ban pynpyiar ïa ka sahit bneng bad pynlong ïa ka kaba eh kum ka nar ba la pynphyrnai ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when I was come again to Jerusalem , even while I prayed in the temple , I was in a trance  ;
translation.kha: Nga la leit phai sha Jerusalem , bad katba nga dang duwai ha ka Templ , nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ,

translation.en: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea : but Silas and Timothy abode there still .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , ki parabangeit ki la phah noh ïa u Paul sha ka rud duriaw ; hynrei u Silas bad u Timothi ki la sah ha Beria .

translation.en: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt , in the country of Goshen  ; and they had possessions therein , and grew , and multiplied exceedingly .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki shong ki sah ha ri Ijipt ha thain Goshen , ha kaba ki ïoh ban lum ka spah ka phew , bad ki nang ïaroi parum pareh .

translation.en: But they that have gathered it shall eat it , and praise the  Lord   ; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi kiba bet bad ot ïa u kew , phin bam ïa u kpu bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , bad phi kiba sumar bad lum ïa ki sohwaiñ phin dih ïa ka waiñ ha ki phyllaw ka Templ jong nga .

translation.en: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the  Lord  , and Satan came also among them to present himself before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba la poi ka sngi ha kaba ki jingthaw ba-im ha bneng ki wanpaw biang ha khmat U  Trai  , u Soitan u la don lang hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger , and did eat no meat the second day of the month : for he was grieved for David , because his father had done him shame .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ïeng noh na kata ka miej ha ka jingbitar bad um shym bam ei ei ha kata ka sngi — ka sngi kaba ar jong ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai . U da khuslai sat shaphang u Dabid , namar u Saul u la pynjahburom ïa u .

translation.en: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands , and upon the smooth of his neck :
translation.kha: Ka buh ïa ki snieh jong kita ki blang ha ki kti bad ha ki bynta bym don shñiuh ha ka ryndang jong u .

translation.en: And they shall take of the blood , and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses , wherein they shall eat it .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki dei ban shim khyndiat na ka snam bad tah ïa ka ha ki shawkad bad ha khlieh jingkhang jong kita ki ïing ha kiba kin ïabam ïa kita ki mrad .

translation.en: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation , and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you  ; no manner of work shall be done in them , save that which every man must eat , that only may be done of you .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong bad kumjuh ruh ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , phi dei ban ïakynduh lang ban mane Blei . Phim bit ban trei ei ei ha kita ki sngi , hynrei phi lah ban pynkhreh jingbam .

translation.en: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble , and the strong men shall bow themselves , and the grinders cease because they are few , and those that look out of the windows be darkened ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki kti jong phi , kiba la ïada ïa phi , kin khynñiuh , bad ki kjat jong phi , kiba khlaiñ mynta , kin sdang tlot . Ki bniat jong phi kin long tang khyndiat eh ban ktha ïa ka jingbam jong phi , bad ki khmat jong phi ki byr-ïe shaba palat ban ïohi shai kdar .

translation.en: And I knew him not : but that he should be made manifest to Israel , therefore am I come baptizing with water .
translation.kha: Ngam pat shym la tip u dei uno , hynrei nga la wan ïa ka ban pynbaptis da ka um , khnang ba yn ïoh pynithuh ïa u ha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob , These daughters are my daughters , and these children are my children , and these cattle are my cattle , and all that thou seest is mine : and what can I do this day unto these my daughters , or unto their children which they have born ?
translation.kha: U Laban u jubab ïa u Jakob ,  Kine ki kynthei ki dei ki khun jong nga ; ki khun jong ki , ki dei ki jong nga , bad kine ki kynhun jingri ki dei ki jong nga . Ha ka jingshisha , kaei kaei baroh kat kaba me ïohi hangne ki dei ki jong nga .

translation.en: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews , that rode on threescore and ten ass colts : and he judged Israel eight years .
translation.kha: U don sawphew ngut ki shynrang bad laiphew ngut ki ksiew shynrang , bad baroh hynñiewphew ngut ki don la ki jong ki kada . U Abdon u ïalam ïa ki Israel phra snem ,

translation.en: The simple believeth every word : but the prudent man looketh well to his going .
translation.kha: Uba bieit un ngeit ïa kaei kaei baroh ; ki briew kiba sian ki da khmih ïa la ka jingjam .

translation.en: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah  ; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land .
translation.kha: Nga la leit ban sah bad u Gedalaïah ha Mispah bad shong hapdeng ki briew ïa kiba la iehnoh ha ka ri .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables , and said ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u pyndonkam biang ïa ki pharshi ha kaba kren ïa ki briew .

translation.en: And brought his head in a charger , and gave it to the damsel : and the damsel gave it to her mother .
translation.kha: nangta u la wallam ïa ka ha ka pliang bad ai ha ka khynnah , kaba la ai ïa ka ha la ka kmie .

translation.en: By humility and the fear of the  Lord  are riches , and honour , and life .
translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , da kaba pynrit , bad phin ïoh ïa ka spah , ka burom , bad ka jingim kaba jlan .

translation.en: While he answered for himself , Neither against the law of the Jews , neither against the temple , nor yet against Caesar , have I offended any thing at all .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ïasaid da ïa lade :  Ngam shym leh ei ei kano kano kaba bakla pyrshah ïa ka Hukum ki Jiw , lane pyrshah ïa ka Templ , lane pyrshah ïa u Patsha ka Hima Rom .

translation.en: Therefore , brethren , we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith :
translation.kha: Kumta , ha ki jingjynjar bad jingshahshitom jong ngi baroh , la pynshlur ïa ngi da ma phi , ko parabangeit . Ka dei ka jingngeit jong phi kaba la pynshlur ïa ngi ,

translation.en: So these nations feared the  Lord  , and served their graven images , both their children , and their children s children : as did their fathers , so do they unto this day .
translation.kha: Kumta kito ki briew ki la mane ïa U  Trai  , hynrei ki mane ruh ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ; bad haduh kane ka sngi kiba hiarpateng na ki , ki ïai leh kumjuh .

translation.en: And as John fulfilled his course , he said , Whom think ye that I am ? I am not he . But , behold , there cometh one after me , whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose .
translation.kha: Bad haba u Ïoannis u la jan pyndep ïa la ka jingtrei , u la ong ha u paidbah , ‘ Phi tharai ba nga dei uei ? Ngam long uta uba phi ïa-ap khmih . Hynrei to shahshkor ! U da wan hadien jong nga , bad ngam long uba bit ban loit ïa ki juti jong u na ki kjat jong u .’

translation.en: So David dwelt in the fort , and called it the city of David . And David built round about from Millo and inward .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïohknieh ïa ka kut , u Dabid u la shong hapoh jong ka bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ka  Ka Nongbah u Dabid .  U la tei ïa ka nongbah sawdong jong ka , da kaba sdang na ka jaka ha kaba la pyndap khyndew ha ka phang mihngi jong u lum .

translation.en: But speaking the truth in love , may grow up into him in all things , which is the head , even Christ :
translation.kha: Pynban , da kaba kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ka mynsiem ka jingieit , ngi dei ban san ha ki rukom baroh ha U Khrist uba long u khlieh .

translation.en: Which was the son of Mathusala , which was the son of Enoch , which was the son of Jared , which was the son of Maleleel , which was the son of Cainan ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Methuselah , u khun jong u Enokh , u khun jong u Jared , u khun jong u Mahalaleel , u khun jong u Kenan ,

translation.en: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki nong Ijipt kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Gad , David s seer , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Gad , u nongïathuhlypa jong u Dabid ,

translation.en: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives , and in their death they were not divided : they were swifter than eagles , they were stronger than lions .
translation.kha: U Saul bad u Jonathan , ki long kiba phylla bad ba sngewieit ; Ryngkat ryngkat ha ka jingim , bad ryngkat ryngkat ha ka jingïap ; ki kham stet ban ïa ki pukni , ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki sing .

translation.en: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness  ; but the battle overtook them  ; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them .
translation.kha: Ki phet noh na ki Israel sha khmat ka jaka kynjah , hynrei kim lah shuh ban lait im . Ki la sahkut hapdeng ki shipai ba ha khmat bad ki nongïapom kiba wan mih na kata ka nongbah , bad ki la shah pynjot .

translation.en: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people , even for salvation with thine anointed  ; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked , by discovering the foundation unto the neck . Selah .
translation.kha: Me mihnoh ban pyllait ïa la ki briew , ban pyllait ïa u syiem ba la jied jong me . Me pynkyllon ïa u nongïalam jong ki bymman bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki nongbud jong u .

translation.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose , that ye might know our affairs , and that he might comfort your hearts .
translation.kha: Dei namar kata keiñ balei ba nga phah ïa u sha phi — ban ïathuh ha phi kumno baroh ngi long , bad ban pynshlur ïa phi .

translation.en: And on the morrow , when they were come from Bethany , he was hungry :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , katba ki dang wan phai pat na Bethania , U Jisu u la sngew thngan .

translation.en: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man , whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal , and it be hid from him  ; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u kum ktah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid kaba mih na u briew , la ka long kaba kumno kumno , u long uba la rem hi mar ïasngewthuh ïa kaei ba u la leh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake suddenly unto Moses , and unto Aaron , and unto Miriam , Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation . And they three came out .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka Miriam ,  Nga kwah ïa phi baroh lai ngut ban wan sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga .

translation.en: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem : and he fled to Lachish  ; but they sent after him to Lachish , and slew him there .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingïasylla ha Jerusalem ban pynïap ïa u Amasaïah , kumta u phet sha ka nongbah Lakhish , hynrei ki nongshun jong u ki bud ïa u shata bad pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And there was war again : and David went out , and fought with the Philistines , and slew them with a great slaughter  ; and they fled from him .
translation.kha: Ka thma bad ki Philistia ka la khie biang . U Dabid u leit ïaleh ïa ki bad u jop thiaw ïa ki kat haduh ba ki phet noh .

translation.en: The diseased have ye not strengthened , neither have ye healed that which was sick , neither have ye bound up that which was broken , neither have ye brought again that which was driven away , neither have ye sought that which was lost  ; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them .
translation.kha: Phim shym la sumar bha ïa kita kiba swai , pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang , phim shym la sop spaiñ ïa kito kiba mynsaw , wallam pat ïa kito kiba la sakma , ne wad ïa kito kiba la jah noh . Pynban phi la lehbeiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: Arise , and go down to the potter s house , and there I will cause thee to hear my words .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka ïing jong u nongthaw khiew , ha kaba ngan ai ha me ka khubor jong nga .

translation.en: Then opened he their understanding , that they might understand the scriptures ,
translation.kha: Nangta u la plie ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki ban shemphang ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , bad u la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: Add thou not unto his words , lest he reprove thee , and thou be found a liar .
translation.kha: Lada phi kam ba u ong ei ei ïa kaba um shym la ong , un sneng tyngeh ïa phi , bad yn pynpaw ba phi dei uba lamler .

translation.en: The multitude of camels shall cover thee , the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah  ; all they from Sheba shall come : they shall bring gold and incense  ; and they shall shew forth the praises of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki kynhun bah ki ut kin wan , na Midian bad na Ephah . Kin wan na Sheba , kin wanrah ïa ka ksiar bad ka jingiwbih . Ki briew kin ïathuh ïa ka khubor kaba bha ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh !

translation.en: And they stoned Stephen , calling upon God , and saying , Lord Jesus , receive my spirit .
translation.kha: Ki la ïai lynthem maw ïa u Stephan katba u dang khot kyrpad ïa U Trai ,  A Trai Jisu , to pdiang ïa ka mynsiem jong nga !

translation.en: And his mother s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words : and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech  ; for they said , He is our brother .
translation.kha: Ki ba-ha-ïing jong ka kmie jong u ki ïakren ïa kane ha ki rangbah ka Shekhem na ka bynta jong u , bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki la kut jingmut ban bud ïa u Abimelekh namar u dei uba ha ïing jong ki .

translation.en: But he , beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace , declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison . And he said , Go shew these things unto James , and to the brethren . And he departed , and went into another place .
translation.kha: U la ai dak ïa ki da ka kti jong u ba kin sngap jar , bad u la batai ha ki kumno U Trai u la ïalam ïa u shabar ka byndi .  Ïathuh ïa kane ha u Jakob bad ha kiwei pat ki parabangeit ,  u la ong ; nangta u la mihnoh bad u la leit shawei pat .

translation.en: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw , and there came water thereout  ; and when he had drunk , his spirit came again , and he revived : wherefore he called the name thereof En–hakkore , which is in Lehi unto this day .
translation.kha: Kumta U Blei u pynpdang ïa ka khyndew hangta ha Lehi , bad ka mih ka um na ka . U Samson u dih ïa ka bad u sdang ban kham ïohbor . Kumta ïa kata ka umpohliew la khot Hakkore ; ka dang don hi hangta ha Lehi .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa kane ! Uno uno u bym pdiang ïa ka Hima U Blei kum u khynnah un ym rung shapoh jong ka da lei lei ruh .

translation.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying , he brought Jesus forth , and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement , but in the Hebrew , Gabbatha .
translation.kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien , u la ïalam shabar ïa U Jisu bad u la shong halor ka khet u nongbishar ha ka jaka ba la khot  Kaba la Siang Maw .  ( Ha ka ktien Hebru ka kyrteng ka long  Gabbatha .  )

translation.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths , and reverence my sanctuary : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa ka Sabbaton , bad burom ïa ka jaka ha kaba ïa nga la mane . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: All these the sons of Jediael , by the heads of their fathers , mighty men of valour , were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers , fit to go out for war and battle .
translation.kha: Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing ha ka kur bad ki dei baroh ki shipai bapawnam . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki kynthup khathynñiew hajar arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .

translation.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks , and lookest narrowly unto all my paths  ; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet .
translation.kha: Me khum da ki kynjri ïa ki kjat jong nga ; me khmih ïa ki jingjam ba nga shim , bad wat ban peit-thuh ïa ki dien jat jong nga .

translation.en: And let them judge the people at all seasons : and it shall be , that every great matter they shall bring unto thee , but every small matter they shall judge : so shall it be easier for thyself , and they shall bear the burden with thee .
translation.kha: Ai kin shakri kum ki nongbishar ha ki por baroh . Ki lah ban wallam sha phi ïa baroh ki kam kiba eh ; hynrei ki hi ki lah ban rai ïa ki jingïakajia kiba rit . Kata kan pynsuk shibun ïa phi , namar kin ïakit lang ïa ka jingkit jong phi .

translation.en: Therefore loosing from Troas , we came with a straight course to Samothracia , and the next day to Neapolis  ;
translation.kha: Ngi la mihnoh da ka lieng na Troas bad ngi la leit beit sha shiliang sha Samothraki , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud sha Neapolis .

translation.en: Favour is deceitful , and beauty is vain : but a woman that feareth the  Lord  , she shall be praised .
translation.kha: Ka jingbhabriew ka long ka jingshukor bad ka jingitynnat ka jah noh , hynrei ka kynthei kaba tiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka dei ban ïoh ïaroh .

translation.en: The fool foldeth his hands together , and eateth his own flesh .
translation.kha: Ki ong ba ngin long ki bieit ban kli ïa ki kti jong ngi bad ai ïa lade ban shahjingit haduh ban ïap .

translation.en: How he went into the house of God , and did take and eat the shewbread , and gave also to them that were with him  ; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone ?
translation.kha: U la leit shapoh ka ïing U Blei , u la shim ïa u kpu ba la ai sha U Blei , u la bam ïa u , bad u la ai ruh ha ki rangbah jong u . Shisha ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ïa uno uno lait noh tang u lyngdoh ban bam ïa uta u kpu .

translation.en: But if ye will not do so , behold , ye have sinned against the  Lord  : and be sure your sin will find you out .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim bat ïa la ka kular , nga maham ïa phi ba phi leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Wat bakla ïa kane ; phin shah pynshitom namar ka pop jong phi .

translation.en: And the sun stood still , and the moon stayed , until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies . Is not this written in the book of Jasher ? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven , and hasted not to go down about a whole day .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la ïeng thik bad u bnai um shym khih tad haduh ba ka jaitbynriew ka la jop thiaw ïa ki nongshun jong ka . Ïa kane la thoh ha ka  Kitab u Jashar . Ka sngi ka la sangeh hapdeng ka sahit bneng bad kam shym la sep ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour , which is Christ the Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi ha ka shnong u Dabid la kha ïa U Nongpynim jong phi — U Khrist U Trai !

translation.en: But he that lacketh these things is blind , and cannot see afar off , and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno u bym don ïa kine , u long u bym ïohi jngai ba um lah ban ïohi bad u la klet ba ïa u la pynkhuid na ki pop jong u kiba mynshuwa .

translation.en: Who hath prevented me , that I should repay him ? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine .
translation.kha: Uei uba lah ban tur ïaleh ïa u , bad u ban dang lait im ? Ym don mano mano ha ka pyrthei baroh uba lah ban leh ïa kata .

translation.en: These are the sons of Rachel , which were born to Jacob : all the souls were fourteen .
translation.kha: Kine khatsaw ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Rakhel .

translation.en: Saying , This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Kane ka long ka snam kaba la shonshab ïa ka jutang ba U Blei u la hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh .

translation.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt : and thou shalt observe and do these statutes .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba phi dei ban kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum ; wat klet ruh ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt .

translation.en: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing . My brethren , these things ought not so to be .
translation.kha: Ki kyntien jong ka jingsngewnguh bad ka jingtim ki mihnoh na kajuh ka shyntur . Ko parabangeit jong nga , kane kam dei ban jia .

translation.en: He is a leprous man , he is unclean : the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean  ; his plague is in his head .
translation.kha: u lyngdoh un rai ïa u ba u long u bymkhuid , namar ba ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka la don ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: And the name of the star is called Wormwood : and the third part of the waters became wormwood  ; and many men died of the waters , because they were made bitter .
translation.kha: ( Ka kyrteng uta u khlur ka long  Ka Jingkthang .  ) Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka um ka la kylla kthang , bad bun ki briew ki la ïap na kaba dih ïa kane ka um , namar ka la kylla kthang .

translation.en: And were beyond measure astonished , saying , He hath done all things well : he maketh both the deaf to hear , and the dumb to speak .
translation.kha: Bad baroh kiba la ïohsngew ki la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei eh .  Kumno u lah ban leh ïa kiei kiei baroh !  ki la ïa-pyrta .  U lah wat ban pynlong ïa uba kyllut ban ïohsngew bad ïa u bymnang kren ban kren !

translation.en: And they told the king , saying , Behold Nathan the prophet . And when he was come in before the king , he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u syiem ba U Nathan u nongïathuhlypa u don hangta , bad u Nathan u rung shapoh bad u dem ngon ha khmat u syiem .

translation.en: Theocratic education has long been a hallmark of Jehovah’s Witnesses .
translation.kha: Ka jinghikai bakynja Blei ka long ka dak ba la slem bha jong ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah .

translation.en: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up , and fell upon him , and slew him : and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Kumta u Benaïah u la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u la pynïap ïa u Joab , bad la tep ïa u ha ka ïing jong u kaba ha rudnong .

translation.en: That she called unto the men of her house , and spake unto them , saying , See , he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us  ; he came in unto me to lie with me , and I cried with a loud voice :
translation.kha: ka la khot ïa ki shakri ïing jong ka bad ka ong ha ki ,  Peit kaei kane ! Une u Hebru uba u tnga jong nga u la wan ïalam ha ïing u la pynjahburom ïa ngi . U la wan rung shapoh ka kamra jong nga bad u la pyrshang ban batbor ïa nga , hynrei nga la lynñiar kat lah kat ïai .

translation.en: And as Peter was beneath in the palace , there cometh one of the maids of the high priest :
translation.kha: U Petros u dang don shapoh ha ka phyllaw haba kawei na ki khynnah shakri jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh ka la ïaid nangta .

translation.en: And when the seven days were almost ended , the Jews which were of Asia , when they saw him in the temple , stirred up all the people , and laid hands on him ,
translation.kha: Hynrei hamar ba ki hynñiew sngi kin sa kut , katto katne ngut ki Jiw na ka probins    jong ka Asia ki la ïohi ïa u Paul ha ka Templ . Ki la pynkhih ïa u paidbah baroh bad ki la kem ïa u Paul .

translation.en: And Jacob did so , and fulfilled her week : and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la mynjur , bad haba ka taïew ka jinglehkmen shongkurim ka la kut , u Laban u la ai ha u ïa ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ba kan long ka tnga jong u .

translation.en: He looketh on the earth , and it trembleth : he toucheth the hills , and they smoke .
translation.kha: U khmih ha ka pyrthei , bad ka khynñiuh ; u ktah ïa ki lumbah , bad ki pynmih ïa ka tdem .

translation.en: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts : so shall I talk of thy wondrous works .
translation.kha: Ïarap ïa nga ban shemphang ïa ki aiñ jong me , bad ngan puson halor ki jinghikai kiba phylla jong me .

translation.en: So the workmen wrought , and the work was perfected by them , and they set the house of God in his state , and strengthened it .
translation.kha: Baroh na ki , ki trei shitom , bad ki pynwandur biang ïa ka Templ kumba ka ju long mynshuwa kaba ïeng skhem .

translation.en: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master , that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets , and the blood of all the servants of the  Lord  , at the hand of Jezebel .
translation.kha: Me dei ban pynïap ïa u syiem uba long u kynrad jong me , uto keiñ u khun jong u Ahab khnang ba ngan ïoh pynshitom ïa ka Jesebel namar ba ka la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga bad ïa kiwei pat ki shakri jong nga .

translation.en: For to their power , I bear record , yea , and beyond their power they were willing of themselves ;
translation.kha: Nga lah ban pynthikna ïa phi ba ki la ai katba ki lah , bad wat palat ban ïa kaba ki lah .

translation.en: And Joab said , As God liveth , unless thou hadst spoken , surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother .
translation.kha: Nga smai da U Blei uba im ,  u Joab u jubab ,  ba lada mem shym la kren , ki rangbah jong nga kin jin da la ïai beh kthong ïa me haduh lashai mynstep .

translation.en: Ever learning , and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth .
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki leit rung sha ki ïingbriew bad pynshohbieit ïa ki kynthei kiba tlot ba la bankhia da ka jingpynrem jong ki pop jong ki bad kiba la shah ringmraw ha ki jingkwah ba har rukom , ki kynthei kiba pyrshang borabor ban shah hikai hynrei ki bym lah ban tip da lei lei ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Brethren , I write no new commandment unto you , but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning . The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , kane ka hukum kaba nga thoh sha phi kam long kaba thymmai ; ka long ka hukum kaba rim , kata kaba phi la ïoh naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . Ka hukum barim ka long ka khubor kaba phi la lah ïohsngew .

translation.en: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death , being bound in affliction and iron  ;
translation.kha: Katto katne ki la im ha ka jingshaïong bad ka jingdum , ki koidi kiba shahshitom ha ki kynjri ,

translation.en: I am the good shepherd : the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long u nongaplangbrot uba bha , uba kloi ban ïap na ka bynta ki langbrot .

translation.en: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh , and spread abroad his hands unto the  Lord  : and the thunders and hail ceased , and the rain was not poured upon the earth .
translation.kha: U Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh , u leit shabar ka nongbah , bad u la rah ïa la ki kti ha ka jingduwai ha U  Trai . U pyrthat , u phria , bad u slap ki la sangeh .

translation.en: Saying ,  I am Alpha and Omega , the first and the last : and , What thou seest , write in a book , and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia  ; unto Ephesus , and unto Smyrna , and unto Pergamos , and unto Thyatira , and unto Sardis , and unto Philadelphia , and unto Laodicea .
translation.kha: Ka la ong ,  Thoh ïa kaei kaba me ïohi , bad phah ïa ka kitab sha ki balang ha kine ki hynñiew tylli ki nongbah : ka Ephesos , ka Smyrna , ka Pergamum , ka Thiatira , ka Sardis , ka Philadelphia , bad ka Laodikaïa .

translation.en: And the rulers brought onyx stones , and stones to be set , for the ephod , and for the breastplate  ;
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki wallam ïa ki mawkordor Karnelian bad kiwei pat ki mawlynnai ban pyndait ha ka ephod bad ha ka jingdeng shadem ,

translation.en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth–el came forth to Elisha , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the  Lord  will take away thy master from thy head to day ? And he said , Yea , I know it  ; hold ye your peace .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa kiba don hangta ki la leit sha u Elisha bad ki kylli ïa u ,  Hato phi tip ba U  Trai  un sa shim noh na phi ïa u kynrad jong phi ha kane ka sngi ?   Ho-oid , nga tip ,  u Elisha u jubab .  Hynrei to ngin ym ïakren shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: And I will pray the Father , and he shall give you another Comforter , that he may abide with you for ever  ;
translation.kha: Ngan pan na U Kpa , bad un ai ïa phi ïa uwei pat U Nongïarap    , u ban shongsah bad phi junom .

translation.en: Now therefore ye are cursed , and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen , and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God .
translation.kha: Namar ba phi leh kumne , U Blei u la pynrem ïa phi . Ki briew jong phi kin ïailong ki mraw , kiba thoh dieng bad kiba kit um ïa ka jaka kyntang U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God , but not according to knowledge .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban ong skhem ïa phi ba ki long kiba ieit ïa U Blei naduh ka dohnud ; hynrei ïa ka jingieit jong ki ïa U Blei , ym shym la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingtip bashisha .

translation.en: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure  ; but he for our profit , that we might be partakers of his holiness .
translation.kha: Ki kpa jong ngi ki sneng sympat ïa ngi tang shipor , katba ki sngewbit ma ki , hynrei U Blei u leh ïa kata na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ngi hi , khnang ba ngin ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingkhuid jong u .

translation.en: For he knoweth not that which shall be : for who can tell him when it shall be ?
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano na ngi batip ïa kaei ka ban jia , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban ïathuh ha ngi .

translation.en: So Joshua arose , and all the people of war , to go up against Ai : and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour , and sent them away by night .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua ryngkat bad ki shipai jong u baroh ki khreh ban leit sha Ai . U da jied laiphew hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai bad phah ba kin leit ha ka por mynmiet

translation.en: Nay , my sons  ; for it is no good report that I hear : ye make the  Lord s  people to transgress .
translation.kha: Sangeh noh ko khun jong nga ! Kane ka long kaba sngewshyrkhei kaba ki briew jong U  Trai  ki ïakren shaphang jong phi .

translation.en: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah , and said unto him , The  Lord  thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place .
translation.kha: U rangbah shipai u la khot ïa nga sharud bad u la ong ,

translation.en: Which was the son of Maath , which was the son of Mattathias , which was the son of Semei , which was the son of Joseph , which was the son of Juda ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Maath , u khun jong u Mattathias , u khun jong u Semein , u khun jong u Josekh , u khun jong u Joda ,

translation.en: Touching the Almighty , we cannot find him out : he is excellent in power , and in judgment , and in plenty of justice : he will not afflict .
translation.kha: Ka bor U Blei ka long kaba khraw haduh katta katta ba ngim lah ban wan hajan jong u ; u long uba hok bad uba beit ha ka jingïadei jong u bad ki briew ,

translation.en: My father peradventure will feel me , and I shall seem to him as a deceiver  ; and I shall bring a curse upon me , and not a blessing .
translation.kha: Lehse i pa jong nga in ktah ïa nga bad in shem ba nga shukor ïa i ; da kumne ngan wallam ka jingtim ha lade hi ha ka jaka ka jingkyrkhu .

translation.en: The sorrows of death compassed me , and the pains of hell gat hold upon me : I found trouble and sorrow .
translation.kha: Ka jingma jong ka jingïap ka la ker sawdong jong nga ; ki jingngiew jong ka jingtep ki la hajan ïa nga ; la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingtieng bad ka jingkhuslai .

translation.en: If there be in the land famine , if there be pestilence , blasting , mildew , locust , or if there be caterpiller  ; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities  ; whatsoever plague , whatsoever sickness there be  ;
translation.kha: Haba don ka  nemsniew ha ka ri , lane ka jingïapthem , lane ba ïa ki jingthung la pynjot da ka lyer khluit lane ka kynhun ki puit , lane haba ki briew jong me ki shah tur ïaleh ha ki nongshun jong ki , lane haba don ka jingpang hapdeng jong ki ,

translation.en: They are destroyed from morning to evening : they perish for ever without any regarding it .
translation.kha: Uno uno u lah ban dang im mynstep , hynrei u ïap khlem da tip ha shuwa ba ka janmiet kan poi .

translation.en: God sent Jesus to earth for three reasons : ( 1 ) To teach us the truth about God ( John 18 :37 ) , ( 2 ) to maintain perfect integrity , providing a model for us to follow ( 1 Peter 2 :21 ) , and ( 3 ) to sacrifice his life to set us free from sin and death .
translation.kha: Don lai tylli ki daw ba balei U Blei u la phah ïa u Jisu sha ka pyrthei . ( 1 ) ban hikai ïa ngi ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei ( Ioannis 18 :37 ) , ( 2 ) ban ïaineh ha ka hok bad ban long u nuksa na ka bynta jong ngi . ( 1 Petros 2 :21 ) , bad ( 3 ) ban aiti ïa la ka jingim ban pyllait ïa ngi na ka pop bad ka jingïap .

translation.en: And she said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Tell the man that sent you to me ,
translation.kha: bad ka ïathuh ïa ki ban leit pat sha u syiem bad ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na U  Trai  :

translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Simon , Simon , behold , Satan hath desired to have you , that he may sift you as wheat :
translation.kha: Ko Simon , Simon ! Sngap ! U Soitan u la ïoh jingbit ban tynjuh ïa phi baroh , ban pynïakhlad ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew , kumba u nongrep u pynïakhlad ïa u kew na u stait .

translation.en: Then the angel of the  Lord  commanded Gad to say to David , that David should go up , and set up an altar unto the  Lord  in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite .
translation.kha: U angel U  Trai  u ong ïa u Gad ban hukum ïa u Dabid ban leit bad tei ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  ha ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah .

translation.en: For now ye are nothing  ; ye see my casting down , and are afraid .
translation.kha: Ïa nga phi long kum kito ki wahduid , phi ïohi ïa ka kupar jong nga bad phi kynran noh ha ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: These are wells without water , clouds that are carried with a tempest  ; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew ki long kum ki pukri ba la tyrkhong , kum ki lyoh ba la rong noh da ka  erïong ; U Blei u la buh tyngkai ïa ka jaka na ka bynta jong ki ha ka jingdum tliw tliw .

translation.en: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself , and God , even our Father , which hath loved us , and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace ,
translation.kha: Ai ba U Jisu Khrist Uba U Trai jong ngi da lade hi bad U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi , uba la ieit ïa ngi , bad ha ka jingaiei jong u un ai ha ngi ka jingshlur baneh bad ka jingkyrmen baskhem ,

translation.en: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest , lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief .
translation.kha: Te , to ngin ïaleh shitom ban ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait , kumta ba yn ym don uwei ruh na ngi u ban duh noh kum ma ki namar ba kim don ka jingngeit .

translation.en: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  seven days : in the seventh day is an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh bam jong phi sha U  Trai  baroh hynñiew sngi . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew phin ïalumlang biang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam kaba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .

translation.en: Then said Pilate unto them , Take ye him , and judge him according to your law . The Jews therefore said unto him , It is not lawful for us to put any man to death :
translation.kha: U Pilat u la ong ha ki ,  Te phi hi da lade to shim ïa u bad bishar ïa u kat kum ka hukum jong phi hi .  Ki la jubab ,  Ngim donbor ban rai pynïap ïano ïano .

translation.en: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood , striving against sin .
translation.kha: Naba ha kata ka jingïaleh jong phi pyrshah ïa ka pop , phim pat ïaleh pyrshah haduh ban da shah pynïap .

translation.en: Salute Asyncritus , Phlegon , Hermas , Patrobas , Hermes , and the brethren which are with them .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei jong nga ïa u Asynkritos , u Phlegon , u Hermes , u Patrobas , u Hermas , bad baroh ki parabangeit kiba don bad ki .

translation.en: And he hath brought us into this place , and hath given us this land , even a land that floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: U la wan ïalam ïa ngi shane bad u la ai ha ngi ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

translation.en: And it came to pass at that time , that Judah went down from his brethren , and turned in to a certain Adullamite , whose name was Hirah .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Judah u la iehnoh ïa la ki hynmen shynrang , bad u la leit sah bad uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Hirah uba na ka shnong Adullam .

translation.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  , she thrust herself unto the wall , and crushed Balaam s foot against the wall : and he smote her again .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel , ka la tur sha kata ka kynroh bad ka ban trait ïa ka kjat u Balaam ha ka . Sa shisien u Balaam u sympat ïa ka kada .

translation.en: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt , and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king  ; who slew him with the sword , and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people .
translation.kha: Ki la wallam pat ïa u sha u syiem Jehoïakim , uba la phah pynïap ïa u bad ïa ka met jong u la bret sha ka jaka tep paidbah . )

translation.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure  ; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury .
translation.kha: Me long uba khuid ha kito kiba khuid , hynrei uba pyrshah ha kito kiba sniew .

translation.en: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom  ; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki briew ki alhia palat wat ban buh jingbam ha la ki jong ki shyntur .

translation.en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept .
translation.kha: ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Josaïah .

translation.en: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight , they have remained in their holds : their might hath failed  ; they became as women : they have burned her dwellingplaces  ; her bars are broken .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Babilonia ki la sangeh ban ïaleh bad ki sah ha ki kut jong ki . Ki la duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki bad ki la long kum ki kynthei . Ïa ki khyrdop jong ka nongbah la pynpra , bad ki ïing ki don ha ka jingpluh .

translation.en: He opened the rock , and the waters gushed out  ; they ran in the dry places like a river .
translation.kha: U plie ïa u mawsiang , bad ka um ka mih shabar , ka tuid lyngba ka ri shyiap kum ka wah .

translation.en: But Jeremiah said , They shall not deliver thee . Obey , I beseech thee , the voice of the  Lord  , which I speak unto thee : so it shall be well unto thee , and thy soul shall live .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Yn ym aiti noh ïa phi sha ki . Nga kyrpad ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ka khubor U  Trai  ; te baroh kan bha ïa phi , bad ïa ka jingim jong phi yn pynsah .

translation.en: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold , and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things :
translation.kha: Phi la shim noh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong nga bad rah noh ïa ki jingkynshew spah jong nga sha ki templ jong phi .

translation.en: Opening and alleging , that Christ must needs have suffered , and risen again from the dead  ; and that this Jesus , whom I preach unto you , is Christ .
translation.kha: da kaba sot bad batai ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad pynshisha na ki ba U Messaïah u la dei ban shahshitom bad ban mihpat na ka jingïap .  Une U Jisu ïa uba nga pynbna ha phi , u dei U Messaïah ,  u Paul u la ong .

translation.en: The  Lord  your God hath multiplied you , and , behold , ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynroi ïa phi kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng .

translation.en: Calling a ravenous bird from the east , the man that executeth my counsel from a far country : yea , I have spoken it , I will also bring it to pass  ; I have purposed it , I will also do it .
translation.kha: Nga khot ïa u briew ban wan na sha mihngi ; un suh wia sha tbian kum u kbeit bad pyndep ïa kaei kaba nga la thmu . Nga la kren , bad ngan leh ïa ka .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Take nothing for your journey , neither staves , nor scrip , neither bread , neither money  ; neither have two coats apiece .
translation.kha: hadien ba u la ong ha ki ,  wat rah ei ei bad phi ha ka jingleit jong phi : Wat rah ïa u diengduh , ïa ka pla khrong , ïa ka jingbam , ïa ka pisa , wat ïa ka sopti bujli ruh .

translation.en: And as for me , when I came from Paddan , Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way , when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath : and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath  ; the same is Beth–lehem .
translation.kha: Dei na ka bynta ka Rakhel ka kmie jong me ba nga leh ïa kane . Nga sngewsih eh ba ka la ïap noh ha ri Kanaan , hajan Ephrath , katba ngi dang ïawan phai na Mesopotamia . Nga la tep ïa ka hangta harud ka lynti kaba leit sha Ephrath .  ( Ïa ka Ephrath la tip mynta kum ka Bethlehem . )

translation.en: The king of Shimron–meron , one  ; the king of Achshaph , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Shimron Meron , ka Akhshaph ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron .

translation.en: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding ? they hold fast deceit , they refuse to return .
translation.kha: Balei te , ko ki briew jong nga , ba phi phai lyndet noh na nga khlem da wan phai shuh ? Phi snoh ha la ki bleithaw bad phi kyntait ban wan phai sha nga .

translation.en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth , that the wicked might be shaken out of it ?
translation.kha: Hato me la hukum ïa ka step ban kurup ïa ka pyrthei bad ban kynther ïa ki bymman na ki jakarieh jong ki ?

translation.en: And there was great joy in that city .
translation.kha: Kumta la don ka jingkmen kaba khraw ha kata ka nongbah .

translation.en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel : for I have seen God face to face , and my life is preserved .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la ong ,  Nga la ïohi ïa U Blei markhmat , bad nga dang im hi .  Kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka , Ka Peniel .

translation.en: And when he came out , he could not speak unto them : and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple : for he beckoned unto them , and remained speechless .
translation.kha: Haba u la mih shabar , um lah ban kren ha ki , bad kumta ki la sngewthuh ba u la ïohi ka jingïohipaw hapoh ka Templ . Um lah ban kren kano kano ka kyntien , u la pyn-i dak ha ki da ki kti jong u .

translation.en: And what shall I more say ? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon , and of Barak , and of Samson , and of Jephthae  ; of David also , and Samuel , and of the prophets :
translation.kha: Hato ngan dang ïai bteng ? Ngam don por shibun ban ïathuh shaphang u Gideon , u Barak , u Samson , u Jepthah , u Dabid , u Samuel bad ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath sworn by his right hand , and by the arm of his strength , Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies  ; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine , for the which thou hast laboured :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang bad da ka bor jong u , un pynlongkam ïa ka :  U kew jong pha un ym long shuh ka jingbam ïa ki nongshun jong pha , bad ki nongwei kin ym ïoh shuh ban dih ïa ka waiñ jong pha .

translation.en: And say to the land of Israel , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I am against thee , and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath , and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked .
translation.kha: Ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong phi . Ngan sei ïa ka waitlam jong nga bad ngan pynïap ïa phi baroh , kiba bha bad kiba sniew kumjuh .

translation.en: It hath been said , Whosoever shall put away his wife , let him give her a writing of divorcement :
translation.kha: La ong ruh , ‘ Uno uno uba pyllait ïa la ka tnga u dei ban ai ïa ka , ka jingthoh pynbna ïa ka jingpyllait tnga .’

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , against this family do I devise an evil , from which ye shall not remove your necks  ; neither shall ye go haughtily : for this time is evil .
translation.kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga dang thmu ban wallam ïa ka jingjot ha phi , bad phin ym lah ban lait na ka . Phin sa shem ïa lade ha ka jingeh , bad nangta phin ym ïaid sngewsarong shuh .

translation.en: How might you benefit from attending an assembly ?
translation.kha: Kumno phin myntoi da kaba wan sha ka asembli ?

translation.en: Now therefore be not grieved , nor angry with yourselves , that ye sold me hither : for God did send me before you to preserve life .
translation.kha: Mynta , wat sngewsih ne kynnoh ïa lade namar ba phi la die ïa nga shane . Dei U Blei keiñ uba la phah ïa nga ha shuwa jong phi ban pynim ïa ki briew .

translation.en: The young lions roar after their prey , and seek their meat from God .
translation.kha: Ki sing samla ki kyrhuh haba ki behmrad , ki wad ïa ka jingbam kaba U Blei u pynbiang .

translation.en: And he answered , My lord , O king , my servant deceived me : for thy servant said , I will saddle me an ass , that I may ride thereon , and go to the king  ; because thy servant is lame .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Kumba phi tip , ko Syiem Kynrad , nga dei uba dkoh . Nga la ong ïa la u shakri ban teh jin ïa ka kada jong nga ba kumta nga lah ban shong lem bad phi , hynrei u la shet shukor ïa nga .

translation.en: Thou art become cruel to me : with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me .
translation.kha: Me la lehbeiñ ïa nga ; me la pynshitom ïa nga da ka bor jong me baroh .

translation.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess . And Abijam his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u khun jong u , u Abijah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: But ye shall not be so : but he that is greatest among you , let him be as the younger  ; and he that is chief , as he that doth serve .
translation.kha: Hynrei kane kam dei ka rukom ka ban long bad phi ; pynban , uta uba khraw tam hapdeng jong phi u dei ban long kum uba rit tam , bad u nongïalam jong phi u dei ban long kum u shakri .

translation.en: If thy brother , the son of thy mother , or thy son , or thy daughter , or the wife of thy bosom , or thy friend , which is as thine own soul , entice thee secretly , saying , Let us go and serve other gods , which thou hast not known , thou , nor thy fathers  ;
translation.kha: Wat u hynmen u para jong phi , u khun jong phi , ka khun jong phi , ka tnga kaba phi ieit , lane u paralok uba jan eh jong phi , ki lah harieh harieh ban khring ïa phi ban leit mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ïa kiba phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim ju mane mynno mynno .

translation.en: Ye fools and blind : for whether is greater , the gift , or the altar that sanctifieth the gift ?
translation.kha: A katno phi long kiba matlah ! Kaei kaba kham donkam , ka jingai sngewbha ne ka duwan kaba pynlong khuid ïa ka jingai sngewbha ?

translation.en: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee  ; which have said to thy soul , Bow down , that we may go over : and thou hast laid thy body as the ground , and as the street , to them that went over .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ïa ka ha kito kiba banbeiñ ïa phi , ïa kito kiba la pynlong ïa phi ban thiah ha ki surok bah bad ïuhroit halor jong phi kum ka jakhlia .

translation.en: Then king Darius wrote unto all people , nations , and languages , that dwell in all the earth  ; Peace be multiplied unto you .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Darius u la thoh sha ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ha ka pyrthei : Khublei !

translation.en: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark  ; let it look for light , but have none  ; neither let it see the dawning of the day :
translation.kha: Wat ai ba u  lurstep un tyngshaiñ ; wat ai ka jingkyrmen jong ka step ïa kata ka miet .

translation.en: For they also built them high places , and images , and groves , on every high hill , and under every green tree .
translation.kha: Ki tei ki jaka mane ïa ki blei thala , bad ki pynïeng ïa ki maw mot bad ki durblei Asherah ban mane ha ki jaka lum bad hapoh syrngiew ki dieng .

translation.en: But I must die in this land , I must not go over Jordan : but ye shall go over , and possess that good land .
translation.kha: Nga te ngan ïap ha kane ka ri bad lano lano ngan ym ïoh jam ïa kata ka wah , hynrei phi pat phin sa ïoh leit shatai sha shiliang ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh .

translation.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment : thou shalt not respect the person of the poor , nor honour the person of the mighty : but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour .
translation.kha: Lehhok bad bishar hok haba phi shim rai ha ka mokotduma ; wat shah shiliang ïa uba duk lane ban sheptieng ïa uba riewspah .

translation.en: Give me now wisdom and knowledge , that I may go out and come in before this people : for who can judge this thy people , that is so great ?
