translation.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and he was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Rehoboam u khun jong u , u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And he straitly charged them , and commanded them to tell no man that thing  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ai ha ki , ki hukum bapyrkhing ban ym ïathuh ïa kane hano hano ruh .

translation.en: And of some have compassion , making a difference :
translation.kha: To leh-isynei ïa kito kiba don ki jingartatien ;

translation.en: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon , from all kings of the earth , which had heard of his wisdom .
translation.kha: Ki syiem ha kylleng ka pyrthei ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingstad jong u bad ki la phah briew ban sngap ïa u .

translation.en: And the sons of Ephraim  ; Shuthelah , and Bered his son , and Tahath his son , and Eladah his son , and Tahath his son ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew u Ephraim na ka pateng sha ka pateng : u Shuthelah , u Bered , u Tahath , u Eleadah , u Tahath , u Sabad , u Shuthelah .

translation.en: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea , they said unto him , Rabbi , when camest thou hither ?
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la shem ïa U Jisu sha shiliang jong ka duriaw , ki la ong ha u ,  Ko Nonghikai , mynno me la poi shane ?

translation.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man , he walketh through dry places , seeking rest  ; and finding none , he saith , I will return unto my house whence I came out .
translation.kha: Haba u mynsiem bymman u mihnoh na u briew , u leit kylleng ka ri ba-tyrkhong da kaba wad ka jaka ban shongthait . Lada um lah ban shem ïa ka , un ong ha lade , ‘ Ngan leit phai pat sha ka ïing jong nga .’

translation.en: Behold , I have set the land before you : go in and possess the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , to give unto them and to their seed after them .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka long kata ka ri kaba nga U  Trai  nga la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki . Khie leit kam kynti ïa ka .’

translation.en: Pilate therefore , willing to release Jesus , spake again to them .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la kwah ban pyllait noh ïa U Jisu , kumta u la kyrpad biang ïa u paidbah .

translation.en: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail  ; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jaiñ pynshah lyer jong pha la shna da ka jaiñ linen , ka linen ba la suh syntiew na Ijipt , ba lah ban ithuh naduh na jngai . Ïa ki jingpynpur la shna na ka jaiñ bakynsai tam , da ka rong jngum na ka dewlynnong Sypros .

translation.en: Him , being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God , ye have taken , and by wicked hands have crucified and slain :
translation.kha: Kat kum ka jingthmu jong u hi , U Blei u la lah thmu lypa ba ïa U Jisu yn aiti ha phi ; bad phi la pynïap ïa u da kaba shah ïa ki briew bapop ban sahnarphna ïa u .

translation.en: Cast thy bread upon the waters : for thou shalt find it after many days .
translation.kha: Thep ïa ka pisa jong phi ha ka jingkhaïi bar ri bad ha kawei na kine ki sngi phin ïohnong .

translation.en: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave . And the unclean spirits went out , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea , ( they were about two thousand  ; ) and were choked in the sea .
translation.kha: U la shah ïa ki ban leit , bad ki mynsiem bymkhuid ki la mih na uta u briew bad ki la rung hapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun sniang baroh kawei — kaba don baroh ar hajar tylli ki sniang — ka la noh kynsan sha ka riat jong ka duriaw bad ïap jyllop .

translation.en: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness , and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pyndap ïa ki lyngdoh da ki jingbam kiba bang eh bad pynhun ïa baroh ki jingdonkam jong ki briew jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: So they took the money , and did as they were taught : and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day .
translation.kha: Ki nongap phira ki la shim ïa ka pisa bad ki la leh ïa kaei kaba la bthah ïa ki ban leh . Bad kumta , kata ka long ka jingïathuh kaba la pynsaphriang kylleng da ki Jiw haduh kane hi ka sngi .

translation.en: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place , and maintain their cause ,
translation.kha: Na ka ïing jong me ha bneng to sngap ïa ki bad leh-isynei ïa ki .

translation.en: John answered and said , A man can receive nothing , except it be given him from heaven .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab ,  Ym don uno uno uba lah ban ïohpdiang ei ei lymda U Blei u ai ïa ka ha u .

translation.en: But now they desire a better country , that is , an heavenly : wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God : for he hath prepared for them a city .
translation.kha: Pynban , ka ri kaba ki kwah hir hir ka long ka ri kaba kham bha , ka ri ba kynja bneng . Bad kumta U Blei um sngewlehrain ïa ki , ba yn khot ïa u , U Blei jong ki , namar u la pynkhreh ka nongbah na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: But let none of you suffer as a murderer , or as a thief , or as an evildoer , or as a busybody in other men s matters .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno na phi u shahshitom , kam dei ban long namar ba u long u nongpynïap briew lane u nongtuh lane u nongkamsniew lane uba lushia ïa ki kam kiwei .

translation.en: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds  ; for their glory is spoiled : a voice of the roaring of young lions  ; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled .
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar ki kyang jam ha ka jingsngewsih ; ka burom jong ki ka la leit noh ! To pynshahshkor ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ki sing ; ïa ka ïing khlaw jong ki ha shi lynter jong ka Jordan la pynjot .

translation.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  , she fell down under Balaam : and Balaam s anger was kindled , and he smote the ass with a staff .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sien , haba ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel , ka la dem khop . U Balaam u la bitar lep bad u la sdang ban sympat ïa ka da la u diengduh .

translation.en: Where is boasting then ? It is excluded . By what law ? of works ? Nay : but by the law of faith .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei te , ngi lah ban sngewsarong ? Yn don ei ei! Bad kaei ka daw na ka bynta kane ? Hato ka dei ba ngi kohnguh ïa ka Hukum ? Em , hynrei ka dei ïa kata kaba ngi ngeit .

translation.en: And a certain centurion s servant , who was dear unto him , was sick , and ready to die .
translation.kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam ka hima Rom uba hangta , u la don u shakri uba u ieit eh ; uta u briew u la pang bad u la jan ïap .

translation.en: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity  ; and falling headlong , he burst asunder in the midst , and all his bowels gushed out .
translation.kha: ( Da ka pisa kaba u Judas u la ïoh na ka bynta ka kam sniew jong u , u la thied ïa ka lyngkha , ha kaba u la noh ïap ïa lade ; u la pait bad ki snier jong u baroh ki la mih shabar .

translation.en: And David came to the two hundred men , which were so faint that they could not follow David , whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor : and they went forth to meet David , and to meet the people that were with him : and when David came near to the people , he saluted them .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u leit phai sha kita ki arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba la thait eh ban leit ryngkat bad u bad kiba la sah shadien hangta ha ka wahduid Besor . Kita ki wan ban ïakynduh ïa u Dabid bad ki briew jong u , bad u Dabid u leit sha ki bad u khublei ïa ki .

translation.en: As the door turneth upon his hinges , so doth the slothful upon his bed .
translation.kha: U briew uba jaipdeh u kylla thiah ha jingthiah , um leit jngai ban ïa ka jingkhang kaba padai ha la ki kopja .

translation.en: And went again into the judgment hall , and saith unto Jesus , Whence art thou ? But Jesus gave him no answer .
translation.kha: U la leit pat sha ïing bad u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Nangno me wan ?  Hynrei U Jisu um shym jubab .

translation.en: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles : that , whereas they speak against you as evildoers , they may by your good works , which they shall behold , glorify God in the day of visitation .
translation.kha: Ka rukom im jong phi hapdeng ki bymngeit ka dei ban long kaba bha kumta ba haba ki mudui ïa phi kum ki nongleh bymman , kin hap ban ithuh shai ïa ki kam babha jong phi bad kumta kin ïaroh ïa U Blei ha ka Sngi ka jingwan jong u .

translation.en: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things , which David the king , and the chief fathers , the captains over thousands and hundreds , and the captains of the host , had dedicated .
translation.kha: U Shelomith bad ki dkhot ka longïing jong u ki dei peit ïa ki jingai sngewbha baroh ba la pynkyntang sha U Blei da u syiem Dabid , ki khlieh jong ki longïing , ki nongïalam jong ki kur , bad ki rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai .

translation.en: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah , that dwelt in the cities of Judah , they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep , and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the  Lord  their God , and laid them by heaps .
translation.kha: Ki briew baroh kiba shong ha ki nongbah jong ka Judah ki wanrah ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong ki masi bad ki langbrot , bad ki wanrah ruh shibun ki jingai , ïa kiba ki pynkyntang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood , and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the  Lord  , before the veil of the sanctuary .
translation.kha: Un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha kata ka snam bad synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha khmat ka jingkah jong ka Jaka Kyntang .

translation.en: Then the disciples took him by night , and let him down by the wall in a basket .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka miet ki nongbud jong u Saul ki la ïalam ïa u bad ki la pynhiar sha tbian ïa u lyngba ka thliew ha ka kynroh , da kaba pynhiar ïa u ha ka shang .

translation.en: And Peter answered unto her , Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much ? And she said , Yea , for so much .
translation.kha: U Petros u la kylli ïa ka ,  Ïathuh ïa nga , hato kane ka pisa baroh ka dei kaba ma pha bad u tnga jong pha , phi la ïohpdiang na kaba die ïa ka jaka jong phi ?   Ho-oid ,  ka la jubab ,  kato ka pisa baroh .

translation.en: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing : and my lord is wise , according to the wisdom of an angel of God , to know all things that are in the earth .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la leh ïa ka khnang ban pynbeit ïa kane ka kam . U Syiem Kynrad u long uba stad kum u angel jong U Blei bad u tip ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba jia .

translation.en: And when he polled his head , ( for it was at every year s end that he polled it : because the hair was heavy on him , therefore he polled it : ) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king s weight .
translation.kha: U  ñiuhkhlieh jong u , u long uba rben katta katta bad u hap ban khap ïa u shisien shisnem ; haba u la jrong than bad khia . U ju khia palat ïa ar kilo kat kum ka jingthew ryntih ba kynja syiem .

translation.en: And there are seven kings : five are fallen , and one is , and the other is not yet come  ; and when he cometh , he must continue a short space .
translation.kha: San ngut na ki , ki la kyllon , uwei u dang synshar , bad uwei pat um pat wan ; haba u wan , u dei ban synshar tang shipor .

translation.en: Arise , get thee to Zarephath , which belongeth to Zidon , and dwell there : behold , I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee .
translation.kha: Khie leit mynta sha ka shnong Sarephath , hajan Sidon , bad sah hangta . Nga la hukum ïa kawei ka riewkynthei hangta ban bsa ïa me .

translation.en: For ye were as sheep going astray  ; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls .
translation.kha: Phi la ju long kum ki langbrot kiba la jah lynti , hynrei mynta la wallam pat ban bud ïa U Nongaplangbrot bad Nongsharai ïa ki mynsiem jong phi .

translation.en: And the firstborn bare a son , and called his name Moab : the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day .
translation.kha: Ka khun nyngkong ka la kha khun shynrang ïa uba ka jer kyrteng u Moab . U la long u kpa tymmen jong ki Moab haduh kine ki sngi .

translation.en: A wise son heareth his father s instruction : but a scorner heareth not rebuke .
translation.kha: Ki khun kiba stad ki shahshkor haba ki kmie ki kpa ki pynbeit ïa ki , hynrei ki briew kiba sarong da lei lei kin ym phla ba ki la bakla .

translation.en: And if I go and prepare a place for you , I will come again , and receive you unto myself  ; that where I am , there ye may be also .
translation.kha: Bad hadien ba nga la leit bad pynkhreh ka jaka ïa phi , ngan wan pat bad ngan shim ïa phi ha lade hi , ba phi ruh phin don ha ka jaka kaba nga don .

translation.en: For this is my covenant unto them , when I shall take away their sins .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa kane ka jutang bad ki haba ngan weng noh ïa ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that the son of the woman , the mistress of the house , fell sick  ; and his sickness was so sore , that there was no breath left in him .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , u khun jong kata ka riewkynthei u la kem pang ; ka jingpang ka nang jur nang jur bad khatduh u la ïap .

translation.en: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho , nor the inhabitants of Zidon , nor of Ahlab , nor of Achzib , nor of Helbah , nor of Aphik , nor of Rehob :
translation.kha: Ki jait Asher kim shym la beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah Akko , Sidon , Ahlab , Akhsib , Helbah , Aphek , bad Rehob .

translation.en: But Sarai was barren  ; she had no child .
translation.kha: Ka Sarai te kam shym la lah ban ïoh khun .

translation.en: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work s sake . And be at peace among yourselves .
translation.kha: To ñiewburom shikatdei eh ïa ki bad to ieit ïa ki namar ka kam kaba ki trei . To phin ïalong kiba ïasuk para ma phi .

translation.en: After the same manner also he took the cup , when he had supped , saying ,  This cup is the new testament in my blood : this do ye , as oft as ye drink it , in remembrance of me .
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh , hadien kaba bam ïa ka jingbam miet u la shim ïa ka khuri bad u la ong ,  Kane ka khuri ka long ka jutang kaba thymmai jong U Blei , la pynskhem da ka snam jong nga . Man ba phi dih ïa ka , to leh kumta ban kynmaw ïa nga .

translation.en: And when he had brought him down , behold , they were spread abroad upon all the earth , eating and drinking , and dancing , because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines , and out of the land of Judah .
translation.kha: Bad u leit ïalam ïa u Dabid sha ki . Ki nonglute ki saphriang kylleng ka jaka , ki da ïabam , ki da ïadih , bad ki da lehkmen , namar ki la ïoh lute shibun na ka ri ki Philistia bad na ka ri Judah .

translation.en: Then said his disciples , Lord , if he sleep , he shall do well .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la jubab ,  Lada u ïohthiah , ko Kynrad , un sa koit .

translation.en: Also he said , Bring the veil that thou hast upon thee , and hold it . And when she held it , he measured six measures of barley , and laid it on her : and she went into the city .
translation.kha: U Boas u ong ïa ka ,  Law ïa kato ka jaiñkup bad siang ïa ka hangne .  Ka leh kumta , bad u theh hangta jan dap arphew kilo u barli bad u ïarap ïa ka ban kyntiew halor ka tyrpeng jong ka . Nangta ka leit phai bad kata sha shnong .

translation.en: For I am the least of the apostles , that am not meet to be called an apostle , because I persecuted the church of God .
translation.kha: Naba nga long uba rit tam na baroh ki Apostol — ngam long wat uba bit ban khot u Apostol , namar nga la pynshitom beiñ ïa ka balang U Blei .

translation.en: And we took their land , and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites , and to the Gadites , and to the half tribe of Manasseh .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi la jop ïa ki , ngi knieh ïa ka ri jong ki , bad ngi pynbynta ïa ka hapdeng ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad , bad ha ki shiteng na ka jait Manasseh .

translation.en: There is one glory of the sun , and another glory of the moon , and another glory of the stars : for one star differeth from another star in glory .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka don la ka jong ka jingitynnat , u bnai da kawei ka jingitynnat , bad ki khlur da kawei pat ka jingitynnat ; bad wat hapdeng ki khlur don ki jingitynnat ba har rukom .

translation.en: And all their wealth , and all their little ones , and their wives took they captive , and spoiled even all that was in the house .
translation.kha: Ki shim lut ïa kiba ishongdor , ki la kurup ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah baroh , bad ki rah lut kat kaba don hapoh ïing .

translation.en: And in the latter time of their kingdom , when the transgressors are come to the full , a king of fierce countenance , and understanding dark sentences , shall stand up .
translation.kha: Haba ka jingkut jong kito ki hima ka la jan bad ki la long bymman katta katta ba ki la dei ban shah pynshitom , yn don u syiem uba mutlop , uba runar eh , bad uba dap da ka jingshukor .

translation.en: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam , and said to Samson , Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us ? what is this that thou hast done unto us ? And he said unto them , As they did unto me , so have I done unto them .
translation.kha: Kumta lai hajar ngut ki rangbah Judah ki leit sha kata ka krem mawsiang ha Etam bad ki ong ha u Samson ,  Mem tip ba ki Philistia ki dei ki nongsynshar jong ngi ? Me la leh aïu ïa ngi ?  U jubab ,  Nga la leh ïa ki tang kaei kaba ki la leh ïa nga .

translation.en: Ye are the light of the world . A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid .
translation.kha: Phi , phi long kum ka jingshai ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Ïa ka nongbah ba la tei halor u lum ym lah ban buhrieh .

translation.en: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean , and cedar wood , and scarlet , and hyssop :
translation.kha: Lada kata ka jingpang ka la jem , u lyngdoh un hukum ba yn wanrah ar tylli ki sim ïa kiba la ñiew ba ki long kiba khuid ryngkat bad uwei u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u  saiwul uba saw , bad uwei u tnat Hissop .

translation.en: And Moses said , Eat that to day  ; for to day is a sabbath unto the  Lord  : to day ye shall not find it in the field .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ,  Bam ïa ka mynta ka sngi , naba mynta ka dei ka Sabbaton , ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , bad phin ym shem jingbam ei ei shabar .

translation.en: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the  Lord  : and what is Aaron , that ye murmur against him ?
translation.kha: Haba phi ujor pyrshah ïa u Aaron , ka mut shisha pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ba ma phi bad ki nongbud jong phi , phi ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: And he took the elders of the city , and thorns of the wilderness and briers , and with them he taught the men of Succoth .
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa ki shiah bad ki dieng shiah na ka ri shyiap bad pyndonkam da ki ban pynshitom ïa ki nongïalam jong ka Sukkoth .

translation.en: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it , and shame shall cover her which said unto me , Where is the  Lord  thy God ? mine eyes shall behold her : now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets .
translation.kha: Te ki nongshun jong ngi kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin shah pynjahburom — kijuh ki nongshun kiba la pynthut ïa ngi da kaba kylli ,  Hangno U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ?  Ngin ïohi ba ki la shahjop , shah ïuh kum ka ktieh ha ki lynti bah .

translation.en: Zenan , and Hadashah , and Migdal–gad ,
translation.kha: Don ruh ka Senan , ka Hadashah , ka Migdalgad ,

translation.en: The workman melteth a graven image , and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold , and casteth silver chains .
translation.kha: Um long kum i bleithaw ba u nongtrei u shna ba ki kamar ki sop da ka ksiar bad pynshong ha u khiew rupa .

translation.en: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests , and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki lyngdoh bad jong ki briew baroh kiba la ïeng ha ka Templ , nga la ong ha u Hananaïah :

translation.en: That the  Lord  may continue his word which he spake concerning me , saying , If thy children take heed to their way , to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul , there shall not fail thee ( said he ) a man on the throne of Israel .
translation.kha: Lada me kohnguh ïa u , U  Trai  un bat ïa ka kular kaba u la pynlong haba u ong ïa me ba ki khun ki ksiew jong nga kin synshar ïa ka Israel katba ki dang phikir ban kohnguh hok ïa ki hukum da ka dohnud baroh bad ka mynsiem jong ki .

translation.en: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden , when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms  ; saying unto them ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi kumno katto katne ngut kiba shah khot sngewbha ki da jied ïa ki jaka bakyrpang tam , kumta u la ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi ha ki baroh :

translation.en: And when David had called him , he did eat and drink before him  ; and he made him drunk : and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord , but went not down to his house .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la khot sngewbha ïa u ban ïabam miet bad u , bad u la pyndih buaid ïa u . Hynrei ha kata ka miet ruh , u Uriah um shym leit sha ïing ; pynban , u la thiah ha la ka jaka thiah ha ka kamra ki nongap phira ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even : as the meat offering of the morning , and as the drink offering thereof , thou shalt offer it , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ynda janmiet pat , ainguh ïa u langbrot uba ar ha kajuh ka rukom kumba la leh ïa ka jingainguh kaba mynstep , ryngkat bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ . Kane ruh ka dei ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And when they cried unto the  Lord  , he put darkness between you and the Egyptians , and brought the sea upon them , and covered them  ; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt : and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki poi ha Duriaw Basaw , ki la kyang sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap , bad nga la buh ïa ka jingdum hapdeng jong ki bad ki nong Ijipt . Nga la pynlong ïa ka duriaw ba kan tyllep halor ki nong Ijipt bad pynïap jyllop ïa ki . Phi tip kaei kaba nga la leh ïa ka Ijipt .   ‘ Phi la im slem bha ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah , Hear the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u ong ha u syiem ,  U  Trai  Bakhrawbor u ong ba

translation.en: And Laban said to him , Surely thou art my bone and my flesh . And he abode with him the space of a month .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u la ïathuh ha u Laban ïa kaba la jia baroh , u Laban u ong ,  Ho-oid , da shisha phi dei ka doh ka snam jong nga .  U Jakob u la shong la sah hangta baroh shi bnai .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also destroy the idols , and I will cause their images to cease out of Memphis  ; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt : and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki blei bashukor ha Memphis . Yn ym don u ban synshar halor ka Ijipt , bad ngan pyntriem ïa ki briew baroh .

translation.en: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root : Israel shall blossom and bud , and fill the face of the world with fruit .
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi ki ban sa wan ki paid Israel , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , kin suhthied kum u dieng , bad kin phuh bad shylluit . Ïa ka pyrthei yn pyndap da u soh uba ki pynmih .

translation.en: There is a crying for wine in the streets  ; all joy is darkened , the mirth of the land is gone .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki pyrta ha ki lynti bah namar ym don waiñ shuh . Ka jingkmen ka la duh noh junom ; la beh noh ïa ka na ka ri .

translation.en: My tabernacle also shall be with them : yea , I will be their God , and they shall be my people .
translation.kha: Ngan shong hangta bad ki ; ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad ki kin long ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: For if I build again the things which I destroyed , I make myself a transgressor .
translation.kha: Lada nga sdang ban tei pat ïa ka rukom ka Hukum ïa kaba nga la jynrat noh , te nga pynpaw noh ïa lade kum uwei uba pynkheiñ Hukum .

translation.en: Before she travailed , she brought forth  ; before her pain came , she was delivered of a man child .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah bakhuid jong nga ka long kum ka briew kaba kha kynsan ïa i khun , khlem da suh kha .

translation.en: But yet in it shall be a tenth , and it shall return , and shall be eaten : as a teil tree , and as an oak , whose substance is in them , when they cast their leaves : so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof .
translation.kha: Wat lada uwei u briew na ki shiphew ngut u sah ha ka ri , ïa u ruh yn pynjot , un long kum u dyngkhong jong u dieng Sning uba la khet .  ( U dyngkhong u ïeng na ka bynta ka jingsdang bathymmai ïa ki briew jong U Blei . )

translation.en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life  ; and he that winneth souls is wise .
translation.kha: Ka hok ka ai jingim , hynrei ka jinglehbor ka shim noh ïa ka .

translation.en: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven , every stone about the weight of a talent : and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail  ; for the plague thereof was exceeding great .
translation.kha: Ki phria kiba heh , uwei uwei uba khia kat sanphew kilo , ki la hap na sahit bneng ha ki briew , kiba la tim ïa U Blei namar ka khlam jong u phria , namar ka la long ka khlam kaba shyrkhei eh .

translation.en: Open thy doors , O Lebanon , that the fire may devour thy cedars .
translation.kha: To plie ïa ki jingkhang jong pha , ko Lebanon , khnang ba ka ding kan thang duh ïa ki dieng Kedar jong pha !

translation.en: Give instruction to a wise man , and he will be yet wiser : teach a just man , and he will increase in learning .
translation.kha: Kano kano kaba phi kren ïa u briew uba stad , kan pynlong ïa u ban nang kham stad . Kano kano kaba phi kren ha u briew uba hok kan nang pynroi ïa ka jingtip jong u .

translation.en: Take , my brethren , the prophets , who have spoken in the name of the Lord , for an example of suffering affliction , and of patience .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , to kynmaw ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kren ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai . To shim ïa ki kum ki nuksa jong ka jingïaineh ba-ïaishah hapdeng ka jingshahshitom .

translation.en: Rejoice evermore .
translation.kha: To kmen borabor ,

translation.en: For he did put his life in his hand , and slew the Philistine , and the  Lord  wrought a great salvation for all Israel : thou sawest it , and didst rejoice : wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood , to slay David without a cause ?
translation.kha: U la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim mynba u pynïap ïa u Goliath , bad U  Trai  u la pynïoh ïa ka jingjop kaba khraw na ka bynta ki Israel . Mynba phi ïohi ïa kata , phi la sngewkmen . Balei te mynta , phi kwah ban leh bymdei ïa u briew uba lui lui bad ban pynïap ïa u Dabid khlem kano kano ka daw ?

translation.en: He hath not dealt so with any nation : and as for his judgments , they have not known them . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Um shym la leh ïa kane ha kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ; kim tip ïa ki aiñ jong u . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: Hear ye , O mountains , the  Lord s  controversy , and ye strong foundations of the earth : for the  Lord  hath a controversy with his people , and he will plead with Israel .
translation.kha: Phi ki lumbah , phi ki nongrim bymjukut jong ka khyndew , to shahshkor ïa ka jingmudui jong U  Trai  ! U  Trai  u don ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa la ki briew . Un wanrah ïa ka jingkynnoh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Now when the sun was setting , all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him  ; and he laid his hands on every one of them , and healed them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la sep ka sngi , baroh kiba don ki paralok kiba pang na ki jait jingpang kiba pher bapher , ki la wallam ïa ki sha U Jisu ; u la buh ïa la ki kti halor uwei pa uwei bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And when this epistle is read among you , cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans ; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea .
translation.kha: Hadien ba phi pule ïa kane ka shithi , pynthikna ba la pule ruh ïa ka ha ka balang ha Laodikaïa . Ha kajuh ka por , phi dei ban pule ïa ka shithi kaba ki parabangeit ha Laodikaïa kin phah sha phi .

translation.en: Therefore , do you think it would be right to use a cross in worship ?—Deuteronomy 7 :26  ; 1 Corinthians 10 :14 .
translation.kha: Namarkata , phi tharai ka long mo kaba dei ban pyndonkam ïa ka diengphna ha ka jingmane ?—Deuteronomi 7 :26 ; 1 Korinth 10 :14 .

translation.en: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews : wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently .
translation.kha: khamtam naduh kaba phi tip bha ïa ki dustur bad ïa ki jingïakajia baroh jong ki Jiw . Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te , ban shahshkor ïa nga da ka jingïaishah .

translation.en: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation , spoken of by Daniel the prophet , standing where it ought not ,  ( let him that readeth understand , )  then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains :
translation.kha: Phin sa ïohi ïa ka ‘ Jingijli Bashyrkhei’ kaba ïeng ha ka jaka kaba kam dei ban don .  ( Ka jingpynkynmaw ïa uba pule : da pynthikna ban sngewthuh ka mut aïu kane ! )  Te kito kiba don ha Judia ki dei ban phet sha ki lum .

translation.en: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage : neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet .
translation.kha: Da kaba kyiuh ha ka jingshongshit , ki kulai ki mareh sha khmat ; haba ka turoi ka riew , kim lah ban ïeng hajuh .

translation.en: One man of you shall chase a thousand : for the  Lord  your God , he it is that fighteth for you , as he hath promised you .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei na phi u lah ban pynher krad shihajar ki nongïapom , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , kumba u la kular .

translation.en: They cause him to go naked without clothing , and they take away the sheaf from the hungry  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei kiba duk kin hap ban ïaid shabar khlem ki jaiñ ban ïada ïa ki ; ki hap ban shahthngan katba dang lum kew .

translation.en: As touching the Gentiles which believe , we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing , save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols , and from blood , and from strangled , and from fornication .
translation.kha: Hynrei shaphang ki Jentil kiba la long kiba ngeit , ngi la phah ka shithi sha ki da kaba ïathuh ïa ki ba ngi la rai ba kim dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ïa kaba la kñia ha ki bleithaw , lane bam ïa kano kano ka snam , lane ïa kano kano ka mrad kaba la khyrwait , bad ba ki dei ban sumar ïa lade na ka jingawria .

translation.en: Go say to them , Get you into your tents again .
translation.kha: Khie ong ba kin ïaleit phai sha la ki dara .

translation.en: But of their children , who were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel consumed not , them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day .
translation.kha: U Solomon u pyndonkam ha kaba pyntrei jubor ïa baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong ki briew ka Kanaan kiba ki Israel kim shym la pynïap mynba ki knieh ïa ka ri jong ki . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , kiba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki dang long ki mraw haduh mynta .

translation.en: And the seventy returned again with joy , saying , Lord , even the devils are subject unto us through thy name .
translation.kha: Ki hynñiewphew ar ngut ki rangbah ki la wan phai ha ka jingkmen kaba khraw .  Ko Trai ,  ki la ong ,  wat ki ksuid ki la kohnguh ïa ngi haba ngi hukum ha ka kyrteng jong me !

translation.en: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives , and pray unto the  Lord  for it : for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace .
translation.kha: Trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki nongbah sha kaba nga la pynlong ïa phi ban leit kum ki koidi . Duwai sha nga na ka bynta jong ki , namar lada ki manbha , phi ruh phin manbha .

translation.en: The leaves thereof were fair , and the fruit thereof much , and in it was meat for all : the beasts of the field had shadow under it , and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof , and all flesh was fed of it .
translation.kha: Ki sla jong u ki long kiba itynnat , bad la pynshlei ïa u da ki soh — kiba kyrhai na ka bynta ka pyrthei baroh kawei ban bam . Ki mradkhlaw ki pynjahthait ha ka syrngiew jong u , ki sim ki shna ïa ki skum ha ki tnat jong u , bad baroh ki jait jingthaw ba-im ki la bam ïa u soh jong u .

translation.en: And Eleazar Aaron s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife  ; and she bare him Phinehas : these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families .
translation.kha: U Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron u la shongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong u Putiel , bad ka la kha ïa u Phinehas . Kine ki la long ki khlieh jong ki kur bad ki jait kiba mih na u Lebi .

translation.en: Come now therefore , and let us slay him , and cast him into some pit , and we will say , Some evil beast hath devoured him : and we shall see what will become of his dreams .
translation.kha: Ale mynta to ngin ïa-pynïap ïa u , bad bret ïa ka met jong u ha kawei na ki pukri ba-tyrkhong . Ngi lah ban ong ba u mradkhlaw u la pynïap ïa u . Nangta ngin sa ïakhmih kan jia aïu ïa ki jingphohsniew jong u .

translation.en: And , behold , an hand touched me , which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands .
translation.kha: Nangta ka kti ka la shim ïa nga bad ka la pynkhie joit ïa nga ; nga dang khynñiuh hi .

translation.en: For , said Hushai , thou knowest thy father and his men , that they be mighty men , and they be chafed in their minds , as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field : and thy father is a man of war , and will not lodge with the people .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba u Dabid , u kpa jong phi bad ki rangbah jong u ki long ki nongïaleh kiba satar , bad ba ki long kiba shyrkhei kum ka dngiem kmie kaba la shah knieh ïa ki khun jong ka . U kpa jong phi u dei u shipai uba la mlien bha bad um ju sah bad la ki rangbah mynmiet .

translation.en: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly , saying , Let me go , I pray thee , and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and no man shall know it : wherefore should he slay thee , that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered , and the remnant in Judah perish ?
translation.kha: Te u Johanan u la ong ha kaba rieh ha u ,  Ai ba ngan leit ban pynïap ïa u Ishmael , bad yn ym don batip mano ba la leh ïa kata . Balei ba yn shah ïa u ban pynïap ïa phi ? Kata kan pynlong ïa ki Jiw baroh kiba ïalum sawdong jong phi ban shah pynsakma , bad kan wallam ïa ka jingjot ha baroh ki briew ïa kiba la pynsah ha Judah .

translation.en: My net also will I spread upon him , and he shall be taken in my snare : and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans  ; yet shall he not see it , though he shall die there .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan phriang ïa ka jar jong nga bad riam ïa u ha ka . Nangta ngan shim ïa u sha ka nongbah Babilon , ha kaba un ïap khlem da ïohi ïa ka .

translation.en: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan , saying , The  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in , with the suburbs thereof for our cattle .
translation.kha: Hangta ha Shiloh ha ka ri Kanaan ki ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  u la hukum da u Moses ba dei ban ai ïa ngi ki nongbah ba ngin shong ngin sah , lem bad ki pyntha phlang sawdong jong ki na ka bynta ki jingri jong ngi .

translation.en: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them  ; and they made ready the passover .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leh kumba U Jisu u la bthah ïa ki bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called ?
translation.kha: Dei ma ki kiba kren sniew ïa kata ka kyrteng babha ïa kaba la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Now why dost thou cry out aloud ? is there no king in thee ? is thy counsellor perished ? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail .
translation.kha: Balei pha kyang jam ? Balei ba pha shahshitom kum ka briew kaba suh kha ? Hato ka long namar ba pham don u syiem , bad ki nongaibuit jong pha ki la ïap ?

translation.en: Saying unto them ,  It is written , My house is the house of prayer : but ye have made it a den of thieves .
translation.kha: La thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Templ jong nga yn khot ka ïing ka jingduwai .’ Hynrei phi la pynkylla ïa ka sha ka jakarieh na ka bynta ki nongtuh !

translation.en: Now therefore stand and see this great thing , which the  Lord  will do before your eyes .
translation.kha: Mynta , namar kata , ïeng thik hangto , bad phin ïohi ïa ka kam kaba khraw ïa kaba U  Trai  un leh ha khmat jong phi .

translation.en: Thou shalt fear the  Lord  thy God , and serve him , and shalt swear by his name .
translation.kha: Tiengburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , mane tang ïa u , bad kular ruh tang ha ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: How can we benefit ourselves by attending Christian meetings ?
translation.kha: Ka jingwan sha ki jingïalang kan ai jingmyntoi aïu ïa ngi ?

translation.en: Look on every one that is proud , and bring him low  ; and tread down the wicked in their place .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , to khmih ïa ki bad to pynhiar ïa ki ; pynlwet ïa ki bymman ha ka jaka kaba ki ïeng .

translation.en: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab , over against Beth–peor : but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la tep ïa u ha kawei ka them ha Moab , marpyrshah ka shnong Bethpeor , hynrei haduh kane ka sngi ruh ym don uba tip ïa ka jaka tep jong u .

translation.en: These waited on the king , beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah .
translation.kha: Kine ki rangbah ki shakri ïa u syiem ha Jerusalem , bad nalor kata , u buh ruh kiwei pat ki shipai ha kiwei ki nongbah ba la tei kut jong ka Judah .

translation.en: Now it was not written for his sake alone , that it was imputed to him ;
translation.kha: Ïa ki ktien  La pdiang kum uba hok  ym shym la thoh tang na ka bynta jong u marwei .

translation.en: A sound heart is the life of the flesh : but envy the rottenness of the bones .
translation.kha: Ka jingmut jingpyrkhat kaba suk ka pynlong ïa ka met ka bakoit bakhiah , hynrei ka jingpihuiñ ka long kum ka jingpang bampong .

translation.en: As they called them , so they went from them : they sacrificed unto Baalim , and burned incense to graven images .
translation.kha: Hynrei katba nga nang khot ïa u , katta u nang phet jngai na nga . Ki briew jong nga ki kñia ainguh sha u Baal , ki thang jingiwbih ha ki bleithaw .

translation.en: Rejoice greatly , O daughter of Zion  ; shout , O daughter of Jerusalem : behold , thy King cometh unto thee : he is just , and having salvation  ; lowly , and riding upon an ass , and upon a colt the foal of an ass .
translation.kha: To kmen to shadkmen ko ki briew ka Seïon ! Pyrta da ka jingkmen phi ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ! Ha khmih u syiem jong phi u wan sha phi ! U wan ha ka jingrisa bad ha ka jingjop , hynrei ha ka jingsngewrit bad u da shong halor ka kada — halor u khun kada .

translation.en: Then king David answered and said , Call me Bath–sheba . And she came into the king s presence , and stood before the king .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ,  Ong ïa ka Bathsheba ban wan biang shane shapoh  — bad ka la wan bad ïeng ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: For Gaza shall be forsaken , and Ashkelon a desolation : they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day , and Ekron shall be rooted up .
translation.kha: Yn ym iehnoh ïano ïano ha ka nongbah Gasa . La iehnoh ïa ka Ashkelon . Ïa ki briew jong ka Ashdod yn beh noh ha ka shiteng sngi , bad ïa ki briew jong ka Ekron yn beh noh na ka nongbah jong ki .

translation.en: And his brethren , men of valour , were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers , whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites , the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasseh , for every matter pertaining to God , and affairs of the king .
translation.kha: U syiem Dabid u jied ar hajar hynñiewspah ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit jong ki longïing na ki kur jong u Jeraïah bad u buh ïa ki ban peit ïa ki kam niam bad ki kam hima sima ha Israel kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan — ki ri jong ki Reuben , ki Gad , bad ki Manasseh ba sha Mihngi .

translation.en: But unto none of them was Elias sent , save unto Sarepta , a city of Sidon , unto a woman that was a widow .
translation.kha: Pynban , ïa u Elijah ym shym la phah hano hano ha Israel , hynrei , tang sha ka riewkynthei kaba shong basah ha Sarephath ha ka thain jong ka Sidon .

translation.en: The elders which are among you I exhort , who am also an elder , and a witness of the sufferings of Christ , and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed :
translation.kha: Ma nga , uba ïa lade nga long u nongsharai balang , nga kyntu ïa ki nongsharai balang ka balang hapdeng jong phi . Nga long u sakhi ïa ki jingshahshitom U Khrist , bad ngan ïoh bynta ha ka burom kaba yn sa pynpaw .

translation.en: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply , and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied , and all that thou hast is multiplied  ;
translation.kha: bad wat ynda ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi , ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong phi , bad ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh ki la nang bun kyrhai ,

translation.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses , saying , Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki ong ,  Kynrad , ngin leh kumba phi hukum .

translation.en: And the young men arose , wound him up , and carried him out , and buried him .
translation.kha: Ki samla shynrang ki la wan shapoh , ki la sop ïa ka met jong u , ki la bah ïa u shabar , bad tep ïa u .

translation.en: The wicked desireth the net of evil men : but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba ki briew ba-bymman ki kwah ka long ban wad ban leh ïa ki kam kiba sniew , hynrei kiba hok ki ïeng skhem .

translation.en: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Namar ki balang ha Makedonia bad Akhaïa da ka jingsngewlaitluid ki la ïakut ban ai ka jingai ban ïarap ïa kiba duk napdeng ki briew jong U Blei ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto the ass , Because thou hast mocked me : I would there were a sword in mine hand , for now would I kill thee .
translation.kha: U Balaam u jubab ,  Namar ba pha la pynlong u bieit ïa nga ! Ba ngan da don waitlam , ngan jin da la pynïap ïa pha .

translation.en: At the time appointed he shall return , and come toward the south  ; but it shall not be as the former , or as the latter .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne un hiarthma pat ïa ka Ijipt , hynrei ha kane ka por kiei kiei kin kylla long da kumwei pat .

translation.en: And they took the bullock which was given them , and they dressed it , and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon , saying , O Baal , hear us . But there was no voice , nor any that answered . And they leaped upon the altar which was made .
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa u masi dab ba la wanrah sha ki , ki la pynkhreh ïa u , bad ki la duwai ha u Baal haduh shiteng sngi . Ki la pyrta jam ,  Jubab ïa ngi , ko Baal !  bad ki la shad sawdong ïa ka duwan kaba ki la shna . Hynrei kim shym ïoh jubab .

translation.en: But he shall not multiply horses to himself , nor cause the people to return to Egypt , to the end that he should multiply horses : forasmuch as the  Lord  hath said unto you , Ye shall henceforth return no more that way .
translation.kha: U syiem um dei ban pynbun ki kulai na ka bynta ïa lade , bad um dei ban phah briew sha Ijipt ban thied kulai nangta , namar U  Trai  u la ong ba ki briew jong u kim dei ban leit phai shata lano lano .

translation.en: He will not suffer me to take my breath , but filleth me with bitterness .
translation.kha: Um shah ïa nga ban ïoh pynhiar mynsiem ; u la pyndap ïa ka jingim jong nga da ka jingkthang .

translation.en: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations  ; Gershon , and Kohath , and Merari : and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years .
translation.kha: U Lebi u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Gershon , u Kohath , bad u Merari ; kine ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki jait kiba ai kyrteng da ki . U Lebi u la im haduh shispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .

translation.en: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer : and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba isih ïa la u hynmen u para u long u nongpynïap briew , bad phi tip ba u nongpynïap briew um pat ïoh ka jingim bymjukut ha u .

translation.en: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness , those that remember thee in thy ways : behold , thou art wroth  ; for we have sinned : in those is continuance , and we shall be saved .
translation.kha: Me pdiang sngewbha ïa kito kiba shem jingkmen ha kaba leh ïa kaei kaba dei , ïa kito kiba kynmaw kumno me kwah ïa ki ban im . Me la bitar ïa ngi , hynrei ngi dang ïai leh pop ; wat la me la bitar shla ngi dang ïai leh ïa kaba sniew naduh mynbarim .

translation.en: Therefore Saul said unto the  Lord  God of Israel , Give a perfect lot . And Saul and Jonathan were taken : but the people escaped .
translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ,  A  Trai  , balei mem shym jubab ïa nga mynta ka sngi ? Ko  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel to jubab ïa nga da ki mawkyntang   . Lada ka dei ka pop jong u Jonathan ne ka jong nga , to jubab da u Urim ; hynrei lada ka dei ka jong ki Israel ki briew jong me , jubab da u Thummim .  Ka jubab ka kdew ïa u Jonathan bad u Saul ; bad u paidbah u lait .

translation.en: For ye are bought with a price : therefore glorify God in your body , and in your spirit , which are Gods .
translation.kha: Phim long la u jong hi hynrei jong U Blei ; u la thied ïa phi da ka dor . Kumta to pyndonkam ïa ki met jong phi na ka bynta ka burom jong U Blei .

translation.en: Dig thou through the wall in their sight , and carry out thereby .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang khmih , to pynpei thliew lyngba ka kynroh ka ïing jong me bad to shim ïa ka song jong me shabar lyngba jong ka .

translation.en: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle , and herb for the service of man : that he may bring forth food out of the earth  ;
translation.kha: Me pynlong ïa u phlang ban mih na ka bynta ki jingri bad ïa ki jingthung ba u briew un pyndonkam , khnang ba un lah ban pynmih jingthung ban bam

translation.en: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught , and loveth to tread out the corn  ; but I passed over upon her fair neck : I will make Ephraim to ride  ; Judah shall plow , and Jacob shall break his clods .
translation.kha: Ka Israel ka la long shisien kum ka masi lud kaba la ïoh jinghikai bha , kaba la kloi bad mon ban shoh kew . Hynrei nga la rai ban buh ïa ka lyngkor ha ka ryndang ba-itynnat jong ka bad ban pyndait lyngkor ïa ka na ka bynta ka kam kaba kham eh . Ngan pynlong ïa u Judah ba un lur , bad u Israel un pynlwet khyndew .

translation.en: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire .
translation.kha: Kumta u Hiram u la pynbiang ïa u Solomon da ki dieng Kedar tylli bad ki dieng Kseh tylli baroh kiba u kwah ,

translation.en: Righteousness exalteth a nation : but sin is a reproach to any people .
translation.kha: Ka hok ka kyntiew ïa ka jaitbynriew ; ka pop ka long ka jingjahburom jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Why did God not destroy Adam and Eve and start over with another human pair ?
translation.kha: Balei U Blei ym shym la pynjot noh ia u Adam bad ka Im bad sdang biang ban thaw da kiwei pat ki shijur ?

translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon : and her whole land shall be confounded , and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her .
translation.kha: Bad ka por ka poi haba ngan leh ïa ki bleithaw jong ka Babilonia . Ïa ka ri baroh kawei yn buh ha ka jinglehrain , bad ïa ki briew jong ka baroh yn pynïap .

translation.en: Moses my servant is dead  ; now therefore arise , go over this Jordan , thou , and all this people , unto the land which I do give to them , even to the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U ong ,  U shakri jong nga , u Moses u la ïap . Khreh mynta , ma me bad ki paid Israel baroh , bad jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha ka ri kaba nga ai ha ki .

translation.en: And Samuel grew , and the  Lord  was with him , and did let none of his words fall to the ground .
translation.kha: Katba u Samuel u nang san , U  Trai  u la don ryngkat bad u , bad u pynurlong ïa baroh kaba u Samuel u ong .

translation.en: Now the  Lord  had said unto Abram , Get thee out of thy country , and from thy kindred , and from thy father s house , unto a land that I will shew thee :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Abram ,  Mihnoh na la ka ri , na la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , bad na ka ïing u kpa jong me , bad leit sha ka ri kaba ngan sa pyn-i ha me .

translation.en: Thus I fell down before the  Lord  forty days and forty nights , as I fell down at the first  ; because the  Lord  had said he would destroy you .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la dem khrup ha khmat U  Trai  ha kita ki sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , namar ba u la ong ba un pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: Therefore we are always confident , knowing that , whilst we are at home in the body , we are absent from the Lord :
translation.kha: Kumta ngi long borabor kiba dap da ka jingshlur . Ngi tip ba katba ngi dang don ha kane ka met ngi don jngai na ka ïing ka jong U Trai .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom , neither let the mighty man glory in his might , let not the rich man glory in his riches :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki rangbah bastad kim dei ban kob sarong ïa ka jingstad jong ki , lymne ki rangbah bakhlaiñ ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki , lymne ki rangbah bariewspah ïa ka spah jong ki .

translation.en: The  Lord  our God spake unto us in Horeb , saying , Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount :
translation.kha: U ong ,  Mynba ngi don ha u Lum Sinai , U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ong ha ngi , ‘ Phi la ïashong slem eh ha une u lum .

translation.en: A cubit shall be the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof  ; foursquare shall it be : and two cubits shall be the height thereof : the horns thereof shall be of the same .
translation.kha: Ka dei ban long kaba sawdong , sawphew san sentimitar ka jingjrong , bad sawphew san sentimitar ka pyngkiang bad khyndaiphew sentimitar ka kynjang . Ki reng jong ka ha ki saw tylli ki dong ki dei ban ïadait lang kawei bad ka .

translation.en: The portion of Jacob is not like them  ; for he is the former of all things : and Israel is the rod of his inheritance : the  Lord  of hosts is his name .
translation.kha: U Blei u Jakob um long kum ma ki ; dei tang ma u uba la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad u la jied ïa ki Israel ban long ki briew jong u hi . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers , and to their posts within the gate round about , and likewise to the arches : and windows were round about inward : and upon each post were palm trees .
translation.kha: La don ki jingpong thliew kiba rit ha ki kynroh kiba shabar jong ki kamra baroh , bad ruh ha ki kynroh kiba hapoh hapdeng ki kamra . La ohdur ïa ki dieng Tlai halor ki païa kiba hapoh kiba phai pyrshah ïa ka lynti ïaid .

translation.en: And every man , with whom was found blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats  hair , and red skins of rams , and badgers  skins , brought them .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba don ka jaiñ linen kaba ni ; ne u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh ne uba rong saw ; ne ka jaiñ ba la thain da u shñiuh blang ; ne ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw ; ne ka snieh kaba jlih , u wanrah ïa ki .

translation.en: For God is my witness , whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son , that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers ;
translation.kha: U Blei u long u sakhi jong nga ba kaei kaba nga ong ka long kaba shisha — U Blei ïa uba nga shakri da ka dohnud jong nga baroh da kaba ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khun jong u . U Blei u tip ba nga kynmaw ïa phi man ba nga duwai .

translation.en: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan , from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon  ;
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ngi la ïohknieh na kita ki ar ngut ki syiem Amor ïa ka ri kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan , naduh ka wah Arnon haduh u lum Hermon .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof : and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof , as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ki ban ai ka jingai jingmut kaba pynkulmar . Kaba mih nangta ka long ba ka Ijipt ka leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba bakla bad ka ïaid sheng sheng kum u briew uba buaid uba syntuid ha la ka jong ka prie .

translation.en: And behold joy and gladness , slaying oxen , and killing sheep , eating flesh , and drinking wine : let us eat and drink  ; for to morrow we shall die .
translation.kha: Pynban , phi ïa-rkhie bad phi ïalehkmen . Phi pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi ban bam , bad phi dih waiñ . Phi ong ,  Ngi lah ruh ban ïabam bad ïadih ! Lashai ngin ïap .

translation.en: Then the chief captain took him by the hand , and went with him aside privately , and asked him , What is that thou hast to tell me ?
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la shim ïa u na ka kti , u la ïalam ïa u da lade hi , bad u la kylli ,  Kaei me don ban ïathuh ïa nga ?

translation.en: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man :
translation.kha: Ka jinglong kaba hapoh jong nga ka kmen ha ka hukum U Blei .

translation.en: Which in time past were not a people , but are now the people of God : which had not obtained mercy , but now have obtained mercy .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por phim shym la long ki briew jong U Blei , hynrei mynta phi long ki briew jong u ; ha kawei ka por phim shym la tip ïa ka jinglehisynei U Blei , hynrei mynta phi la ïohpdiang ïa ka jinglehisynei jong u .

translation.en: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem , Arise , and let us flee  ; for we shall not else escape from Absalom : make speed to depart , lest he overtake us suddenly , and bring evil upon us , and smite the city with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh kiba don bad u ha Jerusalem ,  Ngi dei ban ïaphet noh shisyndon lada ngi kwah ban lait na u Absalom ! Pynkloi ! Ïoh ba un poi shen hangne bad jop ïa ngi bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ha ka nongbah !

translation.en: And they brought it . And he saith unto them ,  Whose is this image and superscription ?  And they said unto him , Caesar s .
translation.kha: Ki la wallam ïa kawei ka sbai rupa , bad u la kylli ,  Ka durkhmat bad ka kyrteng jongno kine ?   Ka jong u patsha ,  ki la ong .

translation.en: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were with him , all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , from Mizpah , after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , even mighty men of war , and the women , and the children , and the eunuchs , whom he had brought again from Gibeon :
translation.kha: Nangta u Johanan lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki shipai u la shimti ïa ki briew kiba u Ishmael u la ïalam noh kum ki koidi na Mispah hadien ba u la pynïap ïa u Gedalaïah — ki shipai , ki kynthei , ki khynnah , bad ki ïunukh .

translation.en: To whom the word of the  Lord  came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah , in the thirteenth year of his reign .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha u Jeremaïah ha ka snem kaba khatlai ba u Josaïah u khun jong u Amon u long u syiem ka Judah ,

translation.en: Is not this the fast that I have chosen ? to loose the bands of wickedness , to undo the heavy burdens , and to let the oppressed go free , and that ye break every yoke ?
translation.kha: Ka rukom shah jingit kaba nga kwah ka dei kane : Pynduh noh ïa ki kynjri ka jingbanbeiñ bad ka lyngkor ka jingbymhok , bad ai ba kiba la shah banbeiñ kin ïoh laitluid .

translation.en: Keep therefore and do them  ; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations , which shall hear all these statutes , and say , Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people .
translation.kha: Sumar bad lehhok ïa ki , bad kata hi kan kren ha ki briew jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew haduh katno phi long kiba stad bad kiba shemphang . Haba ki ïohsngew shaphang kine ki aiñ , kin sa ïa-ong , ‘ Haduh katne pleng , kane ka jaitbynriew ka don ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang !’

translation.en: And the king said unto Haman , The silver is given to thee , the people also , to do with them as it seemeth good to thee .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u ,  Ki briew bad ka pisa jong ki , ki long ki jong me ; leh katba me sngewkwah ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , when there was no king in Israel , that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim , who took to him a concubine out of Beth–lehem–judah .
translation.kha: Ha kita ki sngi , ha shuwa ba ki Israel kin don syiem , la don uwei u Lebi uba shong sha jngai bah ha ka ri lum Ephraim . U shim ïa kawei ka kynthei na Bethlehem ha Judah ban long ka tnga kliar jong u ,

translation.en: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches , except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you ? forgive me this wrong .
translation.kha: Kumno la ñiew ba phi kham sniew ban ïa kiwei pat ki balang , lait noh ba ngam shym pynkhuslai ïa phi ban kyrshan pisa ïa nga ? Sngewbha map ïa nga na ka bynta kane ka jingleh bymdei!

translation.en: So Jesus had compassion on them , and touched their eyes : and immediately their eyes received sight , and they followed him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la isynei ïa ki bad u la ktah ïa ki khmat jong ki ; mar kumta hi ki la lah ban ïohi , bad ki la bud ïa u .

translation.en: Therefore being justified by faith , we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Mynta ngi don ka jingïadei bad U Blei lyngba ka jingngeit , ngi don ka jingïasuk bad U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: And he slew it  ; and Moses took the blood , and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger , and purified the altar , and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar , and sanctified it , to make reconciliation upon it .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynïap ïa u , u shim khyndiat ka snam , bad u pyndei ïa ka da la ka shynriah ti ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , khnang ban pynkyntang ïa ka . Nangta u theh ïa ka snam kaba sah baroh ha trai ka duwan . Ha kane ka rukom u pynkyntang ïa ka bad u pynkhuid ïa ka .

translation.en: And the king said , Is there not yet any of the house of Saul , that I may shew the kindness of God unto him ? And Ziba said unto the king , Jonathan hath yet a son , which is lame on his feet .
translation.kha: U syiem u kylli ïa u ,  Don mano mano ba dang sah na ka longïing u Saul ïa uba nga lah ban pyn-i ka jingïaineh bad ka jingbhasbun ïa u , kumba nga la kular ha U Blei ba ngan leh ?  U Siba u jubab ,  Don sa tang uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Jonathan . U dei uba dkoh .

translation.en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked : but giveth right to the poor .
translation.kha: Um shah ïa ki bymman ba kin ïai im , bad u ïai leh ïa kiba duk da ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest , and ye shall afflict your souls : in the ninth day of the month at even , from even unto even , shall ye celebrate your sabbath .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por sep sngi ha ka sngi kaba khyndai haduh ka por sep sngi ha ka sngi kaba shiphew , rakhe ïa ka kum ka sngi shongthait kaba kyrpang . Hapoh kata ka por , phim bit ban bam ei ei ruh em .

translation.en: And if so be that the king s wrath arise , and he say unto thee , Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight ? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall ?
translation.kha: u lah ban bitar bad kylli ïa phi , ‘ Balei ba phi da leit tur shaduh sha jan eh jong ka nongbah ban ïaleh ïa ki ? Phim sngewthuh ba kin siat da ki khnam na ki kynroh ?

translation.en: Saying ,  The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men , and be crucified , and the third day rise again .
translation.kha: ‘ Ïa U Khun U Briew dei ban aiti ha ki briew kiba pop , ba yn sahnarphna , bad hadien lai sngi un mihpat .’

translation.en: When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it , then proclaim peace unto it .
translation.kha: Haba phi leit ïaleh ïa kano kano ka shnong , ailad ïa ki briew jong ka ban pan ïasuk .

translation.en: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots  ; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee , after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule .
translation.kha: U angel u la ai hukum ban iehnoh ïa ka dyngkhong ha ka khyndew . Kane ka mut ba phin sa long syiem pat haba phi pdiang ba U Blei u synshar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign  ; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Athaliah , the daughter of Omri king of Israel .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew ar snem , bad u la synshar shisnem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Athalaïah , ka khun jong u Syiem Ahab bad ka khun ksiew jong u Omri u syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: As long as I am in the world , I am the light of the world .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang don ha ka pyrthei , nga long ka jingshai ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And he lodged there that same night  ; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother  ;
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la sahmiet hangta , U Jakob u jied na ki jingri jong u kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa u Iso u hynmen jong u :

translation.en: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah , and Eshtaol , and Ir–shemesh ,
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Sorah , ka Eshtaol , ka Irshemesh ,

translation.en: And , having made peace through the blood of his cross , by him to reconcile all things unto himself ; by him , I say , whether they be things in earth , or things in heaven .
translation.kha: Da U Khun , te , U Blei u la kut jingmut ban wallam pat ïa ka jingpynlong baroh kawei sha lade hi . U Blei u la pynïasuk da ka jingïap U Khun jong u kum ka jingkñia halor ka diengphna bad kumta u la wallam pat sha lade hi ïa kiei kiei baroh , kiba ha ka pyrthei bad kiba ha bneng .

translation.en: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved , and the cry is heard among the nations .
translation.kha: Haba ka Babilon ka kyllon , kan don ka jingsawa ka ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , bad ïa ki jingïam pynkyndit yn ïohsngew da kiwei ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: For we know in part , and we prophesy in part .
translation.kha: Naba ki jingai jong ngi ha ka jingtip bad ha ki khubor da ka jingpyrsad mynsiem ki long tang katto katne ;

translation.en: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee , the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee : they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar , and I will glorify the house of my glory .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh ki kynhun langbrot jong ka Kedar bad Nebaïoth yn wallam sha pha kum ka jingkñia bad ainguh ha ka duwan ban pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . U  Trai  un pyndonburom ïa ka templ jong u ban ïa kaba ka ju long .

translation.en: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men , all lusty , and all men of valour  ; and there escaped not a man .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki la pynïap kumba shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Moab kiba kynsai tam ; ym don uwei na ki ruh uba lait im .

translation.en: And the high places that were before Jerusalem , which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption , which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians , and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites , and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon , did the king defile .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la ñiewsang ïa ki duwan ba u syiem Solomon u la tei shaphang mihngi ka Jerusalem , shaphang shathie jong u Lum ki Olib , na ka bynta ban mane ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli ― ka Astarte ka blei ki Sidon , u Khemosh u blei ki Moab bad u Molekh u blei ki Ammon .

translation.en: Moreover the law entered , that the offence might abound . But where sin abounded , grace did much more abound :
translation.kha: Ïa ka Hukum la pynmih khnang ban pynbun ïa ka jingleh bymdei ; hynrei haba ka pop ka man bun , ka jingaiei U Blei ka nang kham khraw .

translation.en: His breath kindleth coals , and a flame goeth out of his mouth .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong u ka pynmeh ding ; ki thylliej ding ki mih shabar ka shyntur jong u .

translation.en: Then the king of Israel called an officer , and said , Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah .
translation.kha: Nangta u Ahab u khot ïa uwei u rangbah ha ka ïingbishar , bad u ong ïa u ban leit bad wan ïalam mar mar ïa u Mikaïah .

translation.en: Who is made , not after the law of a carnal commandment , but after the power of an endless life .
translation.kha: U la long u lyngdoh , ym da ki jingbuhbeit ryntih bad jingpynïaid ba kynja briew , hynrei lyngba ka bor jong ka jingim kaba ym don jingkut .

translation.en: And of the Levites , Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God , and over the treasures of the dedicated things .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki para Lebi jong ki , ki peit ïa ka ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ki kamra buh tiar na ka bynta ki jingai sngewbha kiba la pynkyntang sha U Blei .

translation.en: The Jews had light , and gladness , and joy , and honour .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki Jiw , ka don ka jinglehkmen bad ka jingsngewlaitluid , ka jingkmen , ka jingsuk bad ka jingjop .

translation.en: For I was my father s son , tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang long tang u khynnah rit , u khun marwei ki kmie ki kpa jong nga , i pa i ju hikai ïa nga .

translation.en: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery ; ( as I wrote afore in few words ,
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynpaw shai ïa ka jingthmu barieh jong u bad u la pyntip ïa ka ha nga .

translation.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil , and hideth himself  ; but the simple pass on , and are punished .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang kin ïohi ïa ka jingma ba ka wan bad kin kiar na ka , hynrei ki briew ki bym pyrkhat kin ïaid beit ha ka bad kin babe kylla hadien .

translation.en: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away , and believed on Jesus .
translation.kha: Kumta ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ïasylla ban pynïap ïa u Lasaros ruh , namar na kaei kaba la jia ha u , bun ki Jiw ki la kyntait ïa ki bad ki la ngeit ha U Jisu .

translation.en: And when she could not longer hide him , she took for him an ark of bulrushes , and daubed it with slime and with pitch , and put the child therein  ; and she laid it in the flags by the river s brink .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba kam lah shuh ban buhrieh ïa u , ka shim kawei ka shang ba la shna na u khah bad ka lape ïa ka da ka bsiang ban ym pei um . Ka pynthiah ïa uta u khunlung hapoh kata ka shang bad ka buh ïa ka hapdeng ki khah harud jong ka wah .

translation.en: Now the name of the man was Nabal  ; and the name of his wife Abigail : and she was a woman of good understanding , and of a beautiful countenance : but the man was churlish and evil in his doings  ; and he was of the house of Caleb .
translation.kha: La don u briew na ka kur u Kaleb uba kyrteng u Nabal , uba na ka nongrit Maon , bad uba don jaka hajan ka nongrit Karmel . U long u briew uba riewspah , u trai jong ki lai hajar tylli ki langbrot bad shihajar tylli ki blang . Ka tnga jong u ka Abigail ka long kaba bhabriew bad kaba shemphang , hynrei u pat u long uba byrtia , bad u briew uba khong khong . U Nabal u dang ot shñiuh ïa ki langbrot jong u ha Karmel

translation.en: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God , they are the sons of God .
translation.kha: Kito ïa kiba la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei , ki long ki khun U Blei .

translation.en: It shall not seem hard unto thee , when thou sendest him away free from thee  ; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee , in serving thee six years : and the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest .
translation.kha: Wat sngew bynnud haba phi pyllaitluid ïa la u mraw , naba u la pynmyntoi ïa phi ar shah ban ïa u nongbylla sngi haduh hynriew snem . Leh kumta , bad U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha ki kam jong phi baroh .

translation.en: When Ephraim spake trembling , he exalted himself in Israel  ; but when he offended in Baal , he died .
translation.kha: Ha ki por mynshuwa , haba ka jait Ephraim ka la kren , kiwei pat ki jait Israel ki la sheptieng ; ki peit sha u Ephraim . Hynrei ki briew ki la leh pop da kaba mane ïa u Baal , bad na ka bynta kane kin sa ïap .

translation.en: Then the heaven and the earth , and all that is therein , shall sing for Babylon : for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei ha ka pyrthei bad ha suiñbneng kin risa da ka jingkmen ynda ka Babilonia kan kyllon ha ki briew kiba wan na shatei ban pynjot ïa ka .

translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Who then is that faithful and wise steward , whom his lord shall make ruler over his household , to give them their portion of meat in due season ?
translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab ,  Uei , te , uba long u shakri uba ïaineh bad uba stad ? U long uta uba u kynrad jong u un buh ïa u ban khmih , ban pynïaid ïa ka longïing bad ai ha kiwei ki shakri ïa ka bhah jingbam jong ki ha ka por kaba dei .

translation.en: His sons come to honour , and he knoweth it not  ; and they are brought low , but he perceiveth it not of them .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong ngi ki ïoh burom , hynrei ngim ju tip ïa kata , lane ym don ba ïathuh haba ki jahburom .

translation.en: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do , do it with thy might  ; for there is no work , nor device , nor knowledge , nor wisdom , in the grave , whither thou goest .
translation.kha: Trei shitom ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , namar yn ym don kano kano ka jingtrei , ka jingpyrkhat , ka jingtip , ka jingstad ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap — bad kata ka dei sha kaba phi leit .

translation.en: And , lo , it was all grown over with thorns , and nettles had covered the face thereof , and the stone wall thereof was broken down .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba dap da ki bniap shiah bad mih da ki ñiut suda . Ka kynroh maw baroh sawdong ka la twa .

translation.en: But he said unto them ,  Have ye not read what David did , when he was an hungred , and they that were with him  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Phim pat ju pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh ha kata ka por mynba ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan ?

translation.en: Son of man , cause Jerusalem to know her abominations ,
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kdew ïa ka Jerusalem ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ka la leh .

translation.en: I just need some aspirin .
translation.kha: Nga shu donkam katto-katne u aspirin .

translation.en: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful , and hast forgotten God that formed thee .
translation.kha: Ki la klet ïa la U Blei , u nongpynim bakhrawbor jong ki , uta uba la ai ha ki ka jingim .

translation.en: The  Lord  also spake unto Joshua , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua

translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  , a ram without blemish out of the flock , with thy estimation , for a trespass offering , unto the priest :
translation.kha: U dei ruh ban wallam sha u lyngdoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat sha U  Trai  , ïa u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor kan long kat kum ba la buh .

translation.en: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me : for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth  ; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee , nor rebuke thee .
translation.kha: Ha ka por u Noah nga la kular ba ngan ym pynshlei shuh ïa ka pyrthei . Mynta nga kular ba ngan ym bitar shuh ïa pha ; ngan ym mai ne pynshitom ïa pha .

translation.en: Nor of men sought we glory , neither of you , nor yet of others , when we might have been burdensome , as the apostles of Christ .
translation.kha: Ngim shym pyrshang ban ïoh jingïaroh nano nano , la ka long na phi lane na kiwei ,

translation.en: Go , stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad ïeng ha ka Templ , bad ïathuh ha ki briew baroh shaphang kane ka jingim bathymmai .

translation.en: And the sons of Becher  ; Zemira , and Joash , and Eliezer , and Elioenai , and Omri , and Jerimoth , and Abiah , and Anathoth , and Alameth . All these are the sons of Becher .
translation.kha: U Bekher u don khyndai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Semirah , u Joash , u Elieser , u Elioenai , u Omri , u Jeremoth , u Abijah , u Anathoth , bad u Alemeth .

translation.en: Then take the box of oil , and pour it on his head , and say , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have anointed thee king over Israel . Then open the door , and flee , and tarry not .
translation.kha: theh ïa kane ka umphniang Olib ha ka khlieh jong u , bad ong , ‘ U  Trai  u pynbna ba u pynsleh ïa me ban long u syiem ki Israel .’ Hadien kata mihnoh nangta kloi katba lah .

translation.en: They shall lick the dust like a serpent , they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth : they shall be afraid of the  Lord  our God , and shall fear because of thee .
translation.kha: Kin par ha ka khyndew kum ki bseiñ ; kin mih shabar na ki kut jong ki , da ka jingkyiuh bad jingsheptieng . Kin phai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ha ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines , and brake down the wall of Gath , and the wall of Jabneh , and the wall of Ashdod , and built cities about Ashdod , and among the Philistines .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Philistia . U pyntwa ïa ki kynroh jong ki nongbah jong ka Gath , ka Jamnia , bad ka Ashdod ; bad u tei ïa ki shnong ba la ker kynroh hajan ka Ashdod bad ha ki jaka basah jong ki Philistia .

translation.en: I desire to be present with you now , and to change my voice ; for I stand in doubt of you .
translation.kha: Katno nga da kwah eh ban ïadon bad phi mynta , khnang ba nga lah ban sngew da kumwei pat shaphang jong phi . Nga sngewkhuslai shikatdei eh shaphang jong phi!

translation.en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle : but safety is of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban pynkhreh ïa ki kulai na ka bynta ka thma , hynrei dei U  Trai  uba ai ka jingjop .

translation.en: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy , and after vows to make enquiry .
translation.kha: Pyrkhat sani bha ha shuwa ba phin kular ïa ka jingainguh sha U Blei . Phi lah ban babe ïa ka hadien .

translation.en: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way , when ye were come forth out of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Kynmaw aïu ki Amalek ki la leh ïa phi katba phi dang wan na Ijipt .

translation.en: Will you please go there ?
translation.kha: Phim sngewbha leit re shata ?

translation.en: And because he loved thy fathers , therefore he chose their seed after them , and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la jied ïa phi , bad da ka borbah jong u , u hi da lade u la wan ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt .

translation.en: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us , whether prophecy , let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith ;
translation.kha: Kumta ngi dei ban pyndonkam ïa ki jingai bapher bapher kat kum ka jingaiei U Blei ba la ai ha ngi . Lada ka jingai ïa ngi ka long ban kren ïa ka khubor U Blei , ngi dei ban leh ïa kata kat kum ka jingngeit kaba ngi don ;

translation.en: And there was set meat before him to eat : but he said , I will not eat , until I have told mine errand . And he said , Speak on .
translation.kha: Haba la wanrah jingbam , uta u briew u ong ,  Ngan ym pat bam tad ynda nga la dep ïathuh ïa kaei ba nga don ban ong .  U Laban u ong ,  To ïathuh keiñ .

translation.en: The troops of Tema looked , the companies of Sheba waited for them .
translation.kha: Ki paid nongkhaïi na Sheba bad Tema ki ïawad ,

translation.en: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem , who are his witnesses unto the people .
translation.kha: bad bun sngi u la mihpaw ha kito kiba la ïaleit lem bad u na Galilaïa sha Jerusalem . Ki long mynta ki sakhi na ka bynta jong u sha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: So the  Lord  our God delivered into our hands Og also , the king of Bashan , and all his people : and we smote him until none was left to him remaining .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u aiti ïa u Syiem Og bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh ha ka bor jong ngi , bad ngi pynïap lut ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: The lot causeth contentions to cease , and parteth between the mighty .
translation.kha: Lada ar ngut ki briew kiba donbor ki ïa-pyrshah uwei ïa uwei ha ka ïingbishar , kaba kynting sbai kan lah ban ai ïa ka rai .
