translation.en: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in , the more part advised to depart thence also , if by any means they might attain to Phenice , and there to winter  ; which is an haven of Crete , and lieth toward the south west and north west .
translation.kha: Ka kadlieng kam da long kaba bha ban rieh tlang ; kumta kiba bun ki briew ki la kham mon ban pynmih noh ïa ka sha ka duriaw bad ban pyrshang ban poi ha Phoiniki , lada long kaba lah , khnang ban rieh tlang hangta . Ka Phoiniki ka long ka kadlieng ha Krit kaba phai pyrshah shaphang shathie lam sepngi bad shatei lam sepngi .

translation.en: He that hath not given forth upon usury , neither hath taken any increase , that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity , hath executed true judgment between man and man ,
translation.kha: Um ju ai pisa kylliang na ka bynta ban ïohnong . U kyntait ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad u ai ka jingrai kaba beit ha kano kano ka jingïakajia .

translation.en: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people : for I the  Lord  do sanctify him .
translation.kha: ïoh u pyntngit ïa la ki khun hapdeng ki briew jong u . Nga long U  Trai  , uba pynkyntang ïa u .

translation.en: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth , and to the house of Judah as rottenness .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam jingjot halor ki Israel bad ka jingduh halor ki paid Judah .

translation.en: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years , and he begat Enoch :
translation.kha: Haba u Jared u la dap shispah hynriewphew ar snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Enokh ,

translation.en: And Samuel said to Saul , Thou hast done foolishly : thou hast not kept the commandment of the  Lord  thy God , which he commanded thee : for now would the  Lord  have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever .
translation.kha: Kata ka la dei ka jingleh bieit ,  u Samuel u jubab .  Phim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi . Lada phi la kohnguh , un jin da la shah ïa phi bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ban synshar ïa ki Israel junom .

translation.en: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse , and arrayed Mordecai , and brought him on horseback through the street of the city , and proclaimed before him , Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour .
translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u shim ïa ki jaiñphong bad u kulai , bad u pynphong ïa ki jaiñphong ha u Mordekai . U Mordekai u kiew ha u kulai , bad u Haman u ïalam ïa u lyngba ka jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah , da kaba pyrta sha ki briew katba ki nang ïaid :  Peit kumno u syiem un ainong ïa u briew uba u kwah ban pyndonburom !

translation.en: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the  Lord  , but didst fly upon the spoil , and didst evil in the sight of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Balei te , ba phim shym kohnguh ïa u ? Balei phi pynstet ban kynrup ïa ki jinglute , bad leh kumta ïa kaei kaba pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  ?

translation.en: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing , whereby he may be made unclean , or a man of whom he may take uncleanness , whatsoever uncleanness he hath  ;
translation.kha: lane lada u la ktah ïa u mrad ne ïa u briew u bymkhuid , u kylla long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: Let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof : let the fields rejoice , and all that is therein .
translation.kha: Kyrhuh , ko duriaw , bad baroh ki jingthaw ha phi ; to kmen , ko ki madan , bad baroh kiba don ha phi !

translation.en: They are waxen fat , they shine : yea , they overpass the deeds of the wicked : they judge not the cause , the cause of the fatherless , yet they prosper  ; and the right of the needy do they not judge .
translation.kha: balei ba ki sngaid bad ba la ïoh jingbsa bha . Ym don pud satia ïa ki kam sniew jong ki . Kim ju ai ïa ki hok jong ki khunswet lane pyn-i ka jingbishar hok ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ .

translation.en: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites , which dwelt on the other side Jordan  ; and they fought with you : and I gave them into your hand , that ye might possess their land  ; and I destroyed them from before you .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la wallam ïa phi sha ka ri ki Amor , kiba shong ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan . Ki la ïaleh ïa phi , hynrei nga la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki . Phi la knieh ïa ka jaka jong ki , bad nga la pynjot ïa ki katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat .

translation.en: For that they hated knowledge , and did not choose the fear of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Phim ju sngew donkam ïa ka jingtip bad borabor phi kyntait ban kohnguh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: As cold waters to a thirsty soul , so is good news from a far country .
translation.kha: Khatduh eh kaba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor babha na ka ri ba sha jngai ka long kum ka jingdih ïa ka umkhriat haba phi tyrkhong bad phi sliang .

translation.en: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house , neither did he set his heart to this also .
translation.kha: Pynban , u la phai wak bad u leit noh sha la ka ïingsyiem khlem da pynleit jingmut ei ei ruh em shaphang kane .

translation.en: He goeth after her straightway , as an ox goeth to the slaughter , or as a fool to the correction of the stocks  ;
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi u bud ïa ka kum u masi dab sha ka jaka shohdoh , lane kum u  keirang uba ngat sbak ha ka jingriam

translation.en: Who against hope believed in hope , that he might become the father of many nations ; according to that which was spoken , So shall thy seed be .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la ngeit bad u la kyrmen , wat mynba ym shym don ka daw ban kyrmen , bad kumta u la long  U kpa jong ki jaitbynriew babun .  Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Kiba hiarpateng na me kin bun kat ki khlur .

translation.en: And Samuel told all the words of the  Lord  unto the people that asked of him a king .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ïathuh ha kita ki briew kiba pan syiem na u ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha u .

translation.en: And the men said unto Lot , Hast thou here any besides ? son in law , and thy sons , and thy daughters , and whatsoever thou hast in the city , bring them out of this place :
translation.kha: Kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah ki ong ha u Lot ,  Lada me dang don shuh kino kino hangne — ki khun shynrang , ki khun kynthei , ki pyrsa kurim shynrang , ne kino kino ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem kiba shong basah ha kane ka nongbah — ïalam noh ïa ki na kane ka jaka , namar ngin sa pynjot ïa kane ka jaka .

translation.en: And Moses took the tabernacle , and pitched it without the camp , afar off from the camp , and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation . And it came to pass , that every one which sought the  Lord  went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation , which was without the camp .
translation.kha: Man ka por ba ki Israel ki sher dara , u Moses u shim ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang bad u pynïeng ïa ka kham ha pajih na kata ka jaka sher dara . La khot ïa ka , ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad uno uno uba kwah ban ïasyllok bad U  Trai  u ju leit sha ka .

translation.en: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof : and they shall light the lamps thereof , that they may give light over against it .
translation.kha: Thaw hynñiew tylli ki sharak na ka bynta u diengpynïeng sharak , bad buh ïa ki ba kin ai jingshai ïa ka jaka kaba ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the  Lord  , because he cometh to judge the earth .
translation.kha: Ki dieng ha ki khlaw kin pyrta da ka jingkmen haba U  Trai  un wan ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches , and make a prey of thy merchandise : and they shall break down thy walls , and destroy thy pleasant houses : and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong pha kin shim ha lade ïa ka spah bad ki mar khaïi jong pha . Kin pynpra ïa ki kynroh jong pha bad kin pynkhynñiuh ïa ki ïing baremdor jong pha . Kin shim ïa ki maw bad ïa ki dieng bad ïa baroh kaba sah , bad kin pynngam ïa ki ha ka duriaw .

translation.en: They took the young men to grind , and the children fell under the wood .
translation.kha: Ïa ki samla shynrang jong ngi la pynbor ban tylliat kew kum ki mraw ; ki khynnah shynrang ki ïaid sheng sheng hapoh ka jingkit dieng bakhia .

translation.en: For ye suffer fools gladly , seeing ye yourselves are wise .
translation.kha: Phi hi da lade phi long kiba stad bha , bad kumta phi ïaishah da kaba kmen sngewbha ïa ki bieit .

translation.en: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun , at the entering in of the house of the  Lord  , by the chamber of Nathan–melech the chamberlain , which was in the suburbs , and burned the chariots of the sun with fire .
translation.kha: U la weng ruh ïa ki kulai ba ki syiem Judah ki la pynkyntang ha kaba mane ïa ka sngi , bad u thang ïa ki kali ïapom kiba ju pyndonkam ha kane ka jingmane . ( Ïa kine la buh ha phyllaw jong ka Templ hajan ka khyrdop bad ym da jngai na ka jaka sah jong u Nathan Melekh , u rangbah synshar ba-halor . )

translation.en: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , when ye are gathered together , and my spirit , with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: Bad wat la nga long jngai na phi ha ka met , pynban nga don bad phi ha ka mynsiem ; kumba nga ju don bad phi , ha ka kyrteng U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi nga la lah bishar halor uta u briew uba la leh ïa kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan : and Og the king of Bashan went out against them , he , and all his people , to the battle at Edrei .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki la phai bad leit na ka lynti sha Bashan , bad u syiem Og jong ka Bashan u la wan mih bad la ka kynhun ïapom ban tur ïaleh ïa ki ha Edrei .

translation.en: Nevertheless they shall be his servants  ; that they may know my service , and the service of the kingdoms of the countries .
translation.kha: Ka Jerusalem kan ym mad ïa ka jingbitar lep jong nga , hynrei u Shishak un jop ïa ki , bad kin ïoh jinghikai ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng ka jingshakri ïa nga bad ka jingshakri ïa ki nongsynshar pyrthei .

translation.en: And if the household be too little for the lamb , let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls  ; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb .
translation.kha: Lada ka longïing jong u ka don tang khyndiat ngut ki dkhot bad kam lah bam lut ïa uta u jingri , uta u rangbah un ïasam lang ïa uta u jingri bad uba marjan ïing jong u kat kum ka jingdon briew , bad kat kumba uwei uwei u briew u lah ban bam .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah : he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u la long syiem ka Judah mynba u dap laiphew san snem ka rta bad u synshar ha Jerusalem arphew san snem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Asubah , ka khun jong u Shilhi .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the  Lord  had commanded him to speak unto all the people , that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him , saying , Thou shalt surely die .
translation.kha: bad hamar ba nga la pyndep ïa baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban kren , ki la kem ïa nga bad pyrta ,  Me dei ban shah pynïap namar kane !

translation.en: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol s temple , shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols ;
translation.kha: Tharai u briew uba ka jingïatiplem ka tlot ha kane ka bynta u ïohi ïa phi uba don kata kaba khot  ka jingtip  , ba phi shong bam ha ka templ jong ka bleithaw ; hato kane kam pynshlur ïa uta ban bam ïa ka jingbam ba la kñia sha ki bleithaw ?

translation.en: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there , Joab , and Abishai , and Asahel : and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe .
translation.kha: Ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Seruïah ki la don hangta : u Joab , u Abishai , bad u Asahel . U Asahel , uba lah ban mareh stet kum ka skei khlaw ,

translation.en: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints .
translation.kha: Pynban ïa mynta , nga leit sha Jerusalem ha ka jingshakri ïa ki briew jong U Blei hangta .

translation.en: There is none that understandeth , there is none that seeketh after God .
translation.kha: ym don uno uno uba stad lane uba mane ïa U Blei .

translation.en: A time to weep , and a time to laugh  ; a time to mourn , and a time to dance  ;
translation.kha: U buh ka por ban sngewsih bad ka por ban kmen , ka por ban ïam sngewsih bad ka por ban shad ,

translation.en: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ , that , though he was rich , yet for your sakes he became poor , that ye through his poverty might be rich .
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka jingaiei U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ; la u la long uba riewspah , u la pynlong ïa lade uba duk na ka bynta jong phi , khnang ban ïoh pynriewspah ïa phi da kata ka jinglong duk jong u .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah , and tell him , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall burn it with fire :
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha nga ban leit bad ban ong ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ai ïa kane ka nongbah ha u syiem ka Babilonia , bad un thang duh ïa ka .

translation.en: He turned their heart to hate his people , to deal subtilly with his servants .
translation.kha: U la pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ban isih ïa ki briew jong u bad leh shukor ïa ki shakri jong u .

translation.en: And thou shalt say unto them , This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the  Lord   ; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day , for a continual burnt offering .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingainguh bam kiba dei ban wanrah sha U  Trai  : na ka bynta ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi , ar tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth  ; and thy want as an armed man .
translation.kha: hynrei katba phi dang ïohthiah , ka jingduk kan tur ïaleh ïa phi kum u nongtuh uba la kieng atiar .

translation.en: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart , and put away evil from thy flesh : for childhood and youth are vanity .
translation.kha: Wat shah ïa kano kano ban pynkhuslai ïa phi lane pynpang ïa phi . Phin ym neh sah ha ka jinglong samla .

translation.en: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters  ; and they became blood .
translation.kha: U angel uba lai u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ki wah bad ha ki umpohliew , bad ki la kylla snam .

translation.en: But he answered one of them , and said , Friend , I do thee no wrong : didst not thou agree with me for a penny ?
translation.kha: ‘ To shahshkor , ko paralok ,’ u trai u la jubab ha uwei na ki , ‘ ngam shym la shukor ïa phi . Nalor kata baroh , phi la mynjur ban trei ïa ka jingtrei sngi na ka bynta shi sbai rupa .

translation.en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook ? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban khwai ïa u Lebiathan da u khwai dohkha ? ne teh ïa u thylliej jong u da u tyllai ?

translation.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus : and the Syrians became servants to David , and brought gifts . And the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .
translation.kha: Nangta u la pynïeng ki dara sah shipai ha ki ri jong ki , bad ki la kylla long ki raïot jong u bad ki siew khajna sha u . U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban jop kylleng kylleng .

translation.en: Oh that I were as in months past , as in the days when God preserved me  ;
translation.kha: Lada ka jingim jong nga kan jin da la long biang kum ha ka por ba U Blei u dang peit halor jong nga .

translation.en: And his fame went throughout all Syria : and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments , and those which were possessed with devils , and those which were lunatic , and those that had the palsy  ; and he healed them .
translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang jong u ka la phriang kylleng ka ri Syria baroh kawei , ba ki briew ki la wallam ha u ïa baroh kito kiba pang , kiba shahshitom na ki jingpang babun jait , bad kiba pang bhur , bad kiba ïapshiliang — bad U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: For , lo , I raise up the Chaldeans , that bitter and hasty nation , which shall march through the breadth of the land , to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs .
translation.kha: Ngan wanrah ïa ki nong Babilonia ban don ha ka bor , kito kiba triem , ki briew bym lah ban shong khop . Ki leit kylleng ka pyrthei ban jop ïa kiwei ki ri .

translation.en: How are the mighty fallen , and the weapons of war perished !
translation.kha: Ki shipai bashlur ki la kyllon , Ki tiar ïapom jong ki la shu iehnoh khlem pyndonkam shuh .

translation.en: Heshbon , and all her cities that are in the plain  ; Dibon , and Bamoth–baal , and Beth–baal–meon ,
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Heshbon bad ki nongbah baroh ha ka jaka padun : ka Dibon , ka Bamoth Baal , ka Beth Baalmeon ,

translation.en: For John had said unto Herod , It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother s wife .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la ïai-ong ïa u Herod ,  Kam long kaba dei ïa me ban shongkurim ïa ka tnga u para jong me !

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; We have heard a voice of trembling , of fear , and not of peace .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ka jinglynñiar ka jingsngewtriem , ka jinglynñiar ka jingtieng bad ym ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And when he had set the brands on fire , he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines , and burnt up both the shocks , and also the standing corn , with the vineyards and olives .
translation.kha: Nangta u tbeh ding ïa kita ki dongmusa bad u pyllait ïa kita ki myrsiang ha ki lyngkha kew jong ki Philistia . Ha kane ka rukom u thang duh ym tang ïa u kew ba la ot hynrei ïa u kew uba dang ïeng ha lyngkha , bad wat ïa ki brisoh Olib ruh .

translation.en: Your eyes have seen what the  Lord  did because of Baal–peor : for all the men that followed Baal–peor , the  Lord  thy God hath destroyed them from among you .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi da lade aïu U  Trai  u la leh ha u lum Peor . U la pynjot ïa uwei pa uwei uba mane ïa u Baal hangta ,

translation.en: A wise man is strong  ; yea , a man of knowledge increaseth strength .
translation.kha: Ban long stad ka kham bha ban ïa kaba long khlaiñ ; ho-oid , ka jingtip ka kham donkam ban ïa ka jingkhlaiñ .

translation.en: But he shall acknowledge the son of the hated for the firstborn , by giving him a double portion of all that he hath : for he is the beginning of his strength  ; the right of the firstborn is his .
translation.kha: U dei ban ai ar bynta na ka spah ka phew jong u ha la u khun nyngkong , wat la um dei u khun na ka tnga ba u kham ieit . U dei ban ai ha la u khun nyngkong ïa ka hok kaba u dei ban ïoh .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people , even a marvellous work and a wonder : for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish , and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan sa pynkyndit ïa ki da kawei hadien kawei pat ka jingtied kaba kim poi pyrkhat . Kito kiba stad kin kylla long ki bieit , bad baroh ka jingsian jong ki kan long lehnoh-ei .

translation.en: And the priest shall take cedar wood , and hyssop , and scarlet , and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer .
translation.kha: Nangta , un shim katto katne ka dieng Kedar , u tnat Hissop , bad u tyllai uba rong saw bad un bret ïa ki ha ka ding .

translation.en: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites , so shall also the Son of man be to this generation .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ba u Jonah u nongïathuhlypa u la long ka dak ïa ki briew jong ka Ninebeh , kumta U Khun U Briew un long ka dak ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk .

translation.en: And the children of Israel , even the whole congregation , journeyed from Kadesh , and came unto mount Hor .
translation.kha: U paid Israel baroh u la mihnoh na Kadesh bad u la wan poi ha u lum Hor ,

translation.en: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily .
translation.kha: Naba ka jingdap pura jong ka jinglong Blei ka shong tylli ha U Khrist , ha ka jinglongbriew jong u , bad la ai ha phi ïa ka jingim ba-dap pura ha u .

translation.en: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus , and scourged him .
translation.kha: Te u Pilat u la shim ïa U Jisu bad u la phah sympat ïa u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , The people are yet too many  ; bring them down unto the water , and I will try them for thee there : and it shall be , that of whom I say unto thee , This shall go with thee , the same shall go with thee  ; and of whomsoever I say unto thee , This shall not go with thee , the same shall not go .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Gideon ,  Me dang don bun bah ki rangbah . Ïalam ïa ki sha um , bad hangta ngan pynkhlad ïa ki na ka bynta jong me . Lada nga ong ha me ba u briew un leit bad me , un leit . Lada nga ong ha me ba u briew un ym leit bad me , un ym leit .

translation.en: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself : he that believeth not God hath made him a liar  ; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son .
translation.kha: Kumta uno uno uba ngeit ha U Khun U Blei u don ïa kane ka jingphla ha ka dohnud jong u hi ; hynrei uno uno u bymngeit ha U Blei , la pynlong ïa u , uba lamler , namar um shym la ngeit ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang U Khun jong u .

translation.en: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up  ; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction .
translation.kha: Sngap ïa ka sur jong ki jingud jong ki ha ka lynti sha Luhith , ki jingïam jong ka jingshem jynjar ha ka lynti arsut sha Horonaim .

translation.en: Therefore now , O  Lord  , take , I beseech thee , my life from me  ; for it is better for me to die than to live .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  , ai ba ngan ïap noh . Ka kham bha ïa nga ban ïap ban ïa ka ban im .

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Ye shall drink indeed of my cup , and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with : but to sit on my right hand , and on my left , is not mine to give , but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father .
translation.kha: Phin sa dih shisha na ka khuri jong nga ,  U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ,  hynrei ngam don ka hok ban jied ïa uno u ban shong sha liang kamon jong nga bad sha liang kadiang jong nga . Kine ki jaka ki long na ka bynta kito ïa kiba U Kpa jong nga u la pynkhreh .

translation.en: And their dwelling was from Mesha , as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east .
translation.kha: Ka ri ha kaba ki shong ki sah ka ïar naduh Mesha haduh Sephar , kaba don ha ka ri lum kaba shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: Behold , he shall come up and fly as the eagle , and spread his wings over Bozrah : and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs .
translation.kha: U nongshun un tur ïaleh ïa ka Bosrah kum u pukni uba suh wia sha tbian lem bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar . Ha kata ka sngi ki shipai Edom kin sheptieng kum ka briew kaba suh kha .

translation.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest , which stood above the people , and said unto them , Thus saith God , Why transgress ye the commandments of the  Lord  , that ye cannot prosper ? because ye have forsaken the  Lord  , he hath also forsaken you .
translation.kha: Nangta U Mynsiem U Blei u wan ha u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jehoïada u lyngdoh . U la ïeng ha ka jaka ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohi ïa u , bad u pyrta ,  U  Trai  U Blei u kylli balei ba phim shym kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u bad ba phi wallam ka jingpynjot halor lade hi ! Phi la iehnoh ïa u , kumta u la iehnoh ïa phi !

translation.en: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept , until they had no more power to weep .
translation.kha: U Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la sdang ban ïam bad kim sangeh haduh ba ki la thait ïan .

translation.en: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly , and steal away from me  ; and didst not tell me , that I might have sent thee away with mirth , and with songs , with tabret , and with harp ?
translation.kha: Balei me shukor ïa nga bad mih jar jar khlem da ïathuh ïa nga ? Lada me la ïathuh ïa nga , ngan jin da la phah ïa me da ka jingkmen bad da ki jingkyn-ud sur ha ki kanjari bad ki duitara .

translation.en: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods , and provoked to anger the  Lord  God of his fathers .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah bad ka shnong ha Judah , u tei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , ha kaba yn thang ïa ki jingiwbih ha ki blei nongwei . Ha kane ka rukom , u la pynngat ha lade ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u .

translation.en: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue , and cover it with a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put to the staves thereof :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: Teach me , O  Lord  , the way of thy statutes  ; and I shall keep it unto the end .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa nga , A  Trai  , ïa ka jingmut jong ki aiñ jong me , bad ngan kohnguh ïa ki ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt : but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight , saying , Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad .
translation.kha: Nga don ka bor ban pynmynsaw ïa me ; hynrei hynne mynmiet U Blei jong u kpa jong me u la maham ïa nga ba ngan ym byrngem ei ei ïa me .

translation.en: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease .
translation.kha: Mem don jingjynjar , bad wat la katta me rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ; me tied beiñ ïa uta uba la jan hap .

translation.en: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart , which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ki nongsynshar ki ban kohnguh ïa nga , bad kin synshar ïa phi da ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing , whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast , or a carcase of unclean cattle , or the carcase of unclean creeping things , and if it be hidden from him  ; he also shall be unclean , and guilty .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u kum ktah ïa kaei kaei kaba la ñiew bymkhuid , kum ïa ka mrad ba la ïap , u long u bymkhuid bad ba la rem mar ïasngewthuh ïa kaei ba u la leh .

translation.en: So he came near where I stood : and when he came , I was afraid , and fell upon my face : but he said unto me , Understand , O son of man : for at the time of the end shall be the vision .
translation.kha: U Gabriel u la wan bad u la ïeng hajan jong nga , bad nga la sheptieng katta katta ba nga kyllon ha khyndew . U la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to shemphang ïa ka jingmut . Ka jingïohipaw ka ïadei bad ka jingkut jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And they shall go forth , and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me : for their worm shall not die , neither shall their fire be quenched  ; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit phai noh kin ïohi ïa ki metïap jong kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki ksaiñ kiba bam ïa ki kin ym ïap shuh , bad ka ding kaba thang ïa ki kan ym lip noh . Ka jingïohi ïa ki kan long kaba isaitmet ïa u bynriew baroh .

translation.en: Because the spoiler is come upon her , even upon Babylon , and her mighty men are taken , every one of their bows is broken : for the  Lord  God of recompences shall surely requite .
translation.kha: Ki la wan ban pynjot ïa ka Babilon ; ïa ki shipai jong ka la kem , bad ïa ki ryntieh jong ki la kdiah . Nga long U Blei uba pynshitom ïa kaba sniew , bad ngan leh ïa ka Babilon kumba ka dei hok ban ïoh .

translation.en: We have also a more sure word of prophecy  ; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed , as unto a light that shineth in a dark place , until the day dawn , and the day star arise in your hearts :
translation.kha: Kumta ngi la nang sngewskhem shuh shuh ha ka khubor ba la pynbna da ki nongïathuhlypa . Kan bha ba phi shahshkor ïa ka , namar ka long kum ka sharak kaba shai ha ka jaka ba-dum haduh ba kata ka Sngi ka wan bad ka jingshai jong u  lurstep ka tyngshaiñ ha ki dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: How think ye ? if a man have an hundred sheep , and one of them be gone astray , doth he not leave the ninety and nine , and goeth into the mountains , and seeketh that which is gone astray ?
translation.kha: Phi pyrkhat kumno un leh u briew uba don shispah tylli ki langbrot bad kawei na ki ka jah noh ? Un iehnoh ïa kiwei pat ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ban bam phlang ha ki sharing lum bad leit bad wad ïa ka langbrot ba la jah .

translation.en: And the children of Heth answered Abraham , saying unto him ,
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ko rangbah , to shahshkor ïa ngi .

translation.en: And Janum , and Beth–tappuah , and Aphekah ,
translation.kha: ka Janim , ka Beth Tappuah , ka Aphekah ,

translation.en: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands , which are the figures of the true  ; but into heaven itself , now to appear in the presence of God for us :
translation.kha: Namar U Khrist um shym la leit rung shapoh ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam ba la shna da u briew , kaba long tang ka jingpyrthuh bud ïa kata kaba shisha . U la rung shapoh ka bneng hi , ha kaba mynta u mihkhmat na ka bynta jong ngi ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei .

translation.en: The conies are but a feeble folk , yet make they their houses in the rocks  ;
translation.kha: ki phyllad : kim long kiba khlaiñ , hynrei ki shna la ki skum ha ki synrang mawsiang .

translation.en: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises : that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature , having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , u la ai ha ngi ïa ki jingai kiba khraw eh bad ba kordor ïa kiba u la kular , khnang ba lyngba kine ki jingai phi lah ban phet ïap noh na ka jingkwah brai bapynjot kaba don ha ka pyrthei , bad ba ngi lah ban wan ïashim bynta ha ka jinglong ba kynja Blei .

translation.en: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: u la ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba jong ka , ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: And it came to pass , that at midnight the  Lord  smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon  ; and all the firstborn of cattle .
translation.kha: Hamar shiteng synñia U  Trai  u la pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong baroh ha Ijipt , naduh u khun nyngkong jong u Pharaoh , u ban sa kiew khet , haduh u khun nyngkong jong u koidi uba ha ïingbyndi ; ïa baroh kiba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad ruh la pynïap .

translation.en: But ye , beloved , building up yourselves on your most holy faith , praying in the Holy Ghost ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko ki paralok jong nga , to ïai tei ïa lade halor ka jingngeit bakyntang tam . To duwai ha ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,

translation.en: Then laid they their hands on them , and they received the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Te u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la buh ïa la ki kti ha ki , bad ki la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: And after they had held their peace , James answered , saying , Men and brethren , hearken unto me :
translation.kha: Haba ki la dep kren , u Jakob u la ong :  To shahshkor ïa nga , ko hynmen ko para jong nga !

translation.en: And had suffered many things of many physicians , and had spent all that she had , and was nothing bettered , but rather grew worse ,
translation.kha: wat la ka la ïoh jingsumar na kiba bun ki nongsumar . Ka la pynlut ïa ka pisa jong ka baroh , hynrei ha ka jaka ba kan kham ïoh jingkhiah , ka la nang kham shitom .

translation.en: Hear diligently my speech , and let this be your consolations .
translation.kha: Sngap ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; ka dei tang kata ka jingpyntngen ba nga pan na phi .

translation.en: He directeth it under the whole heaven , and his lightning unto the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka leilieh na shiliang sha shiliang ka sahit bneng , na kawei ka tduh jong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .

translation.en: Because the palaces shall be forsaken  ; the multitude of the city shall be left  ; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever , a joy of wild asses , a pasture of flocks  ;
translation.kha: Wat ïa ka ïingsyiem yn iehnoh bad ka nongbah kan long kynjah jar . Ki ïing bad ki jaka ba la tei kut kiba ïada ïa ki kin don hapdeng ka jingjot junom . Ki kada khlaw kin ïashang hangta , bad ki langbrot kin shem ki jaka phlang hangta .

translation.en: They give gifts to all whores : but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers , and hirest them , that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom .
translation.kha: Ïa ka nuti la siew , hynrei pha ai ki jingai sngewbha ïa baroh ki nongleh-ieit jong pha bad pha pynbam tyngka ïa ki ban wan nangno nangno ban ïathiah bad pha .

translation.en: And Leah said , A troop cometh : and she called his name Gad .
translation.kha: Ka Leah ka ong ,  Nga la long kaba donbok  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Gad .

translation.en: Out of his mouth go burning lamps , and sparks of fire leap out .
translation.kha: Ki thylliej ding ki mih na ka shyntur jong u , bad ki phylliah ding ki bsiat shabar .

translation.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold  ;
translation.kha: Man ka snem u syiem Solomon u ïohpdiang kumba arphew lai hajar kilo ka ksiar ,

translation.en: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while : our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary .
translation.kha: Ïa ngi , u paidlang uba khuid jong me , la beh noh shabar da ki nongshun jong ngi katto katne por : ki la ïuhroit ïa ka jaka kyntang jong me .

translation.en: My manner of life from my youth , which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem , know all the Jews  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ki Jiw ki tip kumno nga la im naduh ba nga dang samla . Ki tip kumno nga la pynlut ïa la ka jingim , nyngkong ha la ka shnong bad nangta ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And I sought for a man among them , that should make up the hedge , and stand in the gap before me for the land , that I should not destroy it : but I found none .
translation.kha: Nga wad ïa uno uno uba lah ban tei ïa ka kynroh , uba lah ban ïeng ha ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh ki twa bad ban ïada ïa ka ri haba ka jingbitar jong nga ka la jan ban pynjot ïa ka , hynrei ngam shem ïano ïano ruh .

translation.en: And to him they had regard , because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries .
translation.kha: Ki la pynshahshkor kumne ïa u namar la kham slem u la pynlyngngoh ïa ki da ka jingleh myntor jong u .

translation.en: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains  ; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out  ; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto .
translation.kha: Nangta kito kiba ha Judia ki dei ban phet noh sha ki lum ; kito kiba don ha ka nongbah ki dei ban mihnoh , bad kito kiba don shabar ha ki rudnong kim dei ban leit shapoh ka nongbah .

translation.en: After this manner ye shall offer daily , throughout the seven days , the meat of the sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord  : it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , ainguh ha U  Trai  ïa ka jingainguh bam hynñiew sngi lynter , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . Ainguh ïa kane nalor ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh waiñ kaba man ka sngi .

translation.en: And he called the name of the first , Jemima  ; and the name of the second , Kezia  ; and the name of the third , Keren–happuch .
translation.kha: U la ai kyrteng ïa ka khun nyngkong ka Jemimah , ïa kaba ar ka Kesaïah bad ïa kaba khatduh ka Keren Happukh .

translation.en: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams  horns : and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times , and the priests shall blow with the trumpets .
translation.kha: Hynñiew ngut ki lyngdoh , uwei uwei uba rah ïa ka turoi , kin ïaid ha shuwa ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ma me lem bad ki shipai jong me , men ïaid tawiar hynñiew sien ïa ka nongbah katba ki lyngdoh ki dang put ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there , and reasoning in their hearts ,
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dang shong hangta ki la pyrkhat ha lade ,

translation.en: And also for the innocent blood that he shed : for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood  ; which the  Lord  would not pardon .
translation.kha: bad khamtam namar baroh ki briew balui lui kiba u la pynïap . U  Trai  um lah shuh ban map ïa u Manasseh na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: And upon Kerioth , and upon Bozrah , and upon all the cities of the land of Moab , far or near .
translation.kha: Kerioth , bad Bosrah . Ka jingbishar ka la wan ha ki nongbah baroh jong ka Moab , hajan bad hajngai .

translation.en: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever : for in six days the  Lord  made heaven and earth , and on the seventh day he rested , and was refreshed .
translation.kha: Ka long ka dak kaba neh junom hapdeng jong nga bad ki Israel , ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la thaw ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka pyrthei ha ki hynriew sngi , bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew nga la sangeh ban trei bad shongthait .

translation.en: One man esteemeth one day above another : another esteemeth every day alike . Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew u pyrkhat ba kawei ka sngi ka kham donkam ban ïa kiwei pat ki sngi , katba uwei pat u pyrkhat ba baroh ki sngi ki ïalong kumjuh . Uwei pa uwei u dei ban skhem ha la ka jong ka jingmut .

translation.en: For who is there of all flesh , that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire , as we have , and lived ?
translation.kha: Ju don mo u briew uba dang im hadien ba u la ïohsngew ïa U Blei uba im ba u kren napdeng ka ding ?

translation.en: And no man was able to answer him a word , neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba lah ban ai kano kano ka jubab ïa U Jisu , bad naduh kata ka sngi ym don mano mano ba nud ban kylli jingkylli shuh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And it fell on a day , that Elisha passed to Shunem , where was a great woman  ; and she constrained him to eat bread . And so it was , that as oft as he passed by , he turned in thither to eat bread .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Elisha u leit sha Shunem , ha kaba ka briew kaba riewspah ka shong . Ka la khot bam ïa u , bad naduh kata , ha man ba u leit sha Shunem , u ju bam jingbam ha ïing jong ka .

translation.en: Is it time for you , O ye , to dwell in your ceiled houses , and this house lie waste ?
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , balei ba ma phi phin shong ha ki ïing ba la shna bha katba ka Templ jong nga ka dang sah ha ki jingjot ?

translation.en: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen , clean and white : for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints .
translation.kha: La ai ha ka ïa ka jaiñ linen baphyrnai kaba khuid ban phong .  ( Ka jaiñ linen ka long ki kam babha jong ki briew jong U Blei . )

translation.en: And the waters returned from off the earth continually : and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated .
translation.kha: U slap u la sangeh , bad ka um ka la nang hiar suki suki ha ki shispah sanphew sngi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city , then I will spare all the place for their sakes .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Lada nga shem sanphew ngut kiba hok ha Sodom , ngan pyllait ïa kata ka nongbah baroh kawei na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God , and set a watch against them day and night , because of them .
translation.kha: hynrei ngi duwai ha U Blei jong ngi bad ngi buh ki rangbah ban ap phira bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki mynsngi bad mynmiet .

translation.en: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world , why , as though living in the world , are ye subject to ordinances ,
translation.kha: Phi la ïap bad U Khrist bad la pyllaitluid ïa phi na ki mynsiem kiba synshar ïa ka jingpynlong .

translation.en: And all the people were amazed , and said , Is not this the son of David ?
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la sngewkyndit ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh .  Hato une un dei U Khun jong u Dabid ?  ki la kylli .

translation.en: Take thou also unto thee wheat , and barley , and beans , and lentiles , and millet , and fitches , and put them in one vessel , and make thee bread thereof , according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side , three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof .
translation.kha: Mynta shim khyndiat u kew , u barli , u phresbin , u motor , u krai , bad uwei pat u kynja kew . Khleh lang ïa ki baroh bad shna kpu . Kata ka dei kaba men bam na ka bynta ki laispah khyndaiphew tylli ki sngi ba me thiah pyrshing sha ka krung kadiang .

translation.en: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food , and multiply your seed sown , and increase the fruits of your righteousness ;)
translation.kha: Bad U Blei , uba ai ïa u symbai ban bet bad ïa u kpu ban bam , un pynbiang ïa phi da u symbai baroh ba phi donkam bad un pynlong ïa u ban san bad un pynmih ïa ka jingot kaba khraw na kata ka jinglehsbun jong phi .

translation.en: Now consider how great this man was , unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils .
translation.kha: Te , phi ïohi , katno u la long uba khraw . U Abraham u kpa tymmen ba-donnam jong ngi , u la ai ha u kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na baroh kaba u la ïoh ha ka thma .

translation.en: Who shall also confirm you unto the end , that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: U ruh un batskhem ïa phi haduh kaba kut , khnang ba phin long kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha ka Sngi jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: They shall go down to the bars of the pit , when our rest together is in the dust .
translation.kha: Ka jingkyrmen kan ym ïaid lang bad nga haba ngan hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins .
translation.kha: Uba ieit jong nga u dei u jong nga hi bad nga dei ka jong u ; u pynbamphlang ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u hapdeng ki  tiew lili .

translation.en: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land .
translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang kane ka la saphriang ha kylleng baroh jong kata ka bynta jong ka ri .

translation.en: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering : it is most holy .
translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingkñia namar ki jingleh palat , kiba khuid bha .

translation.en: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king , and his counsellors , and before all the king s mighty princes . And I was strengthened as the hand of the  Lord  my God was upon me , and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me .
translation.kha: Da ka jingaiei U Blei , nga la ïoh ïa ka jinglehsbun jong u patsha , ki nongai jingmut , bad ki nongsynshar bakhrawbor jong u baroh ; U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la ai ïa nga ka jingshlur , bad nga la lah ban pynkohnguh ïa kiba bun ki rangbah kur jong ki Israel ban wan phai bad nga .

translation.en: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel , I am the  Lord  , and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians , and I will rid you out of their bondage , and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm , and with great judgments :
translation.kha: Kumta ïathuh ïa ki Israel ba nga ong ha ki , ‘ Nga long U  Trai  ; ngan pyllait ïa phi bad pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw jong phi ha ki nong Ijipt . Ngan rah ïa ka ksang ti badonbor jong nga ban wallam ka jingpynshitom bashyrkhei halor jong ki , bad ngan pynim ïa phi .

translation.en: We know that God spake unto Moses : as for this fellow , we know not from whence he is .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei u la kren ha u Moses ; katba ïa une u briew , te , ngim tip wat nangno u wan !

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the firstborn said unto the younger , Behold , I lay yesternight with my father : let us make him drink wine this night also  ; and go thou in , and lie with him , that we may preserve seed of our father .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud kata ka khun nyngkong ka ong ha la ka para ,  Hynne mynmiet nga la ïathiah bad i pa ; mynta to ngin pynbuaid biang ïa i ha kane ka miet ruh , bad phi sa leit thiah lang bad i . Te ma ngi baroh ar ngut ngin ïoh khun mar iwei na la u kpa .

translation.en: Yet I am the  Lord  thy God from the land of Egypt , and thou shalt know no god but me : for there is no saviour beside me .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt . Phim don uwei pat U Blei lait na nga . Nga dei tang ma nga u nongpynim jong phi .

translation.en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them , or that the wild beast may break them .
translation.kha: Kam tip ei ei lada ka kjat ka lah ban pynlwet ïa ki ne lada u mradkhlaw u pynpait ïa ki .

translation.en: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon , that have I given unto you , as I said unto Moses .
translation.kha: Kumba nga la ïathuh ha u Moses , nga la ai ha me bad ha ki briew jong nga baroh ïa ka ri baroh kawei kaba phin leit ïuhkjat .

translation.en: And from Jerusalem , and from Idumaea , and from beyond Jordan  ; and they about Tyre and Sidon , a great multitude , when they had heard what great things he did , came unto him .
translation.kha: na Jerusalem , na ka ri Idumia , na ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka Jordan , bad na ka jaka sawdong ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon . Baroh kine ki briew ki la wan sha U Jisu namar ki la lah ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei kiba u la leh .

translation.en: And when the morning arose , then the angels hastened Lot , saying , Arise , take thy wife , and thy two daughters , which are here  ; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab , kita ki angel ki la pynkyrkieh ïa u Lot .  Pynkloi !  ki ong .  Ïalam ïa la ka tnga bad ïa ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong me bad phet noh , ba men ym duh la ka jingim haba yn pynjot ïa kane ka nongbah .

translation.en: Surely I would speak to the Almighty , and I desire to reason with God .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingïasaid jong nga ka long bad U Blei , ym bad me ; Nga kwah ban pyn-i nia ïa ka kam jong nga bad u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Aaron , Behold , I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel  ; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing , and to thy sons , by an ordinance for ever .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron ,  Da kynmaw ba nga la ai ha me ïa ki jingainguh kiba kyrpang kiba la ai ïa nga ki bym dei kiba la thang kum ki jingkñia . Nga la ai ïa ki ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me kum ka bynta ba la ai ha me junom la junom .

translation.en: The same day went Jesus out of the house , and sat by the sea side .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi U Jisu u la mihnoh na ïing bad u la leit sharud ka duriaw , ha kaba u la shong ban hikai .

translation.en: Hearken unto me , O house of Jacob , and all the remnant of the house of Israel , which are borne by me from the belly , which are carried from the womb :
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , phi baroh kiba dang sah na ki briew jong nga . Nga la sumar ïa phi naduh ka por ba dang kha .

translation.en: And , behold , all the women that are left in the king of Judah s house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon s princes , and those women shall say , Thy friends have set thee on , and have prevailed against thee : thy feet are sunk in the mire , and they are turned away back .
translation.kha: Ha ka , nga la ïohi ba ïa baroh ki kynthei kiba dang sah ha ka ïingsyiem ha Judah ba la ïalam ïa ki shabar sha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Ha sngap ïa kaei kaba ki ïakren katba ki dang ïaleit :   ‘ Ki paralok bajan tam u syiem ki la ïalam bakla ïa u , ki la ïaid lait ïa u . Bad mynta ba ki kjat jong u ki la ngam ha ka ktieh , ki paralok jong u ki la iehnoh ïa u .’

translation.en: And David gathered all the people together , and went to Rabbah , and fought against it , and took it .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u la lumlang ïa ki shipai jong u , u leit sha Rabbah , u tur ïaleh ïa ka , bad u la jop ïa ka .

translation.en: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway . And when the man saw that all the people stood still , he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field , and cast a cloth upon him , when he saw that every one that came by him stood still .
translation.kha: Ka met jong u Amasa , ba la tap da ka snam , ka don hapdeng lynti . U briew jong u Joab u la ïohi ba uwei pa uwei u sangeh , kumta u tan ïa ka metïap na ka surok sha ka lyngkha bad u tap ïa ka da ka jaiñ .

translation.en: And , behold , the  Lord  stood above it , and said , I am the  Lord  God of Abraham thy father , and the God of Isaac : the land whereon thou liest , to thee will I give it , and to thy seed  ;
translation.kha: Bad hangta la don U  Trai  uba ïeng hajan jong u .  Nga long U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Abraham bad u Isaak ,  u ong .  Ngan ai ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïa kane ka jaka ha kaba me thiah .

translation.en: But when Israel came up from Egypt , and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea , and came to Kadesh  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba la jia : mynba ki Israel ki mihnoh na Ijipt , ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap haduh ka Khmut Duriaw Akaba , bad ki wan poi ha Kadesh .

translation.en: When the poor and needy seek water , and there is none , and their tongue faileth for thirst , I the  Lord  will hear them , I the God of Israel will not forsake them .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong nga ha ka jingkyrduh jong ki , ki wad um , haba ki pdot jong ki , ki la tyrkhong da ka jingsliang , Te nga , U  Trai  , ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki ; nga , U Blei jong ki Israel , ngan ym iehnoh ïa ki da lei lei .

translation.en: And some of them would have taken him  ; but no man laid hands on him .
translation.kha: Don kiba la kwah ban kem ïa u , hynrei ym don uba ktah kti ïa u .

translation.en: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years .
translation.kha: U Solomon u synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem ïa ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land : which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa ki khun Israel ba kin lah ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka Duriaw Basaw la kum ha ka dewryngkhiang ; haba ki nong Ijipt ki la pyrshang ban leh kumta , ka um ka la tyllep noh ïa ki .

translation.en: All ye , assemble yourselves , and hear  ; which among them hath declared these things ? The  Lord  hath loved him : he will do his pleasure on Babylon , and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: To ïalumlang bad to shahshkor , ma phi baroh ! Ym don na ki blei kiba lah ban ïathuh lypa ba u briew uba nga la jied un tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon ; un leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa u ban leh .

translation.en: Then said I unto them , Ye see the distress that we are in , how Jerusalem lieth waste , and the gates thereof are burned with fire : come , and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem , that we be no more a reproach .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha ki ,  Peit kaei ka jingeh kaba ngi don namar ka Jerusalem ka long hapdeng ka jingjot bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pynjot ! To ngin ïatei pat ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah bad pynkut noh ïa ka jingjahburom jong ngi .

translation.en: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah , and in the forests he built castles and towers .
translation.kha: Ha ki lum jong ka Judah u tei ïa ki nongbah bad ha ki khlaw u tei ki kut bad ki jaka ap phira .

translation.en: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods , nor serve them , nor do after their works : but thou shalt utterly overthrow them , and quite break down their images .
translation.kha: Wat nguh wat dem ha ki blei jong ki , lane mane ïa ki , bad wat bud ïa ki rukom lehniam jong ki . Pynjot ïa ki blei jong ki , bad pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki païa mawkyntang jong ki .

translation.en: He that cometh from above is above all : he that is of the earth is earthly , and speaketh of the earth : he that cometh from heaven is above all .
translation.kha: Uta uba wan na bneng u kham khraw ban ïa baroh . Uta uba wan na ka pyrthei u dei u jong ka pyrthei bad u kren shaphang kiei kiei kiba dei jong ka pyrthei , hynrei uta uba wan na bneng u long halor baroh .

translation.en: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah , the son of Shaphan , had heard out of the book all the words of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: U Mikaïah , u khun jong u Gemaraïah bad u khun ksiew jong u Shaphan , ki la ïohsngew ba u Barukh u la pule na kot kli ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ong .

translation.en: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel :
translation.kha: Ynda u Moses u la dep ai ïa ki jinghikai U Blei ha u paidbah ,

translation.en: And I made treasurers over the treasuries , Shelemiah the priest , and Zadok the scribe , and of the Levites , Pedaiah : and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur , the son of Mattaniah : for they were counted faithful , and their office was to distribute unto their brethren .
translation.kha: Nga buh ïa kine ki rangbah ban khmih ïa ki kamra buh tiar : U Shelemaïah , u lyngdoh ; u Sadok , u riewstad ka Hukum ; bad u Pedaïah , u Lebi . U Hanan , u khun jong u Sakkur bad u ksiew jong u Mattanaïah , u long u nongïarap jong ki . Nga tip nga lah ban shaniah ïa kine ki rangbah ban lehhok ha kaba sam ïa ki mar sha ki para ba-ïatrei lang .

translation.en: Behold , I will send my messenger , and he shall prepare the way before me : and the Lord , whom ye seek , shall suddenly come to his temple , even the messenger of the covenant , whom ye delight in : behold , he shall come , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u jubab ,  Ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien jong nga ban pynkhreh ïa ka lynti na ka bynta jong nga . Te U Trai uba phi ap khmih lynti , un wan kynsan kynsan ha ka Templ jong u . U nonglamktien uba phi sliang ban ïohi un wan bad pynbna ïa ka jutang jong nga .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child , he shall not enter therein .
translation.kha: Nga kren skhem ïa phi ba uno uno u bym pdiang ïa ka Hima U Blei kum u khynnah un ym lah lano lano ruh ban rung hapoh jong ka .

translation.en: And it shall be , if he say unto thee , I will not go away from thee  ; because he loveth thee and thine house , because he is well with thee  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u mraw jong phi um kwah ban mih , bad u ieit ïa phi bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , bad u sngewhun ban sah bad phi ,

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it , because they have hardened their necks , that they might not hear my words .
translation.kha: ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , u la lah ong ,  Ngan wallam ha kane ka nongbah bad ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong ba-marjan ïa ka jingpynshitom baroh kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh , namar phi long kiba mutlop bad phim shym shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga kren .

translation.en: And now ,  Lord  , thou art God , and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :
translation.kha: Ma me , A  Trai  , me long U Blei , bad me pynlong ïa kane ka jingkular baphylla ha nga .

translation.en: And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said unto her , Fear not  ; for thou hast born a son . But she answered not , neither did she regard it .
translation.kha: Hamar ba kan sa ïap , ki kynthei kiba sumar ïa ka ki ong ,  Long shlur ! pha ïoh khun shynrang !  Hynrei kam shym pynleit jingmut bad kam shym jubab .

translation.en: And when Asa heard these words , and the prophecy of Oded the prophet , he took courage , and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin , and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim , and renewed the altar of the  Lord  , that was before the porch of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba u Asa u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïathuhlypa ba u Asaraïah u khun jong u Oded u la kren , u la ïoh mynsiem . U la pynkynriah noh ïa ki bleithaw baroh ha ka ri Judah bad Benjamin bad baroh ki bleithaw ha ki nongbah kiba u la kurup ha ka ri lum Ephraim . U tei pynbha ruh ïa ka duwan U  Trai  kaba ïeng ha phyllaw jong ka templ .

translation.en: The earth mourneth and languisheth : Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down : Sharon is like a wilderness  ; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits .
translation.kha: Ka ri ka sah shrah bad long ri shyiap . Ki khlaw ka Lebanon ki la tyrkhong , ka them baseisoh ka Sharon ka long kum ka ri shyiap , bad ha Bashan bad ha u lum Karmel ki sla ki hap na ki dieng .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they still went on , and talked , that , behold , there appeared a chariot of fire , and horses of fire , and parted them both asunder  ; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven .
translation.kha: Ki ïai ïakren katba ki dang ïaid ; nangta kynsan kynsan ka kali ïapom da ka ding ba la ring da ki kulai ding ka la wan hapdeng jong ki , bad ïa u Elijah la shim noh sha bneng da ka  erlangthari .

translation.en: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me , it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea .
translation.kha: Uno uno u ban pynlong ïa uwei na kine kiba rit ban duh noh ka jingngeit ha nga , ka kham bha ïa uba kum uta u briew ban pynteh da u mawtylliat uba heh ha ka ryndang jong u bad ban pynngam jyllop hapoh ka duriaw bajylliew .

translation.en: If any man serve me , let him follow me  ; and where I am , there shall also my servant be : if any man serve me , him will my Father honour .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kwah ban shakri ïa nga u dei ban bud ïa nga , khnang ba u shakri jong nga un long lem bad nga hangno hangno ba nga don . Bad u Kpa jong nga un pyndonburom ïa uno uno uba shakri ïa nga .

translation.en: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament , that by means of death , for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament , they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance .
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , U Khrist u long uta uba buh ryntih ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai , khnang ba kito ïa kiba la khot da U Blei ki lah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkyrkhu bymjukut kiba U Blei u la kular . Ïa kane lah ban leh namar ka don ka jingïap kaba pyllaitluid ïa ki briew na ki jingbakla kaba ki la leh katba ka jutang kaba nyngkong ka dang treikam .

translation.en: And Jesus , moved with compassion , put forth his hand , and touched him , and saith unto him ,  I will  ; be thou clean .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la dap da ka jingsngewsynei bad u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa u .  Nga mon ,  u la jubab .  To long khuid !

translation.en: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers , to obey magistrates , to be ready to every good work ,
translation.kha: To pynkynmaw ïa la ki briew ban pyndem ha ki nongsynshar bad ki bor synshar , ban kohnguh ïa ki , bad ban long kiba kloi ban leh ïa kaba bha da ki lad baroh .

translation.en: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word  ; and the care of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , choke the word , and he becometh unfruitful .
translation.kha: Ki symbai kiba hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ; hynrei ki jingkhuslai shaphang kane ka jingim bad ka jingieit ïa ka spah ki kjap ïa ka khubor , bad kim pynmih soh .

translation.en: And Moses called unto Joshua , and said unto him in the sight of all Israel , Be strong and of a good courage : for thou must go with this people unto the land which the  Lord  hath sworn unto their fathers to give them  ; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u khot ïa u Joshua , bad hangta ha khmat ki Israel u ong ha u ,  To long uba kut jingmut bad sngewskhem bha , namar me long uta u ban ïalam ïa kine ki briew bad pynïoh kynti ha ki ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
